kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jesũ agĩtwara arutwo ake arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ handũ keheri-inĩ akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũk- wambata tũthiĩ Jerusalemu, na maũndũ mothe marĩa maandĩkirwo nĩ anabii makoniĩ Mũrũ wa Mũndũ no nginya mahingio.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

kikuyu: “Mũtikanahinyĩrĩrie mũtumia wa ndigwa kana mwana wa ngoriai.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

kikuyu: nao arĩa mahũthagĩra indo cia thĩ ĩno, nĩmaikarage ta matohanĩtio nacio. Nĩgũkorwo ũrĩa thĩ ĩno ĩhaana rĩu-rĩ, nĩgũthira ĩrathira.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

kikuyu: mĩri yaguo ĩĩthiororokeirie kĩhumbu kĩa mahiga, na ĩcaragia ha kwĩgwatĩrĩra rwaro-inĩ rwa mahiga.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli othe nĩmandĩkĩtwo maandĩko-inĩ ma njiarwa marĩa maarĩ mbuku-inĩ ya athamaki a Isiraeli. Andũ a Juda nĩmatahĩtwo magatwarwo Babuloni nĩ ũndũ wa kwaga kwĩhokeka.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold,† they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

kikuyu: Juda gwatuĩkire handũ ha Ngai haamũre, na Isiraeli gũgĩtuĩka nĩkuo arĩathanaga.
english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũrũme ndaagĩrĩirwo nĩkũhumbĩra mũtwe wake, kuona atĩ nĩwe mũhianĩre wa Ngai, na nĩ riiri wa Ngai; no mũndũ-wa-nja nĩwe riiri wa mũndũ mũrũme.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

kikuyu: Kahĩĩ kau gataanamenya gwĩtana koige ‘Baba’ kana ‘Maitũ’, ũtonga wa Dameski na indo iria itahĩtwo nĩ Samaria nĩigakuuo nĩ mũthamaki wa Ashuri.”
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

kikuyu: Nitrogen nīcio irio cia bata harī mīkorobia.
english: Nitrogen is the most important nutrient in avocado.

kikuyu: Ūraihu mūkīru wa mīūngūrwa hīndī ya gūthamia.
english: Oversized seedlings at transplant.

kikuyu: na ndegwa igĩrĩ, na ndũrũme ithano, na thenge ithano na tũtũrũme tũtano twa mwaka ũmwe, irutwo irĩ igongona rĩa ũiguano. Ici nĩcio indo iria ciarutirwo nĩ Nethaneli mũrũ wa Zuaru.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: No arĩa othe makũrongoragia marokena na macanjamũke; arĩa mendete ũhonokio waku marotũũra moigaga atĩrĩ, “Ngai arotũgĩrio!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma atumia ao a ndigwa maingĩhe, makĩre mũthanga wa iria-inĩ. Nĩngarehithia mũniinani hĩndĩ ya mĩaraho okĩrĩre manyina ma aanake ao; ngaamarehera ruo rũnene na makorererwo nĩ kĩeha kĩnene o rĩmwe.
english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

kikuyu: nĩguo ageni matikehũũnie na ũtonga wanyu, na kĩrĩa ũnogeire gĩtongie mũciĩ wa mũndũ wa kũngĩ.
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

kikuyu: Ningī ūgiragīrīrio na njīra ya kūiga mītī īrī mīūmū na Kūhūthīra maaī mahiū na dawa ya kūūraga njamuthi mūthemba wa fungi hīndī ya kūharīria mbeū cia kūhanda.
english: It can be prevented by keeping trees dry and treating seeds for propagation with hot water and fungicides.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Abimeleku akĩĩra Isaaka atĩrĩ, “Ũkĩra ũthiĩ, ũtweherere, tondũ nĩũgĩĩte na hinya mũno gũtũkĩra.”
english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

kikuyu: Githĩ tiwe, Wee Ngai, o Wee ũtũregete, na ũgatiga gũtwarana na mbũtũ ciitũ cia ita?
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka buremu ithathatũ cia mwena wa na thuutha, nĩguo mwena wa mũthia wa ithũĩro wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

kikuyu: nĩgeetha mũtobokie makinya manyu thakame-inĩ ya thũ cianyu, o nacio nĩmĩ cia ngui cianyu igĩe na igai rĩacio.”
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

kikuyu: Nyũmba ĩrĩa nini ĩkongerereka ĩtuĩke andũ ngiri, nayo ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ andũ aingĩ ĩtuĩke rũrĩrĩ rũrĩ hinya mũno. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova. Nĩngeeka ũndũ ũcio narua ihinda rĩaguo rĩakinya.”
english: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, Yahweh, will do this quickly in its time.”

kikuyu: Makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ndungata yaku ũcio ithe witũ arĩ o muoyo na ndarĩ na ũũru.” Nao makĩinamĩrĩra mamũhe gĩtĩĩo.
english: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, ũmwe mũnene gũkĩra hekarũ arĩ haha.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mĩaka ĩĩrĩ yathirire-rĩ, Porikio Fesito agĩcooka ithenya rĩa Felike, no tondũ Felike nĩendaga gũkenia Ayahudi, agĩtiga Paũlũ njeera.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

kikuyu: “Nĩgũkorwo niĩ, Jehova, nĩnyendete ciira wa kĩhooto; nĩthũire ũtunyani na waganu. Nĩ ũndũ wa wĩhokeku wakwa-rĩ, nĩngamarĩha irĩhi rĩao, na ndĩĩkanĩre nao kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa gũtũũra nginya tene.
english: “For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

kikuyu: “Ndĩ na maũndũ mangĩ maingĩ ma kũmwĩra, makĩria ya marĩa mũngĩhota kũũmĩrĩria rĩu.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Ayahudi amwe arĩa maathiiaga makĩingataga ngoma thũku makĩgeria kũhũthĩra rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani Jesũ harĩ andũ arĩa maarĩ na ndaimono. Moigaga atĩrĩ, “Thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Jesũ, ũrĩa ũhunjagio nĩ Paũlũ, ndagwatha uume.”
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

kikuyu: Kiugo kĩa Jehova nĩkĩanginyĩrĩire, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Nũũ ũngĩnandũra kĩndũ atĩ nĩguo ndĩmũrĩhe? Kĩndũ gĩothe kĩrĩ rungu rwa igũrũ nĩ gĩakwa.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo akerubi acio, marĩ na magũrũ ma ngaari mĩena-inĩ, magĩtambũrũkia mathagu mao, naguo riiri wa Ngai wa Isiraeli warĩ igũrũ rĩao.
english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

kikuyu: na Jaareshia, na Elija, na Zikiri maarĩ ariũ a Jerohamu.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

kikuyu: Thiiagĩrai njĩra ĩrĩ kũraya nake, mũtigakuhĩrĩrie mũrango wa nyũmba yake,
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

kikuyu: na ndegwa igĩrĩ, na ndũrũme ithano, na thenge ithano na tũtũrũme tũtano twa mwaka ũmwe, irutwo irĩ igongona rĩa ũiguano. Ici nĩcio indo iria ciarutirwo nĩ Elizuru mũrũ wa Shedeuru.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Andũ amwe arĩa maahĩtũkagĩra hau makĩona mwĩrĩ ũgũĩte hau thĩ, na mũrũũthi ũrũgamĩte o hau mwĩrĩ warĩ, nao magĩthiĩ makĩheana ũhoro ũcio itũũra-inĩ inene rĩrĩa mũnabii ũcio mũkũrũ aatũũraga.
english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jesũ aarĩkirie kuuga maũndũ macio, kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩkĩgega nĩ ũndũ wa ũrutani wake,
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

kikuyu: maaī marīa maumaga maithoini ma waru nīmatūmaga tīīrī wīnyitīīrīre nagūo doro īkagia.
english: Fluid exudes from tuber eyes, which results in soil sticking to tuber eyes when crops are harvested.

kikuyu: Indo iria ikuaga mīrīmū marigū-ini harī marigū niyo īkūragio mboco ini
english: Some of the types of pathogens that cause disease in banana are also found in beans.

kikuyu: na ũndũ wa hinya ũrĩa watũmaga kũringwo ciama na kuonwo morirũ, tondũ wa hinya wa Roho Mũtheru. Na nĩ ũndũ wa ũguo kuuma Jerusalemu kũrigiicũka nginya Iluriko, nĩhunjĩtie biũ Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega wa Kristũ.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Amwe moigaga nĩwe Johana Mũbatithania; angĩ makoiga nĩwe Elija; angĩ nao makoiga atĩ mũnabii ũmwe wa arĩa a tene nĩariũkĩte.”
english: They answered, “ ‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

kikuyu: Ngūkū irekagwo ikeyethera irio.
english: Birds are left to scavenge for food freely.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova nĩekĩrĩte roho wa maheeni tũnua-inĩ twa anabii aya aku. Jehova nĩagwathĩrĩirie mwanangĩko.”
english: “Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

kikuyu: tondũmatiataũkĩirwonĩũhorowamĩgate ĩyo; ngoro ciao ciarĩ o nyũmũ.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo gũtũ gũthuuranagia ciugo o ta ũrĩa rũrĩmĩ rũcamaga irio.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

kikuyu: Endaga Jehova Ngai waku na ũmenyagĩrĩre maũndũ marĩa endaga, arĩ kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, na mawatho make, na maathani make hĩndĩ ciothe.
english: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

kikuyu: Mawatho make mothe marĩ mbere yakwa; ndihutatĩire irĩra cia watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

kikuyu: “Kaĩ mũtooĩ ũrĩa niĩ na maithe maitũ twĩkĩte andũ othe a mabũrũri marĩa mangĩ? Nacio ngai cia ndũrĩrĩ icio-rĩ, nĩciakĩhotire o na rĩ kũgitĩra bũrũri wao kuuma moko-inĩ makwa?
english: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

kikuyu: No hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai angĩrora kĩronda kĩa mũthemba ũcio, na gĩkorwo ti kĩrikĩru gũkĩra ngoothi, na hatirĩ njuĩrĩ njirũ thĩinĩ wakĩo, hĩndĩ ĩyo mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakaiga mũndũ ũcio mũrũaru handũ mwanya mĩthenya mũgwanja.
english: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

kikuyu: Hezekia agĩkĩiga athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii na ikundi, o gĩkundi kũringana na wĩra wakĩo, marĩ athĩnjĩri-Ngai kana Alawii, marutage maruta ma njino na ma ũiguano, ningĩ matungatage, na macookagie ngaatho, na mainage nyĩmbo cia ũgooci marĩ ihingo-inĩ cia gĩikaro kĩa Jehova.
english: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of Yahweh’s camp.

kikuyu: Alawii arĩa othe maatarirwo ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa na Harũni kũringana na mbarĩ ciao, hamwe na arũme othe arĩa maakinyĩtie mweri ũmwe na makĩria, maarĩ andũ 22,000.
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

kikuyu: Na hĩndĩ ĩyo Afarisai monganĩte hamwe-rĩ, Jesũ akĩmooria atĩrĩ,
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩhinga matũ ndakaigue kĩrĩro kĩa arĩa athĩĩni-rĩ, o nake agaakaya na ndone wa kũmwĩtĩka.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa matũmaga mũndũ amenywo atĩ nĩ mũtũmwo-rĩ, nĩmekirwo gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu na gũkirĩrĩria kũnene: gũkĩringwo ciama, na gũgĩĩkwo morirũ, na maũndũ ma kuonania hinya.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

kikuyu: Na ningĩ nowe ithe wa andũ arĩa maruaga, arĩa matarĩ atĩ no kũrua maruĩte, no nĩmathiiaga na mũthiĩre wa wĩtĩkio ũrĩa ithe witũ Iburahĩmu aarĩ naguo mbere ya kũrua.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Kwarĩ mũthenya wa Ihaarĩria rĩa Kiumia gĩa Gĩathĩ kĩa Bathaka; na kwarĩ ta thaa thita. Nake Pilato akĩĩra Ayahudi atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ mũthamaki wanyu.”
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour.† He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

kikuyu: Mbeeca nĩ cia bata ũrĩkũ irĩ guoko-inĩ kwa mũndũ mũkĩĩgu, na ndangĩhota kũgũra ũũgĩ, na ndarĩ ngoro ya kwenda gũtaũkĩrwo?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

kikuyu: Akĩrũmĩrĩra Ashitorethu ngai ya nga ya andũ a Sidoni, na Moleku ngai ĩrĩa meneku ya Aamoni.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

kikuyu: Thondeka beji na ūhande nyeki mīthia-inī.
english: Undertake terracing and plant stabilizing grass on the face of the terraces

kikuyu: ningĩ athamaki othe a Zimuri, na Elamu na Media;
english: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

kikuyu: Ithuĩ nĩtũmuonetie wendo witũ kũna no inyuĩ mũtiratuonia wendo wanyu.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

kikuyu: Aya nĩo Alawii arĩa maatarirwo kũringana na mbarĩ ciao: kuuma kũrĩ Gerishoni, nĩ mbarĩ ya Agerishoni; kuuma kũrĩ Kohathu, nĩ mbarĩ ya Akohathu; kuuma kũrĩ Merari, nĩ mbarĩ ya Amerari.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

kikuyu: nake one rũhiũ rwa njora rũgĩũka gũũkĩrĩra bũrũri ũcio, nake ahuhe karumbeta nĩgeetha amenyithie andũ mehũũge-rĩ,
english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

kikuyu: Ihinda rĩa mahaanda-rĩ, Mũthamaki Nebukadinezaru akĩmũtũmanĩra, akĩrehwo Babuloni hamwe na indo cia goro kuuma hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova, nake agĩtua Zedekia, ithe mũnini wa Jehoiakini, mũthamaki wa gũthamaka Juda na Jerusalemu.
english: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Oandũacioothemathikĩrĩirie, Jesũakĩĩraarutwoakeatĩrĩ,
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: Nĩkuoya nguoya gĩkombe kĩa ũhonokio na igũrũ, ngaĩre rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

kikuyu: Mũthenyaũyũwa ũmũthĩnĩngwambĩrĩriagũtũmaandũa ndũrĩrĩciotheiria itũiregũkũthĩ inyiitwo nĩ guoya na kĩmako nĩ ũndũ wanyu. Ciaigua ũhoro wanyu nĩikũinaina na inyiitwo nĩ kĩgirĩko kĩnene nĩ ũndũ wanyu.”
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

kikuyu: Enoku aakinyia mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na ĩtano-rĩ, akĩgĩa na mũriũ wetagwo Methusela.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

kikuyu: ūgunyu mūingī nī utūmaga tīri ūnyihie Magnesium na phosphorus.
english: Excessive watering increases water logging hence deficiencies of Magnesium and Phosphorus.

kikuyu: Nĩaigire ngo na matimũ matũũra-inĩ macio manene, na agĩtũma magĩe hinya mũno. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Juda na Benjamini gũgĩtuĩka gwake.
english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

kikuyu: agitagĩra mahĩndĩ make mothe, gũtirĩ o na rĩmwe rĩngiunĩka.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

kikuyu: “O hĩndĩ ĩyo andũ atatũ arĩa maatũmĩtwo kũrĩ niĩ kuuma Kaisarea magĩkinya nyũmba-inĩ ĩrĩa ndaikaraga.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Ageni a mũhikania mangĩĩhinga kũrĩa irio atĩa rĩrĩa arĩ hamwe nao? Matingĩhinga rĩrĩa rĩothe marĩ hamwe nake.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

kikuyu: Andũ ethĩ na andũ akũrũ o ũndũ ũmwe nĩmacuukĩire o kĩhingo mĩtĩ kũringana na nyũmba ciao.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

kikuyu: Tondũ nĩmwatũmire arĩa athingu morwo nĩ hinya nĩ ũndũ wa kũmaheenia o rĩrĩa niĩ itaamareheire kĩeha, na mũgĩteithĩrĩria arĩa aaganu mage gũtiga njĩra ciao cia waganu nĩguo mahonokie mĩoyo yao,
english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

kikuyu: Balamu akĩĩra mũraika ũcio wa Jehova atĩrĩ, “Nĩnjĩhĩtie. Ndikũũĩ atĩ nĩũkũrũgamĩte njĩra-inĩ ũhingĩrĩirie. Na rĩrĩ, ũngĩkorwo ndũkenete-rĩ, nĩngũhũndũka.”
english: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

kikuyu: Wee nĩũtaraga mĩeri ĩrĩa ciikaraga ingĩgaaciara? Nĩũũĩ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa iciaraga?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

kikuyu: Tũũgĩriai Jehova, inyuĩ mĩhĩrĩga ya ndũrĩrĩ, mũtũũgĩrie Jehova nĩ ũndũ wa riiri na hinya wake,
english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!

kikuyu: Nĩngahũũnia athĩnjĩri-Ngai na bũthi, nao andũ akwa nĩmakaiganwo nĩ ũtugi wakwa,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ rĩrĩa mũkwĩhinga kũrĩa irio-rĩ, tigagai gũtukia mothiũ manyu ta ũrĩa hinga ciĩkaga, nĩgũkorwo nĩitukagia mothiũ macio nĩguo cionie andũ atĩ nĩciĩhingĩte kũrĩa irio. Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, icio nĩirĩkĩtie kwamũkĩra mũcaara wacio wothe.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũmwe Petero na Johana nĩmambatire magĩthiĩ hekarũ-inĩ ihinda rĩa mahooya, na kwarĩ thaa kenda cia mũthenya.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.†

kikuyu: Ingīka atīa nīguo ngīe na mori irī na ūgima mwega wa mwīrī ūtekūhotomia ūciari kana ona umithio wa cio?
english: How do I manage reproductive health in dairy heifers to optimize future fertility and productivity?

kikuyu: Petero akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte mũrĩĩkanĩre mũgerie Roho wa Mwathani? Atĩrĩrĩ, magũrũ ma andũ arĩa maathika mũthuuriguo marĩ mũromo-inĩ, nĩmegũkuumia nja o nawe.”
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

kikuyu: Andũ acio marĩĩtwa mao magwetetwo hau igũrũ nĩo maarĩ atongoria a mbarĩ ciao. Nyũmba ciao nĩciongererekire mũno,
english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, mũndũ o wothe angĩrũmia kiugo gĩakwa, ndarĩ hĩndĩ akona gĩkuũ.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

kikuyu: Kiugo kĩa Jehova nĩkĩanginyĩrĩire, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa akuhĩrĩirie kĩhingo gĩa itũũra rĩu, mũndũ wakuĩte nĩarutagwo kuo na aarĩ mwana wa mũmwe, nake nyina aarĩ mũtumia wa ndigwa. Nao andũ aingĩ a itũũra rĩu maarĩ hamwe nake.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born† son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

kikuyu: “Bũrũri wa Juda nĩũracakaya, namo matũũra makuo makoorwo nĩ hinya; nĩmararĩrĩra bũrũri, nakĩo kĩrĩro nĩkĩambatĩte na igũrũ kiumĩte Jerusalemu.
english: “Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.

kikuyu: Kana mĩgate mũgwanja ĩrĩa yarĩirwo nĩ andũ ngiri inya, na nĩ ciondo ciigana muonganirie?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa atongu na arĩa athĩĩni harĩ ũndũ ũmwe ũmanyiitithanĩtie; Jehova nĩwe Mũmbi wao othe.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.

kikuyu: Aakorwo nĩ mũndũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtandatũ kana makĩrĩa, ũgaatua irĩhi rĩa mũndũ mũrũme rĩtuĩke nĩ cekeri ikũmi na ithano,§ na rĩa mũndũ-wa-nja nĩ cekeri ikũmi.*
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: Thutha wa mīūngūrūa kūhandwo marima-inī nī harī bata wa gūkindīra wega nīguo mīrī īhutanie wega na tīri.
english: Once the seedling is placed inside the hole the area should be firmed so that sufficient contact is made between the seedling and the soil.

kikuyu: Ũhonokio uumaga harĩ Jehova. Irathimo ciaku irotũũra na andũ aku.
english: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Ayahudi na Ayunani arĩa maatũũraga Efeso maamenyire ũhoro ũcio, othe makĩiyũrwo nĩ guoya, narĩo rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani Jesũ rĩgĩtũũgĩrio.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

kikuyu: Nake Ngai akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Oya mũriũ waku, o we ũrĩa wa mũmwe Isaaka, ũrĩa wendete, ũthiĩ rũgongo rwa Moria, na ũmũrute ta igongona rĩa njino kuo kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩmwe kĩa iria ngaakuonia.”
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

kikuyu: Nake akĩndwara ho, na niĩ ngĩona mũndũ, na mũhianĩre wake watariĩ ta gĩcango; nake aarũngiĩ itoonyero- inĩ arĩ na rũrigi rwa gatani, na rũthanju rwa gũthima* guoko-inĩ gwake.
english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩrehe iruta rĩa mũtu, akĩrũma ngundi yaguo, na akĩũcinĩra igũrũ rĩa kĩgongona hamwe na iruta rĩa njino rĩa rũciinĩ.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngaruta andũ arĩa aremi nĩguo mamenye njĩra ciaku, nao ehia magũcookerere.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

kikuyu: Inĩrai Ngai, mũine mũgooce rĩĩtwa rĩake, kumiai ũcio ũhaicaga matu ta mbarathi, rĩĩtwa rĩake nĩ Jehova; gĩcanjamũkei mũrĩ mbere yake.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

kikuyu: Matũũra macio mothe maarĩ mairigĩre na hinya, na thingo ndaaya na igũrũ, na ihingo ciarĩ na mĩgĩĩko, na ningĩ no kwarĩ tũtũũra tũingĩ tũtaarĩ tũirigĩre.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

kikuyu: Angĩigua ũhoro mũũru ndangĩĩtigĩra; ngoro yake nĩĩkindĩire, aikaraga ehokete o Jehova.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo arutwo a Johana magĩũka kũrĩ we makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ na Afarisai nĩtwĩhingaga kũrĩa, no nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmaga arutwo aku mage kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio?”
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũgeragia gũtũũria muoyo wake nĩakoorwo nĩguo, nake ũrĩa wothe ũũragwo nĩ muoyo wake nĩakaũtũũria.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũrĩa mũnabii angĩaria rĩĩtwa-inĩ rĩa Jehova, naguo ũndũ ũcio wage kuoneka kana kũhinga, ĩyo nĩ ndũmĩrĩri ĩtaarĩtio nĩ Jehova. Mũnabii ũcio aarĩtie na mwĩgerero. Mũtikanamwĩtigĩre.
english: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

kikuyu: Ūnini ūyū wa matunda maya nī mwega tondū nī ūkūmahumbīra na neti nīguo kūgirīrīa nyoni kana gūkūrīria thīinī wa greenhouse kūrīa kūrī rīera rīega
english: Their small size also means that you can easily cover them with netting to keep the birds away or grow them in a greenhouse in cooler climates.

kikuyu: Nao atũmwo makĩĩra Mwathani atĩrĩ, “Tuongerere wĩtĩkio!”
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

kikuyu: Ithe wa mũirĩtu angĩrega biũ kũmũheana kũrĩ mũndũ ũcio, no nginya mũndũ ũcio arĩhe rũracio rwa airĩtu gathirange.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

kikuyu: Kaĩ gũtarĩ ndawa kũu Gileadi?† Gũtirĩ mũthondekani kuo? Ironda cia andũ akwa cikĩagĩte kũhona nĩkĩ? 9
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered? 9

kikuyu: Kuona atĩ andũ aingĩ nĩmareraha ta ũrĩa thĩ ĩĩrahaga-rĩ, o na niĩ ngwĩraha o tao.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

kikuyu: ūndū o ta ūcio wa kūgayūkania mīgūnda ūhūthīkaga harīūgwati wa mīmera kūbutha, ūndū ūrīa ūrathiīna mbere gūkorūo ūrīūritū mūno icigo-inīnyingībūrūri-inī.
english: The same principle of crop rotation applies to the risk of bacterial wilt, which is becoming a big challenge in many parts of the country.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe angĩananga hekarũ ya Ngai-rĩ, Ngai nĩakamwananga; nĩgũkorwo hekarũ ya Ngai nĩ theru, na nĩ inyuĩ hekarũ ĩyo.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

kikuyu: “Harũni nĩagacooka atoonye Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwoarute nguo icio cia gatani iria eekĩrire mbere ya gũtoonya Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno, nake acitige kuo.
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

kikuyu: Marigū makūraga wega kūndū kūrī ūrūgarī wa 20°C nginya 30°C na mabataraga mbura īraura wega mwaka-inī wothe.
english: Bananas thrive in temperatures between 20°C and 30°C and require well-distributed rainfall throughout the year.

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka andũ aku, wee Isiraeli maingĩhĩte ta mũthanga wa iria-inĩ-rĩ, no matigari magaacooka kwao. Mwanangĩko naguo nĩwathanĩtwo, mwanangĩko wa kuonania atĩ itua rĩake nĩ rĩa kĩhooto kũna.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

kikuyu: Nake agĩthiĩ kũrĩ Pilato, akĩhooya etĩkĩrio akuue mwĩrĩ wa Jesũ.†
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Ngai agĩciiga wariĩ-inĩ wa matu mairũ itũmage thĩ kũgĩe ũtheri,
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩĩguna nakĩ angĩĩgwatĩra thĩ yothe, no orwo nĩ muoyo wake?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, inyuĩ kũndũ kũrĩa kwanangĩtwo kwa Jerusalemu, ambĩrĩriai kũina nyĩmbo cia gĩkeno, nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩahooreretie andũ ake, na agakũũra Jerusalemu.
english: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for Yahweh has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.

kikuyu: No andũ arĩa maambatĩte nake makiuga atĩrĩ, “Tũtingĩtharĩkĩra andũ acio, marĩ na hinya gũtũkĩra.”
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

kikuyu: “Ningĩ moe gĩtambaya kĩa rangi wa bururu, mahumbĩre mũtĩ ũrĩa wa kũigĩrĩrwo matawa marĩa mamũrĩkaga, hamwe na matawa maguo, na magathĩ ma gũtinia ndaambĩ, na thaani cia mũrarĩ wa ndaambĩ, na ndigithũ cia gwĩkĩrwo maguta ma matawa macio.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa oigĩte Ibuku-inĩ rĩa Hosea, atĩrĩ: “Andũ arĩa matarĩ akwa nĩo ngeeta ‘andũ akwa’; nake mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio ũtarĩ mwende nĩwe ngeeta ‘mwendwa wakwa.’ ”
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”*

kikuyu: Kalebu mũrũ wa Hezironi nĩagĩire ciana na mũtumia wake Azuba (o na ningĩ na Jeriothu). Ariũ a mũtumia ũcio maarĩ: Jesheri, na Shobabu, na Aridoni.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

kikuyu: Makĩhooya mĩhianano yao, ĩrĩa yatuĩkire mũtego kũrĩ o.
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

kikuyu: No mũromo nĩ mũkunderu na njĩra nĩ njeke ĩrĩa ĩkinyaga muoyo-inĩ, na andũ arĩa mamĩonaga nĩ anini.
english: How† narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

kikuyu: Jehova Ngai waku aarĩkia kũmaingata mehere mbere yaku-rĩ, ndũkaneĩĩre atĩrĩ, “Jehova andehete gũkũ ndĩĩgwatĩre bũrũri ũyũ nĩ ũndũ wa ũthingu wakwa.” Aca, ti ũguo, no nĩ tondũ wa waganu wa ndũrĩrĩ icio, nĩkĩo Jehova egũciingata ciehere mbere yaku.
english: Don’t say in your heart, after Yahweh your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land;” because Yahweh drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

kikuyu: wa ikũmi wagũĩrĩire Shemei, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Ũrutani ũrĩa ndutanaga ti wakwa niĩ mwene. Uumaga kũrĩ ũrĩa wandũmire.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũndũ ũcio wa Ngai aarĩkirie kũrĩa na kũnyua-rĩ, mũnabii ũrĩa wamũcooketie na thuutha akĩmũtandĩkĩra ndigiri yake.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

kikuyu: Riria ngūkū īrarekia itumbī, njīra ya ūciari nīyumanaga nanja na nīūndū wa ūgwo, kūngīkorwo kūrī na ūtheri mūingī gītara-inī gītarī gīake wega, ngūkū ingī no imīkanyekanye na gūcūngīrīria gīkūo kia ngūkū īyo.
english: When an egg is laid, there is extraversion of the oviduct with high light intensity and poor nest quality; the protruded oviduct can be pecked by other birds causing death.

kikuyu: nake Amoni aarĩ mũriũ wa Manase, nake Josia aarĩ mũriũ wa Amoni.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩngũmũthaitha mũthiĩ na mbere kũũmĩrĩria, tondũ gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wanyu ũkũũra; tiga marikabu iiki ĩkwanangĩka.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

kikuyu: Ng'ombe cia iria ibataraga cumbī mūnini mūno mūthemba wa common salt kana sodium chloride, ta gramu 28 harī o kilo ikūmi na inya cia iria rīrīa ng'ombe īraruta.
english: Lactating cows need 2 to 4 ounces of salt daily (about 1 ounce of salt per 30 pounds of milk production).

kikuyu: Daudi akĩĩra atongoria a Alawii mathuure ariũ a ithe wao matuĩke aini, nao maine nyĩmbo cia gĩkeno makĩhũũraga inanda cia kĩnũbi, na cia mũgeeto, na thaani iria ihũũrithanagio ikagamba.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa mũgaacagĩra harĩ maũndũ mothe, nĩmo gwĩtĩkia, na ũhoro wa kwaria, na wa ũmenyo, na thĩinĩ wa kĩyo gĩkinyanĩru, o na wa wendo wanyu harĩ ithuĩ-rĩ, kĩingĩhiei wega ũyũ wa gũtugana o naguo.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

kikuyu: na okĩrĩre mĩtarakwa yothe ya Lebanoni, ĩrĩa mĩraihu na igũrũ na ĩkaneneha mũno,* o na mĩgandi yothe ya Bashani,
english: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

kikuyu: No ngũũria atĩrĩ: Matirĩ maigua Ũhoro? Hatirĩ nganja nĩmaiguĩte, tondũ Maandĩko mekuuga atĩrĩ: “Mũgambo wao nĩwahunjire thĩ yothe, nacio ciugo ciao igĩkinya ituri-inĩ ciothe cia thĩ.”
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”*

kikuyu: Nake Filipu akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũcara wa mĩeri ĩnana ndũngĩgũra mĩgate ya kũigana nĩguo o mũndũ arũme kenyũ!”
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii† worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

kikuyu: o we ũcio wagarũrire rwaro rwa ihiga rũgĩtuĩka karia ka maaĩ, narĩo ihiga rĩũmũ rĩgĩtuĩka ithima cia maaĩ.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũhoro ũcio ũgaakinya bũrũri wa Misiri, andũ akuo nĩmakaagĩa na ruo rũnene mũno maigua ũhoro ũcio wa Turo.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

kikuyu: Jehova aathanĩte ũũ: ‘O mũndũ nĩonganie o ĩrĩa ĩkũmũigana. Oyagai o kĩbaba kĩmwe kĩa omeri* kĩa o mũndũ wothe ũrĩ hema-inĩ cianyu.’ ”
english: This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer† a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’ ”

kikuyu: Andũ acio no matungatage handũ-hakwa-harĩa-haamũre, na maikaragie ihingo cia hekarũ o na matungatage thĩinĩ wayo; no mathĩnje nyamũ cia maruta ma njino, na marutagĩre andũ magongona mao, na marũgamage mbere ya andũ makamatungatĩra.
english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

kikuyu: Rĩu-rĩ, ũhoro wĩgiĩ airĩtu nĩ ũyũ: Ndirĩ na watho uumĩte kũrĩ Mwathani, no nĩngũheana itua rĩakwa ta mũndũ mwĩhokeku nĩ ũndũ wa kũiguĩrwo tha nĩ Mwathani.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

kikuyu: “Kũu nĩkuo ngaatũma rũhĩa rwa Daudi rũthundũke na njigĩre ũrĩa njitĩrĩirie maguta tawa ũgwakana.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

kikuyu: “No ariũ a Barizilai wa Gileadi ũmatugage wega, na ũreke matuĩke amwe a arĩa mũrĩrĩĩaga nao metha-inĩ yaku. Nĩo mandũgamĩrĩire rĩrĩa ndooragĩra mũrũ wa thoguo Abisalomu.
english: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

kikuyu: No ha ũhoro wa andũ-a-nja, na ciana, na mahiũ, o na kĩndũ kĩrĩa kĩngĩ gĩothe kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wa itũũra rĩu, no mũcitahe ituĩke cianyu. Na rĩrĩ, no mũhũthĩre indo icio Jehova Ngai wanyu amũheete kuuma kũrĩ thũ cianyu.
english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God has given you.

kikuyu: No ũta wake ndwenyenyekire, moko make marĩ hinya magĩikara merũmĩtie nĩ ũndũ wa guoko kwa Mwene-Hinya wa Jakubu, na nĩ ũndũ wa Mũrĩithi, o we Ihiga rĩa Isiraeli,
english: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

kikuyu: Korwo ndaarĩ na mehia ngoro-inĩ yakwa-rĩ, Mwathani ndangĩanjiguire;
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

kikuyu: Nĩakaigĩrĩra guoko gwake igũrũ rĩa mũtwe wa thenge ĩyo na acooke amĩthĩnjĩre harĩa iruta rĩa njino rĩthĩnjagĩrwo hau mbere ya Jehova. Rĩĩrĩ nĩrĩo iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Misiri gũgaatuĩka bũrũri mũtiganĩrie, ũgakira ihooru. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova. “ ‘Tondũ wee woigire atĩrĩ, “Rũũĩ rwa Nili nĩ rwakwa; nĩ niĩ ndarũthondekire,”
english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh. “ ‘ “Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it,’

kikuyu: nĩguo marũmagie mataaro make, na maathĩkagĩre mawatho make. Goocai Jehova.
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

kikuyu: Igua ihooya rĩakwa, Wee Jehova; thikĩrĩria ikaya rĩakwa ũnjiguĩre tha.
english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Wee mwene wamũũrangia nĩũkũmenya ma ya ũhoro ũyũ wothe tũmũthitangĩire.”
english: §By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

kikuyu: O na rĩrĩ, nĩthuurĩte Oholiabu mũrũ wa Ahisamaku, wa mũhĩrĩga wa Dani, nĩguo ateithagie Bezaleli wĩra. Ningĩ nĩheete mabundi mothe ũũgĩ wa gũthondeka indo ciothe iria ngwathĩte:
english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa mũngĩthuura airĩtu amwe ao matuĩke atumia a aanake anyu, nao airĩtu acio mahũũre ũmaraya na ngai ciao, nĩmakonereria ariũ anyu gwĩka ũguo.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ ũndũ ũkoniĩ Jehoiakimu mũthamaki wa Juda: Ndakagĩa na mũndũ wa gũikarĩra gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene kĩa Daudi; kĩimba gĩake gĩgaateeo, na kĩanĩkĩrwo riũa mũthenya, na kĩhĩe nĩ mbaa ũtukũ.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

kikuyu: No ũrĩa wothe ũkangaana mbere ya andũ, na niĩ nĩngamũkaana mbere ya Baba ũrĩa ũrĩ igũrũ.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa wambatire igũrũ, nĩwatongoririe arĩa maatahĩtwo mũtongoro-inĩ waku; nĩwamũkĩrire iheo kuuma kũrĩ andũ, o na ũgĩciamũkĩra kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa aremi, nĩgeetha Wee, Jehova Ngai, ũtũũre kuo.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

kikuyu: Nao andũ makĩrehera Jesũ twana tũnini nĩguo atũhutie, no arutwo ake makĩmakaania.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

kikuyu: Andũ a Misiri, hamwe na mbarathi ciothe cia Firaũni na ngaari cia ita, na andũ arĩa mathiiaga mahaicĩte mbarathi, na thigari, makĩrũmĩrĩra andũ a Isiraeli na ihenya makĩmakinyĩra harĩa maambĩte hema rũteere-inĩ rwa iria, hakuhĩ na Pi-Hahirothu kũngʼethera Baali-Zefoni.
english: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio, andũ magaacũthĩrĩria Ũrĩa Mũũmbi wao, namo maitho mao marore Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli.
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Ūū kūraringana na wendi wa mūrīmi
english: This totally depends on the farmer’s interest.

kikuyu: (Nowe Sila akĩona arĩ wega aikare kũu.)
“Kaĩ mũrĩ na haaro-ĩ, inyuĩ atongoria atumumu! Muugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ angĩĩhĩta na hekarũ, ũcio ti ũndũ; no mũndũ angĩĩhĩta na thahabu ya hekarũ-rĩ, ũcio nĩekuohwo nĩ mwĩhĩtwa wake.’
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: Rũhiũ rwa njora nĩrũgookĩrĩra bũrũri wa Misiri, naruo ruo rwa ngoro rũkinyĩrĩre Kushi. Rĩrĩa arĩa moragĩtwo makaagũa kũu bũrũri wa Misiri, ũtonga wakuo nĩũgakuuo, nayo mĩthingi yakuo ĩmomorwo.
english: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.

kikuyu: Ingīka atia nīguo ngacīrithie gūciarana kwa ng'ombe rūru-inī rwakwa?
english: How can I optimize reproduction efficiency in my dairy herd?

kikuyu: Jehova arĩ hamwe na niĩ; nĩwe mũndeithia. Nĩngerorera thũ ciakwa ikĩhootwo.
english: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

kikuyu: Ngai wa maithe maitũ nĩariũkirie Jesũ kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ, ũrĩa mworagire na ũndũ wa kũmwamba mũtĩ-igũrũ.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Maambĩrĩirie wĩra wa gũtheria hekarũ mũthenya wa mbere wa mweri wa mbere, na mũthenya wa ĩnana wa mweri ũcio magĩkinya gĩthaku- inĩ kĩa Jehova. Na handũ ha matukũ mangĩ manana-rĩ, magĩtheria hekarũ ya Jehova yo nyene, na makĩrĩkia wĩra ũcio mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtandatũ wa mweri ũcio wa mbere.
english: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to Yahweh’s porch. They sanctified Yahweh’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

kikuyu: na kuuma harĩ icio Jehova akĩrutĩrwo ngʼondu 675;
english: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩatha Joshua ngĩmwĩra atĩrĩ: “Nĩwĩoneire na maitho maku ũrĩa wothe Jehova Ngai wanyu ekĩte athamaki acio eerĩ. Ũguo noguo Jehova ageeka mothamaki marĩa mothe marĩ kũndũ kũu mũrathiĩ.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ndũkanakome na mũndũ mũrũme ta ũrĩa mũndũ akomaga na mũndũ-wa-nja; ũndũ ũcio ũrĩ magigi.
english: “ ‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

kikuyu: “Mũthenya wa kanana wakinya no nginya acirehe kũrĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai hau itoonyero rĩa Hema- ya-Gũtũnganwo nĩgeetha athererio hau mbere ya Jehova.
english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Anga nĩtũraambĩrĩria gũcooka kwĩgaathĩrĩria? Kana hihi nĩtũbataire kũheo marũa ma gũtũ- gaathĩrĩria kũrĩ inyuĩ kana moimĩte kũrĩ inyuĩ ta andũ arĩa angĩ?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũndũ ũcio akĩndwara na njĩra ya kĩhingo kĩa mwena wa gathigathini nginya hau mbere ya hekarũ. Ngĩcũthĩrĩria, ngĩona riiri wa Jehova ũiyũrĩte hekarũ ĩyo ya Jehova, na niĩ ngĩĩgũithia, ngĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ.
english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akiumagaria ariũ a ithe, na magĩthiĩ akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mũtikanegenanie mũrĩ njĩra-inĩ!”
english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo thũ ciakwa ciaragia ũhoro wa kũnjũkĩrĩra; acio metagĩrĩra kũnjũraga nĩmacokanĩtie ndundu.
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

kikuyu: “Naarĩ korwo ciugo ciakwa nĩciandĩkĩtwo, igakĩandĩkwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa gĩkũnjo,
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

kikuyu: makagoocaga Ngai, na magetĩkĩrĩka kũrĩ andũ othe. Nake Mwathani nĩongagĩrĩra thiritũ-inĩ yao andũ arĩa maahonokaga o mũthenya. 3
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

kikuyu: Ngĩcooka ngĩĩra athĩnjĩri-Ngai na andũ acio angĩ othe atĩrĩ: “Ũũ nĩguo Jehova ekuuga: Tigai gũthikĩrĩria anabii acio mamwĩraga atĩrĩ, ‘Hatigairie o kahinda kanini, nacio indo iria ciarutirwo nyũmba ya Jehova icookio kuuma Babuloni.’ Maramũrathĩra ũhoro wa maheeni.
english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Yahweh says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of Yahweh’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

kikuyu: Gũtingĩhoteka atĩ Mũrungu no eeke mahĩtia, atĩ ũrĩa Mwene-Hinya-Wothe no ogomie kĩhooto.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio ũngĩ warũmĩrĩire, nĩgũkorwo mũnene ũcio wa mbũtũ nĩeendaga kũmenya wega kĩrĩa Ayahudi maathitangagĩra Paũlũ, akĩmuohora na agĩathana athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa anene na athuuri othe a Kĩama magomane. Agĩcooka akĩrehe Paũlũ, na akĩmũrũgamia mbere yao.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

kikuyu: Niĩ ndungata yaku njĩka wega, na nĩngũtũũra muoyo; niĩ nĩndĩrĩathĩkagĩra kiugo gĩaku.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ũkũnjĩta mwega nĩkĩ? Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe mwega tiga Ngai we wiki.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

kikuyu: Naguo mũingĩ wothe wa andũ a Isiraeli ũkĩehera harĩ Musa,
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

kikuyu: Nao atumia acio metigĩrĩte mũno, makĩinamĩrĩra, magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ, no arũme acio makĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũracaria ũrĩa ũrĩ muoyo kũrĩ arĩa akuũ nĩkĩ?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

kikuyu: Marotũũra maconokete na marĩ amaku; marokua na gĩconoko kĩnene.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

kikuyu: Nĩakaminjaminja thakame ĩmwe na kĩara gĩake igũrũ rĩakĩo maita mũgwanja, agĩtherie na akĩamũre nĩguo gĩthirwo nĩ thaahu wa andũ a Isiraeli.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: No ĩrĩa ĩtooĩ na nĩĩkaga maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire kũherithanĩrio, ĩkaahũũrwo mahũũra matarĩ maingĩ. Ũrĩa wothe ũheetwo indo nyingĩ, ageetio indo nyingĩ; nake ũrĩa wĩhokeirwo nyingĩ makĩria nĩageetio nyingĩ makĩria.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

kikuyu: Cookereria andũ arĩa manjambagia ũũru wao; Wee maniine nĩ ũndũ wa wĩhokeku waku.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngaherithia bũrũri wa Misiri, nao nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.’ ”
english: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Mahĩtia makwa meekĩrĩtwo mondo-inĩ, ĩkoohwo na ĩkahũũrwo mũhũũri; nĩũkahumbĩra mehia makwa.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

kikuyu: Namo nĩ ta maya: “Ndũkanyiite! Ndũgacame! Ndũkahutie!”
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

kikuyu: (Kuuma Horebu* gũthiĩ Kadeshi-Barinea, kugerera njĩra ya kĩrĩma gĩa Seiru, nĩ rũgendo rwa mĩthenya ikũmi na ũmwe.)
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: na Serugu, na Nahoru, na Tera,
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

kikuyu: Penueli nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Gedori, nake Ezeri nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Husha. Ici nĩcio ciarĩ njiaro cia Huru ũrĩa irigithathi rĩa Efiratha, na ithe wa Bethilehemu.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

kikuyu: O na kũrĩ ũguo-rĩ, aingĩ ao matiigana gũkenia Ngai; nacio ciimba ciao ikĩhurunjwo werũ-inĩ.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

kikuyu: nake Josia aarĩ ithe wa Jekonia na ariũ a ithe, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ maatahirwo, magĩtwarwo Babuloni.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

kikuyu: Nake Jusufu arĩ kũu Misiri, nĩaciarĩirwo Manase na Efiraimu nĩ Asenathu mwarĩ wa Potifera, mũthĩnjĩri-ngai wa Onu.
english: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

kikuyu: ūnyihu wa fibre, mucamo mwega, na unyihu uria munīnī wa mucamo wa turpentine.
english: scarcity of fibre, sweetness and minimum turpentine taste

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ agĩkaya aanĩrĩire, agĩtuĩkana.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa maikaraga megangarĩte manyũrũragia mũtino, makona ta ũndũ ũcio ũkoraga o andũ arĩa magũrũ mao matenderũkaga.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

kikuyu: “Makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathi, githĩ ndarĩ na mina ikũmi!’
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maaiguire ũguo, makĩgooca Ngai. Magĩcooka makĩĩra Paũlũ atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa ithe witũ, nĩwonete ũrĩa Ayahudi ngiri nyingĩ metĩkĩtie, na othe marĩ na kĩyo gĩa kũhingia watho.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩtoonya na thĩinĩ wa handũ-harĩa-haamũre, agĩthima itingĩ cia itoonyero; o kĩmwe kĩarĩ na wariĩ wa mĩkono ĩĩrĩ.† Itoonyero rĩu rĩarĩ na wariĩ wa mĩkono ĩtandatũ, nacio thingo iria ciarĩ o mwena ciarĩ na wariĩ wa mĩkono mũgwanja.‡
english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa na Harũni atĩrĩ:
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: Anene othe, na andũ arĩa maarĩ njamba, hamwe na ariũ a Mũthamaki Daudi othe magĩtĩkĩra Mũthamaki Solomoni amaathage.
english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

kikuyu: Gwíka úú kúgiragíríria waru citigacinuo ní ríua
english: This prevents the exposure of the tubers to sunlight.

kikuyu: na Kesedu, na Hazo, na Pilidashu, na Jidilafu, na Bethueli.”
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

kikuyu: Nĩmagemirie buremu icio na thahabu, na magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ya thahabu ya kũnyiitĩrĩra mĩgamba ĩyo. Magĩcooka makĩgemia mĩgamba ĩyo na thahabu.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Nao Ayahudi magĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Hekarũ ĩno yakirwo na mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna na ĩtandatũ, nawe ũkũmĩaka na mĩthenya ĩtatũ?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, angĩkorwo kĩrĩa ndĩrarĩa no gĩtũme mũrũ kana mwarĩ wa Ithe witũ agwe mehia-inĩ-rĩ, ndikĩagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũrĩa nyama rĩngĩ, nĩguo ndigatũme agwe.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

kikuyu: Mogwati maya meerĩ nĩmo magũkorete; nũũ ũgaagĩkũhooreria? Mogwati macio nĩ mwanangĩko na ũniinani, ningĩ nĩ ngʼaragu o na rũhiũ rwa njora; nũũ ũgaagĩkũhooreria?
english: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you?

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, angĩnyiitwo-rĩ, no nginya arĩhe maita mũgwanja, o na angĩkorwo ekũrĩha na ũtonga wa nyũmba yake wothe.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

kikuyu: Jehova aaranĩirie na inyuĩ ũthiũ kwa ũthiũ arĩ thĩinĩ wa mwaki kĩrĩma igũrũ.
english: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

kikuyu: Taragai ciumia mũgwanja kuuma mwambĩrĩria kũgetha ngano ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ ngethe.
english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

kikuyu: Matũũra macio matandatũ magaatuĩka kũndũ gwa kũũrĩrwo nĩ andũ a Isiraeli, na ageni, o na andũ arĩa angĩ matũũraga thĩinĩ wao, nĩgeetha mũndũ ũraganĩte ataciirĩire gwĩka ũguo ooragĩre kuo.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa Thabatũ, gwatua gũkĩa mũthenya wa mbere wa kiumia, Mariamu Mũmagidali na Mariamu ũcio ũngĩ magĩthiĩ kũrora mbĩrĩra.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

kikuyu: Angĩona atĩ ndangĩhota kũmũtooria, angĩtũmĩra mũthamaki ũcio ũngĩ andũ arĩ o kũraya mathiĩ makamũũrie kũgĩe na thayũ.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

kikuyu: na magĩthondeka itina mĩrongo ĩna cia betha cia gwĩkĩrwo rungu rwacio; o itina igĩrĩ ikanyiitĩrĩra buremu ĩmwe, rungu rwa kahocio kamwe.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Riitho rĩrĩa rĩamuonaga rĩtikamuona rĩngĩ; harĩa aaikaraga hatikamuona rĩngĩ.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

kikuyu: Cimenyererei nginya mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ othe a Isiraeli magaacithĩnja hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

kikuyu: Mũnene ũcio wa mbũtũ akĩnyiita mwanake ũcio guoko, akĩmũtwara keeheri-inĩ, akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ atĩa ũrenda kũnjĩĩra?”
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

kikuyu: Moima Punoni, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Obothu.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: Niĩ ngweterera Jehova, ũrĩa ũhithĩte nyũmba ya Jakubu ũthiũ wake. Ndĩrĩikaraga ndĩmwĩhokete.
english: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

kikuyu: Mũrũ wa nyũkwa ũrĩa mũciaranĩirwo, kana mũrũguo kana mwarĩguo, kana mũtumia waku ũrĩa wendete, kana mũrataguo ũrĩa mumĩranĩtie ngoro nake angĩkũheenereria, akwĩre atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũthiĩ tũkahooe ngai ingĩ” (ngai iria wee kana maithe manyu matooĩ,
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa aaganu nĩakamoirĩria marakara maraakana na ũbiriti ũgwakana; igai rĩao nĩ rũhuho rũrĩa rũcinaga.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

kikuyu: Nakĩo kiugo kĩa Mwathani gĩkĩhunja kũndũ guothe kũu bũrũri-inĩ.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

kikuyu: Joabu akĩmenyithia Daudi mũigana wa andũ arĩa maangĩarũire mbaara ta ũũ: Isiraeli guothe kwarĩ na andũ 1,100,000 arĩa maangĩahotire kũhũthĩra rũhiũ rwa njora, thĩinĩ wao haarĩ na andũ 470,000 kuuma Juda.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũkwenda ndĩmwĩkĩre atĩa?”
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ andũ a kũrũa arĩa meerutĩte gũtungata marĩ ita-inĩ. Magĩũka Hebironi marĩ na ngoro ĩmwe ya gũtua Daudi mũthamaki wa Isiraeli guothe. Andũ a Isiraeli arĩa angĩ othe o nao maarĩ na rĩciiria o rĩmwe rĩa gũtua Daudi mũthamaki.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

kikuyu: Agĩthiĩ na ngaari cia ita 600 iria njega mũno, o hamwe na ngaari cia ita iria ingĩ ciothe cia bũrũri wa Misiri, ciothe irũgamĩrĩirwo nĩ anene.
english: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova ĩkĩnginyĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Maumīrīra ma kūgetha kahūa gatari keeru nī marīkū?
english: What are the consequences of harvesting unripe coffee berries?

kikuyu: mũrũ wa Iziharu, mũrũ wa Kohathu, mũrũ wa Lawi, mũrũ wa Isiraeli;
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

kikuyu: makiugaga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ma! Mwathani nĩariũkĩte na nĩoimĩrĩire Simoni.”
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, thĩ ĩiyũrĩtwo nĩ wendo waku; nduta kĩrĩra kĩa watho waku.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes. TETH

kikuyu: O na tũhĩĩ tũrĩa tũnini nĩtũũnyararĩte, rĩrĩa ndatuumĩrĩra no gũũthekerera tũũthekagĩrĩra.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

kikuyu: Ũkai ciana ciakwa, mũthikĩrĩrie ũrĩa nguuga; nĩngũmũruta gwĩtigĩra Jehova.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nowe Mũthamaki Daudi agĩcookeria Arauna atĩrĩ, “Aca, no nginya ndĩhe thogora wakĩo ũrĩa ũigana. Ndingĩrutĩra Jehova kĩndũ gĩaku, kana ndute igongona rĩa njino na kĩndũ kĩrĩa itarutĩire thogora.”
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩngĩigananio nayo gũkũ thĩ; nĩ kĩũmbe gĩtarĩ guoya.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

kikuyu: Makĩmuoha na mĩnyororo; makĩmũruta kũu, makĩmũtwara kũrĩ Pilato, ũrĩa warĩ barũthi.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩmaiguĩrĩire Musa ũiru marĩ kũu kambĩ-inĩ, o na makĩiguĩra Harũni ũiru, o ũcio wamũrĩirwo Jehova.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.

kikuyu: na nĩwe ũgaatuĩka handũ hanyu harĩa haamũre; no kũrĩ nyũmba cierĩ cia Isiraeli agaatuĩka ihiga rĩrĩa rĩtũmaga andũ mahĩngwo, na rwaro rwa ihiga rũrĩa rũtũmaga magũe. Na kũrĩ andũ arĩa matũũraga Jerusalemu agaatuĩka mũtego na gĩkerenge gĩa kũmanyiita.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩ mũtugi na nĩ mũigua-tha, ndahiũhaga kũrakara, na aiyũrĩtwo nĩ wendo.
english: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũtarĩ na thaahu nĩakaminjaminjĩria mũndũ ũcio ũrĩ na thaahu maaĩ macio mũthenya wa gatatũ na wa mũgwanja, naguo mũthenya wa mũgwanja nĩguo akamũtheria. Nake mũndũ ũcio ũgũtherio no nginya athambie nguo ciake na ethambe mwĩrĩ na maaĩ, naguo hwaĩ-inĩ ũcio nĩagakorwo athirĩtwo nĩ thaahu.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

kikuyu: ti kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ nyingĩ iria ciaragia mwarĩrie ũtooĩ kana rũthiomi rũritũ, kana rũrĩ na ciugo iria ũtangĩmenya. Ti-itherũ, korwo nĩndagũtũmĩte kũrĩ o, nĩmangĩagũthikĩrĩirie.
english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

kikuyu: “Nĩngarahũra Mũmisiri ookĩrĩre Mũmisiri ũrĩa ũngĩ: mũndũ nĩakarũa na mũrũ wa ithe, nake mũndũ wa itũũra ookĩrĩre mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake, narĩo itũũra inene rĩũkĩrĩre itũũra rĩrĩa rĩngĩ, naguo ũthamaki ũũkĩrĩre ũthamaki ũrĩa ũngĩ.
english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, nĩtũkwenda mũmenye ũhoro wa Wega wa Ngai ũrĩa aheanĩte makanitha-inĩ ma Makedonia.
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

kikuyu: Nake akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ikiai wabu mwena wa ũrĩo wa marikabu na nĩmũkũgwatia.” Rĩrĩa meekire ũguo, makĩremwo nĩ kũguucia wabu ũcio nĩ ũrĩa thamaki icio ciarĩ nyingĩ.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩrehe ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro thĩinĩ wa hema ĩyo nyamũre, na agĩĩkĩra gĩtambaya gĩa kũhakania na akĩhakania ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ, “Ũkoretwo ũkĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Tongoria andũ aya,’ no ndũũmenyithĩtie ũrĩa ũkũndũmĩra tũthiĩ nake. Nĩũnjĩrĩte atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩngũũĩ na rĩĩtwa, na wĩ mwĩtĩkĩrĩku harĩ niĩ.’
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

kikuyu: Inyuĩ inyuothe mũrĩ ciana cia ũtheri na ciana cia mũthenya. Ithuĩ tũtirĩ a ũtukũ kana a nduma.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

kikuyu: Wee Mwathani, wendi wakwa wothe ũrĩ o mbere yaku; gũcaaya gwakwa ti kũhitharu harĩwe.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Jesũ aamuonire akĩrĩra, na Ayahudi arĩa mokĩte hamwe nake o nao makĩrĩra-rĩ, agĩcaaya mũno roho-inĩ thĩinĩ na agĩtangĩka ngoro.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jethero, mũthoni-we wa Musa, akĩrehe maruta ma njino na magongona mangĩ ma kũrutĩra Ngai, nake Harũni agĩũka marĩ na athuuri othe a Isiraeli nĩguo marĩĩanĩre irio na mũthoni-we wa Musa, marĩ mbere ya Ngai.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

kikuyu: Gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene gĩkaahaandwo na wendo; na mũndũ mwĩhokeku nĩwe ũgaagĩikarĩra, o mũndũ wa kuuma nyũmba ya Daudi, mũndũ ũrĩa ũgaatuanagĩra ciira arũmĩrĩire o kĩhooto, namo maũndũ ma ũthingu nĩmo akaahiũhaga gwĩka.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

kikuyu: Mĩrũũthi nĩĩraramĩte; nĩĩmũraramĩire. Nĩyanangĩte bũrũri wake; matũũra make macinĩtwo na mwaki, na magatigwo matarĩ mũndũ.
english: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

kikuyu: Agĩkĩhĩtũkĩra mbere ya Musa akĩanagĩrĩra akoiga atĩrĩ, “Jehova, Jehova, Ngai ũrĩa mũcaayanĩri na mũtugi, ũtahiũhaga kũrakara, ũiyũrĩtwo nĩ wendani na wĩhokeku,
english: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

kikuyu: Jehoshafatu akĩinamĩrĩra, agĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ, nao andũ othe a Juda na a Jerusalemu makĩĩgũithia thĩ mbere ya Jehova, makĩmũhooya.
english: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before Yahweh, worshiping Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Ha ũhoro wa andũ arĩa ahakũre arĩa mamenyagĩrĩra thabatũ ciakwa, na magathuura gwĩka maũndũ marĩa mangenagia, na makarũmia kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa-rĩ,
english: For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,

kikuyu: Rĩu-rĩ, wĩhĩte ũrĩ mbere ya Ngai atĩ ndũkanjuukanĩrĩra, kana ũcuukanĩre ciana ciakwa, o na kana njiaro ciakwa. Nyonagia ũtugi niĩ na bũrũri ũyũ we ũtũũraga ũrĩ mũgeni o ta ũrĩa niĩ nguonetie ũtugi.”
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

kikuyu: Nĩnganeana Moabi hamwe na Aamoni moko-inĩ ma andũ a Irathĩro matuĩke indo ciao, nĩgeetha Aamoni acio matikanaririkanwo ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ;
english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa gwatuka, muugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Kaĩ nĩgũkaara-ĩ, tondũ igũrũ nĩ gũtune’.
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

kikuyu: na tondũ nĩnduĩte mawatho maku mothe nĩmagĩrĩire, nĩthũire njĩra o yothe ĩtarĩ ya ma.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

kikuyu: Mũrooria atĩrĩ, ‘Rĩu nyũmba ya mũndũ ũrĩa mũnene ĩkĩrĩ ha, na hema ĩrĩa andũ aaganu maratũũraga-rĩ, ĩkĩrĩ ha?’
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

kikuyu: Maarĩkia kũrĩa makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Sara mũtumia waku-rĩ, arĩ kũ?” Iburahĩmu akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Arĩ kũũrĩa hema thĩinĩ.”
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa ariũ a baba na arata, nguuga atĩrĩ, “Thayũ ũrogĩa thĩinĩ waku.”
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

kikuyu: Ndūgathīje kana kūrīa na kwendia ngūkū ndwarū.
english: Do Not Slaughter and eat the sick birds or Sell the sick birds

kikuyu: Naguo ũhonokio ndũngĩoneka harĩ mũndũ ũngĩ o wothe, nĩ ũndũ gũtirĩ rĩĩtwa rĩngĩ gũkũ thĩ rĩheanĩtwo kũrĩ andũ rĩngĩtũhonokia.”
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

kikuyu: Ariũ a Musa maarĩ: Gerishomu na Eliezeri.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

kikuyu: Rathima ũmenyi wake wa wĩra, Wee Jehova, na ũkenagĩre wĩra wa moko make. Gũtha njohero cia arĩa mekũmũũkĩrĩra; ringa thũ ciake itigacooke kwarahũka rĩngĩ.”
english: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
