english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba mũndũ mwĩthĩ mũthĩĩni no nĩ mũũgĩ, gũkĩra mũthamaki mũkũrũ no nĩ mũkĩĩgu, ũrĩa ũtangĩtaarĩka.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, twamũthaitha mũtĩĩage andũ arĩa marutaga wĩra na kĩyo thĩinĩ wanyu, arĩa matuĩtwo arori anyu na makamũtaaraga thĩinĩ wa Mwathani.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

kikuyu: Nīma nīīhūthagīra. Ikorobia rīega rīkoragwo rīrī na maaī gīcunjī kīa mīrongo mūganja na īthatū.
english: Yes they do. A good avocado fruit consists of 73% water.

kikuyu: Na tondũ kwarĩ Mũthenya wa Kwĩhaarĩria (nĩguo mũthenya ũrĩa wĩ mbere ya Thabatũ), gwakuhĩrĩria hwaĩ-inĩ-rĩ,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

kikuyu: Ũthamaki waku nĩ ũthamaki wa gũtũũra tene na tene, naguo wathani waku ũtũũraga nginya njiarwa ciothe. Jehova nĩ mwĩhokeku harĩ ciĩranĩro ciake ciothe, na nĩendete kĩrĩa gĩothe ombĩte.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.‡

kikuyu: “Irigithathi rĩa nda o yothe nĩ rĩakwa, hamwe na marigithathi mothe ma njamba ma mahiũ manyu, marĩ ma kuuma ndũũru-inĩ cia ngʼombe kana cia mbũri.
english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

kikuyu: Akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩnjĩhĩtie, nĩgũkorwo nĩngunyanĩire thakame ĩtarĩ na mahĩtia.” Nao makĩmũcookeria makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ũcio ũkĩrĩ ũhoro witũ? Ũcio nĩ ũhoro waku.”
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

kikuyu: ū kiharīria tuta wagīrīirwo nigūtigīrīra ndīrī na ria ona hanini
english: • During the seed bed preparation, make sure that the seed bed is free of weeds.

kikuyu: Potassium īngīnyīha harī mūmera nīigiragīrīria mboga gūkūmba wega. ūingi wayo nītumaga kabici yatūke
english: Potassium (K) deficiency can result in marginal necrosis and lower head quality, but its excess can cause the heads to open (NB: Fertilizer application rates is guided by soil and leaf analysis

kikuyu: Nacio irio icio ciagĩrĩire kũigwo irĩ mũthiithũ wa bũrũri, ikaahũthĩrwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ya mĩaka mũgwanja ya ngʼaragu ĩrĩa ĩkaagĩa Misiri, nĩgeetha bũrũri ndũkanathũkio nĩ ngʼaragu ĩyo.”
english: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

kikuyu: Nowe agĩkaana ũhoro ũcio, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Mũirĩtu ũyũ, niĩ ndimũũĩ.”
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

kikuyu: Iria rĩonire ũguo rĩkĩũra, naruo Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani rũgĩcooka na thuutha;
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩ ũhoro wa hitho nene, na nĩ wa bata mũno, na ngiuga ũguo nĩ ũhoro wa Kristũ na kanitha ndĩraria.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩrehe Harũni na ariũ ake hau mbere, akĩmathambia na maaĩ.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

kikuyu: Ũguo nĩguo aathimire handũ hau mĩena ĩyo yothe ĩna. Handũ hau haarigiicĩirio na rũthingo, naruo rwarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono magana matano, na wariĩ wa mĩkono magana matano, rwa kũhakania handũ harĩa hatheru na harĩa hatarĩ haamũre.
english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

kikuyu: Nake agĩcuurũria mwĩrĩ wa Jesũ mũtharaba-inĩ, akĩũkũnja na taama wa gatani, agĩcooka akĩũiga thĩinĩ wa mbĩrĩra yenjetwo rwaro-inĩ rwa ihiga, nayo ndĩakoretwo ĩigĩtwo mũndũ.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

kikuyu: “Rĩu-rĩ, ariũ aku eerĩ arĩa maaciarĩirwo gũkũ Misiri itanooka kũrĩ we-rĩ, megũtuuo ta marĩ akwa; Efiraimu na Manase meegũtuĩka akwa, o ta ũrĩa Rubeni na Simeoni marĩ akwa.
english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

kikuyu: na Geberi mũrũ wa Uri akarũgamĩrĩra Gileadi (bũrũri wa Sihoni mũthamaki wa Aamori, na bũrũri wa Ogu mũthamaki wa Bashani). Nowe wiki warĩ barũthi wa gwatha rũgongo rũu.
english: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.

kikuyu: “ ‘Matandĩko mothe marĩa mũndũ ũcio ũroira angĩikarĩra akuuĩtwo nĩ nyamũ, nĩmakanyiitwo nĩ thaahu,
english: “ ‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Gĩcigo-inĩ kĩu, nĩhakagaywo gĩcigo kĩa mĩena ĩna ĩigananĩte, gĩkorwo kĩrĩ na mĩkono 500‡ o mwena, hatuĩke handũ-harĩa-haamũre, hacooke hathiũrũrũkĩrio nĩ njĩra ya mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano.§
english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits† for its pasture lands all around.

kikuyu: Agĩtũma bũrũri ũcio ũgĩe ngʼaragu, na akĩniina mĩthiithũ yao yothe ya irio;
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩendete ũthingu na ciira wa kĩhooto; thĩ yothe ĩiyũrĩte wendani wake ũrĩa ũtathiraga.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

kikuyu: agĩtaha matũũra manene marĩa maarĩ mairigĩre ma Juda na agĩthiĩ nginya Jerusalemu.
english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ngoro-inĩ yakwa thĩinĩ, nĩngenagĩra watho wa Ngai;
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

kikuyu: Akĩgarũra mbura yao ĩgĩtuĩka ya mbembe, na heni ikĩhenũka bũrũri-inĩ wao wothe;
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, matukũ-inĩ macio Petero akĩrũgama gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ arĩa meetĩkĩtie (gĩkundi kĩa andũ ta igana rĩa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ),
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

kikuyu: nĩguo ũkaahingio rĩrĩa mahinda marĩa magĩrĩire magaakinya, nĩguo acookanĩrĩrie indo ciothe iria irĩ igũrũ na iria irĩ gũkũ thĩ harĩ mũtongoria ũmwe, na nĩwe Kristũ.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

kikuyu: we wiki nĩwe wĩkaga maũndũ manene ma magegania, Wendo wake nĩ wa tene na tene.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Harĩ ariũ ake othe arĩa aaciarire, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe ũngĩmũtongoria; o na ningĩ ariũ ake othe arĩa aarerire-rĩ, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe ũngĩmũnyiita guoko.
english: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.

kikuyu: Gĩcigo kĩa mũigana wa ũraihu wa mĩkono 25,000, na wariĩ wa 10,000 gĩgaatuĩka kĩa Alawii, arĩa matungataga thĩinĩ wa hekarũ, gĩtuĩke igai rĩao rĩa gwakwo matũũra ma gũtũũrwo.
english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Ĩĩ, njamba cia ita nĩigatunywo andũ arĩa ciohete mĩgwate, na indo iria itahĩtwo itunyanwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa karaũ; nĩngahũũrana na andũ arĩa mahũũranaga nawe, na nĩngahonokia ciana cianyu.
english: But Yahweh says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.

kikuyu: Ndeithũra kuuma kũrĩ thũ ciakwa, Wee Jehova, nĩgũkorwo ndĩĩhithaga harĩwe.
english: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

kikuyu: Rīonūrwo rīkoragwo na rangi mūnini wa ngirini ūrīa ūcenjagia ūgatuīka wa yellow mwena wa kūnyitana na mbegū.
english: The flesh closest to the skin is a lime green color and as it nears the central pit it develops a rich creamy yellow tone;

kikuyu: Nake Beni-Geberi akarũgamĩrĩra Ramothu-Gileadi (itũũro cia Jairu mũrũ wa Manase kũu Gileadi ciarĩ ciake, o hamwe na ngʼongo cia Arigobu kũu Bashani, o na matũũra manene makuo mĩrongo ĩtandatũ maarigiicĩirio na thingo, na maarĩ na ihingo ciarĩ na mĩgĩĩko ya gĩcango);
english: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);

kikuyu: Isiraeli agĩtunya Aamori matũũra mothe mao marĩa manene na magĩtũũra kuo, o hamwe na Heshiboni na tũtũũra tuothe tũrĩa twarigainie nakuo.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, mĩtunyei taranda ĩyo, mũmĩnengere ũrĩa ũrĩ na taranda ikũmi.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

kikuyu: Endai Jehova inyuĩ andũ ake aamũre! Jehova nĩamenyagĩrĩra arĩa ehokeku, no ũrĩa mwĩtĩĩi amũrĩhaga o ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
english: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

kikuyu: Mũtikanaage kũmenyerera maathani ma Jehova Ngai wanyu, na irĩkanĩro, na kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, marĩa akũheete ũrũmagĩrĩre.
english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

kikuyu: Buata mútaratara wa kúhúra dawa íno kuma kúrí abithaa a úrímí
english: An agricultural expert should advise on the best application procedure.

kikuyu: “Nĩmagakua gĩkuũ kiumanĩte na mĩrimũ mĩũru. Matigaacakaĩrwo kana mathikwo, no magaatuĩka ta rũrua rũharaganĩtio gũkũ thĩ. Makaaniinwo na rũhiũ rwa njora na ngʼaragu, nacio ciimba ciao igatuĩka, irio cia nyoni cia rĩera-inĩ na nyamũ cia gĩthaka.”
english: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

kikuyu: Itambaya icio ciothe ikũmi na kĩmwe ikorwo ciiganaine, ikorwo irĩ mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtatũ‡ kũraiha na mĩkono ĩna§ kwarama.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Wee Jehova, njiguĩra tha; njarahũra, nĩguo ndĩĩrĩhĩrie harĩo.
english: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

kikuyu: “Nake Manase aheo gĩcigo kĩmwe; nakĩo gĩkaahakana na rũgongo rwa Nafitali kuuma mwena wa irathĩro nginya mwena wa ithũĩro.
english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

kikuyu: “ ‘No rĩrĩ, athĩnjĩri-Ngai, acio marĩ Alawii na a rũciaro rwa Zadoku, o acio maarutire mawĩra ma handũ-hakwa-harĩa-haamũre na wĩhokeku rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli meeherire makiuma harĩ niĩ, nĩo marĩnguhagĩrĩria makandungatĩra; marĩrũgamaga mbere yakwa makaruta magongona ma maguta na ma thakame, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: “ ‘ “But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũnyamaragia mũciĩ wake akaagaya o rũhuho, nake mũndũ mũkĩĩgu agaatuĩka ndungata ya ũrĩa mũũgĩ.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa rĩothe marĩ na ũndũ matekũiguanĩra, ũrehagwo kũrĩ niĩ, na niĩ ngamatuithania na ngamamenyithia uuge wa Ngai na mawatho make.”
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

kikuyu: Nake Daudi agĩkuhĩrĩria, na rĩrĩa Arauna aarorire akĩmuona, akiuma kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano, akĩinamĩrĩria mũtwe wake mbere ya Daudi, na agĩturumithia ũthiũ thĩ.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: Nĩngũtiira maitho makwa ndore irĩma-inĩ: ũteithio wakwa ũngiuma na kũ?
english: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

kikuyu: No arĩa othe maamũũĩ, o hamwe na atumia arĩa maamũrũmĩrĩire kuuma Galili, makĩrũgama o haraaya, meroreire maũndũ macio.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

kikuyu: Jesũ nĩaringire ciama ingĩ nyingĩ akĩonagwo nĩ arutwo ake, iria itaandĩkĩtwo Ibuku-inĩ rĩĩrĩ.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

kikuyu: “Nake Asheri aheo gĩcigo kĩmwe; nakĩo gĩkaahakana na rũgongo rwa Dani kuuma mwena wa irathĩro nginya mwena wa ithũĩro.
english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

kikuyu: Ingihota atīa gūthaitīra mūrimu ūyū wa Alternaria leaf?
english: How do I control alternaria leaf spot?

kikuyu: Hezekia aarĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtano rĩrĩa aatuĩkire mũthamaki, nake agĩthamaka arĩ Jerusalemu mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na kenda. Nyina eetagwo Abija mwarĩ wa Zekaria.
english: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩ watho wa Jehova akenagĩra, na agecũũranagia ũhoro wa watho wake kũrĩ mũthenya kana ũtukũ.
english: but his delight is in Yahweh’s† law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kikuyu: Na rĩu, mũtigathĩĩnĩke kana mwĩrakarĩre nĩkũnyendia gũkũ, tondũ nĩ Ngai wandũmire njũke mbere yanyu nĩgeetha honokie mĩoyo.
english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

kikuyu: na akĩrekereria ihuru na nja, narĩo rĩgĩtũũra rĩũmbũkaga kũndũ na kũndũ o nginya rĩrĩa maaĩ maahũire thĩ.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo mũrĩ andũ ehokeku, ĩtĩkĩrai ũmwe wanyu aikare gũkũ njeera, na inyuĩ arĩa angĩ mũthiĩ mũtwarĩre andũ anyu ngano nĩ ũndũ wa ngʼaragu ĩrĩa marĩ nayo.
english: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

kikuyu: no gũtũũra muoyo ndĩ na mwĩrĩ ũyũ nĩ ũndũ wanyu nĩ kwagĩrĩire mũno makĩria.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

kikuyu: Solomoni ndaathimire indo icio tondũ ciarĩ nyingĩ mũno; ũritũ wa gĩcango ndwamenyekanire ũrĩa waiganaga.
english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

kikuyu: Akĩĩra Jakubu atĩrĩ, “Ta he gĩtoero kĩu ũraruga! Ndĩ mũhũtu mũno!” (Nĩkĩo gĩatũmire acooke gwĩtwo Edomu.)
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.†

kikuyu: Maroro maniaru na mairū methondekaga ngothi-inī ya makorobia na magakūra na mūhianīre ūtarīmwega.
english: Dry spots, dark brown in color, form on the skin, leading to abnormal development.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Jesũ aarĩĩaga irio cia hwaĩ-inĩ nyũmba kwa Lawi, etia mbeeca cia igooti aingĩ na ehia nĩmarĩĩanĩire nake na arutwo ake, tondũ maarĩ aingĩ nĩmamũrũmĩrĩire.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa ariũ a ithe moonire atĩ ithe nĩamwendete kũmakĩra-rĩ, makĩmũmena na matingĩamwarĩirie kiugo o na kĩmwe kĩega.
english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ũũ nĩguo Jehova aathanĩte, ‘Rũciũ nĩ mũthenya wa kũhurũka, Thabatũ Theru ya Jehova. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio rugai ĩrĩa yothe mũkwenda kũruga, na mũcamũkie kĩrĩa gĩothe mũkwenda gũcamũkia. Kĩrĩa gĩgũtigara-rĩ, mũkĩige nginya rũciinĩ.’ ”
english: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’ ”

kikuyu: Na mwanake ũmwe ũteehumbĩte kĩndũ tiga taama wa gatani akĩrũmĩrĩra Jesũ. Na rĩrĩa maamũnyiitire,
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

kikuyu: wa ikũmi na kenda wagũĩrĩire Malothi, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Rĩu nĩmenyete atĩ Jehova nĩahonokagia ũrĩa wake mũitĩrĩrie maguta; nĩamwĩtĩkaga arĩ kũu igũrũ rĩake rĩamũre, arĩ na ũhoti wa kũhonokania ũrĩa ũrĩ guoko-inĩ gwake kwa ũrĩo.
english: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

kikuyu: Nake mũnene arĩĩtoonyaga kuo na njĩra ya gĩthaku kĩrĩa gĩa itoonyero, na akarũgama hau gĩtugĩ-inĩ gĩa kĩhingo. Nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai marute igongona rĩa maruta make ma njino, na maruta make ma ngwatanĩro. Arĩĩhooyagĩra hau hingĩro-inĩ ya itoonyero, agacooka akoima nja, no kĩhingo kĩu gĩtikahingwo nginya o hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa anthracnose ūrīa ūrehagwo nī njamuthi mūthemba wa fungi ūnyitaga matunda.
english: Anthracnose is a fungal disease that attacks the fruit.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Mwathani, o we Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, nĩakarehera njamba ciake cia ita iria irĩ hinya mũrimũ wa kũhĩnja; na handũ ha kũhumbĩrwo nĩ riiri wake-rĩ, nĩ mwaki magaakĩrio ũrĩrĩmbũke ta rũrĩrĩmbĩ.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

kikuyu: Niĩ menyithanagia maũndũ marĩa mageekĩka marigĩrĩrio-inĩ kuuma o kĩambĩrĩria, namo maũndũ marĩa magooka ngamamenyithania kuuma o tene. Ngoiga atĩrĩ: Ũrĩa nduĩte nĩũkahinga, namo maũndũ mothe marĩa nyendaga gwĩka-rĩ, no mo ngeeka.
english: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.

kikuyu: Ta tuĩriai ũhoro, muone: Hihi mũndũ mũrũme no ahote gũciara mwana? Nĩ kĩĩ kĩragĩtũma nyone arũme othe arĩa marĩ hinya menyiitĩte nda ta mũtumia ũkũrũmwo, na o mũndũ akagarũrũka agatukia gĩthiithi?
english: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mwaka wa ikũmi na ĩtano wa ũthamaki wa Tiberio Kaisari, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Pontio Pilato aarĩ barũthi wa Judea, nake Herode aathanaga Galili, na Filipu mũrũ wa ithe aathanaga Iturea na Tarokoniti, nake Lusania agaathana Abilene,
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

kikuyu: “ ‘O na angĩaga gũkũũrwo na njĩra ĩmwe ya icio, we na ciana ciake no nginya makaarekererio Mwaka wa Jubilii wakinya,
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

kikuyu: Nake mũraika wa Ngai akĩnjarĩria ndĩ kĩroto-inĩ, akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Jakubu.’ Na niĩ ngĩcookia atĩrĩ, ‘Niĩ ũyũ haha.’
english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

kikuyu: Na ngoimbũrĩra Ayahudi o hamwe na Ayunani atĩ no nginya magarũrũke kũrĩ Ngai na ũndũ wa kwĩrira na magĩe na wĩtĩkio thĩinĩ wa Mwathani witũ Jesũ.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.‡

kikuyu: Ũtukũ ũcio-rĩ, ũronyiitwo nĩ nduma ndumanu; ũroaga gũtaranĩrio na mĩthenya ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ya mwaka, o na kana ũtarwo harĩ mweri o na ũrĩkũ.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

kikuyu: Hinya wa rūrū rwa gūciarithania kūrūa na mīrimū no kūhotomie hinya wa njanjo kūruta wīra wega kūrī njiarwa.
english: The immune status of the parent flock also can contribute to a vaccine failure.

kikuyu: Andũ ta acio magĩrĩirwo nĩkũmenya atĩ o ũrĩa ũhoro witũ ũkoragwo ũrĩ marũa-inĩ maitũ rĩrĩa tũtarĩ ho-rĩ, ũguo noguo tũkoragwo tũhaana tũgĩĩka maũndũ rĩrĩa tũrĩ ho.
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, nĩũkũrĩtuĩra ciira? Nĩũgũ- tuĩra ciira itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene rĩitithagia thakame? Nĩ ũndũ ũcio rĩonie maũndũ marĩa mothe rĩĩkaga marĩ magigi,
english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.

kikuyu: Akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mwathi wakwa, wee mwene nĩwehĩtire harĩ niĩ ndungata yaku na rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova Ngai waku, ũkiuga atĩrĩ: ‘Solomoni mũrũguo nĩwe ũgaatuĩka mũthamaki thuutha wakwa, na nĩwe ũgaikarĩra gĩtĩ gĩakwa kĩa ũnene.’
english: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by Yahweh‡ your God§ to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ-rĩ, nũũ Mũrungu tiga Jehova? Na nũũ Rwaro rwa Ihiga tiga Ngai witũ?
english: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio matũũra matano ma bũrũri wa Misiri makaaragia rũthiomi rwa Kaanani, makĩĩhĩtaga atĩ marĩtungatagĩra Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe. Na itũũra rĩmwe rĩamo rĩgeetagwo Itũũra Inene rĩa Mwanangĩko.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

kikuyu: Nĩmaratoonya Aiathu; maratuĩkanĩria Migironi; o na maraiga igĩĩna ciao Mikimashi.
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

kikuyu: “Ohola nĩahũũraga ũmaraya o na arĩ wakwa; nake nĩeriragĩria endwa ake, na nĩo andũ a Ashuri, o acio maarĩ njamba cia ita
english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũhĩahĩaga nĩ thuti cianyu mũrĩ kũu mĩgandi-inĩ, na mũrĩ rungu rwa mũtĩ o wothe mũruru; mũrutaga ciana cianyu magongona kũu ituamba-inĩ, na mĩatũka-inĩ ya ndwaro cia mahiga.
english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

kikuyu: Mūtukanio wa tīīri mūnoru wambīrīre gūthika irima, ūcoke ūrūmīrīrwo nī tīīri wa nathī na ūkindīrwo wega.
english: Topsoil mixtures filled into the hole first, followed by the subsoil and firming down.

kikuyu: Macookaga hwaĩ-inĩ makĩraramaga ta ngui, makĩũrũraga itũũra-inĩ inene.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

kikuyu: Maūthī ma maembe mūthemba wa Apple nī marikū?
english: What are the characteristics of apple mango?

kikuyu: Ũtukũ ũrĩa warũmĩrĩire, Mwathani akĩrũgama hakuhĩ na Paũlũ, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wĩyũmĩrĩrie! O ũguo ũheanĩte ũhoro wakwa gũkũ Jerusalemu, noguo ũkaũheana kũu Roma.”
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

kikuyu: No ha ũhoro wa kũriũka kwa arĩa akuũ-rĩ, kaĩ mũtathomete ũrĩa Ngai oigire atĩrĩ,
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

kikuyu: Njĩra njariĩ ya arĩa arũngĩrĩru yeheragĩra ũũru; mũndũ ũrĩa ũmenyagĩrĩra mĩthiĩre yake nĩ muoyo wake mwene agitagĩra.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

kikuyu: Nĩ mũkaaruta tũmĩgate kuuma mũtu-inĩ wanyu ũrĩa mũgaathĩa rĩa mbere na mũtũheane tũrĩ iruta kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

kikuyu: Amitraz, pyrethroids, organophosphates kana mūtukanio wa ici ciothe nī imwe cia dawa cia mūnanda iria irīthoko-inī.
english: Amitraz, synthetic pyrethroids, organophosphates or combinations of these active ingredients are some of the commonly available acaricide in the market.

kikuyu: Nao makĩhahũka na makĩmaka, magĩĩciiria atĩ nĩ ngoma moonaga.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

kikuyu: Ningĩ-rĩ, nĩ kĩĩ kĩagiririe thikwo tĩĩri-inĩ ta kĩhuno o na kana ta gakenge karĩa gatoonire ũtheri wa riũa?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

kikuyu: Mīmera mīingī ya kūrīa kūrī ūrugarī īkoragwo na ūnyihu wa phosphorus.
english: Most tropical forages are low in Phosphorus.

kikuyu: rĩrĩa Wee Ngai, warũgamire ũtuanĩre ciira, nĩguo ũhonokie arĩa othe anyamaarĩku a bũrũri.
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Nĩ meeheragia andũ arĩa abatari njĩra-inĩ, na makahatĩrĩria athĩĩni othe a bũrũri magatũma mathiĩ makehithe.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

kikuyu: Niĩ njathĩtwo ndathimane; nake arathimanĩte-rĩ, ndingĩhota kũgarũra ũndũ ũcio.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

kikuyu: ningĩ ũngĩrũmia ũhoro wa ma, na ũtuanĩri ciira wa kĩhooto, na wa ũthingu, na wĩhĩte ũkiugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa Jehova atũũraga muoyo,’ hĩndĩ ĩyo ndũrĩrĩ nĩikarathimwo nĩwe, na thĩinĩ wake nĩikaagĩa na riiri.”
english: and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

kikuyu: Anga njamba ĩrĩ hinya no ĩtunywo indo iria itahĩte, o na kana andũ arĩa maanyiitĩtwo mahonokio kuuma kũrĩ andũ karaũ?
english: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

kikuyu: Mweri-inĩ wa gatano mwaka-inĩ ũcio, nĩguo mwaka wa kana, o kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa ũthamaki wa Zedekia mũthamaki wa Juda, mũnabii wetagwo Hanania mũrũ wa Azuri, ũrĩa woimĩte Gibeoni, nĩanjĩĩrire atĩrĩ, tũrĩ o kũu nyũmba ya Jehova mbere ya athĩnjĩri-Ngai na andũ arĩa angĩ othe:
english: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in Yahweh’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

kikuyu: Akĩĩhũgũra, akĩmarora othe, agĩcooka akĩĩra mũndũ ũcio atĩrĩ, “Tambũrũkia guoko gwaku.” Nake agĩĩka o ro ũguo; nakuo guoko gwake gũkĩhonio biũ.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma: Harĩ andũ arĩa manaciarwo nĩ andũ-a-nja, gũtirĩ kuoneka mũndũ mũnene gũkĩra Johana Mũbatithania; no rĩrĩ mũndũ ũrĩa mũnini mũno ũthamaki-inĩ wa igũrũ-rĩ, nĩ mũnene kũmũkĩra.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Musa akĩeherera Firaũni agĩthiĩ akĩhooya Jehova.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mũraikaũcioagĩcookaakĩmwĩraatĩrĩ, “Wĩhumbenguociakunawĩkĩreiraatũ.” NakePeteroagĩĩka o ũguo. Mũraika ũcio akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Wĩhotore nguo yaku na ũnũmĩrĩre.”
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

kikuyu: Nao magĩkinya handũ heetagwo Gethisemane, nake Jesũ akĩĩra arutwo ake atĩrĩ, “Ikarai haha thiĩ ngahooe.”
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ oigaga ũguo nĩ ũndũ witũ, githĩ tiguo? Ĩĩ-ni, ũndũ ũyũ waandĩkirũo nĩ ũndũ witũ, tondũ rĩrĩa mũrĩmi ekũrĩma, nake mũhũũri ngano amĩhũũrage-rĩ, nĩ kwagĩrĩire mekage ũguo marĩ na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro atĩ nĩmakagayana magetha.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mwaka-inĩ wa kenda wa ũthamaki wa Zedekia, mũthenya wa ikũmi wa mweri wa ikũmi-rĩ, Nebukadinezaru mũthamaki wa Babuloni agĩthiĩ kũhũũrana na Jerusalemu arĩ na ita rĩake rĩothe, nao makĩamba hema nja ya itũũra rĩu inene, na magĩaka ihumbu cia tĩĩri mĩena yothe yarĩo cia kũmateithia gũtharĩkĩra itũũra rĩu.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

kikuyu: Nao nĩmakaarĩa na maniine magetha manyu o na irio cianyu, na marĩe na maniine aanake na airĩtu anyu; nĩmakaarĩa ndũũru cianyu cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe maciniine, ningĩ marĩe mĩthabibũ na mĩkũyũ yanyu. Nĩmakananga matũũra marĩa mairigĩre na rũhiũ rwa njora, o macio mwĩhokaga.
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

kikuyu: Nĩmatumire ebodi na ndigi cia rangi wa thahabu, na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na cia gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Ũguo nĩguo akaahoroheria Handũ-harĩa- Hatheru-Mũno tondũ wa thaahu na ũremi wa andũ a Isiraeli, kũringana na mehia mao mothe. Na ũguo noguo ageeka nĩ ũndũ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, ĩrĩa ĩrĩ gatagatĩ kao na thaahu wao.
english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, nĩ maita maigana tawa wa arĩa aaganu ũhoragio? Nĩ maita maigana makoragwo nĩ mũtino, na nĩ maita maigana Ngai amagayagĩra ruo nĩ kũmarakarĩra?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

kikuyu: Ningĩ Daudi akiuga atĩrĩ, “Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩ wagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũkuua ithandũkũ rĩa Ngai tiga o Alawii, tondũ nĩo Jehova aathuurire makuuage ithandũkũ rĩu rĩa Jehova na mamũtungatagĩre nginya tene.”
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gĩthaka kĩu na ngurunga ĩyo yarĩ kuo ikĩgarũrĩrwo Iburahĩmu nĩ Ahiti irĩ handũ ha gũthikanaga. 24
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place. 24

kikuyu: Baba aamũigĩrĩire icooki iritũ; niĩ nĩngũrĩritũhia makĩria. Baba aamũhũũraga na iboko; no niĩ ndĩrĩmũhũũraga na tũngʼaurũ.’ ”
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’ ”

kikuyu: Ningĩ andũ acio ake makĩririkana matukũ ma tene, o hĩndĩ ya Musa na andũ ake, makĩũria atĩrĩ: Ũrĩa wamaringirie iria, hamwe na mũrĩithi wa rũũru rwake-rĩ, akĩrĩ ha? Ĩ we ũrĩa wareehire Roho Mũtheru gatagatĩ kao-rĩ, akĩrĩ ha?
english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”

kikuyu: Tũnyũmba tũu twa mĩena-inĩ twakĩtwo ngoroba ithatũ, kamwe gagakwo karĩ igũrũ wa karĩa kangĩ, o ngoroba tũnyũmba mĩrongo ĩtatũ. Nĩ haarĩ na mĩgamba yohanĩtio gũthiũrũrũkĩria rũthingo rwa hekarũ, ya gũtiirĩrĩra tũnyũmba twa mĩena-inĩ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio mĩgamba ĩyo ndĩatoonyetio rũthingo-inĩ rũu rwa hekarũ.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

kikuyu: mīmera yothe harī o īka ni 14,800
english: Plant population: 14,800 per īka.

kikuyu: Gīthimo kīega nī ngirathi īmwe o mūthenya.
english: Give about 1 glass per day.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ korwo ndarekereria nyamũ cia gĩthaka igerere bũrũri ũcio nacio ciũtige ũtarĩ ciana, naguo ũkire ihooru kwage mũndũ ũngĩtuĩkanĩria kuo nĩ ũndũ wa nyamũ icio,
english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

kikuyu: Jehova nĩoinangĩte rũthanju rwa andũ arĩa aaganu, o na akoinanga thimbũ ya ũnene ya arĩa maathanaga,
english: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

english: Turn at my reproof. Behold,§ I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, mũrũ wa mũndũ, ratha ũhoro wĩre Gogu atĩrĩ: ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Ihinda rĩu, rĩrĩa andũ akwa Isiraeli magaakorwo maikarĩte marĩ na thayũ-rĩ, githĩ o nawe ndũkarĩmenya?

english: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.

kikuyu: Mũnene wa ikũmi na ũmwe, wa mweri wa ikũmi na ũmwe, aarĩ Benaia ũrĩa Mũpirathoni wa rũciaro rwa Aefiraimu. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

english: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

kikuyu: No ũrĩhie mũndũ wa kũngĩ uumithio wa kĩndũ ũmuohoreire, no ti mũrũ wa ithe wanyu Mũisiraeli, nĩgeetha Jehova Ngai wanyu amũrathimage maũndũ-inĩ mothe marĩa mũrĩĩkaga bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩa mũrathiĩ mũwĩgwatĩre.

english: • Mulching: Use rice straw as mulch to partially control weed.

kikuyu: “Mũtikanahutie andũ arĩa akwa aitĩrĩrie maguta; mũtikaneke anabii akwa ũũru.”

kikuyu: Nake ũmwe wao agĩtinia gũtũ kwa ũrĩo kwa ndungata ya mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa wandũmire gũkũ thĩ, na niĩ noguo ndamatũma kũrĩ andũ a gũkũ thĩ.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

english: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’* There is no other commandment greater than these.”
