kikuyu: “Nĩngatua kũndũ kũu gĩikaro kĩa ndundu, na ndĩgũtue bũrũri wa maria ma maaĩ; ngaakũhaata na kĩhato kĩa mwanangĩko,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ekuuga.
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.

kikuyu: Jesũ agĩcooka akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ngũmũũria atĩrĩ, nĩ ũndũ ũrĩkũ mwĩtĩkĩrie nĩ watho mũthenya wa Thabatũ: nĩ gwĩka wega kana nĩ gwĩka ũũru, nĩ kũhonokia muoyo kana nĩ kũũniina?”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcooka agĩthima mwena wa ithũĩro; mũigana waho warĩ mĩkono magana matano ũthimĩtwo na rũthanju rũu rwa gũthima.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩtũrerutanĩria gwĩka maũndũ marĩa mangĩonwo magĩrĩire mbere ya Mwathani, na to harĩ we wiki, no o na ningĩ monwo marĩ magĩrĩru nĩ andũ o nao.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

kikuyu: Nake nĩagatũma araika ake na mũgambo mũnene wa karumbeta, nao nĩmakoongania arĩa ake aamũre moimĩte mĩena ĩna ĩrĩa yumaga rũhuho, kuuma gĩturi kĩmwe kĩa igũrũ nginya kĩrĩa kĩngĩ.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

kikuyu: nĩgeetha mũhotage gũkũũrana maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire makĩria ya marĩa mangĩ, na mũkoragwo mũrĩ atheru na mũtarĩ na ũcuuke o nginya mũthenya ũrĩa wa Kristũ,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

kikuyu: Nĩũgakorwo ũrĩ ũndũ mwega harĩ ndungata iria mwathi wacio agaakora ciĩhaarĩirie, o na angĩgooka ũtukũ gatagatĩ kana thaa kenda gũgĩkĩa.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

kikuyu: Nī magūmirwo nī gūthūka kuuma na thīinī( jelly seed), nī marī fibre nyīngī.
english: danger of internal breakdown (jelly seed), fibre content is slightly higher than average

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ mũtũmia ũrĩ na mũthuuri aikaraga ohanĩtio na mũthuuriwe nĩ watho ihinda rĩrĩa rĩothe mũthuuriwe arĩ muoyo; no mũthuuriwe angĩkua-rĩ, mũtumia ũcio ti muohe nĩ watho ũcio wa ũhiki.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

kikuyu: Riiri na ũnene irĩ mbere yake; hinya na riiri irĩ handũ hake harĩa haamũre.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

kikuyu: hamwe na ciana cianyu, na atumia anyu, na andũ a kũngĩ arĩa matũũraga kambĩ-inĩ cianyu, arĩa mamunagĩra ngũ na makamũtahĩra maaĩ.
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

kikuyu: “Meerei atĩrĩ, ‘Ngai icio itoombire igũrũ na thĩ, nĩigathira gũkũ thĩ, na ithire kũrĩa guothe gũtambũrũkĩirio matu mairũ.’ ”
english: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’ ”

kikuyu: Warega kũmarekereria-rĩ, rũciũ nĩngarehithia ngigĩ bũrũri ũyũ wanyu.
english: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,

kikuyu: kūngīkinyīrīra atī kwīna ria rīrīa rītahukaga raithi ta thangari, hubīra mītī na bucket kana iratathi mbere ya kūhūra dawa ya ria.
english: In the event that there are stubborn weeds like couch grass, cover the seedlings (with a bucket or bag) before spraying the weeds with a suitable herbicide.

kikuyu: na ngʼombe 72,000,
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: Ndũkareke maitho maku mone toro, kana ũreke imone ciaku icũnge.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

kikuyu: No Ngai aandũmire mbere yanyu nĩguo ndũme matigari manyu matũũre gũkũ thĩ, na honokie mĩoyo yanyu na kũhonokania kũnene.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ mũtathomete ũrĩa Daudi eekire, rĩrĩa we na arĩa maarĩ nake maarĩ ahũtu?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

kikuyu: Mĩthenya mũgwanja mũkaarutagĩra Jehova maruta ma gũcinwo na mwaki, naguo mũthenya wa ĩnana-rĩ, mũgĩe na kĩũngano gĩtheru, na mũrutĩre Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki. Mũthenya ũcio nĩguo wa kũhinga kĩũngano; mũtikanarute wĩra ũrĩa mũrutaga.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio ũngĩ, kĩrĩndĩ kĩrĩa kĩarĩ mũrĩmo ũũrĩa ũngĩ wa iria gĩkĩmenya atĩ no marikabu ĩmwe yarĩ ho, na atĩ Jesũ ndaamĩingĩrĩte hamwe na arutwo ake no maathiĩte marĩ oiki.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Nuhu aarĩĩũkirwo na akĩmenya ũrĩa mũriũ wake ũrĩa mũnini aamwĩkĩte-rĩ,
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

kikuyu: “Mũngiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Ĩ nĩtũthingatane nake, kuona atĩ nĩwe kĩhumo gĩa thĩĩna ũyũ,’
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

kikuyu: Nyamũ icio na ngai icio cia kũhooywo irainamĩrĩra hamwe; ciothe ikaremwo nĩkũhonokia mĩhianano ĩyo ĩkuuĩtwo, nacio nyene igatahwo igatwarwo ũkombo-inĩ.
english: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Esaũ (na nowe Edomu) agĩthiĩ gũtũũra bũrũri wa irĩma wa Seiru.
english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩndatuĩte itua ndirĩ ũndũ ũngĩ ngwenda kũmenya, rĩrĩa rĩothe ndaarĩ na inyuĩ, o tiga ũhoro wa Jesũ Kristũ na kwambwo gwake mũtĩ-igũrũ.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

kikuyu: Ũreka atĩa, wee ũnũhĩtwo? Ũkwĩhumba nguo ndune na ũkegemia na mathaga ma thahabu nĩkĩ? Ũrahaka mbutu ciaku cia maitho rangi nĩkĩ?† Atĩrĩrĩ, kwĩgemia gwaku no gwa tũhũ. Endwa aku nĩmakwagĩire bata; rĩu maracaria ũrĩa mangĩkũruta muoyo.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.

kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩĩra Harũni ũrĩa wothe Jehova amũtũmĩte akoige, o na ningĩ ũhoro wa ciama ciothe iria aamwathĩte aringe.
english: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.

kikuyu: Mĩbango ya ngoro ya mũndũ nĩ mĩingĩ, no muoroto wa Jehova noguo ũkaahinga.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

kikuyu: Mũndũ wa kũgĩa thiritũ na mũici nĩ muoyo wake mwene athũire; ehĩtithagio na ndangĩruta ũira.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Mũthamaki Daudi aakũrire na agatindĩka mĩaka-rĩ, ndaiguaga ũrugarĩ o na mamũhum- bĩra na nguo.
english: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

kikuyu: Nĩngeheria ũthamaki moko-inĩ ma mũriũ na ngũhe mĩhĩrĩga ikũmi.
english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu, ũrĩa ũtũmaga iria rĩikie ndiihũ nĩguo makũmbĩ marĩo makaruruma; Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe nĩrĩo rĩĩtwa rĩake.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

kikuyu: No nĩmageririe Ngai na makĩremera Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno; matiathikĩrĩirie mawatho make.
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

kikuyu: “Mwĩtharei muume kũu Babuloni! Ũrai mũhonokie mĩoyo yanyu! Mwĩtharei mũtikaniinanĩrio nakuo nĩ ũndũ wa mehia makuo. Nĩ ihinda rĩa Jehova rĩa kwĩrĩhĩria; agaakũrĩha o kĩrĩa gĩkwagĩrĩire.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo wendo waku nĩ mũnene, ũgagĩkinya o igũrũ; wĩhokeku waku ũkinyĩte o matu-inĩ.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

kikuyu: No nĩ ũndũ waku tũtindaga tũngʼetheire gĩkuũ mũthenya wothe; tũtuĩtwo ta ngʼondu cia gũthĩnjwo.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

kikuyu: Aheaga mũthamaki wake ũhootani mũnene; onanagia ũtugi wake ũtathiraga kũrĩ ũcio wake mũitĩrĩrie maguta, kũrĩ Daudi na njiaro ciake nginya tene.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring,‡ forever more.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa athuuri othe a Isiraeli maakinyire, Alawii makĩoya ithandũkũ rĩu,
english: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

kikuyu: īkoragwo na mahūa matune.
english: It exhibits presence of white flowers.

kikuyu: Hinya wa wĩthĩ ũrĩa ũiyũrĩte mahĩndĩ-inĩ make ũgaakoma hamwe nake rũkũngũ-inĩ.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, nĩnyendete nyũmba ĩrĩa ũtũũraga, o handũ harĩa riiri waku ũikaraga.
english: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

kikuyu: Waru wa Shangi nī mwega gūkīma, gūtherūkia, gūcina na gūthondeka chips.
english: Shangi potatoes are good for mashing, boiling, roasting and making chips.

kikuyu: “Wee no ũhote kũmenya maũndũ marĩa mahithe ma Ngai? Kana no ũhote gũtuĩria kũna maũndũ ma Mwene-Hinya-Wothe?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

kikuyu: Ndũkareke mũndũ ũrĩa mũhinyĩrĩrie acooke na thuutha aconokete; andũ arĩa athĩĩni na arĩa abatari nĩmagooce rĩĩtwa rĩaku.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

kikuyu: Kaingī ihūthagīra mīeri 9-12 itanahandwo
english: Usually, this takes 9–12 months after planting.

kikuyu: Ndibei nĩ mũnyũrũrania, na njoohi nĩ mũndũ wa ngũĩ; mũndũ ũrĩa ũhĩtithagio nĩcio ti mũũgĩ.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

kikuyu: Zera ũrĩa Mũkushi agĩũka kũmũũkĩrĩra arĩ na mbũtũ nene ya thigari na ngaari cia ita 300, nake agĩũka agĩkinya Maresha.
english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

kikuyu: mũrũ wa Mahali, mũrũ wa Mushi, mũrũ wa Merari, mũrũ wa Lawi.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: kwambĩrĩria hĩndĩ ya ũbatithio wa Johana nginya hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Jesũ oirwo akĩambata akĩehera harĩ ithuĩ. Nĩgũkorwo mũndũ ũmwe wa aya no nginya atuĩke mũira hamwe na ithuĩ ũhoro-inĩ wa kũriũka gwake.”
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

kikuyu: na makĩria ma ũguo ũkoiga atĩ marakara make matiherithanagia na ndarũmbũyagia waganu o na hanini!
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

kikuyu: Magĩcaria ũrĩa mangĩmũnyiita tondũ nĩmamenyire aaragia ũhoro wao na ngerekano ĩyo, no nĩmetigagĩra kĩrĩndĩ; nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩtigana nake, magĩthiĩ.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

kikuyu: nawe nĩũkarathimwo. O na gũtuĩka matingĩhota gũkũrĩha, nĩũkarĩhwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ arĩa athingu makaariũkio.”
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

kikuyu: na maarĩ gĩtuamba-inĩ gũkuhĩ na Bethi-Peori, irathĩro rĩa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani, bũrũri-inĩ wa Sihoni mũthamaki wa Aamori, ũrĩa waathanaga Heshiboni, nĩwe wahootirwo nĩ Musa na andũ a Isiraeli hĩndĩ ĩrĩa moimaga bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Iburahĩmu akĩhiũha agĩthiĩ hema-inĩ kũrĩ Sara, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Oya ibaba ithatũ* cia mũtu ũrĩa mũhinyu wega, ũũkande na ũruge mĩgate naihenya.”
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs† of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

kikuyu: “Nake mwathi wao agĩĩta ndungata ĩyo, akĩmĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Wee ndungata ĩno njaganu, ngũrekeire thiirĩ waku wothe tondũ nĩũũthaithire.
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩkũnja ibuku rĩu rĩa gĩkũnjo, agĩcookeria mũmenyereri wa thunagogi, agĩikara thĩ. Nao andũ arĩa othe maarĩ thunagogi makĩmũrora.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

kikuyu: Ndakanatoonye handũ harĩ kĩimba. Ndakanethaahie o na aakorwo nĩ ũndũ wa ithe kana nyina,
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

kikuyu: Andũ amwe a kuuma Benjamini na angĩ a kuuma Juda o nao magĩũka kũrĩ Daudi kũu kĩĩhitho-inĩ gĩake.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ igũrũ-rĩ, makaai nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoro ũcio, inainai mũrĩ na kĩeha kĩnene,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Tũma tũgaacĩre rĩngĩ, Wee Jehova, ta ũrĩa njũũĩ cia Negevu icookaga kũiyũra.
english: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

kikuyu: Ūtungata nī ūhanaine
english: The management practices are the same.

kikuyu: Hihi gūciara kwa mītī ya makorobia kūngīgacīrithio atia?
english: How is pollination enhanced in avocado orchard?

kikuyu: “Ici nĩcio ithimo cia kĩgongona, ithimĩtwo na mĩkono ĩrĩa mĩraihu, mũkono ũrĩa wa ũraihu wa mũkono ũmwe* na wariĩ wa rũhĩ†: Mũberethi wakĩo ũrĩ na ũriku wa mũkono ũmwe, na wariĩ wa mũkono ũmwe, naguo mũgũkũ ũrĩa ũkũrigiicĩirie nĩ wa irata rĩmwe‡ mũthia-inĩ. Kĩu nĩkĩo kĩrũgamo gĩa kĩgongona.
english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit† is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span;‡ and this shall be the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Igũrũ gwakĩtwo na mahiga marĩa mega mũno matinĩtio na gĩthimo, na mbaũ cia mĩtarakwa.
english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Solomoni akiuga atĩrĩ, “Jehova oigĩte atĩ arĩikaraga thĩinĩ wa itu rĩrĩa itumanu.
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

kikuyu: Moima Periga, magĩthiĩ na mbere magĩkinya Antiokia ya bũrũri wa Pisidia. Na mũthenya wa Thabatũ magĩtoonya thunagogi magĩikara thĩ.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

kikuyu: Petero akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, akorwo nĩwe-rĩ, njĩĩra njũke kũrĩ we ngereire maaĩ igũrũ.”
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, nĩndĩrehoka kũmũtũma kũrĩ inyuĩ o ndaarĩkia kũmenya ũrĩa maũndũ makwa megũikara.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ a Isiraeli magĩtũmanĩra Jeroboamu, nake Jeroboamu hamwe na Isiraeli rĩothe magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Rehoboamu, makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ:
english: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

kikuyu: Rĩu nĩrĩo igai rĩaku, rũgai rũrĩa ngũtuĩrĩire,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga, “tondũ nĩũriganĩirwo nĩ niĩ, ũkehoka ngai cia maheeni.
english: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says Yahweh, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”

kikuyu: Mīembe ībataraga maaī manīnī gūkīra mīmera īrīa īngī ya matunda ta marigū.
english: Mango trees need less water than other commercial fruit tree farming like banana farming.

kikuyu: “Ta thikĩrĩriai ngerekano ĩngĩ: Mũndũ warĩ mwene mũgũnda nĩahaandire mũgũnda ũcio wake mĩthabibũ. Agĩaka rũgiri rũgĩthiũrũrũkĩria mũgũnda ũcio, akĩenja kĩhihĩro gĩa thabibũ o kũu thĩinĩ, na agĩaka nyũmba ndaaya na igũrũ ya arangĩri. Agĩcooka agĩkomborithia mũgũnda ũcio wa mĩthabibũ kũrĩ arĩmi na agĩthiĩ rũgendo.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Ngai nĩ mwĩhokeku, o we ũrĩa wamwĩtire nĩguo mũkorwo na ngwatanĩro na Mũriũ Jesũ Kristũ, Mwathani witũ.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Mbegū cia waru ciigagwo handū hega hatarī na ūtheri mūingī nīgetha ikūre na ngūrū na irī na marangi, no ndūgaikare ūtheri-inī wa riū
english: Seed potatoes are kept in a cool store with diffuse light for coloured, short sprouts to develop, however, avoid direct sunlight

kikuyu: Mītī īrīa mīrwaru yagaga hinya wa gūciara, īkaruta mathangū manini na ndīrutaga maciaro maingī.
english: Trees affected lose vitality, become sparsely foliated and do not produce a good crop.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jesũ aarorire akĩona kĩrĩndĩ kĩnene gĩgĩũka kũrĩ we, akĩũria Filipu atĩrĩ, “Tũkũgũra mĩgate kũ andũ aya marĩe?”
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

kikuyu: Aburamu akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ndungata yaku ĩrĩ moko-inĩ maku. Ĩka nayo ũrĩa ũkuona kwagĩrĩire.” Nake Sarai akĩnyamaria Hagari mũno; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Hagari akĩmũũrĩra.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

kikuyu: Gĩathane rĩu atĩ ũhiũ waku na indo ciothe iria ũrĩ nacio mũgũnda itoonyio handũ ingĩĩgitia, tondũ mbura ĩyo ya mbembe yoirĩra mũndũ o wothe ũrĩ nja kana nyamũ ĩtarehetwo mũciĩ o yothe na ĩrĩ kũu mũgũnda no ĩgũkua.’ ”
english: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Thũ ciao ikĩmahinyĩrĩria, na ikĩmaiga rungu rwa wathani wao.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova, inyuĩ ndũrĩrĩ ciothe; mũkumiei, inyuĩ andũ othe.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

kikuyu: “Maturubarĩ nĩmagwĩte thĩ, no ithuĩ tũgwaka rĩngĩ na mahiga maicũhie; mĩtĩ ya mĩkũyũ nĩmĩteme, no ithenya rĩayo tũgwaka na mĩtarakwa.”
english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

kikuyu: Jehova nĩamenyithanĩtie ũhonokio wake na akaguũria ũthingu wake kũrĩ andũ a ndũrĩrĩ.
english: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: Nĩahunjagia ũhoro wa ũthamaki wa Ngai, na akarutana ũhoro ũkoniĩ Mwathani Jesũ Kristũ arĩ na ũcamba, na hatarĩ na ũndũ ũngĩmũrigĩrĩria.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa meekĩrire hingĩro ciao hau hingĩro-inĩ ciakwa, na itugĩ cia mĩrango yao magĩciĩkĩra itugĩ-inĩ cia mĩrango yakwa, na no rũthingo rwarĩ gatagatĩ gakwa na o-rĩ, nĩmathaahirie rĩĩtwa rĩakwa itheru na mĩtugo ĩyo yao ĩrĩ magigi. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩmaniina ndĩ na marakara.
english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndookire kũrĩ inyuĩ, ngĩmũhunjĩria ũira wa hitho ya ũhoro wa Ngai, ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndiamwarĩirie na mĩario ya kanua kega kana ũũgĩ mũnene.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

kikuyu: Naguo mũigana wothe wa atongoria a nyũmba arĩa maarũgamagĩrĩra thigari warĩ 2,600.
english: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Ngai ndaatwamũrire nĩguo tũtuĩke a kũrakarĩrwo, no nĩtũtuĩke a kwamũkĩra ũhonokio thĩinĩ wa Mwathani witũ Jesũ Kristũ.
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mũthenya ũcio nĩũkuhĩrĩirie, mũthenya wa Jehova nĩũkuhĩrĩirie, mũthenya ũrĩ na matu, mũthenya ũrĩ na mũthiro harĩ ndũrĩrĩ.
english: For the day is near, even Yahweh’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

kikuyu: O na korwo ndihĩtĩtie-rĩ, ndingĩhota kũmũcookeria ũndũ; ũrĩa ingĩĩka no gũthaitha ingĩthaitha Mũnjiirithia anjiguĩre tha.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Asa agĩkaĩra Jehova Ngai wake, akiuga atĩrĩ: “Jehova, gũtirĩ ũngĩ ũhaana tawe wa gũteithũra arĩa matarĩ hinya kuuma kũrĩ arĩa maarĩ hinya. Tũteithie, Wee Jehova Ngai witũ, nĩgũkorwo nĩwe twĩhokete, na nĩ thĩinĩ wa Rĩĩtwa rĩaku tuoka gũũkĩrĩra mbũtũ ĩno nene ũũ. Wee Jehova-rĩ, nĩwe Ngai witũ, ndũkareke mũndũ akũhoote.”
english: Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

kikuyu: “Kũrumwo-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũkũruta wĩra wa Jehova arĩ na ũgũũta! Kũrumwo-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũkũgirĩrĩria rũhiũ rwake rwa njora gũita thakame!
english: “Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩmatũmĩra nyoka ciarĩ na thumu; ikĩrũma andũ a Isiraeli, na aingĩ ao magĩkua.
english: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

kikuyu: Rũthanju rwa Lawi ũrwandĩke rĩĩtwa rĩa Harũni, nĩ ũndũ no nginya kũgĩe na rũthanju rũmwe rwa mũtongoria wa o mũhĩrĩga wa maithe mao ma tene.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Tondũ wa ũrĩa wee wĩhokete ciĩko ciaku o na ũtonga waku-rĩ, o nawe nĩũgatahwo, nayo ngai ĩrĩa ĩtagwo Kemoshu* nĩĩgatwarwo ithaamĩrio, ĩrĩ hamwe na athĩnjĩri-ngai, o na anene a yo.
english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

kikuyu: Tondũ ndũigana gũtungatĩra Jehova Ngai waku ũrĩ na gĩkeno na ũcanjamũkĩte hĩndĩ ya ũgaacĩru,
english: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, kiugo gĩkĩ kĩa Jehova gĩkĩnginyĩrĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ, ‘Wee nĩũitĩte thakame nyingĩ na ũkarũa mbaara nyingĩ. Ndũgwaka nyũmba ĩtanĩtio na rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, nĩ ũndũ nĩũitithĩtie thakame nyingĩ gũkũ thĩ, maitho-inĩ makwa.
english: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

kikuyu: Mũthuuri wake nĩamwĩhokete biũ, na ndarĩ kĩndũ kĩa bata angĩaga.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

kikuyu: ūkihuthira cindano na syringe īyo, tahia gīcambicūri kīrīa kīrahūthīka kūringia njanjo.
english: Using the needle fixed to a syringe, withdraw some or all of diluent to be used to dilute the vaccine into the syringe through the needle

kikuyu: Nũũ ũngĩhota kũruta kĩndũ gĩtheru kuuma harĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩa gĩtarĩ gĩtheru? Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe!
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mĩthenya ĩyo mũgwanja-rĩ, kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩkĩnginyĩrĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Tiga kũhiũha kwaria ũtambĩte gwĩciiria, ndũgetĩkĩrie ngoro yaku ĩhiũhe kwaria ũndũ mbere ya Ngai. Ngai arĩ igũrũ, nawe ũrĩ gũkũ thĩ, nĩ ũndũ ũcio nyiihagia ciugo ciaku.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

kikuyu: mũndũ akĩrĩ kĩ atĩ amwĩhoke? Mũndũ nĩ mwaganu na nĩ kĩmaramari, anyuuaga waganu ta maaĩ!
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

kikuyu: No rĩu, tũtirĩ na wendo wa kũrĩa; na tũtirĩ kĩndũ o nakĩ tuonaga, tiga o mana maya moiki!”
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

kikuyu: Nĩngamũtheria, ndĩmwehererie andũ arĩa aremi na arĩa manjũkagĩrĩra. O na gũtuĩka nĩngamaruta bũrũri ũrĩa matũũraga-rĩ, matigatoonya bũrũri wa Isiraeli. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmũkamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Maakinya handũ harĩa Ngai aamwĩrĩte-rĩ, Iburahĩmu agĩaka kĩgongona ho na akĩara ngũ igũrũ rĩakĩo. Agĩcooka akĩoha mũriũ wake Isaaka na akĩmũkomia kĩgongona-inĩ kĩu igũrũ rĩa ngũ.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

kikuyu: ‘Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Tigai kwambata mũkahũũrane na ariũ a ithe wanyu. O mũndũ wothe wanyu nĩacooke mũciĩ, nĩgũkorwo nĩ niĩ njĩkĩte ũndũ ũyũ.’ ” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩathĩkĩra ciugo cia Jehova na magĩtiganĩria ũhoro wa gũthiĩ kũhithũkĩra Jeroboamu.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.” ’ ” So they listened to Yahweh’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

kikuyu: Andũ acio othe makĩgega mũno nginya makĩũrania atĩrĩ, “Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ ũrĩkũ? Ũyũ nĩ ũrutani mwerũ, wĩ na ũhoti! Nĩ araatha o na ngoma thũku na ikamwathĩkĩra.”
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

kikuyu: Mīmera īno īitīīrīrio maaī angīkorwo gūtirī mbura kana angīkorwo mīri ndīnyitīte wega.
english: - Irrigation is necessary in absence of adequate rainfall for proper establishment of the young trees.

kikuyu: Heshiboni nĩrĩo rĩarĩ itũũra inene rĩa Sihoni mũthamaki wa Aamori, ũrĩa warũĩte na mũthamaki wa Moabi ũrĩa waathanaga mbere ĩyo, na akamũtunya bũrũri wake wothe o nginya Arinoni.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

kikuyu: Tondũ Mwathani Jehova nĩwe ũndeithagia-rĩ, ndirĩ hĩndĩ ngaaconorithio. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndũmĩte ũthiũ wakwa ũikare ũũmĩte o ta ihiga rĩa nyaigĩ, na nĩnjũũĩ ndirĩ hĩndĩ ngaaconorithio.
english: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.

kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa makwĩhĩria, nĩgũkorwo gũtirĩ mũndũ ũtehagia, nawe ũmarakarĩre ũmaneane kũrĩ thũ, nacio imatahe ĩmatware bũrũri wa kũraya kana wa gũkuhĩ;
english: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

kikuyu: na itambaya cia gũcuurio cia itoonyero rĩa nja hamwe na itugĩ na itina ciacio na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩa itoonyero rĩa kuuma nja ya hema
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

kikuyu: Ariũ a Merari maarĩ: Mahali na Mushi. Ariũ a Mahali maarĩ: Eleazaru na Kishu.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

kikuyu: No wee nĩũũĩ, Wee Jehova, ũrĩa wothe manjiirĩire nĩguo manjũrage. Tiga kũmarekera mahĩtia mao, kana kũhuura mehia macio mao mehere ũthiũ-inĩ waku. No marongʼaũranĩrio thĩ mbere yaku; meeke maũndũ macio rĩrĩa ũgaakorwo ũrakarĩte. 19
english: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin from your sight, Let them be overthrown before you. Deal with them in the time of your anger. 19

kikuyu: No ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, Elija nĩarĩkĩtie gũũka, no andũ makĩaga kũmũmenya, no nĩmamwĩkire ũrĩa wothe meendaga kũmwĩka. O ũguo noguo nake Mũrũ wa Mũndũ akaanyariirwo nĩo.”
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

kikuyu: Nĩwe ũgaatuĩka gĩtina kĩrũmu matukũ-inĩ maku, na atuĩke kĩgĩĩna kĩa ũhoro mũingĩ wa ũhonokio, na ũũgĩ, na ũmenyi wa maũndũ; na ũhoro wa gwĩtigĩra Jehova nĩguo ũgaakorwo ũrĩ mũthiithũ wa ma.
english: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.

kikuyu: Ndũkanoige atĩrĩ, “Ngũmwĩka o ta ũrĩa anjĩkĩte; ngwĩrĩhĩria harĩ mũndũ ũcio kũringana na ũrĩa eekire.”
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

kikuyu: “Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maũndũ macio mothe makaahinga, na ti-itherũ nĩmakahinga, hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmaka- menya atĩ thĩinĩ wao nĩ kwarĩ na mũnabii.”
english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

kikuyu: No mũrĩe nyamũ o yothe ĩrĩ mahũngũ maatũku na makarekania na nĩĩcookagia ithagumia.
english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

kikuyu: Thondeka mĩrĩnga ĩngĩ ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu na ũmĩnyiitithanie magũrũ-inĩ ma ndaamĩ cia kĩande mwena-inĩ wa mbere wa ebodi, hakuhĩ na rũtumo, igũrũ hanini wa mũcibi wa njohero ya ebodi.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Zinc na Boron ibatarainie makīria mītī īgīkīra kīro nīguo mbegū ciībange wega na magetha maingīhe.
english: Zinc and Boron are particularly important at the flowering stage to improve berry set and overall coffee yield potential.

kikuyu: Mīri kūongerereka na kūora
english: Galled roots often invaded by secondary rot organisms, such as soft rot bacteria resulting in rapid decay of roots

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, tiga kũndaihĩrĩria; Wee Ngai wakwa, ũka narua ũndeithie.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

kikuyu: “No acio oogĩ makĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Aca, matingĩtũigana na mamũigane. Handũ ha ũguo-rĩ, thiĩi kũrĩ arĩa mendagia maguta mũkegũrĩre manyu.’
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ ndũrĩrĩ ihaana ta itata rĩa maaĩ rĩrĩ ndoo-inĩ; cionagwo ihaana ta karũkũngũ kanini karĩa gatigagwo ratiri-inĩ; we athimaga icigĩrĩra cia iria-inĩ taarĩ rũkũngũ rũhinyu.
english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

kikuyu: Yagīrīire gūkorwo na ūtheri mūiganu.
english: Should have proper lighting (natural or artificial light)

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ ũrĩa ũrekeirwo mahĩtia make, o ũrĩa mehia make mahumbĩrĩtwo.
english: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

kikuyu: Nake nĩathiire na mũtumia wake Sarai, na Loti, mũriũ wa mũrũ wa nyina, na indo ciothe iria maagĩte nacio, na andũ arĩa maagĩte nao kũu Harani, na makiumagara marorete bũrũri wa Kaanani, na magĩkinya kuo.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩngathondeka kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa thayũ nacio, nacio nyamũ cia gĩthaka ndĩcieherie kũu bũrũri-inĩ ũcio, nĩgeetha itũũre werũ-inĩ na ikomage mĩtitũ-inĩ irĩ na thayũ.
english: “ ‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

kikuyu: Gũkaahaana o ta rĩrĩa mũgethi acookanagĩrĩria ngano ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ ngethe, akagetha ngano na guoko gwake: gũkahaana ta mũndũ ũkũhaara itira cia ngano Gĩtuamba-inĩ kĩa Refaimu.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Eheriai gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu ũũru wa ngoro, na mangʼũrĩ na marakara, na njũgitano na njambanio, o hamwe na rũmena rwa mũthemba o na ũrĩkũ.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

kikuyu: Irio iria ikeemeria, nĩcio cia maitĩka-rĩ, mũtikanacigethe kana mũgethe thabibũ cia mĩthabibũ yanyu ĩyo ĩtarĩ mĩrutĩre wĩra. Bũrũri ũcio no nginya ũkaagĩa na mwaka wa kũhurũka.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Juda makĩũngana meethe ũteithio kuuma kũrĩ Jehova; ti-itherũ magĩũka kuuma matũũra mothe ma Juda nĩguo mamũrongorie.
english: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from Yahweh. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩmarekwo makumie Jehova, na maanĩrĩre ũgooci wake kũu icigĩrĩra-inĩ.
english: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.

kikuyu: “ ‘Naguo mũhaka wanyu wa mwena wa gathigathini uumĩte Iria rĩrĩa Inene ũgaakinya Kĩrĩma- inĩ kĩa Horu,
english: “ ‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Njanjo ciigwo kūraya na ciana(Ciana itigathake na njanjo)
english: Keep vaccines away from children (children should not play with vaccines).

kikuyu: o na nyũngũ, na icakũri, na mbakũri cia kũminjaminjĩria. Indo icio ciothe HuramuaathondekeireMũthamaki Solomoni cia hekarũya Jehova ciarĩ cia gĩcango gĩkumuthe gĩkahenia.
english: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for Yahweh’s house, were of burnished bronze.

kikuyu: Tigai gwĩtigĩra mũthamaki wa Babuloni, ũcio mwĩtigĩrĩte. Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ, mũtikamwĩtigĩre, nĩgũkorwo ndĩ hamwe na inyuĩ, nĩngamũhonokia ndĩmũrute moko-inĩ make.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says Yahweh, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

kikuyu: Mīūngūrwa īhinyīrīrio tīiri-inī tondū handu hatarī na irima rīenje wega, mīri ndīkūraga wega na nīūndū ūcio mūmera ūkahinyīrīrīka na magetha makanyiha.
english: If the seedlings are forced into the ground, without a hole being prepared for them to be inserted into, the root system will be compromised and the plant will experience stress resulting in poor yield.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya wa gatatũ nĩ kwagĩire na kihikanio kũu Kana ya Galili. Nyina wa Jesũ aarĩ kuo,
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

kikuyu: Ĩtĩkĩra tha ciaku inginyĩre nĩguo ndũũre muoyo, nĩgũkorwo watho waku nĩguo ngenagĩra.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Nīkīī gītūmaga kahūa gakūrīirio irīma-inī kagīe mūcamo mwega?
english: Why is coffee grown at high altitudes better?

kikuyu: Pilato akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ mũkwenda ndĩmuohorere mũthamaki wa Ayahudi?”
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Nake mũthamaki akĩmacookeria ehĩte mũno. Akĩregana na ũtaaro ũrĩa aaheetwo nĩ athuuri,
english: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

kikuyu: Gīterenge kīrūmu na kīretīkīria rīera gūceera nīkīabata harī ūgima mwega wa mwīrī na thayū wa ngūkū. Tigīrīra nīwekīra ithandūkū ria kūrekeria na mītī ya kūūmba.
english: A strong, well-ventilated chicken coop is essential for the health and well-being of your chickens. Make sure to include nesting boxes and perches inside the coop.

kikuyu: Ariũ a ithe wao a matũũra mao nĩmookaga rĩmwe na rĩmwe magateithania mawĩra nao ihinda rĩa mĩthenya mũgwanja.
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

kikuyu: Ũrũngĩrĩru wa arĩa marũgamĩte wega nĩũmonagĩrĩria njĩra, no andũ arĩa matarĩ ehokeku, nĩmanangagwo nĩ ũhinga wao.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

kikuyu: Arĩa othe mathondekaga mĩhianano ya kũhooywo nĩmagaconorithio na manyararithio; makoimagara mathiĩ manyararithio othe hamwe.
english: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.

kikuyu: Nī kūrī mīthemba ngūrani ya mīhandīre, o hamwe na gūthondeka kīharo kīna kona inya itaiganaine, kona ithathatū kana ona kona inya ciganaine
english: There are different systems of layout, including the rectangular, hexagonal or square system.

kikuyu: Ndũkanareke wendani na wĩhokeku ikweherere; cioherere ngingo yaku, ũciandĩke kĩhengere-inĩ kĩa ngoro yaku.
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: marigū nīmanyitanagīra na mīmera īngī mīrimū ta mboco?
english: Do bananas share any diseases with other crops like beans?

kikuyu: Avian influenza kana homa ya ngūkū : Ndariri nī ta kūremwo nī kūhihia, ūrugarī mūingīna gīkuū kia hi na hi. Mūrimū ūyū umanaga na virus na ndūrī kīhonia no nī kūrī njanjo ya kūgirīrīria.
english: Avian Influenza: Symptoms include respiratory distress, fever, and sudden death. This is a viral disease, and there is no cure, but a vaccine is available to prevent it.

kikuyu: Ĩkaga maũndũ ma gũkenia Jehova, na nĩarĩkũhingagĩria merirĩria ma ngoro yaku.
english: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

kikuyu: Ũnene-inĩ wake ahaana ta ndegwa ya irigithathi; hĩa ciake igakĩhaana ta cia ndegwa ya gĩthaka-inĩ. Nĩagatheeca ndũrĩrĩ na cio, o na ndũrĩrĩ iria irĩ ituri cia thĩ. Ũguo nĩguo kũrĩ makũmi-inĩ ma ngiri ma Efiraimu; ũguo noguo kũrĩ harĩ ngiri na ngiri cia Manase.”
english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

kikuyu: Na kũrĩa guothe aathiiaga, mĩciĩ-inĩ, na tũtũũra-inĩ o na kana mĩgũnda-inĩ, o maigaga arĩa arũaru ndũnyũ-inĩ, na makamũthaitha ametĩkĩrie naarĩ mahutie gĩcũrĩ kĩa nguo yake, na arĩa othe maamũhutirie makĩhona.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe‡ of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

kikuyu: Ikuo cia njui na ngūkū no ikoragwo na ūtiganū mūnene, ūū atī no ikue ciothe kana ciathe gūkua onea īmwe, kūringana na ūrūrū wa njamuthi īyo.
english: In both chicks and old birds’ mortality varies from zero to 100 percent depending on the virulence of the organism.

kikuyu: Thĩ kũrĩa kũriku mũno kũrĩ guoko-inĩ gwake, o na tũcũmbĩrĩ twa irĩma no twake.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio, Jesũ amenya atĩ maũndũ mothe nĩmathira, na nĩguo Maandĩko mahinge, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩnyootiĩ.”
english: After this, Jesus, seeing‡ that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

kikuyu: ngerutanagĩria gũthiĩ ndorete na mbere nĩguo hootane heo kĩheo kĩrĩa Ngai aheanaga, na nĩkĩo aanjĩtĩire thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ atĩ nĩguo thiĩ igũrũ.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jeremia aarĩkirie kũhe andũ acio ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova Ngai wao, ũhoro ũrĩa wothe Jehova aamũtũmĩte akameere-rĩ,
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

kikuyu: ngurunga ĩrĩa ĩrĩ gĩthaka- inĩ kĩa Makipela hakuhĩ na Mamure kũu Kaanani, ĩrĩa Iburahĩmu aagũranĩirie na gĩthaka kĩu, ĩrĩ handũ ha gũthikana, kuuma kũrĩ Efironi ũrĩa Mũhiti.
english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩyo mĩario ya Aguri mũrũ wa Jake, na nĩ ndũmĩrĩri nditũ: Mũndũ ũcio eerire Ithieli, akĩĩra Ithieli na Ukali atĩrĩ:
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩngarahũra ũiguano wa ndũrĩrĩ nene, ciumĩte bũrũri wa gathigathini ciũkĩrĩre Babuloni. Nĩikarũgama handũ ha cio irĩũkĩrĩre na igũtunyane, kuuma mwena ũcio wa gathigathini. Mĩguĩ yao ĩgaatuĩka ta ĩrĩa ya njamba njoorua, iria itacookaga moko matheri.
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ihinda rĩake rĩa gũtungata† rĩathirire-rĩ, akĩinũka gwake mũciĩ.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Daudi ndaambatire agĩthiĩ igũrũ, no nĩoigire atĩrĩ, “ ‘Mwathani nĩeerire Mwathani wakwa atĩrĩ: “Ikara guoko-inĩ gwakwa kwa ũrĩo,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

kikuyu: mũrũ wa Jahathu, mũrũ wa Gerishoni, mũrũ wa Lawi;
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: higo cierĩ hamwe na maguta marĩa macihumbĩire hakuhĩ na honge, na marĩa mahumbĩire ini, amarutanĩrie na higo icio.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: No hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Hiramu ooimire Turo nĩguo akoone matũũra marĩa aaheetwo nĩ Solomoni, ndaakenirio nĩmo.
english: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

kikuyu: Na inyuĩ, andũ a Kaperinaumu, mũũĩ atĩ nĩmũgatũũgĩrio nginya matu-inĩ? Aca, mũkaaharũrũkio mũkinye kũrĩa kũriku mũno.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades. ‡

kikuyu: Narĩo itũũra rĩothe rĩkĩambũrũrũka nao andũ magĩũka mahanyũkĩte moimĩte mĩena yothe. Makĩnyiita Paũlũ, makĩmũguucũrũria makĩmũruta hekarũ, na o hĩndĩ ĩyo ihingo ikĩhingwo.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

kikuyu: Mwanangĩko ũrarũmanĩrĩra na mwanangĩko; bũrũri wothe nĩwanangĩtwo. O rĩmwe hema ciakwa nĩthũkangie, o kahinda gatarĩ cooho kĩĩgitio gĩakwa gĩgathũkangio.
english: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.

kikuyu: Nake akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩngũmahitha ũthiũ wakwa, nyone ũrĩa marigĩrĩrio mao magaakorwo matariĩ; nĩgũkorwo nĩ rũciaro rũremi, ciana itaangĩĩhokeka.
english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Abimeleku akĩũria Iburahĩmu atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũmire wĩke ũguo?”
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

kikuyu: Moabi nĩ kĩraĩ gĩakwa gĩa gwĩthambĩra, na Edomu nĩho njikagia kĩraatũ gĩakwa; nyanagĩrĩra nĩ ũrĩa ndooretie bũrũri wa Filistia.”
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

kikuyu: no Ngai nĩatũguũrĩirie maũndũ macio na ũndũ wa Roho wake. Roho nĩathuthuuragia maũndũ mothe, o na maũndũ ma Ngai marĩa marikĩru mũno.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩiga imwe nginya rũciinĩ, o ta ũrĩa maathĩtwo nĩ Musa, nacio itiigana kũnunga, kana kũgĩa na igunyũ.
english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa kũgĩa na ciana, o na ciana cia ciana cianyu, na mũkorwo mũtũũrĩte bũrũri ũcio ihinda iraaya, mũngĩgacooka mwĩthũkie mwĩthondekere mũhianano mũicũhie wa mũthemba o na ũrĩkũ, na mwĩke maũndũ mooru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova Ngai wanyu, mũtũme arakare-rĩ,
english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

kikuyu: Mwĩrĩ wothe ũngĩkorwo no riitho-rĩ, kũigua tũngĩiguaga na kĩ? Mwĩrĩ wothe ũngĩkorwo no gũtũ-rĩ, kũnungĩra tũngĩnungagĩra na kĩ?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ihinda rĩu nĩrĩo rĩgaakorwo rĩrĩ rĩa kũherithanio, nĩguo maũndũ marĩa mothe mandĩkĩtwo mahingio.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Atũmaga wathani wake ũkinye gũkũ thĩ; kiugo gĩake kĩhanyũkaga narua mũno.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

kikuyu: Watho o ro ũmwe nĩguo ũrĩhũthagĩrwo harĩ mũndũ o wothe ũkehia atekwenda, arĩ Mũisiraeli ũciarĩirwo kwanyu kana arĩ mũgeni.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

kikuyu: Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda akĩruta ndegwa 1,000 na ngʼondu na mbũri 7,000 nĩ ũndũ wa kĩũngano kĩu, nao anene makĩmahe ndegwa 1,000 na ngʼondu na mbũri 10,000. Athĩnjĩri-Ngai aingĩ mũno magĩĩtheria.
english: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

kikuyu: Angĩkaaruta gatũrũme-rĩ, nĩagakaneana mbere ya Jehova.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

kikuyu: Nĩahaarĩirie nyama, na akahaarĩria ndibei,* o na akaara metha yake.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

kikuyu: “Ariũ a Baba, o na inyuĩ maithe makwa, thikĩrĩriai ngĩĩyarĩrĩria.”
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

kikuyu: Kuuma kũu tũgĩthiĩ Filipi, kũrĩa gwathagwo nĩ andũ a Roma, na nĩrĩo rĩarĩ itũũra rĩrĩa inene rĩa bũrũri ũcio wa Makedonia. Na tũgĩikara kũu mĩthenya ĩtaarĩ mĩingĩ.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

kikuyu: ūtaganu ūringanaga na mūthemba wa mūembe
english: Spacing depends on the mango variety you’re growing.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo andũ othe a itũũra nao nĩmakamũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto nginya akue. No nginya mũniine ũũru ũcio wehere gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu. Ũhoro ũcio nĩũkaiguuo nĩ andũ a Isiraeli othe nao meetigĩre.
english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

kikuyu: Koine-inĩ icio cierĩ no nginya ikorwo irĩ mbaũ igĩrĩ igĩrĩ kuuma thĩ nginya igũrũ, na ciohanio na mũrĩnga ũmwe; koine cierĩ igakorwo itariĩ ũguo.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũkĩĩgu aitũrũraga marakara make mothe, no mũndũ mũũgĩ aikaraga amarigĩrĩirie, akahoorera.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũiguaga agĩtaarwo arĩ njĩra-inĩ ya muoyo, no mũndũ ũrĩa ũregaga kũrũithio-rĩ, nĩahĩtithagia andũ arĩa angĩ.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

kikuyu: Akĩiga mbũtũ ciake cia kũrangĩra ũthamaki wa Asuriata kũu Dameski, nao Asuriata magĩtuĩka a gwathagwo nĩwe na makamũrutagĩra igooti. Jehova nĩaheire Daudi ũhootani kũrĩa guothe aathiiaga.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Nake mũthamaki wa Isiraeli akĩĩra Jehoshafatu atĩrĩ, “Githĩ ndikwĩrire atĩ ndarĩ hĩndĩ angĩn- dathĩra ũhoro mwega, tiga o ũrĩa mũũru?”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

kikuyu: Mũthenya wothe ndindaga ndambũrũkĩirie moko makwa kũrĩ andũ aremi, arĩa matathiiaga na mĩthiĩre mĩega, no marũmagĩrĩra mathugunda mao:
english: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

kikuyu: Handa mīūngūrwa īrīa īnahinya mītheri.
english: Only transplant healthy seedlings.

kikuyu: We Kiugo agĩtuĩka mũndũ na agĩtũũrania na ithuĩ. Nĩtuonete riiri wake, riiri wa Mũrũ wake wa Mũmwe, ũrĩa woimire kũrĩ Ithe aiyũrĩtwo nĩ ũtugi na ũhoro wa ma.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born‡ Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

kikuyu: Ndúbatie gúthika múmera makíria ma 4cm tondú nocigie mímera yaku ya waru na úgúo kúnyihia magetha.
english: Never bury new plants deeper than 4cms, as this may stress or suffocate the plant and will bring an enormous decrease in yield.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jesũ akĩambĩrĩria ũtungata wake aarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka ta mĩrongo ĩtatũ. Nao andũ meeciiragia atĩ aarĩ mũrũ wa Jusufu, mũrũ wa Heli,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

kikuyu: Ndarigiicĩirio nĩ ndũrĩrĩ ciothe, no tondũ wa kwĩhoka rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova, ngĩciananga.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: “Tũhei kĩrĩra, na mũtue itua. Tũmai kĩĩruru kĩanyu gĩtuĩke ta ũtukũ, o kũrĩ mũthenya barigici. Hithai arĩa maingatĩtwo kwao, na mũtigakunyanĩre arĩa moorĩire kwanyu.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

kikuyu: Kũmenyerera mũthenya ũyũ nĩkuo kũrĩtuĩkaga ta rũũri guoko-inĩ gwaku, na kĩririkania ũthiũ-inĩ waku, atĩ watho wa Jehova nĩũrĩikaraga iromo-inĩ ciaku. Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩakũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri na guoko gwake kwa hinya.
english: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand Yahweh has brought you out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Kristũ ũyũ, Mũthamaki wa Isiraeli-rĩ, ta nĩakĩharũrũke rĩu oime mũtharaba-inĩ, nĩguo tuone twĩtĩkie.” O nao arĩa maambanĩirio hamwe nake, makĩmũruma.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.”§ Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Jeroboamu, mbaara ciake, na ũrĩa aathanire, nĩmandĩke ibuku-inĩ rĩa athamaki a Isiraeli.
english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũtiĩkĩrĩte iria hinyaru hinya, kana mũkahonia iria ndwaru, o na kana mũkooha iria ndiihie. Mũtihũndũrĩte iria itururĩte, kana mũgacaria iria ciũrĩte. Mũciathĩte na hinya, o na mũtarĩ na tha.
english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

kikuyu: Ihinda-inĩ o rĩu gĩkundi kĩnene kĩa Ayahudi gĩkĩmenya atĩ Jesũ aarĩ kũu na gĩgĩũka, na gĩtiokire nĩ ũndũ wa Jesũ tu, no ningĩ nĩgeetha kĩone o na Lazaro ũcio aariũkĩtie kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Kana nĩ kĩĩ mũndũ angĩkũũrania na muoyo wake?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: O ũguo, noguo athuuri magĩrĩirwo nĩ kwenda atumia ao o taarĩ mĩĩrĩ yao ene. Mũndũ ũrĩa wendete mũtumia wake nĩwe mwene wĩyendete.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

kikuyu: Nake Kirisipo, ũrĩa warĩ mũtongoria wa thunagogi, agĩĩtĩkia Mwathani hamwe na nyũmba yake yothe; na andũ aingĩ a Korinitho arĩa maamũiguire akĩaria magĩĩtĩkia na makĩbatithio.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa arutwo acio angĩ ikũmi maiguire ũhoro ũcio, makĩrakarĩra arutwo acio eerĩ a nyina ũmwe.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

kikuyu: o na ũrĩa eekire Dathani na Abiramu, ariũ a Eliabu ũrĩa Mũrubeni, rĩrĩa thĩ yamaathamĩirie kanua kayo marĩ gatagatĩ ka andũ a Isiraeli othe, thĩ ĩkĩmameria hamwe na nyũmba ciao, na hema ciao, na kĩrĩa gĩothe maarĩ nakĩo.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũndũ o mũndũ witũ nĩaheetwo wega wa Ngai, kũringana na ũrĩa Kristũ aheanaga.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Zedekia mũrũ wa Kenaana nĩathondekete hĩa cia kĩgera, nake akiuga atĩrĩ, “Jehova ekuuga ũũ: ‘Ici nĩcio mũgaatheeca Asuriata nacio nginya mũmaniine.’ ”
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’ ”

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa wonete ũũgĩ, mũndũ ũcio wĩgĩĩrĩire na ũmenyo,
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, kwa ihinda iraaya Isiraeli matiarĩ na Ngai ũrĩa wa ma, na matiarĩ na mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai wa kũmaruta na matiarĩ na watho wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

kikuyu: Mũgoocei, inyuĩ igũrũ rĩa igũrũ, o na inyuĩ maaĩ ma kũu igũrũ wa matu.
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

kikuyu: Nogūkoruo na itūmi nyingī ingītwīra nīkīī mūgūnda wa marigū wahūthīkaga kahinda karaihu mīaka ya thutha; mīrīmū yarī mīnini, (mūrimū ta Xanthomonas wilt ndīarīkuo) tīīrī warī mūnoru gukīra rīu na ūrūgarī dwarī mūingi.
english: There could be several reasons to explain why banana fields used to last longer in the past, such as less disease pressure (e.g. diseases like Xanthomonas wilt were not yet present), soil fertility was not as depleted as it is currently, and global warming was not as intense as it is now.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩiga thanju icio oonũrĩte mĩtaro-inĩ yothe ĩrĩa yanyuuagĩrwo maaĩ, nĩgeetha ikoragwo irĩ mbere ya mbũri rĩrĩa cioka kũnyua maaĩ. Rĩrĩa ndũũru icio ciakorwo irĩ na mũrukĩ na cioka kũnyua maaĩ-rĩ,
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

kikuyu: Nĩmahinganĩtie ngoro ciao nyũmũ, na tuo tũnua twao tũkaaria na mwĩgaatho.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

kikuyu: Ng'ombe hingīre nīngitīre kuuma kūrī thū. Ningī nī kūhonokagia ihinda rīa kūrīithia, ūguo ihinda rīu rīkahūthīka kūruta wīra ūngī.
english: • The animals are kept inside which is more secure and protect them from attack by predators • Little or no time is spent on herding the animals. Therefore labour for other farm tasks is saved

kikuyu: Rĩĩaga gĩcunjĩ kĩu ta kĩndũ kĩamũre mũno; mũndũ mũrũme o wothe wa nyũmba yaku nĩagakĩrĩĩaga. Wee no nginya ũtuage atĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩu nĩ kĩamũre.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jeroboamu mũrũ wa Nebati aiguire ũhoro ũcio (aarĩ o Misiri, kũrĩa oorĩire eherere Mũthamaki Solomoni), akiuma Misiri, akĩinũka.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo nĩnjĩhĩtie-rĩ, nĩ atĩa niĩ ngwĩkĩte, Wee mũrori wa andũ? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte ũnjorote? Kaĩ nduĩkĩte mũrigo harĩwe?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

kikuyu: Wee mwarĩ wa Babuloni, o wee ũtuĩrĩirwo kũniinwo, gũkena nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũgũgwĩka o ta ũguo ũtwĩkĩte:
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

kikuyu: Mũtongoria wa nyũmba cia mbarĩ cia Akohathu aarĩ Elizafani mũrũ wa Uzieli.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ nĩ wega wa Ngai watũmire mũhonokio nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia, naguo ũndũ ũcio nduoimanire na inyuĩ ene, no nĩ kĩheo kĩa Ngai,
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

kikuyu: Ngĩoya kobi ĩmwe ya marũa macio ma kuonania nũũ mwene gĩthaka, ĩcinĩrĩirwo mũhũũri wakwa na ĩkandĩkwo maũndũ ma ũrĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩu gĩatariĩ, hamwe na kobi ya marũa macio mataarĩ macinĩrĩre mũhũũri,
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

kikuyu: “Iguai ciugo ciakwa, inyuĩ andũ aya oogĩ; thikĩrĩriai, inyuĩ amenyi a maũndũ.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

kikuyu: Ngai aroraga ciana cia andũ arĩ o igũrũ, one kana nĩ harĩ ũrĩ na ũmenyo, o na kana nĩ harĩ ũrongoragia Ngai.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa thĩ na andũ ayo othe maathingitha, nĩ niĩ nyiitagĩrĩra itugĩ ciayo ngacirũmia.
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kikuyu: “Kaĩ ũrĩ gũteithia ũrĩa ũtarĩ na ũhoti-ĩ! Kaĩ ũrĩ kũhonokia guoko kũrĩa gũtarĩ na hinya-ĩ!
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

kikuyu: Ũrute Harũni nguo ciake, ũcihumbe mũriũ Eleazaru, nĩ ũndũ Harũni nĩegũkua, na egũkuĩra o ro kũu.”
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, inyuĩ ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndamũthaitha thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani witũ Jesũ Kristũ, atĩ inyuothe mũiguane o mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ, nĩguo mũtikagĩe na nyamũkano gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu, no mũikare mũiguanĩte, na mũrĩ na meciiria o mamwe, na ngoro o ĩmwe.
english: Now I beg you, brothers,‡ through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

kikuyu: Ningĩ moe mahiga mangĩ make namo mathenya macio mamomoretwo, na macooke moe rĩũmba rĩerũ mathinge nyũmba ĩyo narĩo.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

kikuyu: Iburahĩmu agĩtuĩkana na agĩkua arĩ mũthuuri mũniaru, arĩ mũkũrũ na akaingĩhia mĩaka, agĩthikwo hamwe na andũ ao arĩa maakuĩte.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũtigũcirĩa o mũthenya ũmwe, kana mĩthenya ĩĩrĩ, kana ĩtano, kana ikũmi, kana mĩthenya mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ,
english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

kikuyu: Mahuti meethī na maruru makoragwo na macumbī maingī kurī marīa makūrū, momū na marī na rangi wa ngoikoni.
english: Young dark green forage tends to have more minerals than old, dry and yellow forages.

kikuyu: Gūthuura. Mītwe irīa mīthūku na mīrwarū ibatīe nī gūteo.
english: Sorting: Damaged and diseased heads are discarded

kikuyu: Mboga īkūraga na mīeri 2-5 kuuma gūthamia tuta-inī kūringana na mūthemba kana kūrīa īkūrīirio.
english: Maturity Period: 2.5 – 4 months after transplanting depending on variety and location

kikuyu: Mĩhũmũ yake nĩ ta rũũĩ rũratherera na hinya rũkambata rũgakinya o nginya ngingo. Athũngũthagia ndũrĩrĩ gĩcungi-inĩ kĩa mwanangĩko; ekagĩra andũ matamu kanua nĩgeetha amahĩtithie.
english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio thigari igĩthiĩ ikiuna magũrũ ma mũndũ wa mbere ũrĩa mambanĩirio na Jesũ na igĩcooka ikiuna ma ũcio ũngĩ.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

kikuyu: Githĩ tũtiakwĩrire tũrĩ o bũrũri wa Misiri atĩ ũtigane na ithuĩ, ũreke tũtungatĩre andũ a bũrũri wa Misiri? Kũngĩarĩ wega tũtungatĩre andũ a Misiri kũrĩ gũkuĩra werũ-inĩ!”
english: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

kikuyu: “Mũrutani, Musa aatwĩrire atĩ mũndũ angĩkua atarĩ na ciana, mũrũ wa nyina no nginya ahikie mũtumia ũcio wa ndigwa, nĩguo aciarĩre mũrũ wa nyina ciana.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring† for his brother.’

kikuyu: Matunda ma ngowe magarūrūkaga rangi meruha magakorwo ma orange na ngoikoni.
english: The fruits are orange to yellow-coloured when ripe.

kikuyu: Nī mītheba īrīkū ya irio yagīrīire kūheo ng'ombe cia iria rīrīa īrī thīnī wa dry period, kana rīrī itarakamwo?
english: What are the nutritional requirements for dairy cows during the dry period?

kikuyu: Rīma ūthiūrūrūkīirie mītī ūkīmunyaga ria rīothe.
english: Cultivate around the trees to keep them weed free.

kikuyu: (No Ogu mũthamaki wa Bashani wiki watigarire harĩ matigari ma Arefai. Gĩtanda gĩake kĩarĩ gĩa cuuma, na kĩarĩ na ũraihu wa makĩria ma buti ikũmi na ithatũ,* na wariĩ wa buti ithathatũ.† Gĩtanda kĩu kĩrĩ o kũu Raba kwa Aamoni.)
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits† was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka andũ arĩa etĩĩi nĩmahakĩte gĩko na ndeto cia maheeni, ngũtũũra nũmĩtie mawatho maku na ngoro yakwa yothe.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

kikuyu: Na hau mbere yake nĩ haarĩ na mũndũ warũarĩte mũrimũ wa kũimba mwĩrĩ.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa aingĩ ũmagaĩre igai inene, nao arĩa maanyiiha ũmagaĩre igai inini; o mũhĩrĩga ũheo igai rĩaguo kũringana na mũigana wa andũ arĩa maandĩkĩtwo.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

kikuyu: ingĩkorwo ndanarũmbũiya riũa rĩarĩte, kana mweri ũgĩthiĩ ũcangararĩte,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

kikuyu: Wee nĩwe wekĩrire mũhaka ũrĩa matangĩkĩra; gũtirĩ hĩndĩ magaacooka kũhumbĩra thĩ.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

kikuyu: Rūūru rūkoragwo na ngūkū cia mīhīrīga yothe na riika itiganu.
english: The flock contains birds of different types and different ages.

kikuyu: Mũngĩrũmbũiya mawatho macio na mũmamenyerere mũmarũmĩrĩre, nake Jehova Ngai wanyu nĩarĩigaga kĩrĩkanĩro gĩake kĩa wendo na inyuĩ, o ta ũrĩa eehĩtire mbere ya maithe manyu.
english: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

kikuyu: Maraaraga njaga nĩ kwaga nguo; matirĩ kĩndũ gĩa kwĩhumbĩra rĩrĩa kwagĩa heho.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩkanĩro kĩanyu kĩrĩa mwarĩkanĩire na gĩkuũ nĩgĩgathario; ũiguano wanyu na mbĩrĩra ndũkehaanda. Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa iherithia ta rĩa kĩguũ rĩkaamũhubanĩria, nĩmũgatoorio nĩrĩo.
english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol‡ shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

kikuyu: Thumu úria uri tírí íní útarabutha úbatie kweherio naihenya.
english: Also, organic matter in the ground that does not decompose quickly must be removed.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ciugo ciaingĩha mehia matiagaga, no mũndũ ũrĩa ũkiraga nĩ mũũgĩ.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

kikuyu: “Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, Ngai wa Isiraeli, ekuuga atĩrĩ: Thiĩ ũkeere andũ a Juda na arĩa othe matũũraga Jerusalemu atĩrĩ: ‘Kaĩ inyuĩ mũtangĩĩruta ũndũ nĩguo mwathĩkĩre ciugo ciakwa?’ ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩmathĩnĩkĩte nĩ ũndũ wa wagi na ngʼaragu, ũtukũ-rĩ, moorũũraga bũrũri mũngʼaru, bũrũri mwanangĩku ũkirĩte ihooru.
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩaherithĩtie mũno, no ndandekereirie ngue.
english: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

kikuyu: Ti wega kũgĩa na kĩyo hatarĩ na ũmenyo, ningĩ kũhĩkĩka mũno gũtũmaga mũndũ ahĩtie njĩra.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũũgĩ angĩthiĩ igooti-inĩ na mũndũ mũkĩĩgu, mũndũ mũkĩĩgu arĩrĩmbũkaga nĩ marakara na akanyũrũrania, naguo thayũ ũkaaga.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

kikuyu: Gūthuthuria gūkū gūteithaiga wanangi wa irio kana kūhe ng'ombe irio nini o na nīngī nīgūgateithia kūmenya rīrīa mūrimū ūracema ng'ombe.
english: This will also avoid overfeeding/underfeeding of the cow and detection of health challenges on time.

kikuyu: (“Naarĩ korwo ndaarĩ na mũndũ wa kũnjigua! Rĩu nĩndekĩra rũũri rwa kwĩyarĩrĩria: reke Mwene-Hinya-Wothe anjookerie ũhoro; reke mũũthitangi andĩke marũa ma thitango yake.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

kikuyu: Ha ũhoro ũkoniĩ Dameski: “Hamathu na Aripadi nĩamaku, nĩ ũndũ nĩmaiguĩte ndeto njũru. Nĩmorĩtwo nĩ hinya, makaagaaga ta maaĩ ma iria.
english: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.
