kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũiguagĩra athĩĩni tha nĩ Jehova akombagĩra indo, nake Jehova nĩakamũrĩha nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa ekĩte.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.

kikuyu: Marĩ ha anabii acio aku, acio maakũrathĩire ũhoro atĩrĩ, ‘Mũthamaki wa Babuloni ndagagũtharĩkĩra wee o na kana bũrũri ũyũ’?
english: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land’?

kikuyu: Arĩithi matiĩciiragia, na matituĩragia ũhoro harĩ Jehova; nĩ ũndũ ũcio matigaacagĩra, nacio ndũũru ciao ciothe cia mbũri nĩihurunjũkĩte.
english: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.

kikuyu: Agaatuĩka ta mũthabibũ ũhũrũrĩtwo thabibũ ciaguo itarĩ njĩru, ahaane ta mũtamaiyũ ũraita kĩro kĩaguo.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

kikuyu: Tiga kwenda toro, ndũkae gũthĩĩna; ikaraga wĩiguĩte, na nĩũrĩrĩĩaga irio ũkahũũna.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, Ngai nĩamũtũũgĩririe o nginya igũrũ mũno, na akĩmũhe rĩĩtwa rĩrĩa rĩkĩrĩte marĩa mangĩ mothe,
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

kikuyu: Mũthamaki nake agĩtũma Jehudi agĩĩre ibuku rĩu rĩa gĩkũnjo, nake Jehudi akĩrĩrehe kuuma kanyũmba-inĩ ka Elishama, ũrĩa mwandĩki, akĩrĩthomera mũthamaki na anene acio othe marũgamĩte hau harĩ mũthamaki.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo watho ũrĩa Musa aaheire andũ a Isiraeli maũrũmagĩrĩre.
english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Paũlũ na Baranaba moimaga thunagogi, andũ makĩmeera moke mũthenya ũrĩa warũmĩrĩire wa Thabatũ nĩguo mathiĩ na mbere kwaria ũhoro ũcio.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

kikuyu: “Nĩgũkorwo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Ndĩ hakuhĩ gũkũneana kũrĩ acio ũthũire, ngũneane kũrĩ acio wamenire ũkĩmahutatĩra.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.

kikuyu: O akĩaragia-rĩ, itu ikengu rĩgĩũka rĩkĩmahumbĩra, na mũgambo ũkiuma itu-inĩ rĩu ũkiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ nĩwe Mũrũ wakwa ũrĩa nyendete; na nĩngenagio mũno nĩwe. Mũiguagei!”
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mũgwanja, mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũcio nĩakarora ũhere ũcio o rĩngĩ, na angĩkorwo ndũthegeete ngoothi-inĩ na ndũkuoneka ũrikĩire gũkĩra ngoothi-rĩ, mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũcio nĩagatua atĩ mũndũ ũcio ndarĩ na thaahu. No no nginya athambie nguo ciake, na nĩagatuĩka ndarĩ na thaahu.
english: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

kikuyu: Wega na thayũ irogĩa kũrĩ inyuĩ ciumĩte kũrĩ Ngai Ithe witũ na Mwathani Jesũ Kristũ.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩmũtaarĩria wĩra wa ikundi cia athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na wa Alawii, na wĩra wothe wa ũtungata thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova, o na wa indo ciothe cia kũhũthagĩrwo ũtungata-inĩ wayo.
english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio kũngĩkorwo na mũndũ wanyu ũhĩtĩirio maũndũ-inĩ ta macio- rĩ, no mũthuure o na andũ matangĩtĩĩka kanitha-inĩ matuĩke a kũmũciirithia!
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

kikuyu: Mbũtũ ciake cia ita injerekagĩra na hinya; ciakaga ihumbu cia kũnjũkĩrĩra, igathiũrũrũkĩria hema yakwa.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

kikuyu: Eheria īgunyū iria ithegethaga mītī ta yellow headed borer
english: Eliminate wood boring insect pests e.g. yellow headed borer.

kikuyu: Protein īngīnyiha o rīmwe irio-inī, iria rikanyiha na ng'ombe īkahīnja, nacio njaū na mori igakūra kahora.
english: If the amount of protein in ration is suddenly reduced, milk production will drop rapidly and the cow will lose weight, growth rate of calves and heifers will be reduced also.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũhinyagĩrĩria athĩĩni nĩkũnyarara anyararaga Ũrĩa wamombire, no ũrĩa wothe ũiguagĩra athĩĩni tha, nĩ Ngai atĩĩaga.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩ mwega harĩ andũ othe; nĩaiguagĩra tha kĩrĩa gĩothe ombĩte.
english: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ciahurunjũkire tondũ itiarĩ na mũrĩithi, na rĩrĩa ciahurunjũkire ĩgĩtuĩka irio cia nyamũ ciothe cia gĩthaka.
english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

kikuyu: Moima Dofika, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Alushu.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, maitho makwa nĩmekũhingũka, namo matũ makwa maigue mahooya marĩa mahooeirwo handũ haha.
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

kikuyu: Iga mūgūnda waku ūtarī na ihinga cia ria ūtangīkorwo ndūkwenda gūtheria na ūrenda gūthondeka imamo cia thū
english: • Keep the surroundings of your farm free of weeds, unless they are maintained and intended as habitat for natural enemies

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmũkamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, rĩrĩa ngaahingũra mbĩrĩra cianyu ndĩmwambatie muume kuo, inyuĩ andũ aya akwa.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

kikuyu: Mũtongoria mũnene wa Alawii aarĩ Eleazaru mũrũ wa Harũni, ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai. Nĩwe watuirwo mũrũgamĩrĩri wa arĩa maamenyagĩrĩra harĩa haamũre.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: We atũmaga nyeki ĩkũre nĩ ũndũ wa kũrĩĩo nĩ mahiũ, na agakũria mĩmera ĩrĩa andũ mahaandaga, tĩĩri-inĩ gũgakiumaga irio:
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

kikuyu: o ĩmwe ĩnyiitanĩte na ĩrĩa ĩngĩ, ũũ atĩ gũtirĩ rĩera rĩngĩtoonyera gatagatĩ ga cio.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

kikuyu: Ũmũ wa ngoro ciao ũtherũkaga o ũmaramari; meciiria mao mooru matirĩ mũhaka.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

kikuyu: Nao atumumu nĩngamagereria njĩra iria matooĩ, na ndĩmatoongorerie tũcĩra tũrĩa mataahũthĩrĩte gũthiĩra; nayo nduma nĩngamĩgarũra ĩtuĩke ũtheri mbere yao, nakuo kũndũ kũrĩa gũtarĩ kũigananu ndĩkwaraganie. Maũndũ macio nĩmo ngeeka, na ndikamatiganĩria.
english: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

kikuyu: No gīcigo kīa irathīro gīkūragia gīcunjī kīa mīrongo ītandatū na īmwe harī igana kīa maembe moothe, kīrūmīrīirwo nī gītaro kīa Rift Valley kīrīa gīkūragia gīcunjī kīa mīrongo ītatū harīa igana na gīcūa-inī kīrīa gīkūragia gīcunjī kīa mīrongo īrī na īnana harī igana.
english: But the generally arid eastern region produces 61 per cent of all mangoes, followed by Rift Valley at 30 per cent and Coast, which produces 28 per cent.

kikuyu: Jehova akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: Roho agĩcooka akĩnjoya na igũrũ akĩnjeheria, na niĩ ngĩthiĩ ndĩ na marũrũ na marakara ngoro-inĩ, nakuo guoko kwa Jehova kũrĩa kwa hinya kwarĩ igũrũ rĩakwa.
english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mbũtũ icio cia ita cia andũ a Babuloni kwehera kũu Jerusalemu nĩ ũndũ wa mbũtũ cia Firaũni,
english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

kikuyu: Rora ūgunyu wa tīīri ūriku-inī wa 10cm .
english: Check your soil moisture to a depth of 10 cm.

kikuyu: Handũ ha ũguo, Johanani mũrũ wa Karea hamwe na anene othe a mbũtũ cia ita magĩtongoria matigari mothe ma andũ a Juda, o acio macookete nĩguo maikare kũu bũrũri wa Juda moimĩte ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ ciothe kũrĩa mahurunjĩtwo.
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—

kikuyu: o na ningĩ Basemathu ũrĩa warĩ mwarĩ wa Ishumaeli na mwarĩ wa nyina na Nebaiothu.
english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

kikuyu: Magĩkĩĩra mũtumia ũcio atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ tũtiretĩkia no ũndũ wa ũrĩa ũratwĩrire; rĩu nĩtwĩiguĩrĩire ithuĩ ene na tũkamenya atĩ mũndũ ũyũ ti-itherũ nĩwe Mũhonokia wa kĩrĩndĩ.”
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo andũ a Isiraeli magĩatũkana ikundi igĩrĩ, nuthu ĩmwe makĩrũmĩrĩra Tibini mũrũ wa Ginathu atuĩke mũthamaki, nayo nuthu ĩyo ĩngĩ makĩrũmĩrĩra Omuri.
english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

kikuyu: No rĩu-rĩ, ũtitikithĩtio ituĩro rĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire arĩa aaganu; ituĩro rĩa ciira na kĩhooto nĩcigũkumbatĩte.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra na ma, ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ti- itherũ, o ta ũrĩa ndĩĩrahaga nĩ ũndũ wanyu thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ Mwathani witũ, atĩ niĩ nguaga o mũthenya.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

kikuyu: Rīūnūkaga na ūhūthū mūno.
english: Excellent peeling;

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, iga mũrangĩri kanua-inĩ gakwa, rangagĩra mũrango ũyũ wa mĩromo yakwa.
english: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe o na ũngĩkuhĩrĩria Hema-ĩyo-Nyamũre ya Jehova nĩegũkua. Kaĩ tũgũgĩkua ithuothe?”
english: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

kikuyu: Mīkorobia īkūraga wega gatagatī-inī ka mita 1500-2100 igūrū kūma iriainī, na 100mm cia mbura njega.
english: Avocado performs best between 1500-2100m a.s.l. with 1000 mm of well-distributed rainfall

kikuyu: arĩa mameetaga magongona-inĩ ma ngai ciao. Andũ acio a Isiraeli makĩrĩa na makĩinamĩrĩra mbere ya ngai icio.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

kikuyu: Mĩĩrĩ yothe ndĩhaanaine: Andũ marĩ mũthemba ũmwe wa mwĩrĩ, nacio nyamũ mũthemba ũngĩ, na nyoni mũthemba ũngĩ, o nacio thamaki irĩ mwĩrĩ wa mũthemba ũngĩ.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa rũheni rũhenũkaga rũkamũrĩka matu kuuma mũthia ũmwe nginya ũrĩa ũngĩ, no taguo gũũka kwa Mũrũ wa Mũndũ gũkahaana mũthenya ũcio wake.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki Asa agĩcooka akĩruta cũwe Maaka kuuma gĩtĩ-inĩ gĩake kĩa mũthamaki-mũndũ-wa- nja, nĩ ũndũ nĩathondekithĩtie gĩtugĩ kĩa mũhianano ũrĩ magigi wa Ashera. Asa agĩtemenga gĩtugĩ kĩu, agĩkiunanga na agĩgĩcinĩra Gĩtuamba-inĩ gĩa Kidironi.
english: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: na gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩa mbaara gĩthondeketwo gĩa gũgũũkĩrĩra gĩkaagaacĩra wĩra-inĩ wakĩo, na nĩũkahoota mũndũ ũrĩa ũkaaria ciugo cia gũgũthitanga. Rĩĩrĩ nĩrĩo igai rĩa ndungata cia Jehova, o naguo ũhoro wacio wa gũtuuo thingu uumaga harĩ niĩ,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: “Athĩkĩra Ngai ũikare ũrĩ na thayũ nake, ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo ũgaakũrehere ũgaacĩru.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũndũ o wothe agaakua nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make we mwene; ũrĩa wothe ũkaarĩa thabibũ irĩ rwagatha, nĩ magego make mwene makaigua thithi.”
english: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.

kikuyu: Handa mūmera mūthemba wa indian mastard (Brassica junce) gatagatī-inī ka raini cia mboga nīgūo kūhenereria kīhuruta gīa kīgunyū kīa mboga hamwe na DBM.
english: Plant Indian mustard (Brassica juncea) as a trap crop between several rows of common cabbage to attract most cabbage head caterpillar moths and some Diamondback moth (DBM) adults.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ aaganu matheerema, noguo mehia matheeremaga, no andũ arĩa athingu nĩmakerorera igwa rĩao.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

kikuyu: “ ‘Angĩkorwo o na mwekwo maũndũ macio mũtikanjigua-rĩ, ngaakĩrĩrĩria kũmũherithia nĩ ũndũ wa mehia manyu maita mũgwanja.
english: “ ‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Simeoni maarĩ Jemueli, na Jamini, na Ohadi, na Jakini, na Sohari, na Shauli ũrĩa warĩ mũriũ wa mũtumia Mũkaanani. Acio nĩo maarĩ mbarĩ cia Simeoni.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa onire atĩ andũ acio atatũ matiarĩ na ũndũ ũngĩ wa kuuga-rĩ, agĩakanwo nĩ marakara.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Nake Nathanieli akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ũnjũũĩ atĩa?” Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩngũkuonete o na rĩrĩa uuma rungu rwa mũkũyũ, Filipu atanagwĩta.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

kikuyu: Nake ũrĩa wamũkagĩra mbeũ ĩrĩa yagũire mĩigua-inĩ-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũiguaga kiugo, no mĩhangʼo ya mũtũũrĩre ũyũ, na kũheenererio nĩ ũtonga, igagĩthararia, ikagiria kĩgĩe na maciaro.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Ikoragwo arī nogu na itekwīigwa.
english: Tired and lifeless

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Abija, marĩa eekire na ũrĩa oigire-rĩ, nĩmandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa ũtaũranĩri rĩa mũnabii Ido.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo kũrĩa mĩthiithũ yanyu ĩrĩ, nokuo ngoro cianyu o nacio irĩĩkoragwo irĩ.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

kikuyu: Ndũgũcooka gwĩtwo Aburamu; ũrĩĩtagwo Iburahĩmu, nĩgũkorwo nĩngũtuĩte ithe wa ndũrĩrĩ nyingĩ.
english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: Ingīrūa na tūtambi mūthemba wa mbūmbūī ndūne atīa?
english: How to manage and control Red spider mites?

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ũyũ nĩguo ũhoro wa Esaũ (na nowe Edomu).
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩ ũndũ wa waganu warĩo, nĩrĩremeire mawatho makwa o na watho wakwa wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo gũkĩra ndũrĩrĩ na mabũrũri macio marĩthiũrũrũkĩirie. Nĩrĩregete mawatho makwa na rĩtirũmĩrĩire watho wakwa wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

kikuyu: Natharī cia mīkorobia ibatiī gūthondekwo haraya na mūgūnda wa mananathi nīūndū nīmo kīhumo kia mūrimū mūrū wa Phytopthora Cinnamoni.
english: Nurseries should be sited away from Pineapple fields as this is a source of Phytopthora cinnamoni infection.

kikuyu: No Ngai, nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoti wake, nĩakururagia arĩa marĩ hinya; o na mangĩĩhaanda wega-rĩ, matirĩ na mwĩhoko atĩ nĩmagatũũra muoyo.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

kikuyu: Athuuri amwe a bũrũri ũcio makĩrũgama hau mbere, makĩĩra ũngano ũcio wa andũ othe atĩrĩ,
english: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

kikuyu: Twanaigua na matũ maitũ Wee Ngai, tũkĩĩrwo nĩ maithe maitũ ũrĩa wekire matukũ-inĩ mao, o matukũ macio ma tene.
english: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

kikuyu: Rĩu nĩ kĩĩ wetereire? Ũkĩra, ũbatithio na ũthambio mehia maku, ũgĩkayagĩra rĩĩtwa rĩake.’
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

kikuyu: Nyũmba ĩrĩa mũrango wayo werekeire mwena wa gathigathini yarĩ ya ũraihu wa mĩkono igana* na wariĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano.†
english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits† was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Nĩngoretwo ndĩĩrirĩirie mũno kũrĩanĩra Bathaka ĩno na inyuĩ itananyariirwo.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

kikuyu: “Rwĩgĩ-rĩ, nĩwe ũrũhotithagia kũmbũka na ũũgĩ waku, kana gũtambũrũkia mathagu maruo rwerekeire mwena wa gũthini?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩndĩmacũthĩrĩirie ndĩmarehere ũũru, no ti ndĩmarehere wega; Ayahudi arĩa marĩ bũrũri wa Misiri nĩmakaniinwo na rũhiũ rwa njora na ngʼaragu, nginya othe mathire biũ.
english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

kikuyu: Magnesium no ībataranie kwa wūingī hanini makīria mieri-inī ya mbere thutha wa ng'ombe gūciara, kana rīrīa supplemental fat cikūongererwo irio-ini iria ng'ombe īraria, kana rīrīa mūrimū wa grass tetany weyumīria.
english: Higher magnesium levels may be required during early lactation, when supplemental fat is fed, or when grass tetany conditions occur.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ndokire-rĩ, nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũmire haage mũndũ o na ũmwe? Ningĩ rĩrĩa ndetanire-rĩ, nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũmire haage mũndũ o na ũmwe wanjĩtĩkire? Kaĩ guoko gwakwa gwakuhĩhĩte, nĩguo kũremwo nĩkũmũkũũra? Nĩ hinya njagĩte wa kũmũhonokia? Ikũũma rĩakwa riiki nĩrĩtũmaga iria rĩhũe, o na ngatũma njũũĩ ituĩke werũ; thamaki ciakuo ikabutha nĩ kwaga maaĩ, na igakua nĩ nyoota.
english: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.

kikuyu: “Nake nĩarigiicĩirio nĩ kĩrĩndĩ kĩingĩ kĩanegenaga gĩtekũmaka; andũ a Sabea* makĩrehwo kuuma werũ-inĩ, marĩ hamwe na gĩkundi kĩa andũ matarĩ igweta, nao magĩĩkĩra mũtumia ũcio na mwarĩ wa nyina bangiri moko, na makĩmekĩra tanji thaka mĩtwe.
english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki wa itũũra rĩa Hamathu arĩ ha, na mũthamaki wa Aripadi, na mũthamaki wa itũũra rĩrĩa inene rĩa Sefarivaimu, na wa Hena, na wa Iva, rĩu marĩ ha?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’ ”

kikuyu: Nĩndaheire Isiraeli ũcio wahutatĩire marũa ma gũtigana nake, ngĩmũingata nĩ ũndũ wa ũtharia ũcio wake wothe. No rĩrĩ, nĩndonire atĩ o na Juda, mwarĩ wa nyina ũcio ũtaarĩ mwĩhokeku, ndaarĩ na guoya; o nake nĩoimagarire, agĩthiĩ gũtharia.
english: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.

kikuyu: Nake Solomoni akĩamũra kũu gatagatĩ ka nja, hau mbere ya hekarũ ya Jehova, na hau nĩho aarutĩire magongona ma njino na maguta na magongona ma ũiguano, tondũ kĩgongona gĩa gĩcango kĩrĩa aathondekete gĩtingĩahotire kũiganĩra maruta ma njino, na maruta ma mũtu, na ma maguta.
english: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before Yahweh’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

kikuyu: “Rũmagiai maathani makwa na mũmarũmagĩrĩre. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: “O na gũtuĩka nĩwanangĩtwo ũgakira ihooru, o naguo bũrũri waku ũkonũhwo-rĩ, bũrũri ũcio nĩũkanyiiha wage kũiganĩra andũ arĩa matũũraga kuo, nao arĩa magũtambuurangĩte magaakorwo maingatĩtwo magathiĩ haraaya nawe.
english: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.

kikuyu: Mũrũgamie mbere ya Eleazaru ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na mbere ya kĩũngano gĩothe ũmũtue mũtongoria wao hau mbere yao.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

kikuyu: na ngoragwo ndĩ thĩinĩ wake, itarĩ na ũthingu wakwa mwene ũrĩa uumanaga na watho, no ũkorwo arĩ ũthingu ũrĩa uumanaga na gwĩtĩkia Kristũ; ũguo nĩ kuuga, ũthingu ũrĩa uumaga kũrĩ Ngai, na wonekaga na ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ningĩ andũ a Dedani nĩo mwonjorithanagia nao matandĩko ma mbarathi.
english: “ ‘ “Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.

kikuyu: Kuona atĩ thakame yayo ndĩnatoonyio thĩinĩ wa Handũ-hau-Hatheru-rĩ, nĩmũkwagĩrĩirwo nĩkũrĩĩra mbũri ĩyo Handũ-hau-Haamũre, o ta ũrĩa ndaathanire.”
english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

kikuyu: Arũme arĩa othe maathiĩte kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa itũũra rĩu inene magĩĩtĩkania na Hamoru na mũriũ Shekemu, na arũme othe a itũũra rĩu makĩrua.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Na ta ũrĩa twagĩire na mũhianĩre wa mũndũ ũcio wa tĩĩri-rĩ, noguo tũkaagĩa na mũhianĩre wa mũndũ ũcio wa kuuma igũrũ.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s† also bear the image of the heavenly.

kikuyu: Nake ahaicĩtie bendera handũ igũrũ eete ndũrĩrĩ iria irĩ kũraya, nao arĩa marĩ ituri cia thĩ ahuhaga biringi akĩmeeta.§ Nĩo aya mokĩte, matengʼerete na ihenya.
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, thuutha-inĩ nĩngacookia ũgaacĩru wa andũ a Amoni,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩũgaciamũra nĩgeetha ituĩke theru mũno makĩria, nakĩo kĩrĩa gĩothe gĩgacihutia nĩgĩgatuĩka gĩtheru.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

kikuyu: No Ngai nĩoĩ atĩ rĩrĩa mũkaarĩa matunda macio, maitho manyu nĩmakahingũka, mũtuĩke o ta Ngai, mũmenyage wega na ũũru.”
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

kikuyu: Aakũhooire atũũre muoyo, nawe ũkĩmũhe muoyo, ũkĩmũhe matukũ maingĩ atũũre nginya tene na tene.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

kikuyu: Maruta manyu marĩtuĩkaga ta ngano ĩrĩa ĩrutĩtwo kĩhuhĩro-inĩ, kana ndibei ĩrĩa ĩrutĩtwo kĩhihĩro-inĩ.
english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

kikuyu: Nake Petero akĩririkana ũhoro ũrĩa Jesũ aamwĩrĩte atĩrĩ, “Ngũkũ ĩtanakũga, ũrĩkorwo ũngaanĩte maita matatũ.” Akiuma nja, akĩrĩra mũno.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũrĩa ũtarĩ hamwe na niĩ, ũcio nĩ thũ yakwa, nake ũrĩa ũtacookanagĩrĩria hamwe na niĩ, ũcio nĩkũhurunja ahurunjaga.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ndũkanathengerere mũndũ-wa-nja mũkomanie rĩrĩa arĩ na thaahu wa hĩndĩ yake ya mweri.
english: “ ‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Musa nĩetĩkagĩria mũndũ aandĩkĩre mũtumia wake marũa ma gũtigana nake, amũte.”
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ othe a Isiraeli moonire atĩ mũthamaki ũcio nĩarega kũmathikĩrĩria, magĩcookeria mũthamaki atĩrĩ: “Tũrĩ na igai rĩrĩkũ harĩ Daudi, na nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩrĩkũ tũrĩ nakĩo harĩ mũrũ wa Jesii? Cooka hema-inĩ ciaku wee Isiraeli! Wee Daudi-rĩ, menyerera nyũmba yaku wee mwene.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ othe a Isiraeli makĩinũka.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩcemania na mũirĩtu gathirange itũũra-inĩ orĩtio ahikio, na mũndũ ũcio akome nake,
english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa Fowl typhoid: Ndariri nī ta ūrugarī kūingīha, kūharwo na gīkuū kia hi na hi. Mūrimū ūyū ūrehagwo nī njamuthi cia bacteria na no urigitwo na dawa cia kūūraga njamuthi.
english: Fowl Typhoid: Symptoms include high fever, diarrhea, and sudden death. It’s caused by bacteria and can be treated with antibiotics.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa anene a mbũtũ cia ngaari cia ita moonire Jehoshafatu magĩĩciiria atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ nĩwe mũthamaki wa Isiraeli” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩgarũrũka mamũtharĩkĩre, no Jehoshafatu agĩkaya, nake Jehova akĩmũteithia. Ngai akĩmaroria na kũngĩ, makĩmweherera,
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahweh helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

kikuyu: ndĩhokete o Ngai; ndingĩĩtigĩra. Mũndũ-rĩ, angĩnjĩka atĩa?
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: (“ ‘Ici nĩcio ciathĩ cia Jehova iria ciathanĩtwo, iria mũkaahunjanĩria irĩ ciũngano theru cia kũrehere Jehova maruta ma gũcinwo na mwaki, na nĩmo maruta ma njino, na maruta ma mũtu, na magongona na maruta ma kũnyuuo marĩa marĩbataranagia o mũthenya.
english: “ ‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

kikuyu: Ndakwĩra maũndũ ma gũkũ thĩ, waga gwĩtĩkia; ũngĩtĩkia atĩa ingĩkwĩra maũndũ ma na igũrũ?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

kikuyu: Ndikũmwarĩria ũhoro ũyũ ihinda iraaya, nĩgũkorwo mũnene wa gũkũ thĩ nĩarooka. We ndarĩ na hinya wa kũnjatha,
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Jehova arĩ hamwe na niĩ ta njamba ĩrĩ hinya; nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ arĩa maanyariiraga nĩmakahĩngwo na matikahootana. Nĩmagaconorithio mũno nĩgũkorwo matigaatooria; kũnyararwo kwao gũtikariganĩra o na rĩ.
english: But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.

kikuyu: Njĩra cia andũ arĩa aaganu nĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩ magigi harĩ Jehova, no nĩendete andũ arĩa mathingataga ũthingu.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

kikuyu: No mangĩaga gwĩtĩkia ciama ici cierĩ kana mage gũkũigua-rĩ, ũgaataha maaĩ kuuma Rũũĩ rwa Nili na ũmaite thĩ. Maaĩ macio ũgaataha kuuma rũũĩ nĩmagatuĩka thakame maitwo thĩ.”
english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”

kikuyu: Thĩ nĩyatũkangĩte, nĩ ũndũ gũtirĩ mbura yurĩte bũrũri-inĩ, arĩmi nao magakua ngoro, makehumbĩra mĩtwe.
english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũrũme wothe ũtarĩ mũruu, ũrĩa ũtaruithĩtio mwĩrĩ wake-rĩ, nĩakeherio harĩ andũ ao; ũcio ndahingĩtie kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa.”
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ mangĩgaagũtharĩkĩra-rĩ, niĩ ndigakorwo ũhoro-inĩ ũcio; na mũndũ o wothe ũgaagũtharĩkĩra-rĩ, ũcio nĩ kwĩneana akeeneana harĩwe.
english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

kikuyu: Nũũ ũũĩ hinya wa marakara maku? Nĩgũkorwo mangʼũrĩ maku nĩ manene o ta gwĩtigĩrwo kũrĩa wagĩrĩire.
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “O na niĩ nĩngũmũũria kĩũria. Mwanjookeria-rĩ, nĩngũmwĩra njĩkaga maũndũ maya na ũhoti ũrĩkũ.
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Nĩmarutĩire ndaimono magongona, iria itarĩ Ngai: ngai iria matooĩ, ngai iria cieyumĩrĩtie o ica-ikuhĩ, ngai iria iteetigĩrĩtwo nĩ maithe manyu.
english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

kikuyu: “Haha harĩ kahĩĩ karĩ na mĩgate ĩtano ya mũtu wa cairi na thamaki igĩrĩ nini, no ingĩkĩigana atĩa andũ marĩ aingĩ ũũ?”
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

kikuyu: Meciiria ma mũndũ mwaganu nĩ kĩndũ kĩrĩ magigi harĩ Jehova, no meciiria ma andũ arĩa atheru nĩmamũkenagia.
english: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũmwe rĩrĩa ahooyaga arĩ hekarũ-inĩ ya ngai yake Nisiroku-rĩ, ariũ ake eerĩ Adarameleki na Sharezeru makĩmũũraga na rũhiũ rũa njora, na makĩũrĩra bũrũri wa Ararati. Nake mũriũ Esari-Hadoni agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Mangiferin, īrīa yumaga kūrīembe nī īteithagīrīria mīrimū ya ngoro,na kūgirīrīria gūkua gwa cells na stress irīa irehagwo nī wagi wa rīera thīinī wa cells.
english: Mangiferin, an antioxidant found in mangoes, may protect heart cells against inflammation, apoptosis (controlled cell death), and oxidative stress.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩũũhonoketie kuuma gĩkuũ-inĩ, na ũkagirĩrĩria magũrũ makwa kũhĩngwo, nĩguo thiiage mbere ya Ngai ngĩonaga ũtheri ũrĩa wonagwo nĩ arĩa marĩ muoyo.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living. 57 For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave.

kikuyu: Nĩũũĩ ngiumagara o na ngĩkoma; Wee nĩũũĩ mĩthiĩre yakwa yothe.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩyo ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova ĩkoniĩ ndũrĩrĩ ĩrĩa yakinyĩrĩire mũnabii Jeremia:
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, nĩngũkũgooca na ngoro yakwa yothe; nĩngũgana maũndũ maku mothe ma magegania marĩa wĩkĩte.
english: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

kikuyu: Nathani agĩcookeria Daudi atĩrĩ, “Ũndũ ũrĩa ũreciiria gwĩka-rĩ, wĩke, nĩgũkorwo Ngai arĩ hamwe nawe.”
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

kikuyu: nake Buki aarĩ mũriũ wa Abishua, nake Uzi aarĩ mũriũ wa Buki, nake Zerahia aarĩ mũriũ wa Uzi,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

kikuyu: Na inyuĩ ngombo-rĩ, athĩkagĩrai aathani anyu a gũkũ thĩ maũndũ-inĩ mothe, na to hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maramuona atĩ nĩgeetha mamwende, no maathĩkagĩrei mũrĩ na ngoro itarĩ na ũhinga na nĩ ũndũ wa gũtĩĩa Mwathani.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

kikuyu: Nĩngamũrehithĩria rũhiũ rwa njora rũrĩhĩrie kĩrĩkanĩro kĩrĩa mũthũkĩtie. Muorĩra matũũra-inĩ marĩa manene manyu, nĩngamũrehithĩria mũthiro thĩinĩ wanyu, na ndĩmũrekererie moko-inĩ ma thũ cianyu.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: No mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai angĩgũra ngombo na mbeeca, kana ngombo ĩciarĩrwo gwake mũciĩ, ngombo ĩyo no ĩrĩe irio ciake.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, haarĩ na rũũru rũnene rwa ngũrwe rwarĩĩaga harũrũka-inĩ cia kĩrĩma kĩarĩ hakuhĩ na hau.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

kikuyu: Jehoiakimu aarĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtano rĩrĩa aatuĩkire mũthamaki, nake agĩthamaka arĩ Jerusalemu mĩaka ikũmi na ũmwe. Nĩekire maũndũ mooru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova Ngai wake.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũthamaki aikarĩra gĩtĩ gĩake kĩa ũnene atue ciira, maitho make mathũngũrũraga ũũru wothe.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũthenya ũcio-rĩ, nĩngatũma andũ moime harĩ niĩ marĩ na marikabu, mathiĩ makahahũre andũ a Kushi, moime mwĩcaaro-inĩ wao. Nĩmakanyiitwo nĩ ruo rwa ngoro mũthenya ũcio bũrũri wa Misiri ũkaaniinwo, nĩgũkorwo ti-itherũ nĩũgakinya.

english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũraika ũcio wamwarĩirie aathiire, Korinelio agĩĩta ndungata ciake igĩrĩ na mũthigari ũmwe weamũrĩire Ngai, na aarĩ ũmwe wa andũ arĩa maamũtungatagĩra.
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

kikuyu: na ũngĩgaakayũrũrũka na ũhooe gũkũũrana maũndũ, na wĩtane wanĩrĩire ũheo ũtaũku,

english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Werũ na matũũra makuo nĩmanĩrĩre na mĩgambo; o na tũtũũra tũrĩa Kedari atũũraga nĩtũkũngũĩre. Andũ a Sela nĩmarekwo maine rwĩmbo nĩ gũkena; o na mũreke maanĩrĩre marĩ kũu irĩma-igũrũ.
english: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

kikuyu: Rĩu-rĩ, Wee Jehova Ngai witũ, tũhonokie kuuma guoko-inĩ gwake, nĩgeetha mothamaki mothe ma thĩ mamenye atĩ Wee Jehova, o Wee wiki, nĩwe Ngai.”
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”

kikuyu: Nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa anene a Ayahudi makĩĩra Pilato atĩrĩ, “Tiga kwandĩka ‘Mũthamaki wa Ayahudi’, no andĩka atĩ mũndũ ũyũ nĩ kuuga oigire atĩ nĩwe mũthamaki wa Ayahudi.”
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa athingu nĩmakona ũguo metigĩre; nao magathekerera mũndũ ũcio, moige atĩrĩ,
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

kikuyu: Nĩngakũharaganĩria ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ, na ngũhurunjĩre mabũrũri-inĩ; na nĩngakinyia thaahu waku mũthia.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ ndaarĩkia gũthiĩ, njũũi ndĩĩani nĩigooka gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu na itigacaaĩra rũũru rũrũ.
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

kikuyu: Nyũmba yakwa nĩĩtharĩĩtio, ĩkeherio kũrĩ niĩ, o ta ũrĩa hema ya mũrĩithi yambũragwo. Nĩngũnjĩte muoyo wakwa ta ũrĩ taama wa mũndũ ũrĩa ũtumaga na mĩtambo, na rĩu nĩkũndinia ekũndinia anjeherie mũtambo-inĩ ũcio wake; mũthenya na ũtukũ-rĩ, ũtuĩkĩte o wa kũũniina.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩ mũthingu njĩra-inĩ ciake ciothe, na nĩendete kĩrĩa gĩothe ombĩte.
english: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Baranaba na Saũlũ maarĩkirie ũtungata wao-rĩ, magĩcooka kuuma Jerusalemu, na magĩ- cooka na Johana, na nowe wetagwo Mariko.

english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

kikuyu: Maciaro makwa nĩ mega gũkĩra thahabu ĩrĩa therie; uumithio wakwa nĩũkĩrĩte betha ĩrĩa njega.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩoya Ibuku rĩa Kĩrĩkanĩro, na akĩrĩthomera andũ. Nao andũ magĩĩtĩkanĩria, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũgwĩka ũrĩa wothe Jehova oigĩte; nĩtũgwathĩka.”
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

english: The priests went into the inner part of Yahweh’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in Yahweh’s temple into the court of Yahweh’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

kikuyu: Nĩcio iheaga nyamũ ciothe cia gĩthaka maaĩ ma kũnyua; nĩkuo njagĩ cia werũ-inĩ inyootoragĩrwo.
english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩndĩraigua njambanio ya andũ aingĩ; guoya mũnene ũkĩnyumaga na mĩena yothe; marathugunda manjĩke ũũru, makagĩa ndundu ya ũrĩa mangĩnjũraga.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩratha ũhoro o ta ũrĩa ndaathĩtwo. Na rĩrĩa ndaarathaga, hakĩgĩa na inegene, mũgambowagũkaragacana, namomahĩndĩmaciomagĩcookanĩrĩra, oihĩndĩrĩgĩcookereraihĩndĩrĩrĩa rĩagĩrĩire.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũcio andũ arĩa magaatigara a Isiraeli, o na arĩa makaahonoka a nyũmba ya Jakubu, matigacooka kwĩgiritania na ũcio wamahũũrĩte,* no makegiritania na Jehova o ma, o we Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’*

english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

kikuyu: Nĩũnjehereirie athiritũ akwa na arĩa nyendete; nduma nĩyo mũrata wakwa ũrĩa ũnguhĩrĩirie mũno.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: Mũrĩ kũu nĩmũkaririkana mĩtugo yanyu na ciĩko ciothe iria mwĩthaahĩtie nacio, na inyuĩ nĩmũkeemena nĩ ũndũ wa ũũru ũrĩa wothe mwaneeka.

english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

english: • Cut harvested stems into very small pieces to allow faster drying

english: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

english: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: “Ingĩkorwo thiiaga na njĩra itarĩ cia ma-rĩ, kana kũgũrũ gwakwa gũkahiũha thiĩ ngaheenanie-rĩ,
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

kikuyu: Ariũ a ithe magĩcooka magĩthiĩ kũrĩ we, makĩĩgũithia thĩ mbere yake, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Tũrĩ ngombo ciaku.”
english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

kikuyu: Lameku akĩĩra atumia ake atĩrĩ, “Ada na Zila, taa thikĩrĩriai; inyuĩ atumia a Lameku, ta iguai ciugo ciakwa. Nĩnjũragĩte mũndũ nĩ ũndũ wa kũndiihia, ngooraga mũndũ mwĩthĩ nĩ ũndũ wa kũnguraria.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũinamanagia maũndũ, mũũmbi ageciirĩrio nĩwe rĩũmba! Kĩrĩa kĩombirwo no kĩĩre mũkĩũmbi atĩrĩ, “Wee tiwe wanyũũmbire”? Nyũngũ no ĩĩre mũmĩũmbi atĩrĩ, “Wee ndũrĩ ũndũ ũũĩ”?
english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

kikuyu: “Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: O rĩngĩ nĩngetĩkĩra kũigua ithaithana rĩa andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli na ndĩmekĩre ũũ: Nĩngatũma andũ ao maingĩhe o ta rũũru rwa ngʼondu,
english: “ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

kikuyu: na mũtwĩre ũrĩa gũgaikara thuutha-inĩ, nĩguo tũmenye atĩ mũrĩ ngai. Ĩkai ũndũ mwega kana mũũru, nĩguo tũmake na tũiyũrwo nĩ guoya.
english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

kikuyu: arogoocwo thĩinĩ wa kanitha na thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ, o nginya njiarwa-inĩ ciothe, tene na tene! Ameni.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Nĩahaarĩirie indo ciake cia mbaara cia kũũragana; akahaarĩria mĩguĩ yake ĩkũrĩrĩmbũka mwaki.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, nĩ kwarĩ na maruta ma njino maingĩ mũno, hamwe na maguta ma maruta ma ũiguano, o na maruta ma indo cia kũnyuuo marĩa maarutanagĩrio na maruta ma njino. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio wĩra wa ũtungata wa hekarũ ya Jehova ũgĩcookio rĩngĩ.
english: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of Yahweh’s house was set in order.

kikuyu: Nĩngahurunja andũ a Misiri ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ, na ndĩmaharaganĩrie mabũrũri-inĩ. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.”
english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’ ”

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Jeduthuni: maarĩ Gedalia, na Zeri, na Jeshaia, na Shimei, na Hashabia, na Matithia; othe maarĩ atandatũ, marũgamĩrĩirwo nĩ ithe wao Jeduthuni, ũrĩa warathaga ũhoro, akĩhũũraga kĩnanda kĩa mũgeeto, agacookagĩria Jehova ngaatho na akamũgoocaga.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

kikuyu: Na mũkenagĩre Jehova Ngai wanyu mũrĩ handũ harĩa agaathuura ha gũtũũria Rĩĩtwa rĩake, inyuĩ, na ariũ anyu, na airĩtu anyu, na ndungata cianyu cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja, na Alawii arĩa marĩ matũũra-inĩ manyu, na andũ a kũngĩ, na ciana cia ngoriai, o na atumia a ndigwa arĩa matũũranagia na inyuĩ.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

kikuyu: Tondũ andũ a Isiraeli nĩ ndungata ciakwa, iria ndaarutire bũrũri wa Misiri, matikanendio matuĩke ngombo.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

kikuyu: Makoiga atĩrĩ, “Mũrungu angĩmenya atĩa? Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno nĩarĩ na ũmenyo?”
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

kikuyu: Rīrīa kwīna ūrugarī mūingī, he mīmera milimita 20-25 ya maaī harī o wiki ngīnyagia nuthu ya kīmera na thutha ūcio ūhe milimita 40-50 cia maaī
english: In hot days, apply 20 to 25 mm per week for the first third to half of the growing season and 40 to 50 mm per week thereafter

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngirie kũniina Baasha na nyũmba yake, na nĩngatũma nyũmba yaku ĩtuĩke ta ĩrĩa ya Jeroboamu mũrũ wa Nebati.
english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jakubu akĩmahe mawatho maya: “Ndĩ hakuhĩ gũkua. Mũgaathika harĩa maithe makwa mathikĩtwo, ngurunga-inĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ gĩthaka-inĩ kĩa Efironi ũrĩa Mũhiti,
english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

kikuyu: Nake Petero agĩthiĩ hamwe nao, na aakinya agĩtwarwo nyũmba ya igũrũ. Atumia othe a ndigwa makĩrũgama, makĩmũthiũrũrũkĩria makĩrĩraga, na makĩmuonagia kanjũ na nguo ingĩ iria Dorokasi aatumĩte rĩrĩa aarĩ nao.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wakwa ndehere nyama imwe cia ũguĩmi waku ndĩe nĩgeetha ngũrathime na kĩrathimo gĩakwa.” Jakubu akĩmũrehera nake akĩrĩa, na akĩmũrehera ndibei na akĩnyua.
english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

kikuyu: Mītī ītigagwo īkūre o urīa īkwenda, itagūcehwo kana kūgitīrwo kuumana na mīrimū, tūtambi, na maūndū mangī.
english: The trees are left to scatter on the farm and grow as they wish, without any activities like pruning, disease control, pest control, etc.

kikuyu: Jethero, mũthoni-we wa Musa, hamwe na mũtumia wa Musa na ariũ ake, magĩũka kũrĩ we kũu werũ-inĩ, kũrĩa aambĩte hema hakuhĩ na kĩrĩma kĩa Ngai.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩatũririkanĩte na nĩegũtũrathima: Nĩekũrathima nyũmba ya Isiraeli, nĩekũrathima nyũmba ya Harũni,
english: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mũgambo ũcio ndũnaaria nĩ ũndũ wakwa, no waria nĩ ũndũ wanyu.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

kikuyu: Nĩ ta maguta manungi wega maitĩrĩirio mũtwe, makĩnyũrũrũkĩra nderu-inĩ, o nderu-inĩ cia Harũni, makanyũrũrũka nginya ngingo-inĩ ya kanjũ yake.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka nĩakaanĩtie Solomoni kũrũmĩrĩra ngai ingĩ-rĩ, Solomoni ndaigana kũrũmia watho wa Jehova.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

kikuyu: Waru ūyu nī ūrī na stachi nyīngī īrīa ītūmaga īkorūo hūthu na nyūmīrīru.
english: These have a rich content of starch making them soft with a dry texture.

kikuyu: Ndũkanathĩĩnĩke ngoro nĩ ũndũ wa andũ arĩa ooru, kana wĩrirĩrie kũhaanana na arĩa aaganu,
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

kikuyu: Jehova nĩatuumĩrĩire matukũ-inĩ ma tene, agĩtwĩra atĩrĩ: “Niĩ ngwendete na wendo wa tene na tene; nĩngũguucĩrĩirie na ũtugi.
english: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

kikuyu: Nayo ngai ya mahinda maya, nĩtũmĩte meciiria ma andũ arĩa matetĩkĩtie matumane, nĩgeetha matigathererwo nĩ ũtheri wa Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega wa riiri wa Kristũ, o we ũrĩa arĩ we mũhaanĩre wa Ngai.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

kikuyu: Nĩũmũhingĩirie wendi wa ngoro yake, naguo ũndũ ũrĩa akũhooete na mĩromo yake ndũmũimĩte.
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Nĩ niĩ ndamoonagia njĩra, ngaikaraga ta ndĩ mũnene wao; ndatũũraga ta mũthamaki arĩ gatagatĩ ga ita rĩake; ningĩ ndaatariĩ ta mũndũ ũrĩa ũhooragĩria arĩa maracakaya.
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũndũ angĩkeendia nyũmba ĩrĩ itũũra-inĩ inene rĩirigĩre, nĩarĩkoragwo arĩ na kĩhooto gĩa kũmĩkũũra ihinda rĩa mwaka mũgima kuuma amĩendia. Thĩinĩ wa ihinda rĩu no amĩkũũre.
english: “ ‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

kikuyu: “No ũhote kũguucũrũria nyamũ ĩrĩa ĩĩtagwo Leviathani na ndwano, kana wohe rũrĩmĩ rwayo na mũkanda?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan† with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

kikuyu: Imwe cia mbegū iria ikoragwo kuo nī: Kenya Mavuno, Rudolph, Shangi, Sherekea, na Tigoni. Angī nī Ambition, Arizona, Arnova, Kenya Karibu, Dutch Robin na ingī.
english: Some of the seed varieties available are: Kenya Mavuno, Rudolph, Shangi, Sherekea, and Tigoni. Others include Ambition, Arizona, Arnova, Kenya Karibu, Dutch Robin among others.

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa Baba anjũũĩ, na niĩ ngamenya Baba, na nĩndutĩte muoyo wakwa nĩ ũndũ wa ngʼondu.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Nake mũraika wa Jehova agĩatha Gadi eere Daudi aambate athiĩ agaakĩre Jehova kĩgongona o kũu kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano kĩa Arauna ũrĩa Mũjebusi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Tũrĩ werũ-inĩ wa Kedemothu nĩndatũmire andũ kũrĩ Sihoni mũthamaki wa Heshiboni ngĩmũũria tũgĩe na thayũ, na ngĩmwĩra atĩrĩ,
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ndungata iria ingĩ cioonire ũrĩa gwekĩka-rĩ, ikĩigua ũũru mũno, igĩthiĩ ikĩĩra mwathi wacio ũrĩa wothe gwekĩkĩte.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

kikuyu: Kĩndũ o gĩothe kĩngĩkaagwĩrwo nĩ kĩimba kĩmwe gĩacio, nĩgĩkanyiitwo nĩ thaahu; riiko kana nyũngũ ya kũruga no nginya ciũragwo. Indo icio irĩ na thaahu, nacio indo icio nĩigatuĩka thaahu harĩ inyuĩ.
english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

kikuyu: ĩtataranĩirio na igooti rĩa athũgũri na onjorithia na ya kuuma kũrĩ athamaki a Arabia, othe, na abarũthi a bũrũri.
english: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli magĩtaha kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a ithe wao atumia 200,000 na ariũ na aarĩ ao. Ningĩ no maatahire indo nyingĩ iria maacookire nacio Samaria.
english: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩrĩa Johana aatetirie Herode ũrĩa warĩ mũthamaki tondũ wa kũhikia Herodia, mũtumia wa mũrũ wa ithe na nĩ ũndũ wa maũndũ marĩa mangĩ mothe mooru eekĩte,
english: but Herod the tetrarch,† being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s‡ wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũthamaki wa Ngai ti ũhoro wa kũrĩa na kũnyua, no nĩ wa ũthingu, na thayũ o na gĩkeno iria ciumaga kũrĩ Roho Mũtheru,
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Mūno makīria ūnyitaga ngūkū irī na ūkūrū wa ciumia igīrī nginya ciumia ikūmi, na ngūkū īka hinyīrīrīka na njīra nene.
english: It usually occurs at eight to 10 weeks of age and normally expresses itself in acute and chronic forms.

kikuyu: Magĩthiĩ matuĩkanĩirie gĩcigĩrĩra kĩu gĩothe nginya magĩkinya Pafo. Kũu magĩkora Mũyahudi warĩ mũragũri na mũnabii wa maheeni wetagwo Bari-Jesũ,
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

kikuyu: Nayo mĩtĩ ya mĩtitũ yake ĩgaatigara o mĩnini, atĩ o na mwana no andĩke mũigana wayo.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũũciongũmwĩra atĩrĩ, ũthingu wanyu waga gũkĩra ũrĩa wa Afarisai na wa arutani a watho, mũtigatoonya ũthamaki wa igũrũ o na atĩa.
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩũria Musa atĩrĩ, “Andũ aya megũtũũra maanyararĩte nginya-rĩ? Megũtũũra maregete kũnjĩtĩkia nginya-rĩ, o na ningĩte ciama nyingĩ ũguo gatagatĩ kao?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

kikuyu: Mũnene ũcio wa mbũtũ agĩthiĩ kũrĩ Paũlũ, akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ta njĩĩra atĩrĩ, wee ũrĩ raiya wa Roma?” Nake akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ĩĩ, ndĩ raiya wa Roma.”
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

kikuyu: We aarĩ kĩũngano-inĩ kũu werũ-inĩ, arĩ hamwe na mũraika ũrĩa wamwarĩirie Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sinai, na aarĩ hamwe na maithe maitũ; nake nĩamũkĩrire ciugo irĩ muoyo nĩgeetha atũkinyĩrie.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

kikuyu: Hĩ! Kũroaga gũtuĩka ũguo! Ithuĩ-rĩ, nĩtwakuire ũhoro-inĩ wa wĩhia; twakĩhota atĩa gũcooka gũtũũra thĩinĩ waguo?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli othe, arũme na andũ-a-nja arĩa meyendeire, nĩmareheire Jehova maruta ma kwĩyendera nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra ũrĩa Jehova aamaathĩte na kanua ka Musa marute.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ngoma ĩyo thũku ĩkagĩĩra ngoma ingĩ mũgwanja thũku makĩria mayo, igatoonya, igaikara kuo. Naguo mũikarĩre wa mũndũ ũcio ũgathũka gũkĩra wa mbere.”
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Makĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ nĩ mwana wanyu? Ũyũ nĩwe mũroiga aaciarirwo arĩ mũtumumu? Rĩu ahotete atĩa kuona?”
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

kikuyu: Githĩ niĩ ndirĩ na wĩyathi? Githĩ niĩ ndirĩ mũtũmwo? Githĩ niĩ ndionire Jesũ Mwathani witũ? Anga inyuĩ mũtirĩ maciaro ma wĩra wakwa thĩinĩ wa Mwathani?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

kikuyu: “Athamaki na mbũtũ cia ita moraga na ihenya; nakuo kambĩ-inĩ andũ magayanaga indo cia ndaho.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

kikuyu: Mũthamaki wa Isiraeli agĩcookeria Jehoshafatu atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kũrĩ mũndũ ũmwe ũrĩa ũngĩtũtuĩrĩria ũhoro kuuma kũrĩ Jehova, no nĩndĩmũthũire tondũ gũtirĩ hĩndĩ andathagĩra ũndũ mwega, no maũndũ mooru hĩndĩ ciothe. Nake nĩwe Mikaya mũrũ wa Imula.” No Jehoshafatu agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Mũthamaki ndagĩrĩirwo nĩ kuuga ũguo.”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

kikuyu: kũgerera we Ngai nĩatũheete wega wake, na agatũhe ũhoti ta atũmwo nĩguo twĩre andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ ciothe kũndũ guothe ũrĩa Ngai amekĩire, nĩguo mamwĩtĩkie na mamwathĩkĩre, nĩguo matũme rĩĩtwa rĩake rĩgoocagwo.
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

kikuyu: Thogora no ūkorūo ūri īgūrū ūngīkobora mūgūda taūninī.
english: The costs will also be higher if you lease land in urban areas.

english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Hezekia agĩathana atĩ kũrutwo iruta rĩa njino kĩgongona-inĩ. Narĩo igongona rĩambĩrĩria kũrutwo-rĩ, andũ makĩambĩrĩria kũinĩra Jehova marĩ na tũrumbeta na inanda cia kũina cia Daudi mũthamaki wa Isiraeli.
english: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki mwathi wakwa, andũ a Isiraeli othe nĩwe macũthĩrĩirie, nĩguo ũmamenyithie nũũ ũgaikarĩra gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene thuutha waku wee mũthamaki, mwathi wakwa.
english: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

kikuyu: itinga gúkara, tígíríra magúrú ní maceke níguo rítigathúkie mikaro íyo
english: When using a tractor, you need narrow wheels to ensure you do not break or destroy the ridges with the tyres.

kikuyu: Nyamũrĩra Alawii handũ ha marigithathi mothe ma andũ a Isiraeli; o naguo ũhiũ wa Alawii ũwaamũre handũ ha marigithathi mothe ma mahiũ ma andũ a Isiraeli. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.”
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am Yahweh—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: O na nĩndathondekire kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa nao atĩ nĩngamahe bũrũri wa Kaanani, kũrĩa maatũũraga marĩ ageni.
english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

kikuyu: Riũa nĩrĩkagarũrwo rĩtuĩke nduma, naguo mweri ũtuĩke ta thakame, mbere ya mũthenya ũcio mũnene wa Mwathani ũrĩa ũrĩ riiri gũkinya.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

kikuyu: “Mũrutani, Musa aatwandĩkĩire atĩ mũrũ wa nyina na mũndũ angĩkua atige mũtumia atarĩ na ciana- rĩ, mũndũ ũcio no nginya ahikie mũtumia ũcio watigwo, aciarĩre mũrũ wa nyina ciana.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩhĩtũka Misia, magĩikũrũka magĩkinya Teroa.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

kikuyu: Amwe anyu nĩmatuĩkĩte etĩĩi, makona ta itarooka kũu kũrĩ inyuĩ.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

kikuyu: Ngoro yakwa nĩĩnyiitĩrĩire harĩwe; guoko gwaku kwa ũrĩo gũkaanyiitĩrĩra.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

kikuyu: Thikĩrĩria gũkaya gwakwa, nĩgũkorwo ndĩĩmũhinyĩrĩrie mũno; ndeithũra kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa mathingatanĩte na niĩ, nĩgũkorwo marĩ na hinya mũno kũngĩra.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli othe arĩa maarĩ kĩanda moonire atĩ ita nĩrĩorĩte, na atĩ Saũlũ na ariũ ake nĩmakuĩte-rĩ, magĩtiganĩria matũũra mao, makĩũra; nao Afilisti magĩthiĩ magĩikara kuo.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Gĩkuũ na Mwanangĩko ciikaraga ciĩyanĩkĩte mbere ya Jehova, ĩ nacio ngoro cia andũ-rĩ, ikĩĩanĩkĩte atĩa!
english: Sheol† and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

kikuyu: Kīhuruta kīa diamond black kīngīgirīrīrio atīa kabici-inī?
english: How is diamondback moth controlled in cabbage?

kikuyu: Andũ acio nĩ arĩithi; marĩithagia mahiũ, na mokĩte na ndũũru ciao cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe, na indo ciothe ciao.
english: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

kikuyu: kana ũtonga ũrĩa ũthiraga na njĩra ya mũtino, atĩ angĩgaaciara kahĩĩ, gatirĩ kĩndũ kangĩgaya.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

kikuyu: Nake Jusufu agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ariũ a baba ndĩracaria. No ũnjĩĩre kũrĩa mararĩithia mbũri ciao?”
english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Jesũ aambataga Jerusalemu-rĩ, nĩetire arutwo ake arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ keheri-inĩ akĩmeera atĩrĩ,
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

kikuyu: Andũ othe nĩmagĩte meciiria na makaaga ũũgĩ; nake mũturi wa thahabu o wothe nĩaconorithĩtio nĩ mĩhianano ĩyo yake. Nĩ ũndũ mĩhianano ĩyo yake ya gwĩturĩra nĩ ya maheeni; ndĩrĩ mĩhũmũ thĩinĩ wayo.
english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

kikuyu: Hooyai Jehova, nĩgũkorwo nĩtũiganĩtie marurumĩ na mbura ya mbembe iria tuonete. Nĩngũmũrekereria mũthiĩ; mũtigũikara gũkũ rĩngĩ.”
english: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

kikuyu: Tigĩrĩra atĩ nĩ weka maũndũ mothe marĩa ngwathĩte; ndũkanongerere ũndũ kana ũrutarute.
english: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

kikuyu: Makīria ma ūū, rīrīa mbegū irenda irio kwa wūingī, bataraitha ya mathangū ya phosporous nīyagīrīire mūno kūhūrwo nīguo magetha maingīhe.
english: Especially during peak periods of demand, phosphorus foliar applications can increase coffee yields.

kikuyu: Gūkūria mīkorobia ya Hass nīkūrī ūhūthū nīūndū gūtibataraga mīrūtīre mīingī ya wīra kana ona mathaa maingī ma kūmītungata ta mīmera īngī ya biacara ta macani na kahūa.
english: Growing Hass avocado is easy and require less labor and time to maintain than the traditional cash crops like tea and coffee;

kikuyu: No ambe arute kabutu kayo hamwe na kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wako, agaikie mwena-inĩ wa irathĩro wa kĩgongona, harĩa mũhu ũitagwo.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

kikuyu: Lea agĩcooka akĩgĩa nda ĩngĩ, na agĩciarĩra Jakubu, kahĩĩ ga gatandatũ.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

kikuyu: Ĩkagai andũ arĩa angĩ o ũrĩa mũngĩenda mamwĩkage.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

kikuyu: Mũtego ũmũnyiitĩire ndiira-inĩ ya kũgũrũ; mũtego ũgakĩmũrũmia biũ.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Jerusalemu magĩtua Ahazia mũriũ wa Jehoramu ũrĩa warĩ mũnini mũno mũthamaki ithenya rĩake, nĩgũkorwo atharĩkĩri ao arĩa mookire kambĩ-inĩ hamwe na Arabu, nĩmooragĩte ariũ arĩa akũrũ othe. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Ahazia mũriũ wa Jehoramu mũthamaki wa Juda akĩambĩrĩria gũthamaka.
english: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

kikuyu: Nao nĩmagaikũrũka iharũrũka-inĩ cia Afilisti cia mwena wa ithũĩro; na marĩ hamwe nĩmagataha andũ a mwena wa irathĩro. Nĩmakenyiitĩra Edomu na Moabi, na nĩo magaathaga andũ a Amoni.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, nĩtũkũngũĩre Gĩathĩ, ti na ndawa ĩyo ya tene ya kũimbia mĩgate, ĩyo ya rũmena na ya waganu, no tũkũngũĩre na mũgate ũtarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia, o guo mũgate wa wĩhokeku na wa ũhoro wa ma.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũngĩrehe iruta rĩa mũtu rĩhĩhĩirio riiko, nĩrĩkorwo rĩrĩ rĩa mũtu mũhinyu mũno, keki irugĩtwo itarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia, itukanĩtio na maguta, kana tũmĩgate tũhũthũ tũtarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia tũhakĩtwo maguta.
english: “ ‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩĩra ndungata icio atĩrĩ, “Iyũriai ndigithũ maaĩ”; nacio ikĩiyũria riita.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

kikuyu: Maathani maku matũmaga njũhĩge gũkĩra thũ ciakwa, nĩgũkorwo makoragwo hamwe na niĩ hĩndĩ ciothe.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

kikuyu: Makĩnyiitithania itambaya ithano hamwe, na magĩĩka o ro ũguo na icio ingĩ ithano.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Tondũ andũ maramwĩra atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ mũniinũkagia andũ, na mũgatunya rũrĩrĩ rwanyu ciana ciaruo,”
english: “ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

kikuyu: Nī mīthemba īrīkū ya waru īrīa yagīrīire mūno kūrīma būrūri-inī wa Kenya?
english: What potato varieties are best suited for farming in Kenya?

kikuyu: “ ‘No rĩrĩ, ciana icio nĩcianemeire: Itiarũmĩrĩire kĩrĩra kĩa watho wakwa wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, o na kana ikĩmenyerera kũrũmia mawatho makwa, o na gwakorwo mũndũ ũrĩa ũmathĩkagĩra nĩagatũũrio nĩmo, nĩciathaahirie Thabatũ ciakwa. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngiuga nĩngũciitĩrĩria mangʼũrĩ makwa, na ndũme marakara makwa maciũkĩrĩre kũu werũ-inĩ.
english: “ ‘ “But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Magĩtwekia mĩrĩnga ya gĩcango ya kũnyiitĩrĩra mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraaya ya koine inya cia kĩrũtara gĩa gĩcango.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

kikuyu: Nĩngumbũra waganu wakwa; nĩthĩĩnĩtio nĩ mehia makwa.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, nĩtũgeragia na kĩyo muoroto witũ ũtuĩke wa kũmũkenia, twakorwo tũrĩ mwĩrĩ-inĩ ũyũ witũ o na kana twakorwo tuumĩte thĩinĩ waguo.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

kikuyu: Na rĩu ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, nĩngwenda mũmenye atĩ maũndũ marĩa mangorete ti-itherũ nĩmatũmĩte Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega ũthiĩ na mbere.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers,‡ that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

kikuyu: Ngirĩrĩriai na niĩ njarie, na ndaarĩkia kwaria-rĩ, mũgĩcooke mũũnyũrũrie.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩona ũndũ wa tũhũ gũkũ thĩ kwaraga riũa:
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

kikuyu: Mwaka-inĩ wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano wa mweri ũcio, kiugo kĩa Jehova nĩkĩanginyĩrĩire, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Nacio thigari§ ikĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Na ithuĩ-rĩ, twagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩkaga atĩa?” Nake agĩcicookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũtigatunyage andũ mbeeca na mũtikamaigagĩrĩre igenyo; na ningĩ iganagwoi nĩ mũcaara wanyu.”
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Njookererai, inyuĩ andũ aya mũũhutatĩire, nĩgũkorwo nĩ niĩ mũthuuri wanyu; nĩngamũcookanĩrĩria, ndute mũndũ ũmweitũũra-inĩrĩmwe, na angĩ eerĩ ndĩmarute mũhĩrĩga ũmwe, ndĩmũtware Zayuni.
english: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

kikuyu: O narĩo ithagu rĩmwe rĩa ikerubi rĩa keerĩ rĩarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono ĩtano na rĩkahutia rũthingo rũu rũngĩ rwa hekarũ, na ithagu rĩu rĩngĩ rĩarĩo o narĩo rĩarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono ĩtano na rĩkahutia ithagu rĩa ikerubi rĩa mbere.
english: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

kikuyu: Athĩnjĩri-Ngai acio anene makĩoya mbeeca icio makiuga atĩrĩ, “Kũiga mbeeca ici kĩgĩĩna-inĩ nĩ kuuna watho, nĩgũkorwo nĩ mbeeca cia thakame.”
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

kikuyu: Warekire andũ matũikarĩre mĩtwe; twagĩtuĩkanirie mwaki-inĩ o na maaĩ-inĩ, no ũgĩcooka ũgĩtũrehe kũndũ kũrĩ bũthi.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩathikagĩrĩria arĩa abatari, na ndangĩnyarara andũ ake moohetwo.
english: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

kikuyu: Eeheragia irĩma itekũmenya, na agacingʼaũrania nĩ kũrakara.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

kikuyu: Arīmī matibatīe kūrida nguha dawa īnī iria cīīna thūmu. Gwīka ūguo no gūtūme cithūke.
english: Farmers should not deep sprouted tubers in chemicals, as these can cause damage.

kikuyu: Mũriũ wa Harũni ũrĩa ũrahorohanĩria na thakame na maguta ma iruta rĩu rĩa iruta rĩa ũiguano-rĩ, nĩakaheo kĩero kĩa mwena wa ũrĩo kĩrĩ rwĩga rwake.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

kikuyu: Mwathani, o we Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, nĩwe ũkaananga bũrũri ũcio wothe ta ũrĩa gwathanĩtwo.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

kikuyu: No nginya ũmũthĩ Jehova ndamũheete meciiria marĩ na ũmenyo, kana maitho me kuona, kana matũ me kũigua.
english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

kikuyu: Hingũra maitho makwa nĩguo nyone maũndũ ma magegania marĩa marĩ watho-inĩ waku.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

kikuyu: Kūhe mūtī maaī kaingī thutha wa kūhanda, ihinda rīa kūruta mahūa na rīrīa ūrekīra matunda nī njīra njega mūno ya kūhotithia mūtī gūciara matunda mega.
english: Giving frequent water to mango tree, after the plantation, at the time of flowering and fruit bearing stage is the best possible way to get good quality mangoes.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maikũrũkaga kuuma kĩrĩma-inĩ, Jesũ akĩmaatha akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mũtikae kwĩra mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũrĩa muona, nginya rĩrĩa Mũrũ wa Mũndũ akaariũkio oime kũrĩ arĩa akuũ.”
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: Nī manene, mūhiano wa oval na gītina gīthiūrūrī na timacomoku.
english: Large, ovate & plumb, rounded base shape and without a beak.

kikuyu: na mũgĩcookagĩria Ithe witũ ngaatho, ũrĩa ũmũtuĩte aagĩrĩru a kũgaya igai rĩa arĩa aamũre ũthamaki-inĩ wa ũtheri.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Musa na Harũni mehereire Firaũni, Musa agĩkaĩra Jehova ũhoro wĩgiĩ ciũra iria aarehithĩirie Firaũni.
english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to Yahweh concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Nĩwe waringire marigithathi ma Misiri, marigithathi ma andũ na ma nyamũ.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

kikuyu: Ũhoro ũkoniĩ anabii nĩ atĩrĩ: Ngoro yakwa nĩthuthĩku; mahĩndĩ makwa mothe nĩmarainaina. Haana ta mũndũ mũrĩĩu, ngahaana ta mũndũ mũtoorie nĩ ndibei, nĩ ũndũ wa Jehova, na nĩ ũndũ wa ndũmĩrĩri ciake theru.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.

kikuyu: Mwĩmenyererei, nĩgeetha ũhoro ũrĩa anabii maaririe ndũkanamũkore, rĩrĩa moigire atĩrĩ:
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

kikuyu: Maembe makūraga na ihinda rīigana atīa?
english: What is the maturity period of mangoes?

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa eerire maithe maitũ, atĩ nĩakaiguĩra Iburahĩmu hamwe na njiaro ciake tha, nginya tene.”
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring§ forever.”

kikuyu: Ũmĩgemie na thahabu therie, na ũmĩtirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Nao arutwo makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩkĩ gĩtũmaga arutani a watho moige atĩ Elija no nginya aambe ooke?”
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
