kikuyu: Wee Ngai, twetereire gũkũgooca tũrĩ Zayuni; nĩ harĩwe mĩĩhĩtwa iitũ ĩkaahingio.
english: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

kikuyu: Ihinda-inī rĩmwe, kīmera kīu no gīthūke. Thĩinī wa mūgūnda, mūrimū ūcio nīūmenyekaga wega nīūndū wa ironda nene cia rangi wa ngoikoni nginya yellow-orange ĩhaana ta V ĩratambūrūrūkĩra na thĩinī kuuma mīthia-inī ya mathangū.
english: In some cases, the crop may be destroyed. In the field, the disease is easily recognized by the presence of large yellow to yellow orange V-shaped lesions extending inward from the margin of the leaf.

kikuyu: Agaakoma arĩ mũtongu, no ndagacooka gwĩka ũguo rĩngĩ; akaahingũra maitho akore gũtirĩ kĩndũ arĩ nakĩo.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

kikuyu: Arũgamĩrĩri a ngombo makĩmahinyĩrĩria mũno, makameeraga atĩrĩ, “Rĩĩkiai wĩra ũrĩa mwagĩrĩirwo wa o mũthenya, o ta ũrĩa mwekaga rĩrĩa mwaheagwo nyeki.”
english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

kikuyu: Imũndũ imwe cia tũhũ nĩcionganire hamwe nake, na makĩregana na Rehoboamu mũrũ wa Solomoni rĩrĩa aarĩ mwĩthĩ na ataahotaga gũtua itua, na ndaarĩ na hinya wa kũmeetiiria.
english: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩwe ũrĩa ũhoro wake waarĩtio nĩ mũnabii Isaia rĩrĩa oigire atĩrĩ: “Kũrĩ na mũgambo wa mũndũ ũkwanĩrĩra werũ-inĩ, akoiga atĩrĩ: ‘Haarĩriai njĩra ya Mwathani, rũngariai njĩra ciake.’ ”
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”*

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa makaamũnyiita-rĩ, mũtikanetange nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa mũkoiga kana ũrĩa mũgaacookia. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmũkeerwo ũrĩa mũkoiga,
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

kikuyu: Njamuthi ici nīcionekaga thīinī wa mara ma njui.
english: The microorganism can also be found in the intestine of chicks.

kikuyu: na rũciinĩ nĩmũkona riiri wa Jehova, tondũ nĩaiguĩte ũrĩa mũmũtetetie. Ithuĩ tũkĩrĩ a, atĩ nĩguo mũtũtetie?”
english: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

kikuyu: nĩngũmũtegeire matũ biũ. No gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wanyu wonanirie mahĩtia ma Ayubu; gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wanyu ũmũcookeirie mĩario yake.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

kikuyu: Nĩarũgamagĩrĩra kĩhooto kĩa arĩa ahatĩrĩrie, na akahe arĩa ahũtu irio. Jehova nĩwe wohoraga arĩa mohetwo,
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.

kikuyu: kũrĩa gwatũmire ndĩmookĩrĩre nginya ngĩmatwarithia bũrũri wa thũ ciao, thuutha ũcio rĩrĩa ngoro icio ciao nyũmũ ikenyiihia na ciĩtĩkĩre ihũũra rĩa mehia mao-rĩ,
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

kikuyu: “No nĩwahithire maũndũ maya ngoro-inĩ yaku, na nĩnjũũĩ no warĩ na ũndũ ũyũ meciiria-inĩ maku:
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

kikuyu: Hihi bruda nīkīī?
english: What is a Brooder?

kikuyu: Thuutha wa ithaa rĩmwe, mũndũ ũngĩ akiuga agwatĩirie atĩrĩ, “Hatirĩ nganja mũndũ ũyũ moima hamwe nake, nĩgũkorwo o nake nĩ Mũgalili.”
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

kikuyu: “Wee nĩwe mũndũ wa mbere gũciarwo? Wee-rĩ, waciarirwo mbere ya irĩma igĩe ho?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

kikuyu: Rekei tũmwenderie Aishumaeli aya, no tũtikamwĩke ũũru na moko maitũ, tondũ ũyũ nĩ mũrũ wa ithe witũ, tũrĩ a mũthiimo ũmwe na thakame o ĩmwe.” Nao ariũ a ithe magĩtĩkĩra.
english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, airĩtu acio a Zelofehadi mũrũ wa Heferi mũrũ wa Gileadi, mũrũ wa Makiru, mũrũ wa Manase maarĩ a mbarĩ cia Manase mũrũ wa Jusufu. Marĩĩtwa ma airĩtu acio maarĩ Mahala, na Noa, na Hogila, na Milika, na Tiriza. Nĩmathiire, magĩkuhĩrĩria
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: na Bakabakari, na Hereshi, na Galali, na Matania mũrũ wa Mika, mũrũ wa Zikiri, mũrũ wa Asafu;
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ nĩĩgakinya rĩrĩa thũ ciaku igaaka ihumbu cia tĩĩri ikũrigiicĩrie, na ikũhingĩrĩrie na mĩena yothe.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

kikuyu: nao andũ arĩa maarĩ ahũtu akĩmarehe kuo, nao magĩaka itũũra inene rĩa gũikara.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa tũrĩ na ciĩga nyingĩ thĩinĩ wa mwĩrĩ ũmwe, nacio ciĩga ici ciothe itirutaga wĩra mũthemba ũmwe-rĩ,
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

kikuyu: Ndariri cia mūrimū ūyū nī kuinaina, kuremwo nī kūrīa na kwaga mītūkī.
english: Signs include -the cow experiences muscle tremors, lack of appetite and unsteadiness.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, kĩu nĩkĩo kĩratũma ndĩmũtũme na kwĩyendera kũnene, nĩgeetha mwamuona rĩngĩ mũkene, na niĩ nyihanyiihĩrwo nĩ gũtangĩka.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

kikuyu: Nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai magĩcooka makĩrehe ithandũkũ rĩu rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova handũ harĩo harĩa haamũre thĩinĩ wa hekarũ, ũguo nĩ ta kuuga Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno, makĩrĩiga rungu rwa mathagu ma makerubi.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

kikuyu: Mīrimū na tūtambi: Mīrimū na tūtambi no īgūthūkīrie mūgūnda wothe kana ītūme mīembe īciare matunda matarī mega na gūcūngīrīria hathara.
english: Pest and diseases – Mango pests and diseases can wipe out your mango orchard, or make your mango harvest be of inferior quality, leading to losses.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, nĩgũtuĩke o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo, atĩrĩ: “Arĩa matarĩ meerwo ũhoro wake nĩo makaawona, na arĩa matarĩ maigua nĩo magaataũkĩrwo nĩguo.”
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”*

kikuyu: Wega wa Mwathani Ngai witũ ũrogĩa na ithuĩ; tũma wĩra wa moko maitũ ũgaacĩre, ĩĩ-ni, kĩrũmie wĩra wa moko maitũ.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

kikuyu: Othe makĩrĩa makĩhũũna, nao arutwo makĩiyũria ciondo ikũmi na igĩrĩ cia cienyũ iria ciatigarire.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: ũthiũ wa Jehova ũũkagĩrĩra andũ arĩa mekaga ũũru, nĩguo moima thĩ matikanaririkanwo.
english: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

kikuyu: Nī ihinda rīrīkū rīega rīa kūrenga makūmba ma njamba?
english: When is the best time to cut off the male bud?

kikuyu: Woire nguo imwe ciaku, ũkĩgemia mahooero ma kũndũ gũtũũgĩru kũrĩa wahũũragĩra ũmaraya. Maũndũ ta macio matiagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩkĩka, kana magĩe kuo o na rĩ.
english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

kikuyu: No akorwo ti ũguo-rĩ, wee gĩthikĩrĩrie; kira ki, na nĩngũkũruta ũũgĩ.”
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

kikuyu: Tondũ- rĩ, ingĩkĩmũiguithia kĩeha-rĩ, nũũ ũngĩgĩtigara wa kũngenia, o tiga inyuĩ arĩa njiguithĩtie kĩeha?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

kikuyu: Nake Shafani ũcio mwandĩki akĩĩra mũthamaki atĩrĩ, “Hilikia ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩanengera ibuku.” Nake Shafani agĩthoma ibuku rĩu arĩ mbere ya mũthamaki.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, nĩngũmba igũrũ rĩerũ o na thĩ njerũ. Maũndũ marĩa ma tene matigacooka kũririkanwo, o na kana meciirio.
english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.

kikuyu: Tondũ ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ na ma, anabii na andũ aingĩ athingu nĩmerirĩirie kuona maũndũ marĩa mũrona no-o matiamonire, na nĩmerirĩirie kũigua maũndũ marĩa mũraigua no matiamaiguire.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

kikuyu: Nũũ ũtangĩgwĩtigĩra, Wee mũthamaki wa ndũrĩrĩ? Wee nowe wagĩrĩire gwĩtigĩrwo. Thĩinĩ wa andũ arĩa othe oogĩ a ndũrĩrĩ, o na mothamaki-inĩ mao mothe, gũtirĩ ũngĩ ũhaana tawe.
english: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ndĩ mũthĩĩni na mũbatari, nayo ngoro yakwa nĩĩgurarĩtio thĩinĩ wakwa.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

kikuyu: arĩa maathikaga marigithathi mao mothe, marĩa Jehova ooragĩte gatagatĩ kao; nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩatuĩrĩire ngai ciao ciira.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

kikuyu: Mũthuuri nĩagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũhingagĩria mũtumia wake bata wake wa kĩhiko, o nake mũtumia ahingagĩrie mũthuuriwe bata wake.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her,† and likewise also the wife her husband.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wao warĩ na mbeeca cia kũmũrĩha, nĩ ũndũ ũcio marĩ o eerĩ akĩmarekera thiirĩ ũcio. Rĩu-rĩ, acio eerĩ nũũ ũngĩmwenda makĩria?”
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

kikuyu: Akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Mũndũ ũmwe warĩ igweta nĩathiire bũrũri wa kũraya agatuuo mũthamaki, na thuutha wa ũguo acooke.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

kikuyu: kīaga kīagīrīire gūkorwo na huhīrio njega cia rīera.
english: The house should be well ventilated

kikuyu: “Wĩyaramĩrie handũ ha hema yaku, na ũtambũrũkie mataama ma hema yaku maarame, maguucie ũtekũmacaaĩra; raihia mĩkanda ya hema yaku, nacio higĩ ciayo ũcikiindĩre irũme biũ.
english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.

kikuyu: Wee Juda-rĩ, ũrĩ na ngai nyingĩ o ta ũrĩa matũũra maku maigana, na igongona iria ũhaandĩte cia gũcinĩra ngai ĩyo ya thoni ĩtagwo Baali ũbumba nĩ nyingĩ o ta barabara cia Jerusalemu.’
english: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩneana ndegwa ya iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, nake Harũni na ariũ ake makĩigĩrĩra moko mao igũrũ rĩa mũtwe wa ndegwa ĩyo.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

kikuyu: Wee ũthondekete ũrĩrĩ waku karĩma-inĩ karĩa karaaya na igũrũ, na gatũũgĩru; na kũu igũrũ nĩkuo waambatire, ũgĩthiĩ kũrutĩra magongona maku kuo.
english: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

kikuyu: Watho wa Jehova nĩ mũkinyanĩru, ũriũkagia ngoro ya mũndũ. Kĩrĩra kĩa Jehova nĩ gĩa kwĩhokeka, nĩkĩũhĩgagia mũndũ ũrĩa ũtarĩ mũũgĩ.
english: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jusufu nĩwe warĩ mwathi wa bũrũri wa Misiri na nĩwe wendagĩria andũ othe a bũrũri ngano. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio rĩrĩa ariũ a ithe maakinyire kuo-rĩ, makĩmũinamĩrĩra, magĩturumithia mothiũ maothĩ.
english: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

kikuyu: Ūndū ūyū wonekaga rīrīa irio cia mūtu irī nagoro mūno.
english: This happens when the cost of concentrate is too high.

kikuyu: “Nĩwe wombire thĩ na ũndũ wa hinya wake; ningĩ akĩhaanda thĩ na ũũgĩ wake, na agĩtambũrũkia matu mairũ na ũndũ wa ũmenyo wake.
english: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

kikuyu: “Rĩu-rĩ, mwene mũgũnda ũcio ageeka atĩa? Agooka oorage akombori acio, acooke ahe andũ angĩ mũgũnda ũcio.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, tema njĩra igĩrĩ cia kũgererwo nĩ rũhiũ rwa njora rwa mũthamaki wa Babuloni, cierĩ ciumĩte bũrũri o ũmwe. Haanda rũũri harĩa njĩra yahũkĩire ĩrorete itũũra inene.
english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

kikuyu: “Ithe witũ aakuĩrĩire werũ-inĩ. Ndaarĩ ũmwe wa arũmĩrĩri a Kora, arĩa manyiitanire mokĩrĩre Jehova, no aakuire nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make mwene na ndaarĩ na aanake.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

kikuyu: ingĩkorwo ndanarĩa maciaro maguo iteekũrĩha, kana ngoraga ngoro cia ene guo-rĩ,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

kikuyu: Nakuo kũrĩa kũngĩ guothe gwatigaire kũu Gileadi o na Bashani guothe, kũrĩa Ogu aathanaga, ngĩkũhe nuthu ya mũhĩrĩga wa Manase. (Bũrũri wothe wa Arigobu kũu Bashani hĩndĩ ĩmwe wetagwo bũrũri wa Arefai.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũũgĩ nĩũgatoonya ngoro yaku, naguo ũmenyo ũkenagie muoyo waku.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũtikanethondekere mĩhianano kana mwĩrũgamirie mũhianĩre wa kĩndũ kana ihiga rĩamũre rĩa kũhooywo, mũtikaige ihiga rĩacũhie bũrũri-inĩ wanyu atĩ nĩguo mũrĩinamagĩrĩre. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.
english: “ ‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.

kikuyu: Mũtikanahooe ngai ĩngĩ o na ĩrĩkũ, nĩgũkorwo Jehova, ũrĩa rĩĩtwa rĩake arĩ Mũigua Ũiru, nĩ Ngai ũrĩ ũiru.
english: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

kikuyu: Mĩromo ya mũndũ mũkĩĩgu ĩmũrehagĩra ngũĩ, nako kanua gake geetagia rũthanju.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

kikuyu: no ndahooire kĩrĩra kũrĩ Jehova. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩmũũraga, na akĩneana ũthamaki kũrĩ Daudi mũrũ wa Jesii.
english: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Marambata na njĩra ya gũthiĩ Luhithu, makĩrĩraga na ruo rũnene o magĩthiiaga; marĩ njĩra-inĩ ya gũikũrũka Horonaimu nĩmaiguĩte kĩrĩro kĩa ruo ruumĩte ngoro nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa kwanangĩtwo.
english: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

kikuyu: mũrũ wakwa, tiga gũtwarana nao, ndũkagerere njĩra ciao;
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

kikuyu: No mūhaka akorūo arī handūharīa hatarī maaī, handū harī ndūma, harī rīera rīega, kūrīa rīera rītikoragwo na ūrugarī wa digrii 10 kana makīria ma digrii 20, na kūrīa waru itangīthūkagio nī tūnyamū kana tūnyamū tūngī kana indo ingī cia ndūire.
english: It should be in a dry, dark, very well-ventilated place where temperatures don’t go below 10 degrees or above 20 degrees, and the potatoes can not be affected by rodents or insects, or other elements of nature.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Tũnyũmba tũu tũrĩ mwena wa gathigathini na tũu tũrĩ mwena wa gũthini, tũu tũngʼetheire nja ya hekarũ, nĩtuo twa athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na nĩkuo athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa megũkuhĩrĩria Jehova makarĩĩagĩra indo cia maruta marĩa matheru mũno. Kũu nĩkuo makaigaga indo cia maruta iria theru mũno, nacio nĩ maruta ma ngano, o na maruta ma mehia, na maruta ma mahĩtia, nĩgũkorwo handũ hau nĩ hatheru.
english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Musa aikũrũkire kuuma kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai arĩ na ihengere igĩrĩ cia Ũira moko-inĩ make, ndaamenyaga atĩ ũthiũ wake nĩwakengaga nĩ ũndũ nĩarĩtie na Jehova.
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa Jehova aakeneire kũmũgaacĩrithia na kũmũingĩhia, noguo agaakena akĩmũharagania na akĩmũniina. Nĩmũkamunywo mweherio bũrũri ũrĩa mũrathiĩ mũwĩgwatĩre.
english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

kikuyu: Maruta marĩa ũrĩamũkagĩra kuuma kũrĩ o nĩmo maya: thahabu, na betha na gĩcango;
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: Na hĩndĩ ĩyo akĩambĩrĩria kũhunjia thunagogi-inĩ atĩ Jesũ nĩ Mũrũ wa Ngai.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Cookai mũkeere Johana maũndũ marĩa mwaigua na marĩa muona:
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ arĩa manyariiragwo nĩ ũndũ wa ũthingu, nĩgũkorwo ũthamaki wa igũrũ nĩ wao.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Ingĩhunjia nĩ ũndũ wa kwĩyendera-rĩ, ndaheo mũcaara; no angĩkorwo ti na ũndũ wa kwĩyendera-rĩ, niĩ no kũhingia ndĩrahingia ũndũ ũrĩa ndĩhokeirwo.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩarĩrũmaga ngundi ya mũtu ũcio mũhinyu mũno ũrĩ na maguta, hamwe na ũbani wothe ũrĩ iruta-inĩ rĩu rĩa mũtu, na acinĩre gĩcunjĩ gĩa kĩririkano hau kĩgongona-inĩ kĩrĩ mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩatambũrũkirie itu rĩmahumbagĩre, o na mwaki wa kũmamũrĩkagĩra ũtukũ.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

kikuyu: Ũrĩa wothe wĩ na indo nĩakongererwo nyingĩ; na ũrĩa wothe ũtarĩ nĩagatuunywo o na kĩrĩa arĩ nakĩo.”
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

kikuyu: Ngoro ciitũ nĩcikenete nĩ ũndũ wake, nĩgũkorwo twĩhokete rĩĩtwa rĩake itheru.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akiumĩrĩra Aburamu, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Bũrũri ũyũ nĩguo ngaahe rũciaro rwaku.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Aburamu agĩakĩra Jehova kĩgongona hau, o we Jehova ũcio wamuumĩrĩire.
english: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.”† He built an altar there to Yahweh, who had appeared to him.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jehova akaamũkinyia bũrũri wa Akaanani, na Ahiti, na Aamori, na Ahivi, na Ajebusi bũrũri ũrĩa eehĩtire mbere ya maithe manyu ma tene atĩ nĩakamũhe bũrũri ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ-rĩ, mũkaamenyagĩrĩra gĩathĩ gĩkĩ mweri-inĩ ũyũ:
english: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa rĩothe marĩtoonyaga Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo, marĩĩthambaga na maaĩ nĩgeetha matigakue. O na ningĩ rĩrĩa mathengerera kĩgongona nĩguo marutĩre Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki,
english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nake agĩcooka akĩamũkĩra rũũri rwa kũrua, rũrĩ mũhũri wa ũthingu ũrĩa aarĩ naguo nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia o na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ataarĩ mũruu. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩtuĩka ithe wa arĩa othe metĩkagia o na matarĩ aruu, nĩgeetha o nao matuuagwo athingu.
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

kikuyu: Hekarũ iitũ ĩrĩa nyamũre na ĩrĩ riiri, kũrĩa maithe maitũ maakũgoocagĩra, nĩĩcinĩtwo na mwaki, nacio indo ciitũ ciothe iria irĩ bata nĩcianangĩtwo.
english: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

kikuyu: Nĩ niĩ njugaga ũhoro wa Mũthamaki Kurusu atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩwe mũrĩithi wa mbũri ciakwa, na nĩwe ũkaahingia ũrĩa wothe nyendaga wĩkwo; Nĩakoiga ũhoro wa Jerusalemu atĩrĩ, “Nĩrĩakwo,” na ha ũhoro wa hekarũ oige atĩrĩ, “Mĩthingi yayo nĩyakwo.” ’ ”
english: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’ ”

kikuyu: Kĩu nĩkĩo gĩtũmi kĩa Alawii gũkorwo matarĩ na igai rĩao kĩũmbe gatagatĩ ka ariũ a ithe wao; Jehova nĩwe igai rĩao, o ta ũrĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu aameerire.)
english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

kikuyu: Andũ acio mekaga maũndũ mooru kaĩ matarĩ ũmenyo, o acio marĩĩaga andũ akwa o ta ũrĩa andũ marĩĩaga irio, o acio matakayagĩra Ngai?
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

kikuyu: Aamaragĩria arĩ thĩinĩ wa gĩtugĩ kĩa itu; makĩrũmia mawatho make na kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo kĩrĩa aamaheete.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

kikuyu: Nīwega gwaka itara thīinī wa kīūmba kia ngūkū na makīria handū igūrū (gītara kīmwe harī o ngūkū ithano)
english: Nests should be placed inside the chicken house and preferably above the ground (1 for every 5 hens)

kikuyu: Rũrĩmĩ rwakwa rũrĩrahaga ũhoro wa ciĩko ciaku cia ũthingu mũthenya wothe, nĩgũkorwo arĩa meendaga kũnjĩka ũũru nĩmaconorithĩtio na makarigiicwo.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Warū cīthuragūo na kūgrīdūo atīa?
english: How to grade and sort potatoes?

kikuyu: Thahabu yothe ĩrĩa yoimire kũrĩ anene a ikundi cia o ngiri, ngiri na anene a ikundi cia o igana, igana ĩrĩa Musa na Eleazaru maatwarĩire Jehova kĩrĩ kĩheo, yarĩ ya ũritũ wa cekeri 16,750.*
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.†

kikuyu: ningĩ nĩ aarĩ na ngʼondu 7,000, na ngamĩĩra 3,000, na ndegwa cia kũigana kuohwo macooki 500, na ndigiri 500, na nĩ aarĩ na ndungata nyingĩ mũno. Nĩwe warĩ mũndũ ũrĩa mũnene mũno kũrĩ andũ arĩa angĩ othe a mwena wa Irathĩro.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩmatumire ndaamĩ cia ciande cia ebodi, nacio ikĩohererwo koine-inĩ igĩrĩ ciayo, nĩguo inyiitithanio nayo.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

kikuyu: Nake akiuga atĩrĩ: “Wee Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli, gũtirĩ Ngai ũngĩ ũhaana tawe, kũu igũrũ kana gũkũ thĩ, o Wee ũhingagia kĩrĩkanĩro gĩaku kĩa wendo harĩ ndungata ciaku iria irũmagĩrĩra njĩra yaku na ngoro ciao ciothe.
english: Then he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

kikuyu: Rekei gũkirĩrĩria kwanyu kũmenyeke nĩ andũ othe. Mwathani arĩ hakuhĩ gũũka.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: “ ‘Juda na Isiraeli nĩmoonjorithanagia nawe; magĩkũũrania indo ciaku cia wonjoria na ngano ya kuuma Minithu, na theremende, na ũũkĩ, na maguta, na ũbani.
english: “ ‘ “Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

kikuyu: Mũnene ũcio arĩkoragwo arĩ hamwe nao, agatoonyaga magĩtoonya, na akoimaga makiuma.
english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

kikuyu: Tũhonokie, Wee Jehova Ngai witũ, na ũtũcookanĩrĩrie ũtũrute kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ, nĩguo tũcookagĩrie rĩĩtwa rĩaku itheru ngaatho, na twĩrahagĩre ũgooci waku.
english: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

kikuyu: Gūkūra nī thutha wa thīkū 65-70 thutha wa kūruta mīūngūrwa kuuma natharīīni.( gūkū ni gūkūra kwa naihenya)
english: Maturity: 65 – 70 days after transplanting (early maturing).

kikuyu: “Nake akĩnjookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Jehova ũrĩa ndũire thiiaga mbere yake, nĩagatũma mũraika wake athiĩ nawe, na atũme rũgendo rwaku rũgaacĩre, nĩgeetha ũkaarutĩra mũriũ wakwa mũtumia kuuma kũrĩ mũhĩrĩga wakwa na kuuma kũrĩ andũ a nyũmba ya baba.
english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

kikuyu: Ngoro ĩrĩ na thayũ ĩheaga mwĩrĩ muoyo, no ũiru ũbuthagia mahĩndĩ.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

kikuyu: Gũtikageranwo ngero kana kũniinanwo, kũu kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩakwa gĩtheru, nĩgũkorwo thĩ nĩĩkaiyũrwo nĩ ũmenyo wa Jehova, o ta ũrĩa maaĩ maiyũrĩte iria-inĩ.
english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

kikuyu: Nĩaigire kĩraĩ gĩa gwĩthambĩrwo gatagatĩ ka Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo na kĩgongona na agĩgĩĩkĩra maaĩ ma gwĩthamba,
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

kikuyu: Njũkĩte thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Baba na mũtinjĩtĩkagĩra; no mũndũ ũngĩ angĩũka na rĩĩtwa rĩake mwene, nĩmũkũmwĩtĩkĩra.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

kikuyu: Indo iria aarutire ciarĩ thaani ya betha ya ũritũ wa cekeri igana rĩa mĩrongo ĩtatũ, na mbakũri ĩmwe ya betha ya kũminjaminjĩria ya ũritũ wa cekeri mĩrongo mũgwanja, cierĩ kũringana na gĩthimo gĩa cekeri ya harĩa haamũre, na o ĩmwe ĩiyũrĩtio mũtu ũrĩa mũhinyu mũno ũtukanĩtio na maguta, ũrĩ iruta rĩa mũtu;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: Ũũ nĩguo aathaga ndũrĩrĩ na akaheana irio nyingĩ.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

kikuyu: Ciana iria ciaciarĩirwo bũrũri ũrĩa watahĩirwo, ikoiga ũkĩiguaga atĩrĩ, ‘Bũrũri ũyũ nĩ mũnini, ndũngĩtũigana, tũhe kũndũ kũngĩ gwa gũtũũra.’
english: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’

kikuyu: na ndegwa igĩrĩ, na ndũrũme ithano, na thenge ithano, na tũtũrũme tũtano twa mwaka ũmwe, irutwo irĩ igongona rĩa ũiguano. Ici nĩcio indo iria ciarutirwo nĩ Abidani mũrũ wa Gideoni.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: “ ‘Rĩrĩa mũndũ ũcio angĩhonio mũrimũ ũcio wa kuura, nĩageterera mĩthenya mũgwanja nĩguo ambĩrĩrie gũtherio gwake; no nginya athambie nguo ciake na ethambe na maaĩ, matahĩtwo o hĩndĩ ĩyo, nake nĩagathirwo nĩ thaahu.
english: “ ‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

kikuyu: Mūembe ūciaraga thutha wa ihinda rīigana atīa?
english: When do a mango seedling start to bear fruits?

kikuyu: Ngūkū inyitagwo nī mūrimū ūyū īmwe kwa īmwe na njīra ya kūhutia iria ndwaru, kana ona kūhutia indo ta mai ma ngūkū iria ndwaru.
english: The chicken gets infection directly on contact with infected birds or indirectly through contact with material contaminated with infected fecal matter.

kikuyu: Ndaimono icio igĩthaitha Jesũ, ikĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Twĩtĩkĩrie tũthiĩ kũrĩ ngũrwe iria, tũtoonye thĩinĩ wacio.”
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

kikuyu: Ikerubi rĩa keerĩ o narĩo rĩarĩ rĩa mĩkono ikũmi; makerubi macio meerĩ nĩmaiganaine na makahaanana.
english: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

kikuyu: Ūndū ūyū wītagwo ketosis ūrīa ndariri ikoragwo nī hamwe na ng'ombe kūremwo nī kūrīa, ūnyihu wa iria, na ketosis īngīneneha, ini rīthukaga biū na ng'ombe īgakua.
english: The condition is associated with pronounced ketosis, feed intake depression, and decreased productivity; severe cases lead to liver failure and a fatal outcome.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, mwaka ũcio mũnene wa anene a ita rĩa Ashuri aakinyire Ashidodi atũmĩtwo nĩ Sarigoni mũthamaki wa Ashuri, aakinya kuo, na aarĩtharĩkĩra na aarĩtunyana-rĩ,
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩathondekire ciongo cia gĩcango gĩtwekie cia kũigĩrĩra igũrũ rĩa itugĩ icio, o kĩongo kĩmwe kĩarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono ĩtano.‡
english: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

kikuyu: Daudi na andũ a Isiraeli othe arĩa maarĩ nake magĩthiĩ Baala kũu Juda (nĩkuo Kiriathu-Jearimu) makagĩĩre ithandũkũ rĩa Jehova Ngai ũrĩa ũikarĩire gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene gatagatĩ ka makerubi, o ithandũkũ rĩu rĩĩtanĩtio na Rĩĩtwa rĩake.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

kikuyu: Na inyuĩ, andũ a Kaperinaumu, nĩmũkambarario nginya matu-inĩ? Aca, mũkaaharũrũkio mũkinye kũrĩa kũriku mũno. Ciama iria mwaringĩirwo ingĩaringĩirwo Sodomu, nĩkũngĩtũũraga nginya ũmũthĩ.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. § For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

kikuyu: Ihinda-inĩ o rĩu Saũlũ no eehĩtagĩra kũũraga arutwo a Mwathani. Agĩthiĩ kũrĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene,
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

kikuyu: o ũmwe ateithagia ũrĩa ũngĩ, na akeera mũrũ wa nyina atĩrĩ, “Wĩyũmĩrĩrie mũno!”
english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

kikuyu: Makĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Tũtingĩĩka ũndũ ta ũcio; tũtingĩheana mwarĩ witũ kũrĩ mũndũ ũtarĩ mũruu. Ũndũ ũcio no ũtuĩke wa gũtũnyararithia.
english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

kikuyu: Ningĩ o ũndũ ũmwe, thuutha wa kũrĩa irio, akĩoya gĩkombe, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Gĩkombe gĩkĩ nĩ kĩrĩkanĩro kĩrĩa kĩerũ thĩinĩ wa thakame yakwa; ĩkagai ũũ, rĩrĩa rĩothe mũrĩkĩnyuuagĩra, nĩguo mũndirikanage.”
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Na rĩu, maũndũ maya matatũ nĩ ma gũtũũra: wĩtĩkio, na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro, o na wendani. No ũrĩa mũnene wamo nĩ wendani.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mwathani eerire Mwathani wakwa atĩrĩ: “Ikara guoko-inĩ gwakwa kwa ũrĩo, nginya ngaiga thũ ciaku rungu rwa makinya maku.” ’
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?*

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ndĩraarĩ nao, nĩndĩramagitagĩra na ngamamenyerera na rĩĩtwa rĩu waheire. Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe ũũrĩte o tiga ũrĩa wathĩrĩirwo kwanangwo nĩguo Maandĩko mahingio.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Arĩ kũu andũ amwe makĩmũrehere mũndũ ũtaiguaga na ũtaaragia, makĩmũthaitha amũigĩrĩre guoko.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

kikuyu: Ũgwati ũrĩa ũrĩ ho nĩ atĩ to wonjoria witũ wiki ũkũmenererio, no o na hekarũ ya ngai ya mũndũ-wa-nja ĩrĩa nene ĩĩtagwo Aritemi nĩĩkwagithio kĩene, na ngai ĩyo ya mũndũ-wa-nja yo nyene, ĩrĩa ĩhooyagwo bũrũri-inĩ wothe wa Asia, na thĩ yothe, nĩĩkũimwo ũkaru wayo.”
english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

kikuyu: Mwĩhũgagei na mũhooyage nĩgeetha mũtikagwe magerio-inĩ. Ngoro nĩyenda, no mwĩrĩ ndũrĩ na hinya.”
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Athĩnjĩri-Ngai, arĩa Alawii, hamwe na mũhĩrĩga ũcio wothe wa Lawi, matikagĩa na gĩthaka kana igai hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli arĩa angĩ. Magaatũũragio nĩ indo iria irutĩirwo Jehova cia igongona rĩa njino, nĩgũkorwo rĩu nĩrĩo igai rĩao.
english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.

kikuyu: Naguo mũtwe ũcio wake ũkĩrehwo na kiuga, ũkĩnengerwo mũirĩtu ũcio, nake akĩũtwarĩra nyina.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

kikuyu: mbura ya mbembe ĩgĩkiura, naruo rũheni rũkĩhenũka kũndũ guothe. Nĩkĩo kĩarĩ kĩhuhũkanio kĩrĩa kĩũru mũno kĩonekanĩte bũrũri wothe wa Misiri kuuma wambĩrĩria gũtũũrwo nĩ andũ.
english: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

kikuyu: Magũrũ makwa moimĩte makinya make thuutha; nũmagĩrĩra njĩra yake itekwahũka na mwena.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ-rĩ, anga no eetangaga ha ũhoro wa andũ ake arĩa agaatiga na thuutha, matukũ make maathira?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩ harĩ ndundu ya njũkanĩrĩro ĩthugundĩtwo thĩinĩ wa andũ a Juda, o na thĩinĩ wa andũ arĩa matũũraga Jerusalemu.
english: Yahweh said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: No matukũ nĩmarooka, rĩrĩa ngaatũma andũ arĩa monoranagia moke, nao mamuonorerie thĩ; matige ndigithũ ciake irĩ theri, na moragaange nyũngũ ciake,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.

kikuyu: Huthīra icembe rīrīa ūkūrima gatagatī ka mīkaro.
english: Use implements like the half-moon jembe to weed in between the rows.

kikuyu: Guoko kwa mũndũ gũtharĩkagĩra gũkanyiita ihiga rĩa nyaigĩ, na gũkaguũria itina cia irĩma.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

kikuyu: Ngũrongoragia na ngoro yakwa yothe; ndũkanareke njũrũũre ndigane na maathani maku.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Harīria mūgūnda wega tene, ūkīmunyaga ithukī, mīīri, mahuti ona nyeki.
english: Prepare the land well in advance, digging out all tree stumps, roots, bushes and grasses.

kikuyu: nao mamũnyũrũrie na mamũtuĩre mata, na mamũhũũre iboko o na mamũũrage. No thuutha wa mĩthenya ĩtatũ nĩakariũka.”
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Kūhanda mbegū cia kabici īria ingīgitia mīrimu na tūtambi
english: Use of pest resistant varieties:Row covering of seedlines with nets:

kikuyu: Kũu mĩtĩ-inĩ ya mĩethia nĩkuo twacuuragia inanda ciitũ cia mũgeeto,
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

kikuyu: Andũ acio nĩmakaherithĩrio wĩhia wao; mũnabii ũcio agaatuuo mwĩhia o ta mũndũ ũcio ũtuĩrĩtie ũhoro harĩ we.
english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

kikuyu: No nyama cia ndegwa ĩyo hamwe na rũũa na mahu ũcicinĩre nja ya kambĩ. Rĩu nĩ iruta rĩa mehia.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Mwathani aamenyire ũhoro ũcio, akiuma Judea na agĩcooka Galili o rĩngĩ.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

kikuyu: naguo mũhari wa kana ũtumĩrĩrwo kahiga ga thumarati ĩrĩa theru, na ka onigithi, na ka njathibi. Ũtũtumĩrĩre tũkonyo- inĩ tũgemu twa thahabu.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

kikuyu: Jehova Ngai wanyu nĩakamũtũmĩra mũnabii o ta niĩ kuuma harĩ ariũ a thoguo. No nginya mũmũiguage.
english: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

kikuyu: (Marikabu cia Hiramu nĩ ciarehire thahabu kuuma Ofiri, o na ikĩrehe mĩrigo mĩnene ya mĩthandari na tũhiga twa goro kuuma kuo.
english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees† and precious stones.

kikuyu: Rũgongo rũrĩa maatũũraga ruoimĩte Mesha rũgathiĩ rũrorete Sefari, kũu mwena wa irathĩro wa bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kikuyu: wa ikũmi na mũgwanja wagũĩrĩire Joshibekasha, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Nĩoirugire maaĩ ma iria na ũndũ wa hinya wake; na nĩ ũndũ wa ũũgĩ wake nĩatinaangirie Rahabu tũcunjĩ.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Finehasi mũrũ wa Eleazaru, mũrũ wa Harũni ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, onire ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, akiuma kĩũngano-inĩ kĩu, akĩoya itimũ,
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

kikuyu: Ningī nī īrī mūkamo wūigananīirie na mwīrī mūnyoroku.
english: It has symmetrically shaped udders and a smooth body.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa watũma Roho waku, ikagĩa kuo, nawe ũkerũhia maũndũ mothe gũkũ thĩ.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ndetigĩra-rĩ, nĩwe ndĩrĩhokaga.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ciama irĩkũ ũgũtũringĩra tuone nĩguo tũgwĩtĩkie? Ũgwĩka atĩa?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

kikuyu: Gũtiarĩ andũ maagaga kĩndũ gatagatĩ-inĩ kao. Nĩgũkorwo ihinda kwa ihinda andũ arĩa maarĩ na ithaka kana nyũmba nĩmaciendagia, makarehe mbeeca icio mendetie,
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

kikuyu: Na tondũ ũcio-rĩ, mũndũ ũrĩa waragia na rũthiomi rũgeni nĩahooyage nĩguo ahote gũtaũra ũrĩa aroiga.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

kikuyu: Jehova aanjĩĩrire atĩrĩ: “Ũguo moiga nĩ wega.
english: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

kikuyu: Maitho makwa nĩmakamarora na ndĩmeeke maũndũ mega, na nĩngamacookia gũkũ bũrũri ũyũ. Nĩngamarũgamia na ndikamamomora; nĩngamahaanda na ndigacooka kũmamunya.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

kikuyu: Ashuri ithe wa Tekoa aarĩ na atumia eerĩ, nĩo Hela na Naara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

kikuyu: No tũngiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Woimire kũrĩ andũ’ … .” (Nĩmetigagĩra andũ, tondũ andũ othe mooĩ kũna atĩ Johana aarĩ mũnabii.)
english: If we should say, ‘From men’ ”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

kikuyu: Wendani waku ũrĩa ũtathiraga ũrotuĩka wa kũũhooreria, kũringana na kĩĩranĩro gĩaku kĩrĩa werĩire ndungata yaku.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

kikuyu: Filipu agĩkora Nathanieli, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩtuonete mũndũ ũrĩa Musa aandĩkire ũhoro wake Ibuku-inĩ rĩa Watho, na nowe anabii maandĩkire ũhoro wake, nake nĩwe Jesũ wa Nazarethi, mũrũ wa Jusufu.”
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

kikuyu: Nĩmagire wĩhokeku na makĩaga wĩtĩkio o ta maithe mao, makĩaga kwĩhokeka o ta ũta mũgathũku ũrĩa ũtangĩĩhokwo.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

kikuyu: Nao andũ 4,000 matuĩke arangĩri a ihingo, nao acio angĩ 4,000 matuĩke a kũgoocaga Jehova marĩ na inanda cia ũini iria heanĩte nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra ũcio kĩũmbe.”
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

kikuyu: nake Asa na mbũtũ yake makĩmaingatithia, makĩmakinyia o nginya Gerari. Akushi aingĩ mũno makĩũragwo ũũ atĩ gũtirĩ watigirwo muoyo, makĩniinĩrwo o hau mbere ya Jehova o na mbere ya mbũtũ ciake. Andũ a Juda makĩinũkia indo nyingĩ iria maatahire.
english: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before Yahweh and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nguuga atĩrĩ, thiiagai mũtongoretio nĩ Roho, na mũtirĩhingagia merirĩria ma mwĩrĩ.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

kikuyu: Hihi mīrimū īrīa kaingī īnyitaga ngūkū cia gīcejī nī īrīkū, ndariri nī irīkū cia mīrimū īyo na īngīrigitwo atīa?
english: What are the common Kienyeji chicken diseases, their symptoms, and treatment options?

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo kanitha wa Judea guothe, na Galili, na Samaria ũgĩkenera ihinda rĩa thayũ. Nĩwon- gereirwo hinya; na ũkĩũmĩrĩrio nĩ Roho Mũtheru, na ũkĩongererwo andũ, nao magĩtũũra metigĩrĩte Mwathani.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Shemu maarĩ: Elamu, na Ashuri, na Arafakasadi, na Ludu, na Aramu. Ariũ a Aramu maarĩ: Uzu, na Hulu, na Getheru, na Mesheki.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, wee mũrũ-wa-mũndũ, nĩmagakuoha na mĩhĩndo; ũgaikara ũrĩ muohe nĩguo ndũkoime ũthiĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ.
english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

kikuyu: Ndakanarĩe nyama cia nyamũ ĩkuĩte, kana nyama cia nyamũ ĩtambuurĩtwo nĩ nyamũ cia gĩthaka, nĩguo ndakae gũthaahio nĩcio. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩngũririkana ciĩko cia Jehova; ĩĩ nĩguo, nĩngũririkana ciama ciaku cia tene.
english: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

kikuyu: Ngai, na nowe Ithe wa Mwathani Jesũ, ũrĩa ũgoocagwo nginya tene-rĩ, nĩoĩ atĩ ndiraheenania.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo angĩremwo nĩ kũmĩrĩkia thuutha wa gwaka mũthingi, andũ arĩa othe marĩmĩonaga nĩmarĩmũthekagĩrĩra,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa arutwo maamuonire agĩthiĩ agereire maaĩ igũrũ, makĩnyiitwo nĩ guoya, makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ĩrĩa nĩ ngoma,” na magĩkaya nĩ gwĩtigĩra.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, inyuĩ andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli, nĩngũmũtuĩra ciira, o mũndũ o mũndũ kũringana na mĩthiĩre yake, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga. Mwĩrirei! Tiganai na mahĩtia manyu mothe; namo mehia manyu matigatũma mwanangwo.
english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

kikuyu: O harī kīro kīu kionanagia matunda maria magūciaruo
english: Each of these flowers will become an individual banana, or a “finger.”

kikuyu: Acio oiki nĩo marĩtoonyaga handũ-hakwa- harĩa-haamũre; acio oiki nĩo marĩĩkuhagĩrĩria metha yakwa makandungatĩra na makaruta wĩra wakwa.
english: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

kikuyu: We nĩarĩ hinya gũkĩra makũmbĩ ma iria, arĩ hinya gũkĩra marurumĩ macio ma maaĩ maingĩ, Jehova arĩ igũrũ nĩ arĩ hinya.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

kikuyu: No rĩu, thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ, inyuĩ arĩa hĩndĩ ĩmwe mwarĩ kũraya, rĩu nĩmũreharehetwo hakuhĩ nĩ ũndũ wa thakame ya Kristũ.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ-rĩ, mũndũ aahota atĩa gũtoonya nyũmba ya mũndũ njamba na amũtunye indo ciake ataambĩte kuoha mũndũ ũcio njamba? Hĩndĩ ĩyo no rĩo angĩhota kũmũtunya indo cia nyũmba yake.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Nĩngananga Mwarĩ wa Zayuni, o ũcio mũthaka na mwĩbacĩrĩri mũno.
english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ atumia-rĩ, mwĩnyiihagĩriei athuuri anyu, o ta ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire thĩinĩ wa Mwathani.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

kikuyu: na ahoroherie Handũ-harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno, na Hema- ya-Gũtũnganwo, na kĩgongona, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na andũ othe a mũingĩ wa Isiraeli.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

kikuyu: Ndaageririe ũrĩa ingĩkenia mwĩrĩ wakwa na ndibei, o ndongoretio nĩ ngoro yakwa na ũũgĩ, ngĩhĩmbĩria ũkĩĩgu, ngĩenda kũmenya nĩ ũndũ ũrĩkũ andũ maagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩka gũkũ thĩ matukũ-inĩ o macio manini ma muoyo wao.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

kikuyu: No angĩ makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ĩno ti mĩario ya mũndũ ũrĩ na ndaimono. Ndaimono no ĩhingũre maitho ma mũtumumu?”
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”*

kikuyu: Ariũ a Rubeni maarĩ: Hanoku, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Nīirī maguoya matheru na manyoroku
english: Have smooth neat feathers

kikuyu: Ningī ūndū ūyū no wongerereke thikū-inī cia 25 nginya 40 thutha wa kūheo mbegū, nīūndū gacaū gatirī karenyitīrira wega thingo-inī cia nyūngū ya nyina.
english: Additional late embryonic losses can occur during the period of 25 to 40 days after insemination due to failure of attachment to the uterine wall.

kikuyu: “O na gũtuĩka ngoretwo ngĩaria na ngerekano-rĩ, hĩndĩ nĩĩroka rĩrĩa itagacooka kũmwarĩria na njĩra ĩyo, no ngaamwĩraga ũhoro wa Baba itekũhithĩrĩra.
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

kikuyu: No nyũmba cia tũtũũra-inĩ tũrĩa tũtarĩ tũirigĩre, irĩtuagwo ta mĩgũnda ya kũndũ gũtarĩ kũirige. Icio no ikũũrwo, na nĩ igaacookio Mwaka wa Jubilii.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

kikuyu: Menyagĩrĩrai maathani macio wega, nĩgũkorwo ũguo nĩguo ũkoonania ũũgĩ na ũmenyo wanyu kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ iria irĩiguaga ũhoro wa watho ũyũ wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, ciugage atĩrĩ, “Ti-itherũ rũrĩrĩ rũrũ rũnene nĩ rũũgĩ na nĩ andũ marĩ na ũmenyo wa maũndũ.”
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
