english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmaarĩria rĩngĩ na ngerekano, akĩmeera atĩrĩ,
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

kikuyu: nake Azaria mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene wa kuuma nyũmba ya Zadoku akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Kuuma andũ maambĩrĩria kũrehe mĩhothi yao hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova-rĩ, nĩtũkoretwo tũrĩ na irio cia kũigana kũrĩa, o na tũgatigia nyingĩ mũno, nĩ ũndũ Jehova nĩarathimĩte andũ ake, na irio ici nyingĩ ũũ igagĩtigara.”
english: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into Yahweh’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

kikuyu: Indo ta iratu, indo cia wira, nguo kana indo ingī iria ihutanītie giko kīa mwīrī kīa nyoni ndwaru noitheremie mūrimū rūūru-inī rwerū.
english: Objects such as shoes, equipment, clothing and other materials contaminated with infected feces can spread the disease to new flock.

kikuyu: Maherithia maigĩirwo anyũrũrania, nacio iboko ikaigĩrwo mĩgongo ya andũ arĩa akĩĩgu. 20
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools. 20

kikuyu: Aca, Kwarīra marigū gūtigiragīrīria gūtamba kwa mboca cia marīgu
english: No, mulching does not control banana weevils.

kikuyu: Ndūgekīre thumu wa ngūkū kana bataraitha na ihenya thutha wa kūhanda mīembe yaku.
english: Do NOT use chicken manure or fertilise too soon after planting.

kikuyu: O ūrīa ūrambata irīma-inī, noguo rīera rīcenjagia na makīria uhehu ūkaingīha. ūndū ūyū nīūtūmaga kahūa gakorwo na ngūrani na mūcamo ūgacenjia.
english: The altitude is closely related to the latitude of the region which affects the temperature, and this directly affects the quality of the coffee bean.

kikuyu: Ūgīthamia mīūngūrwa yaku ūmenyerere ndūkaunange mīri.
english: In removing the seedlings from the seed beds, be very careful not to break the roots

kikuyu: “Andũ-a-nja aingĩ manatuĩka ngatha, no wee nĩũmakĩrĩte othe.”
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

kikuyu: Tondũ watho wokire na Musa, no ũtugi na ũhoro ũrĩa wa ma ciokire na Jesũ Kristũ.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.§

kikuyu: Nake Labani akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩndetĩkĩra; reke gũtuĩke o ro ũguo woiga.”
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

kikuyu: Juda akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ atĩa tũngĩĩra mwathi witũ? Tũngiuga atĩa? Tũngĩhota atĩa kuonania atĩ tũtiĩhĩtie? Ngai nĩwe ũguũrĩtie mahĩtia ma ndungata ciaku. Rĩu ithuĩ tũrĩ ngombo cia mwathi witũ, ithuothe ũndũ ũmwe na ũrĩa ũkorirwo na gĩkombe kĩu.”
english: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

kikuyu: Haragĩriai gatũrũme ga keerĩ hwaĩ-inĩ kũrĩ mairia hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu o na iruta rĩa kĩndũ gĩa kũnyuuo o ta ũrĩa mũharagĩria rĩa rũciinĩ. Rĩu nĩrĩo igongona rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki rĩrĩ na mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ mũndũ ũcio mwathi wa bũrũri agĩtwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Gĩkĩ nĩkĩo gĩgũtũma menye kana mũrĩ andũ ehokeku: Ndigĩrai mũrũ wa thoguo ũmwe gũkũ, muoe irio mũthiĩ mũcitwarĩre andũ a nyũmba cianyu acio marĩ na ngʼaragu.
english: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

kikuyu: Ũgũtũũra ũrũũraga nginya-rĩ, wee mwarĩ ũyũ ũtarĩ mwĩhokeku? Jehova nĩegũthondeka ũndũ mwerũ gũkũ thĩ: mũndũ-wa-nja nĩakagitĩra mũndũ mũrũme.”
english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For Yahweh has created a new thing in the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”

kikuyu: O ihinda rĩu rĩa ũtukũ, mũrangĩri ũcio wa njeera akĩmooya, akĩmathambia ironda, na o hĩndĩ ĩyo we na andũ othe a nyũmba yake makĩbatithio.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ gũtirĩ ũndũ ũngĩ mwega andũ mangĩĩka ũkĩrĩte gũkena na gwĩka maũndũ mega rĩrĩa rĩothe megũtũũra muoyo.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

kikuyu: No woe tũcui, no no nginya ũkaarekereria nyina yũmbũke, nĩgeetha wonage maũndũ mega na ũtũũre hĩndĩ ndaaya.
english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

kikuyu: ndiigana kũgĩa na thayũ ngoro-inĩ yakwa, tondũ ndiakorire mũrũ-wa-Ithe witũ Tito kuo. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngiugĩra andũ akuo ũhoro, ngĩcooka ngĩthiĩ nginya Makedonia.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

kikuyu: Na ũmenyerere wega atĩ, bũrũri ũyũ ũkaaheanwo na ũndũ wa gũcuuka mĩtĩ. Kĩrĩa o gĩkundi gĩkaagaya gĩkaringana na marĩĩtwa ma mĩhĩrĩga ya maithe mao ma tene.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

kikuyu: Hakĩrĩ ũguo-rĩ, menyerera ũtheri ũrĩa ũrĩ thĩinĩ waku ndũgatuĩke nduma.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo acio eerĩ makĩmeera maũndũ marĩa meekĩkĩte marĩ njĩra-inĩ, na ũrĩa maamenyire Jesũ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa eenyũrire mũgate.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

kikuyu: Mĩaka yothe ĩrĩa Nuhu aatũũrire muoyo yarĩ mĩaka magana kenda na mĩrongo ĩtano, agĩcooka agĩkua. 10
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died. 10

kikuyu: Nake Pelegu aakinyia mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ, agĩtuĩka ithe wa Reu.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩagacina gĩcunjĩ gĩa kĩririkano kĩa ngano thĩye ĩrĩ na maguta hamwe na ũbani wothe, rĩrĩ iruta rĩrutĩirwo Jehova na mwaki.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩakamũharagania kũrĩ andũ a ndũrĩrĩ, na no andũ anini anyu magaatigara gatagatĩ-inĩ ka ndũrĩrĩ iria Jehova akaamũharaganĩria.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.

kikuyu: Arũme othe a ũkũrũ wa kuuma mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ nginya mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtano arĩa mookire kũruta wĩra wa gũtungata na gũkuua Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: No itirĩ hĩndĩ ingĩrũmĩrĩra mũgeni; ũrĩa kũrĩ nĩ atĩ nĩikũmũũrĩra, tondũ itiũĩ mũgambo wa mũgeni.”
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩatũma njuge ũguo? Nĩ tondũ ndimwendete? Ngai nĩoĩ atĩ nĩndĩmwendete!
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

kikuyu: Na makĩria-rĩ, nĩnjiguĩte gũcaaya kwa andũ a Isiraeli, arĩa matuĩtwo ngombo nĩ andũ a Misiri, na nĩndirikanĩte kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa nao.
english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

kikuyu: Nake Jakubu aarĩkia kũhe ariũ ake ũhoro ũcio-rĩ, agĩthuna magũrũ make arĩ o gĩtanda-inĩ, agĩtuĩkana, agĩcookanĩrĩrio kũrĩ andũ ao arĩa maakuĩte. 50
english: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people. 50

kikuyu: Makaahĩnganaga makĩũra o ta andũ maroorĩra rũhiũ rwa njora o na gũtarĩ mũndũ ũmaingatithĩtie. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũtikahota gwĩtiiria thũ cianyu.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

kikuyu: Ngai ũrĩa ũtũũraga tene na tene nĩwe kĩĩhitho gĩaku, namo moko make matũũraga nginya tene na tene marĩ mũhuro waku. Nĩakarutũrũra thũ yaku yehere mbere yaku, akiugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Mĩniine!’
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

kikuyu: Jehova, o we Mũkũũri waku, o we Mũtheru wa Isiraeli, ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai waku, ũrĩa ũkũrutaga maũndũ marĩa makwagĩrĩire, na nowe ũkuonagĩrĩria njĩra ĩrĩa wagĩrĩirwo nĩkũgera.
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Musa agĩtoonya itu-inĩ o akĩambataga kĩrĩma. Agĩikara kũu kĩrĩma-inĩ matukũ mĩrongo ĩna, ũtukũ na mũthenya.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Scales cia magūrū nīnyoroku na rangi wa ngoikoni
english: Scales on the feet are smooth and yellow

kikuyu: O na acio maruaga matiathĩkagĩra watho, no nĩmendaga inyuĩ mũrue nĩguo metĩĩage nĩ ũndũ wa mĩĩrĩ yanyu.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcooka akĩndwara nja ĩyo ya nyumĩrĩra, na agĩĩthiũrũrũkia koine-inĩ ciayo inya, na niĩ ngĩona atĩ o koine-inĩ nĩ haarĩ na nja ĩngĩ.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

kikuyu: Ngurumo-inĩ cia njũũĩ cia Babuloni nĩkuo twaikaraga thĩ tũkarĩra, twaririkana Zayuni.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

kikuyu: Na ũtukũ o ro ũcio, Jakubu agĩũkĩra, akĩoya atumia ake eerĩ, na ndungata iria igĩrĩ cia andũ-a- nja, na ariũ ake ikũmi na ũmwe, na akĩmaringĩria iringĩro rĩa Jaboku.
english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

kikuyu: Nacio ciothe nĩcigooka ciikare iharũrũka-inĩ cia mĩkuru, na mĩatũka-inĩ ya ndwaro cia mahiga, na ihinga-inĩ ciothe cia mĩigua, na marima-inĩ mothe ma maaĩ.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

kikuyu: Maatungataga na ũini Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo o nginya rĩrĩa Solomoni aakire hekarũ ya Jehova kũu Jerusalemu. Nao maarutaga wĩra wao kũringana na mawatho marĩa maatuĩtwo.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Rũciaro rwaganu na rwa ũtharia rũrenda rũringĩrwo kĩama! No gũtirĩ kĩama rũkũringĩrwo tiga o kĩama kĩrĩa kĩa mũnabii Jona.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: inyuĩ njiaro cia Isiraeli ndungata yake, o inyuĩ ciana cia Jakubu, inyuĩ andũ ake arĩa athuurĩte.
english: you offspring† of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: “No niĩ ngĩrĩ ũ, nao andũ akwa-rĩ, makĩrĩ a, atĩ no tũhote kũheana na ũtaana ta ũyũ? Indo ciothe ciumaga kũrĩ we, na kĩrĩa twakũhe no kĩrĩa kiumĩte moko-inĩ maku.
english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jesũ akĩrũgama mbere ya barũthi, nake barũthi ũcio akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Wee nĩwe Mũthamaki wa Ayahudi?” Jesũ agĩcookia atĩrĩ. “Ĩĩ, wee nĩwoiga.”
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Mũtikanamĩrĩĩanĩrie na mĩgate mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia, no ihinda rĩa mĩthenya mũgwanja mũrĩe mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩimbie, arĩ yo mĩgate ya mĩnyamaro, nĩ ũndũ mwoimire bũrũri wa Misiri na ihenya, na nĩgeetha matukũ-inĩ mothe ma muoyo wanyu mũririkanage mũthenya ũcio mwoimire bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩmwamũkĩrire Roho Mũtheru rĩrĩa mwetĩkirie?” Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Aca, ithuĩ o na tũtirĩ twaigua atĩ nĩ kũrĩ Roho Mũtheru.”
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Arahũka, arahũka, wee Zayuni, wĩĩkĩre hinya. Ĩkĩra nguo ciaku iria irĩ riiri, o wee Jerusalemu, itũũra rĩrĩa inene na rĩamũre. Nĩgũkorwo kuuma rĩu thĩinĩ waku gũtigacooka gũtoonya mũndũ ũtarĩ mũruu kana mũndũ ũrĩ na thaahu.
english: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.

kikuyu: Nake mũirĩtu ũcio warĩ kĩhingo-inĩ akĩũria Petero atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ wee ũrĩ ũmwe wa arutwo a mũndũ ũyũ?” Nake agĩcookia agĩkiuga atĩrĩ, “Aca, ndirĩ ũmwe wao.”
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩu ndĩ hakuhĩ gwaka hekarũ ĩtanĩtio na Rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova Ngai wakwa na ndĩmĩamũre ĩtuĩke yake ya gũcinagĩra ũbumba ũrĩa ũtararĩkaga wega mbere yake, o na ya kũigagwo mĩgate ĩrĩa mĩamũre mahinda mothe, na ya kũrutagĩra magongona ma njino o rũciinĩ, na hwaĩ-inĩ, na mĩthenya ya Thabatũ, na hĩndĩ ya Tũrũgamo twa Mweri na ciathĩ iria nyamũre cia Jehova Ngai witũ. Ũyũ nĩ watho mwandĩke wa Isiraeli wa gũtũũra nginya tene.
english: Behold,† I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Yahweh our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

kikuyu: Ndũũru ciothe cia mbũri cia Kedari igaacookanĩrĩrio irehwo kũrĩ we, ũtungatagĩrwo nĩ ndũrũme cia Nebaiothu; nĩigetĩkĩrwo, ituĩke cia kũrutwo igongona kĩgongona-inĩ gĩakwa, na niĩ nĩngagemia hekarũ yakwa ĩrĩa ĩrĩ riiri.
english: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.

kikuyu: Nĩ gũkorwo o ta ũrĩa Jona aikarire matukũ matatũ, mũthenya na ũtukũ, arĩ nda ya thamaki ĩrĩa nene, ũguo noguo Mũrũ wa Mũndũ agaikara matukũ matatũ, mũthenya na ũtukũ, arĩ tĩĩri-inĩ.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

kikuyu: Andũ maathiiaga makamongania, magacooka makamathĩa na gĩthĩi kĩa moko, kana makamahũrĩra ndĩrĩ-inĩ na mũũthĩ. Maamarugaga na nyũngũ kana magathondeka tũmĩgate. Na maacamaga ta kĩndũ gĩthondeketwo na maguta ma mũtamaiyũ.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

kikuyu: Nake nĩekire maũndũ marĩa maarĩ magĩrĩru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova, o ta ũrĩa ithe Amazia eekĩte.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova agĩtwatha twathĩkagĩre kĩrĩra kĩa watho wothe wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, na twĩtigagĩre Jehova Ngai witũ, nĩgeetha tũgaacagĩre hĩndĩ ciothe, na tũtũũre muoyo o ta ũrĩa gũtariĩ ũmũthĩ.
english: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa twaheirwo ũhoro wamo nĩ arĩa meyoneire maũndũ macio kuuma o kĩambĩrĩria marĩ aira na ndungata cia ũhoro ũcio.
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

kikuyu: “ ‘Kĩũmbe gĩothe kĩrĩa gĩtambaga thĩ nĩgĩthũũre; ti gĩa kũrĩĩo.
english: “ ‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Hamwe nao kwarĩ na Alawii nao nĩ, Shemaia, na Nethania, na Zebadia, na Asaheli, na Shemiramothu, na Jehonathani, na Adonija, na Tobija, na Tobu-Adonija, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai Elishama na Jehoramu.
english: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa mũtumia ũmwe Mũsamaria okire gũtaha maaĩ-rĩ, Jesũ akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “No ũũhe maaĩ ma kũnyua?”
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

kikuyu: Nĩmahutatĩire makaaga kũhũgũra mothiũ mao kũrĩ niĩ; o na gũtuĩka nĩndamarutire kaingĩ kaingĩ, matiathikĩrĩirie kana magĩtĩkĩra gũtaarwo.
english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Andũ a ihinda rĩĩrĩ nĩo mahikaga na makahikania.
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

kikuyu: ũguo nĩ kuuga atĩ inyuĩ na niĩ tũgĩe na ũhoro wa kũũmanĩrĩria, o mũndũ omĩrĩrie mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ na wĩtĩkio wake.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

kikuyu: Ihooya rĩakwa ti ũmarute gũkũ thĩ, no nĩ atĩ ũmagitagĩre kuuma kũrĩ ũrĩa mũũru.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

kikuyu: Ngai nĩwe ũgaaciirithia arĩa marĩ nja. “Ingatai mũndũ ũcio mwaganu oime thĩinĩ wanyu.”
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”*

kikuyu: Hĩndī ĩrĩa mbeū iria irīna mūrimū ūcio yahandwo, mĩmera ĩrĩa ĩmeraga nayo nīikuaga na ihenya; no mĩmera ĩyo ĩihūthīkaga na kīhumo kīa inoculum kīa mīmera īngī.
english: When infected seeds germinate, the resulting young plants usually die quickly; however, these plants serve as an inoculum source for other plants.

kikuyu: Wee thiĩ ũkuhĩrĩrie, ũigue ũrĩa wothe Jehova Ngai witũ ekuuga. Ũcooke ũũke ũtwĩre ũrĩa wothe Jehova Ngai witũ egũkwĩra. Nĩtũkũigua na twathĩke.”
english: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

kikuyu: guoya na kĩmako nĩikamakinyĩrĩra. Na ũndũ wa hinya wa guoko gwaku-rĩ, makahaana ta ihiga matekwĩnyagunyia, nginya andũ aku, Wee Jehova, maringe, nginya andũ arĩa wegũrĩire maringe.
english: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, Yahweh, until the people you have purchased pass over.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ magĩtharĩkĩra kambĩ cia arĩithi na magĩtaha ndũũru cia ngʼondu, na cia mbũri, na cia ngamĩĩra. Nao magĩcooka Jerusalemu.
english: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Na ithuĩ tũngĩmenyerera gwathĩkĩra watho ũyũ wothe tũrĩ mbere ya Jehova Ngai witũ, o ta ũrĩa atwathĩte- rĩ, ũcio nĩ ũgaatuĩka ũthingu witũ.”
english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Tũnyamũ tuothe tũrĩa tũmbũkaga na tũthiiagĩra thĩ na magũrũ mana nĩ mwagĩrĩirwo nĩ gũtũthũũra mũno.
english: “ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

kikuyu: Kũũmĩrĩria kwanyu nĩkuo gũgaatũma mũhonokie mĩoyo yanyu.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩkaagĩa na mũriũ ũtangĩigua na mũremi, ũtaathĩkagĩra ithe na nyina, na ũtangĩ- maigua o na mamũhũũra-rĩ,
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

kikuyu: Moima Refidimu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Werũ-inĩ wa Sinai.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Ũmwe wao, mũrutwo ũrĩa Jesũ endete, aikarĩte thĩ etiiranĩtie na Jesũ.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

kikuyu: Kuuma 9 x 9 m nginya 13 x 13 na ūringanaga na mūthemba wa mūembe, tīīri na rīera rīa itūra.
english: Range from 9 x 9 m to 13 x 13 m depending on growth characteristic of the individual variety, the type of soil, and agroecological conditions

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũgenyũ wa arĩa matarĩ ũũgĩ nĩũkamooraga, nakuo kwĩgangara kwa arĩa akĩĩgu nĩgũkamaniina;
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

kikuyu: Mūthemba wa Ruiru 11 woyaga kahinda kaigana atia kūruta maciaro ma mbere?
english: How long does Ruiru 11 coffee take to mature?

kikuyu: Nĩ maita maingĩ atĩa maamũremagĩra marĩ kũu werũ-inĩ, na makamũiguithia kĩeha marĩ kũu rũngʼũrĩ-inĩ.
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

kikuyu: Nacio ciĩhitho ciao cia hinya nĩikaagũa nĩ ũndũ wa guoya; nao anene ao a ita moona bendera ya ita nĩmakamaka mũno,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga, ũrĩa wakĩtie mwaki wake Zayuni, o na icua rĩake rĩa mwaki rĩrĩ kũu Jerusalemu.
english: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nake Petero akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa angĩ.” Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ariũ ao matirĩhaga.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũgũikara itũũra-inĩ rĩĩrĩ inene, akooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora, kana ngʼaragu, kana mũthiro. No ũrĩa wothe ũgaathiĩ eneane kũrĩ andũ a Babuloni arĩa mamũrigiicĩirie nĩagatũũra muoyo; nĩakahonokia muoyo wake.
english: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.

kikuyu: nĩoirwo agĩtwarwo kũrĩa andũ arĩa metĩkĩtie mathiiaga, akĩigua maũndũ matangĩĩranĩka nĩ mũndũ, na maũndũ marĩa mũndũ atangĩtĩkĩrio kwaria.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

kikuyu: Wagīrīire kūhanda itina cigana cia kahūa mūthemba wa Ruiru harī īka imwe ya mūgūnda?
english: How many Ruiru coffee trees per īka?

kikuyu: Ĩkagai maũndũ mothe mũrĩ na wendani.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũrata wakwa, ĩka ũrĩa ũũkire gwĩka.” Nao andũ acio makĩmũguthũkĩra, makĩmũnyiita.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

kikuyu: nao andũ othe, arĩa anini na arĩa anene, makamũthikagĩrĩria na makoiga na mũgambo mũnene atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũyũ nĩwe hinya wa ũngai ũrĩa ũĩkaine ta Hinya Mũnene.”
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

kikuyu: Mũtumia ũrĩa ngatha nĩwe thũmbĩ ya mũthuuri wake, no mũtumia ũconorithagia mũthuuri wake atariĩ ta ũbuthu mahĩndĩ-inĩ make.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

kikuyu: Mũkaũgayana ũtuĩke igai rĩanyu inyuĩ ene, na rĩa andũ a kũngĩ arĩa matũũraga gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu na nĩ marĩ na ciana. Nĩmũkamatua ta marĩ andũ a Isiraeli maciarĩirwo bũrũri ũcio; acio makaagaĩrwo igai hamwe na inyuĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ ka mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli.
english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Efiraimu ciarĩ: Shuthela na mũriũ Beredi, na Tahathu mũriũ wa Beredi, na Eleada mũriũ wa Tahathu, na Tahathu mũriũ wa Eleada, na mũriũ Zabadi, na Shuthela mũriũ wa Zabadi,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jesũ aarĩkia gwĩta arutwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ hamwe, nĩamaheire hinya na ũhoti wa kũingata ndaimono ciothe na kũhonia mĩrimũ,
english: He called the twelve† together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

kikuyu: Nĩwaingatire ndũrĩrĩ na guoko gwaku, na ũgĩcooka kũhaanda maithe maitũ kuo; Wee nĩwanyariirire irĩndĩ iria ingĩ, na ũgĩtũma maithe maitũ magaacĩre.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũrĩa ũgũtwĩra, ũrĩ mwega kana ũrĩ mũũru, nĩtũgwathĩkĩra Jehova Ngai witũ, o ũcio tũragũtũma kũrĩ we, nĩgeetha na ithuĩ tuonage maũndũ mega, nĩ ũndũ nĩtũgwathĩkĩra Jehova Ngai witũ.”
english: Whether it is good, or whether it is bad, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, andũ arĩa Musa aatũmĩte magathigaane bũrũri ũcio wa Kaanani, o acio macookire na magĩtũma kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩnugunĩre Musa nĩkũmemerekia ũhoro mũũru wa bũrũri ũcio,
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ũyũ nĩguo ũira wa Johana hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Ayahudi a Jerusalemu maamũtũmĩire athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii makamũũrie we aarĩ ũ.
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

kikuyu: Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndingĩahotire kũmwarĩria ta mũrĩ andũ a kĩĩroho, no ndaamwarĩirie ta mũrĩ andũ a thĩ, o ta twana tũnini thĩinĩ wa Kristũ.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

kikuyu: Ūharagīria atīa harīa urathamīria mīungūrwa?
english: How do I prepare land for transplanting of cabbages seedlings?

kikuyu: O hĩndĩ ĩyo Jesũ akĩaragia-rĩ, hagĩũka andũ moimĩte kwa Jairũ ũrĩa warĩ mũnene wa thunagogi, makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mwarĩguo nĩakua. Ũgũgĩthĩĩnia mũrutani rĩngĩ nĩkĩ?”
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

kikuyu: na Zora, na Aijaloni, na Hebironi. Maya maarĩ matũũra manene mairigĩirwo na thingo cia hinya kũu Juda na Benjamini.
english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

kikuyu: nĩ ũndũ wao akĩririkana kĩrĩkanĩro gĩake, na nĩ ũndũ wa wendo wake mũnene akĩringwo nĩ tha.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Ona kūrī ūguo, hactare īmwe no īgethwo tani mīrongo īrī na ītano ona makīria ya maembe mūthemba wa Kent, Sabine, Tommy Atkins na Keītt.
english: However, it is well known that yields of 25 t/ha and more for Kent, Sabine, Tommy Atkins and Keitt are not uncommon.

kikuyu: No Paũlũ akĩĩra thigari icio atĩrĩ, “Maratũhũũrire mbere ya mũingĩ tũtaciirithĩtio, o na gũtuĩka ithuĩ tũrĩ raiya a Roma, na maratũikia njeera. Rĩu marakĩenda gũtũruta na hitho? Aca! Reke mooke o ene matũrute nja, matuumagarie.”
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

kikuyu: Ũtonga waku, na indo ciaku cia wonjoria, na cia wendia, na thigari ciaku cia iria-inĩ, na arĩa marutaga wĩra marikabu-inĩ, na arĩa marutaga wĩra wa gũthinga, na onjorithia aku, na thigari ciaku ciothe, na mũndũ ũngĩ o wothe ũrĩ marikabu-inĩ, nĩmagatoonyerera iria gatagatĩ mũthenya ũrĩa marikabu yaku ĩkoinĩkanga.
english: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

kikuyu: Ohania irengeeri igĩrĩ cia thahabu mĩrĩnga-inĩ hau mĩthia-inĩ ya gakuo ga gĩthũri,
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngamĩgayanĩria igai hamwe na arĩa anene, o na magayane indo cia gũtahwo na andũ arĩa marĩ hinya, tondũ nĩarutire muoyo wake akue, na agĩtaranĩrio na arĩa aagarari watho. Nĩgũkorwo nĩakuuire mehia ma andũ aingĩ, o na arĩa maahĩtĩtie akĩmathaithanĩrĩra.
english: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

kikuyu: No rĩu-rĩ, ndagũthaitha marekere mehia mao; angĩkorwo ndũkũmarekera, o na niĩ tharia ibuku-inĩ rĩrĩa wandĩkĩte andũ aku.”
english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

kikuyu: “Ĩtai aikia a mĩguĩ mokĩrĩre Babuloni, o arĩa othe mageetaga ũta. Ambaai hema mũgũthiũrũrũkĩirie; mũtikareke mũndũ o na ũmwe warĩo oore. Rĩrĩhei kũringana na ciĩko ciarĩo; o ta ũrĩa rĩaneeka andũ angĩ-rĩ, rĩĩkei o ta guo. Nĩgũkorwo nĩrĩngʼathĩirie Jehova, o we Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli.
english: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: O na ũkũrũ-inĩ wanyu, no niĩ, o na rĩrĩa mũgaakorwo mũrĩ na mbuĩ, niĩ nĩ niĩ ngũmũtũũria muoyo. Nĩ niĩ ndaamũũmbire, na nĩ niĩ ngũtũũra ndĩmũkuuaga, ĩĩ ti-itherũ nĩ niĩ ngũmũtũũria muoyo na ndĩmũhonokagie.
english: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

kikuyu: Na niĩ ndaatuirwo ndungata yaguo na ũndũ wa gũtũmwo nĩ Ngai ndĩmũrehere ũhoro wa Ngai mũũmenye kũna,
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩrakarĩra andũ ake, na agĩthũũra igai rĩake mũno.
english: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

kikuyu: Athamaki ao nĩakamaneana moko-inĩ manyu, na inyuĩ nĩmũkaniina marĩĩtwa mao biũ mehere gũkũ thĩ mũhuro wa riũa. Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũkaahota kũmwĩtiiria; nĩ mũkaamaniina.
english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

kikuyu: tondũ nĩtũiguĩte ũhoro wa ũrĩa mwĩtĩkĩtie Kristũ Jesũ, o na ũrĩa mwendete andũ arĩa othe aamũre,
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩwe ũhoro wake waandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “ ‘Nĩngũtũma mũtũmwo wakwa athiĩ mbere yaku, agagũthondekere njĩra yaku.’
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’*

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ Mũisiraeli, mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja, ũgaatuĩka mũmaraya wa ihooero.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa mwaganu etĩĩaga rĩrĩa ekũhĩta andũ arĩa matarĩ hinya, rĩrĩa magwatio nĩ mĩbango ĩyo mathugundĩte.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

kikuyu: Kiugo kĩa Jehova nĩkĩanginyĩrĩire, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ningĩ magĩthondeka buremu mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia mwena wa gũthini wa hema ĩyo nyamũre,
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

kikuyu: na akĩmatũma mathiĩ makahunjie ũhoro wa ũthamaki wa Ngai na mahonagie andũ arĩa arũaru.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

kikuyu: Maaĩ magĩcookana, magĩthika ngaari cia ita na andũ arĩa mathiiaga mahaicĩte mbarathi; nĩo mbũtũ yothe ya Firaũni ĩrĩa yarũmĩrĩire andũ a Isiraeli iria-inĩ. Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wao wahonokire.
english: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.

kikuyu: Mĩthiĩre ya andũ arĩa athingu ĩhaana ta ũtheri wa gũgĩkĩa, ũrĩa ũthiiaga ũgĩthererũkaga nginya mũthenya barigici.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, kwa ihinda rĩa mĩaka ĩtatũ gũtiarĩ na mbaara gatagatĩ ga Suriata na Isiraeli.
english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

kikuyu: “ ‘Gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũtarĩ wa nyũmba ya mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai wagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũrĩa maruta marĩa matheru, o na mũgeni wa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, kana mũruti wa wĩra gwake o nao matigacirĩe.
english: “ ‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

kikuyu: akaaruta maguta macio o ta ũrĩa marutagwo ndegwa ĩrĩa ĩthĩnjagwo ĩrĩ iruta rĩa ũiguano. Nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩagacicinĩra kĩgongona-inĩ kĩa igongona rĩa njino,
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

english: The Sabine variety is best suited for cultivation in mid altitudes.

kikuyu: Bũrũri wa Misiri ndũgacooka gũtuĩka mwĩhoko wa andũ a Isiraeli, no ũgaatũĩka kĩririkania kĩa mehia mao ma gũcaria ũteithio kuo. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Mwathani Jehova.’ ”
english: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Mũthamaki Solomoni nĩaheire mũthamaki-mũndũ-wa-nja wa Sheba kĩrĩa gĩothe eerirĩirie na kĩrĩa eetirie; akĩmũhe indo makĩria ma iria we aamũreheire. Mũthamaki mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio akiumagara hamwe na ndungata ciake, agĩcooka bũrũri wake mwene.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

kikuyu: O na ndwarekire mumunye ciana cia ciana ciakwa, kana njugĩre airĩtu akwa ũhoro. Nĩwĩkĩte ũndũ wa ũrimũ.
english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ũmũthĩ ũngĩĩtĩkĩra gũtuĩka ndungata ya andũ aya na ũmatungatĩre, na ũmacookerie na njĩra njagĩrĩru-rĩ, megũtũũra marĩ ndungata ciaku hĩndĩ ciothe.”
english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

kikuyu: Mwathani Jehova Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Njĩra ĩrĩa ĩngĩtũma mũhonoke no ya kwĩrira na gũikara mũtegwĩtanga, naguo hinya ũrĩa mũkaagĩa naguo ũkooneka nĩ ũndũ wa gũikara mũhooreire na kwĩhoka, no macio mothe nĩmũmaregete.
english: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

kikuyu: Kĩndũ gĩothe kĩanakorwo kuo kĩaheirwo rĩĩtwa, nake mũndũ nĩamenyekete ũrĩa atariĩ; gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩhota gũkararania na ũrĩa ũrĩ hinya kũmũkĩra.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

kikuyu: Mawega ma gūkūria mīembe ya Kent nīatī nī marī cama, matirī ndigi, mūtararīko mūnene na matithūkaga naihenya
english: Some advantages of growing the fruits is because they are sweet, fibreless, strong flavored and have a long shelf life.

kikuyu: Honge ciaguo ciarĩ hinya, igakĩagĩrĩra gũtuuo mũthĩgi wa mũthamaki. Mũthabibũ ũcio ũkĩraiha na igũrũ, ũgĩkĩra mahuti marĩa matumanu, na nĩwonekaga wega nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa waraihĩte na igũrũ, na nĩ ũndũ wa honge ciaguo nyingĩ.
english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.

kikuyu: Ũrĩa wothe wĩraga mũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩ na mahĩtia atĩrĩ, “Wee ndũrĩ na mahĩtia,” kĩrĩndĩ nĩgĩkamũruma, na athũũrwo nĩ ndũrĩrĩ.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

kikuyu: iria ciugaga atĩrĩ, “Tũkũhootana nĩ ũndũ wa nĩmĩ ciitũ; mĩromo ĩno tũrĩ nayo nĩ iitũ; mwathi witũ akĩrĩ ũ?”
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

kikuyu: Ndĩ na ngʼondu ingĩ iria itarĩ cia gĩcegũ gĩkĩ. No nginya o nacio ndĩcirehe. O nacio nĩigathikĩrĩria mũgambo wakwa, na gũgaakorwo na rũũru rũmwe, na mũrĩithi ũmwe.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold.* I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

kikuyu: akĩrũmĩrĩra ũtaaro wa aanake, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Baba nĩamũritũhĩirie icooki, no niĩ nĩngũrĩritũhia makĩria. Baba aamũhũũraga na iboko, no niĩ ndĩrĩmũhũũraga na tũngʼaurũ.”
english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

kikuyu: ngĩkĩĩririkania ũrĩa ndainaga ũtukũ, ngoro yakwa ĩgĩtarania maũndũ, naguo roho wakwa ũkĩyũũria atĩrĩ:
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

kikuyu: Mūthemba wa Sabine nīūhotaga gūītiria mīrimū ya powdery mildew na anthracnose.
english: The Sabine Variety has some resistance to powdery mildew and anthracnose.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Hebironi, Jeria nĩwe warĩ mũnene wao kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa cia nyũmba ciao. Mwaka wa mĩrongo ĩna wa ũthamaki wa Daudi nĩ gwatuĩririo maandĩko-inĩ, na gũkĩoneka thĩinĩ wao andũ ehoti o kũu Jazeri ya Gileadi.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

kikuyu: Mangʼũrĩ ma Ngai nĩmaguũrĩtio kuuma igũrũ mokĩrĩre ũhoro wothe wa andũ kũregana na Ngai, na waganu wa andũ arĩa magiragĩrĩria ũhoro-ũrĩa-wa-ma na ũndũ wa waganu wao,
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ciĩranĩro cia Ngai, o na cingĩhĩte atĩa-rĩ, ciothe nĩ “Ĩĩ” thĩinĩ wa Kristũ. Na nĩ ũndũ ũcio thĩinĩ wake, ithuĩ tũkoigaga “Ameni” nĩgeetha Ngai agoocagwo.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

kikuyu: Na maatoonya nyũmba thĩinĩ, arutwo makĩũria Jesũ ũhoro ũcio o rĩngĩ.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

kikuyu: Mũira wa ma arutaga o ũira wa ma, no mũira ũtarĩ wa ma aaragia maheeni.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

kikuyu: Makĩria ma ũguo, nĩwe wathuurirwo nĩ makanitha nĩguo atwarane na ithuĩ ũhoro-inĩ wa mũhothi ũcio wa ũtaana, o ũcio tũrutagĩra wĩra nĩguo tũgoocithie Mwathani we mwene, na tuonanie kĩyo kĩrĩa tũrĩ nakĩo gĩa kwenda gũteithia.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Firaũni agĩĩta Musa, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Thiĩi mũkahooe Jehova. O na atumia anyu na ciana no mathiĩ na inyuĩ; no rĩrĩ, mũtige ndũũru cianyu cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe.”
english: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

kikuyu: Matũ marĩa maiguaga na maitho marĩa monaga-rĩ, cierĩ nĩ Jehova waciũmbire.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

kikuyu: Nake Petero agĩikara Jopa mĩthenya mĩingĩ kwa mũndũ wetagwo Simoni, ũrĩa warĩ mũtanduki wa njũũa.†
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

kikuyu: Irigithathi rĩa ndigiri ũrĩrĩkũũraga na gatũrũme, no ũngĩaga kũrĩkũũra, riune ngingo. Nao ariũ aku a marigithathi ũmakũũrage. “Gũtikanagĩe mũndũ o na ũmwe ũrĩũkaga mbere yakwa moko matheri.
english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: No-o magĩthiĩ na mbere kwanĩrĩra, makiugaga atĩrĩ, “Mwambe mũtĩ-igũrũ! Mwambe mũtĩ-igũrũ!”
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

kikuyu: na Shemueli mũrũ wa Amihudu, kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Simeoni;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũrĩa ũtakeima irio mũthenya ũcio nĩakaingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: “ ‘Gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa indo ciothe cia kuuma mũgũnda, arĩ ngano ya mũgũnda kana maciaro ma mĩtĩ, nĩ kĩa Jehova; gĩcunjĩ kĩu kĩamũrĩirwo Jehova.
english: “ ‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Oholibama mũtumia wa Esaũ: Anene maarĩ Jeushu, na Jalamu, na Kora. Aya nĩo anene arĩa maaciarirwo nĩ Oholibama mũtumia wa Esaũ mwarĩ wa Ana.
english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Athingithagia thĩ ĩkoima handũ hayo, na akainainia itugĩ ciayo.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

kikuyu: Bũrũri wao ũiyũrĩte betha na thahabu, igĩĩna ciao itingĩthira. Bũrũri wao ũiyũrĩte mbarathi; na ngaari ciao cia ita itingĩtarĩka.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

kikuyu: Maũndũ make nĩmatũũgĩru gũkĩra igũrũ, wee nĩ atĩa ũngĩka? Nĩ mariku gũkĩra ũriku wa mbĩrĩra, wee nĩ atĩa ũngĩmenya?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol.† What can you know?

kikuyu: No handũ hau hangĩkorwo hatigarũrũkĩte na hatithegeete, kĩu no kĩrema kĩa ihũha, nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩagatua atĩ mũndũ ũcio ndarĩ na thaahu.
english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

kikuyu: Nake akĩrũmĩrĩra mĩthiĩre ya ithe Asa na ndaigana gũtigana nayo; agĩĩka ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire maitho-inĩ ma Jehova.
english: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Elihu mũrũ wa Barakeli ũrĩa Mũbuzi, wa nyũmba ya Ramu, nĩarakaririo mũno nĩ Ayubu nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtua aarĩ na kĩhooto gũkĩra Ngai.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

kikuyu: “Ndũkanetigĩre; tondũ ndũgaaconoka. O na ndũkanaigue guoya wa gũconorithio; nĩgũkorwo ndũrĩ hĩndĩ ũkaanyararithio. Nĩukariganĩrwo nĩ thoni cia ũnini waku, na ndũgacooka kũririkana rĩngĩ ũrĩa wananyararwo nĩgũkorwo ũrĩ wa ndigwa.
english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, na gũtirĩ ũngĩ; tiga niĩ gũtirĩ Ngai ũngĩ. Nĩndĩrĩkuongagĩrĩra hinya, o na gũtuĩka wee ndũnjũũĩ,
english: I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen† you, though you have not known me,

kikuyu: Ũthiũ wakwa nĩũtunĩhĩte nĩkũrĩra, nduma nene ĩgakĩhumbĩra maitho makwa;
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

kikuyu: Mũthamaki Zedekia akĩĩra Jeremia atĩrĩ, “Nĩndĩretigĩra Ayahudi arĩa meneanĩte kũrĩ andũ a Babuloni, nĩ ũndũ andũ a Babuloni mahota kũũneana kũrĩ Ayahudi acio nao maanyamarie.”
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”

kikuyu: No mũndũ ũrĩa ũiguaga ciugo ciakwa, na ndekaga ũrĩa ciugĩte, ahaana ta mũndũ ũrĩa waakire nyũmba ĩtarĩ na mũthingi. Na rĩrĩa kĩguũ kĩagũthire nyũmba ĩyo, ĩkĩmomoka, naguo mwanangĩko wayo warĩ mũnene.”
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

kikuyu: Isaaka akĩmarugithĩria iruga, nao makĩrĩa na makĩnyua.
english: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano wa mweri ũcio nĩguo mũrĩgĩaga na gĩathĩ; mĩthenya mũgwanja mũrĩĩage mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

kikuyu: Thahabu kana icicio-rĩ, itingĩhota kũgerekanio naguo; o na kana ũkũũranio na mathaga ma thahabu.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

kikuyu: “Warĩkia gũtheria Alawii acio na kũmaruta matuĩke ta igongona rĩa gũthũngũthio-rĩ, nĩmarutage wĩra wao Hema-inĩ-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

kikuyu: Hihi njīra cia gūciarithia ng'ombe nī irīkū?
english: What are the available breeding methods?

kikuyu: O na mũngĩkagarũrũka na mwena wa ũrĩo kana wa ũmotho, matũ manyu nĩmakaiguaga mũgambo thuutha wanyu ũkiuga atĩrĩ, “Ĩno nĩyo njĩra; gererai yo.”
english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

kikuyu: Mũnabii ũcio mũkũrũ akĩĩra ariũ ake atĩrĩ, “Ndandĩkĩrai ndigiri.” Nao magĩĩka o ũguo.
english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

kikuyu: Tinia thuna ya ūraihu wa iji ithathatū na īkorwo na mathangū meerī.
english: The cutting should be about 6 inches long with at least two leaves.

kikuyu: Beni-Hadadi agĩĩtĩkĩra ũhoro wa Mũthamaki Asa, agĩtũma anene a ikundi cia thigari ciake makahũũre matũũra ma Isiraeli. Nao magĩtooria Ijoni, na Dani, na Abeli-Maimu, na matũũra manene mothe marĩa maarĩ makũmbĩ ma kũu Nafitali.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Nī indo īrīkū ībatarainie hīndī ya gūciarithania mīembe?
english: What materials are needed for mango grafting?

kikuyu: Rĩĩtwa rĩaku, Wee Jehova, rĩtũũraga nginya tene, ngumo yaku, Wee Jehova, ĩgakinyĩra njiarwa na njiarwa.
english: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Jothamu nĩaakire rĩngĩ mwako wa Kĩhingo kĩa Rũgongo kĩa hekarũ ya Jehova, na akĩruta wĩra mũnene wa rũthingo rũrĩa rwarĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Ofeli.
english: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

kikuyu: uuge atĩrĩ, ‘Ta iguai ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova, inyuĩ athamaki a Juda, na andũ a Jerusalemu. Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, o we Ngai wa Isiraeli ekuuga atĩrĩ: Ta thikĩrĩriai! Nĩngũrehithia mwanangĩko kũndũ gũkũ ũrĩa ũgaatũma mũndũ o wothe ũrĩa ũkaũigua ararakwo nĩ matũ.
english: Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

kikuyu: Marĩ kũu Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Horu, hakuhĩ na mũhaka wa Edomu, Jehova akĩĩra Musa na Harũni atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

kikuyu: Hooyai Jehova thĩinĩ wa riiri wa ũtheru wake; inainai mũrĩ mbere yake, inyuĩ andũ a thĩ yothe.
english: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

kikuyu: makĩĩra Daudi atĩrĩ, “Ndũngĩtoonya gũkũ.” No rĩrĩ, Daudi nĩagĩtunyanire gĩikaro kĩu kĩairigĩirwo na thingo cia hinya gĩa Zayuni, Itũũra Inene rĩa Daudi.*
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

kikuyu: Wĩra wa Alawii warĩ wa gũteithia njiaro cia Harũni ũtungata-inĩ wa hekarũ ya Jehova ta ũũ: kũrũgamĩrĩra nja cia hekarũ na tũnyũmba twa ithaku-inĩ, na gũtherithia indo iria nyamũre, na kũruta mawĩra marĩa mangĩ thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Ngai.
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ũũ nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga: Niĩ mwene nĩngũgũũkĩrĩra, wee Jerusalemu, ngũherithie ũkĩonagwo nĩ ndũrĩrĩ icio.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ, ngoro-inĩ ciitũ twaiguaga tũtuĩrĩirwo gũkua. No kwahanĩkire ũguo nĩguo tũtikae kwĩĩhoka ithuĩ ene, no twĩhoke Ngai, ũrĩa ũriũkagia arĩa akuũ.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

kikuyu: na kũhooya mĩhianano, na kũrogana, na ũthũ, na kũũgitana, na ũiru, na mangʼũrĩ, na kwĩyenda, na nyamũkano, na ngarari,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

kikuyu: Gūkū nī gūtinia mūtī mūkūrū nīguo honge njerū ciume.
english: The procedure involves decapitating a mature tree so that new branches emerge.

kikuyu: Ihiga nĩ iritũ na mũthanga nĩ mũrigo, no kũrakario nĩ mũndũ mũkĩĩgu nĩ kũritũ gũkĩra icio cierĩ.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

kikuyu: Ta thikĩrĩriai! Nĩtũrakinyĩrio ũhoro, tũkeerwo atĩrĩ, kũrĩ na gacagaca nene kuuma bũrũri wa mwena wa gathigathini! Gacagaca ĩyo nĩĩgatũma matũũra ma Juda makire ihooru, ĩtũme matuĩke ma gũtũũragwo nĩ mbwe.
english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, kĩrĩa gĩothe ũmbĩte nĩkĩrĩkũgoocaga; andũ aku arĩa aamũre nĩmarĩgũkumagia.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Asuriata meeherire-rĩ, magĩtiga Joashu agurarĩtio mũno. Anene ake makĩgĩa ndundu mamũũkĩrĩre nĩ ũndũ wa kũũraga mũriũ wa Jehoiada ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri- Ngai, nao makĩmũũragĩra gĩtanda-inĩ gĩake. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩkua na agĩthikwo Itũũra-inĩ Inene rĩa Daudi, no ndaathikirwo mbĩrĩra-inĩ cia athamaki.
english: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.

kikuyu: “Mũtumia ũrĩ na mũthuuriwe angĩĩhĩta kana ehinge we mwene na kĩĩranĩro kĩa mwĩhĩtwa,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

kikuyu: Tondũ ngũmũhe ũrutani mwega, nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũtigatirike ũrutani wakwa.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

kikuyu: Nayo mbũtũ yothe ya ita ya Babuloni, ĩtongoretio nĩ mũnene ũcio wa arangĩri a mũthamaki, ĩkĩmomora thingo ciothe iria ciathiũrũrũkĩirie Jerusalemu.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

kikuyu: Mĩaka yothe ĩrĩa Methusela aatũũrire muoyo yarĩ mĩaka magana kenda na mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na kenda, agĩcooka agĩkua.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

kikuyu: Mītī īheo maaī rūcinī tene tondū o ūrīa mūthenya ūrakīa, noguo tīīri ūrahiūha.
english: Water early in the morning because as the day progresses, the soil warm up.

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa fungal- ūthūkagia mahuti ma marigū, ūgetūo Leaf Streak Sigatoka
english: General Descriptions: • A fungal disease that destroys banana leaves also called Leaf Streak Sigatoka

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũthingu nĩathũire ũhoro ũtarĩ wa ma, no mũndũ mwaganu ekaga maũndũ ma thoni na ma njono.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

kikuyu: Kahinda kanini thuutha wa mũnabii Hanania kuunanga icooki rĩu rĩarĩ ngingo-inĩ ya Jeremia ũcio mũnabii, ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova nĩyakinyĩire Jeremia akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: Weka ũguo nĩũgeetĩkĩrĩka, na ũgĩe na rĩĩtwa rĩega maitho-inĩ ma Ngai o na ma andũ.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

kikuyu: Uzia nĩathiire kũrũa na Afilisti, na akĩmomora thingo cia Gathu, na cia Jabine, na cia Ashidodi. Ningĩ agĩcooka agĩaka rĩngĩ matũũra marĩa maarĩ hakuhĩ na Ashidodi na kũndũ kũngĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ ka Afilisti.
english: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

kikuyu: No andũ aya-rĩ, marĩ ngoro cia rũngʼathio na nemi; nĩmahĩtĩtie njĩra na makoora.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, marathĩre ũhoro, ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Inyuĩ andũ akwa, nĩngũhingũra mbĩrĩra cianyu ndĩmwambatie muume kũu; nĩngũmũcookia bũrũri ũcio wa Isiraeli.
english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ Musa akĩĩra andũ atĩrĩ, “Nĩmwĩhĩtie mũno. No rĩu, nĩngwambata kũrĩ Jehova; hihi no kũhoteke ndĩmũrutĩre horohio nĩ ũndũ wa rĩhia rĩanyu.”
english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

kikuyu: Rĩĩrĩ nĩrĩo ituĩro: Ũtheri nĩwokire gũkũ thĩ, no andũ makĩenda nduma gũkĩra ũtheri, nĩ ũndũ ciĩko ciao ciarĩ njũru.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba kĩenyũ kĩũmũ kĩa mũgate kũndũ kũrĩ na thayũ na ũhooreri, gũkĩra nyũmba ĩiyũrĩte ndĩa no ĩrĩ na ngũĩ.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

kikuyu: Hihi ingīhota atīa kūgirīrīria mīrimū wa Newcastle?
english: How do you prevent Newcastle disease?

kikuyu: Nī ngumo irīkū (cia maciaro, ūritū na mūcamo) ikoragwo na maembe mūthemba wa Apple?
english: What are the features (yields, average weight and flavor) of the Apple mango variety?

kikuyu: andũ mĩrongo ĩnana meyenjete nderu, na magatembũranga nguo ciao, o na magetemanga mĩĩrĩ nĩmookire moimĩte Shekemu, na Shilo, na Samaria, marĩ na ngano ya maruta na ũbumba, magĩcirehe thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Jehova.
english: men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: “Nĩgũkorwo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Kuuma mwena wa gathigathini nĩngarehe Nebukadinezaru, mũthamaki wa Babuloni, mũthamaki wa athamaki, okĩrĩre Turo arĩ na mbarathi, na ngaari cia ita, na ahaici a mbarathi, na mbũtũ nene ya ita.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

kikuyu: Na kuuma ũiyũrĩrĩru wa ũtugi wake-rĩ, ithuothe nĩtwamũkĩrĩte irathimo nyingĩ mũno.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

kikuyu: “o na ndũkeyũrie, ‘Nũũ ũkaaharũrũka irima rĩrĩa rĩtarĩ gĩturi?’ ” (ũguo nĩ kuuga, ambatie Kristũ kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ).
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’* (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

kikuyu: Mūtī wa maembe ūbataraga maaī maigana atīa?
english: How much water does a mango tree need?

kikuyu: nĩguo kũmenyekage rĩrĩa kĩndũ gĩtarĩ na thaahu na rĩrĩa kĩrĩ na thaahu. Macio nĩmo mawatho makoniĩ mĩrimũ ya ngoothi ĩrĩa ĩngĩgwatanio, na makoniĩ ũgumu.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ngwĩra mũndũ mwaganu atĩrĩ, ‘Ti-itherũ, nĩũgaakua,’ nawe wage kũmũkaania, kana kũmwarĩria atigane na mĩthiĩre yake ya waganu nĩguo ahonokie muoyo wake-rĩ, mũndũ ũcio mwaganu nĩagaakua nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make, nawe nĩwe ngooria thakame yake.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

kikuyu: Dawa cīa kūhuthīra-Huhīra maaī ma thabuni kana thabuni wa tūtambi harī mīmera wega harī petiols, mathangū makūnjīkanu, whorls kana kūrī thuna iria nini
english: Chemical Control Spray soapy water or insecticidal soap on plants thoroughly on petioles, furled leaves, whorls or on young suckers.

kikuyu: na o gĩcunjĩ kĩmwe gĩa ikũmi‡ kĩrutagwo harĩ o gatũrũme ga tũu mũgwanja.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo acio makaahooha o narua o ta ũrĩa nyeki ĩhoohaga, na makue narua o ta ũrĩa riya rĩhoohaga rĩamunywo.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

kikuyu: Nake mũtumia ũcio, aamenya ũrĩa eekĩtwo, agĩũka, akĩĩgũithia magũrũ-inĩ make akĩinainaga nĩ guoya, akĩmũhe ũhoro wothe ũrĩa watariĩ.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

kikuyu: Nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa anene na arutani a watho maarũgamĩte hau, makĩmũthitanga magwatĩirie mũno.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

kikuyu: Ishumaeli agĩcooka akĩũraga Ayahudi othe arĩa maarĩ na Gedalia kũu Mizipa, o ũndũ ũmwe na thigari cia Babuloni iria ciarĩ kuo.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.

kikuyu: Nĩaconorithirio na ndaigana gũtuĩrwo ciira na kĩhooto. Nũũ ũngĩaria ũhoro wa njiaro ciake? Nĩgũkorwo muoyo wake nĩwehererio ũkiuma gũkũ thĩ.”
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”*

kikuyu: Ũgũtũũra bũrũri wa Gosheni* na ũkorwo ũrĩ hakuhĩ na niĩ, wee na ciana ciaku, na ciana cia ciana ciaku, na ndũũru ciaku cia mbũri na cia ngʼombe, na kĩrĩa gĩothe ũrĩ nakĩo.
english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

kikuyu: Agĩĩta athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii hamwe, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Thiĩi matũũra-inĩ ma Juda mũnganie mbeeca iria ciagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũrĩhwo o mwaka kuuma Isiraeli cia gũcookereria hekarũ ya Ngai wanyu. Ĩkai ũndũ ũcio o rĩu.” No Alawii matiigana gwĩka ũndũ ũcio narua.
english: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

kikuyu: Calcium īkoragwo ī nini thīīnī wa irio mūthema wa mbembe.
english: Grains are low in Calcium.

kikuyu: Mũcooke mũrute thenge ĩmwe ya igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, na tũtũrũme twĩrĩ, o kamwe karĩ na ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, twa iruta rĩa ũiguano.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

kikuyu: Nĩndĩmũheete bũrũri wa Misiri ũtuĩke kĩheo gĩa kĩyo gĩake, tondũ we na mbũtũ ciake cia ita meekire ũguo nĩ ũndũ wakwa, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũrĩa ũgathondeka ũngĩ taguo nĩguo ekenagie na mũtararĩko waguo nĩakaingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.”
english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

kikuyu: Thiūrūrūkīria bataraitha iyo o gītina-inī gīa kahūa ūmenyereire ndugaitīīrīrie mathangū kana gītina-inī gīa kahūa.
english: Spread the fertilizer in a ring around each coffee tree, but be very careful not to put any on its trunk, branches or leaves.

kikuyu: Jehova agĩcemania na Balamu, agĩĩkĩra ndũmĩrĩri kanua gake, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Cooka kũrĩ Balaki ũmũhe ndũmĩrĩri ĩno.”
english: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

kikuyu: Solomoni, mũrũ wa Daudi, nĩehaandire akĩrũma wega ũthamaki-inĩ wake, nĩgũkorwo Jehova Ngai wake aarĩ hamwe nake na akĩmũnenehia mũno makĩria.
english: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and Yahweh† his God‡ was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

kikuyu: Andũ a Kushi na Putu, na Ludu, na Arabia guothe, na Lubia, na andũ a bũrũri wa kĩrĩkanĩro, makooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora marĩ hamwe na andũ a Misiri.
english: “ ‘ “Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”

kikuyu: Apple, mūthemba ūrīa ūīkaīne ta maharaja, ndūciaraga mūno na ūkūraga tene kīambīrīria-inī gīa kīmera.
english: The Apple also known as Maharaja mango variety is a medium yielding and an early season variety.

kikuyu: Kitovu nī mūthemba ūciaraga mūno na ūkūraga tene kīmera-inī. (Dithemba nginya April)
english: Kitovu is a high yielding and early variety (December-April).

kikuyu: Mahe ndũmĩrĩri matwarĩre anene ao, ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Ũũ nĩguo Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, Ngai wa Isiraeli, ekuuga: “Ĩrai anene anyu atĩrĩ:
english: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:

kikuyu: Naguo mũhaka ũcio ũtambũrũke kuuma iria-inĩ ũkinye Hazari-Enani, mũhaka-inĩ wa mwena wa gathigathini wa Dameski, naguo mũhaka wa Hamathu ũkorwo ũrĩ mwena wa gathigathini. Ũcio nĩguo ũgaatuĩka mũhaka wa mwena wa gathigathini.
english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

kikuyu: “Ũndũ mũũru mũno na wa kũmakania nĩwĩkĩkĩte bũrũri-inĩ ũyũ:
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

kikuyu: Indo ingī ikuīte mūrimū ūyū ta nguo, matandīko, indo cia wīra, ona indo ingī no iteithīe gūtheremia mūrimū ūyū.
english: Contaminated clothes, beddings, equipment and other materials can spread the disease to a flock.

kikuyu: Acio nĩo maarĩ a rũciaro rwa Rafa wa kũu Gathu, nao makĩũragwo nĩ Daudi na andũ ake.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

kikuyu: Mwaka-inĩ wa mĩrongo ĩtatũ,* mũthenya wa gatano wa mweri wa kana, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndaarĩ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Kebari tũrĩ hamwe na andũ arĩa maatahĩtwo magatwarwo kuo, igũrũ nĩrĩahingũkire, na niĩ ngĩona cioneki cia Ngai.
english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.†

kikuyu: “Ingĩkorwo nĩnyimĩte ndungata ciakwa cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja kĩhooto rĩrĩa manateta nĩ ũndũ wakwa-rĩ,
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

kikuyu: Andũ maataanyaga kuona akĩimba kana agwe o rĩmwe akue, no thuutha wa gweterera hĩndĩ ndaaya, makĩona gũtirĩ ũndũ ũtarĩ wa ndũire ũrekĩka harĩ we, makĩĩricũkwo makiuga atĩ aarĩ ngai.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

kikuyu: No nginya mũikare itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo mĩthenya mũgwanja, mũthenya na ũtukũ, nĩguo mũhingie ũrĩa Jehova arenda, nĩguo mũtigakue; nĩgũkorwo ũguo nĩguo njathĩtwo.”
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

kikuyu: Naguo warĩ mũgambo wa mathagu ma ciũmbe icio irĩ muoyo makĩhutania mo mene, na wa magũrũ ma ngaari marĩa maarĩ mĩena yacio, naguo warĩ mũgambo mũnene warurumaga.
english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

kikuyu: Kaĩ tũrageria kwarahũra ũiru wa Mwathani? Kaĩ tũrĩ na hinya kũmũkĩra?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

kikuyu: Ningĩ marĩhumbĩre na gĩthii kĩa njũũa cia pomboo, na maare gĩtambaya kĩa rangi wa bururu mũtheri igũrũ rĩacio, na matoonyie mĩtĩ ya kũrĩkuua handũ hayo.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: Nake akiumagara agĩthiĩ, agĩkora mwĩrĩ ũgũithĩtio njĩra-inĩ, na mũrũũthi na ndigiri irũgamĩte o hau warĩ. Mũrũũthi ndwarĩte mwĩrĩ ũcio kana ũgatambuura ndigiri.
english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa wenjaga irima na akarĩthikũria, agũũaga o irima rĩu enjete.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

kikuyu: Nigūo kūgīrīrīria, wiki cia mbere 4-6, thuna njerū nīicenjagio thutha wa wiki 1-2
english: To prevent this, during the first 4–6 weeks fresh shoots are transferred to new medium every 1–2 weeks.

kikuyu: Arĩithi amwe nĩmookire na makĩingata airĩtu acio, no Musa agĩũkĩra, akĩmateithũra na akĩhe ũhiũ wao maaĩ.
english: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

kikuyu: Na marĩ njĩra thigari ikĩnyiita mũndũ wahĩtũkaga akiuma mĩgũnda-inĩ, wetagwo Simoni wa kuuma Kurene, ithe wa Alekisandero na Rufusi, na ikĩmũkuuithia mũtharaba wa Jesũ na hinya.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

kikuyu: na agĩakia matawa macio mbere ya Jehova, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
english: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Nĩndarigirwo nĩ ũrĩa ingĩtuĩria maũndũ ta macio; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩmũũria kana no eende gũthiĩ Jerusalemu agaciirithĩrio maũndũ macio aathitangĩirwo kuo.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

kikuyu: “Ciugo icio ciothe-rĩ, nĩcikwaga gũcookio? Mwaria ũyũ-rĩ, nĩegũgĩtuuo mwagĩrĩru?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
