kikuyu: ‘Ũũ nĩguo Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli ekuuga: Ngirie gũtũma indo icio cia mbaara, o icio irĩ moko-inĩ manyu, iria mũrahũthĩra mũkĩrũa mbaara na mũthamaki wa Babuloni na andũ a Babuloni arĩa marĩ nja ya rũthingo mamũrigiicĩirie, imũcookerere imũhũũre inyuĩ ene. Andũ acio nao nĩngamacookanĩrĩria thĩinĩ wa itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene.
english: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.

kikuyu: Ikundi cia kambĩ ya Juda nĩcio cioimagarire mbere, irũmĩrĩire bendera yao. Nake Nahashoni mũrũ wa Aminadabu nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

kikuyu: Firaũni nĩageciiria atĩrĩ, ‘andũ a Isiraeli marĩ na kĩrigiicano no kũũrũũra marorũũra bũrũri-inĩ, mahingĩrĩirio nĩ werũ.’
english: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

kikuyu: Mũtikanareke mũndũ o na ũmwe atoonye hekarũ ya Jehova tiga o athĩnjĩri-Ngai na Alawii arĩa marĩ wĩra-inĩ; acio no matoonye tondũ nĩ aamũre, no andũ acio angĩ othe marangĩre kĩrĩa Jehova oigĩte marangĩre.
english: But let no one come into Yahweh’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow Yahweh’s instructions.

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Atĩrĩrĩ! Nderi nĩĩracuuhũka, ĩtambũrũkĩtie mathagu mayo igũrũ rĩa Moabi.
english: For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.

kikuyu: rīrīa ūkwenda kūgarūra kahūa, wagīrīire gūtiga gīthūkī kīna ūrahu woigana atīa?
english: When you want to change cycle, what height of stump should you leave?

kikuyu: No Jehova akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Aca, ti ũguo; mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ angĩkooraga Kaini, nĩakarĩhio maita mũgwanja.” Jehova agĩcooka agĩĩkĩra Kaini rũũri nĩgeetha ũrĩa wothe ũngĩmuona ndakamũũrage!
english: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, maitho ma andũ arĩa aaganu nĩmakaaga kuona, na matikoona gwa kũũrĩra; naguo ũndũ ũrĩa meriragĩria ũgaatuĩka mũcaayo wa gĩkuũ.”
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

kikuyu: Makorobia marīa makūrū mareraga igūrū me maaī-inī.
english: Fruits that float on the surface when immersed in water are usually mature.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ rũngʼathio rwake, no nĩ rwa tũhũ, naguo mwĩraho wake ndũrĩ ũndũ ũhingĩtie,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa mĩthiĩre yake ĩtarĩ ũcuuke aikaraga arĩ mũgitĩre, no mũndũ ũrĩa ũthiiaga na njĩra cia waganu akaagũa o rĩmwe, hubu!
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Ahabu akĩĩra Jezebeli ũrĩa wothe Elija eekĩte, o na ũrĩa ooragithĩtie anabii othe a Baali na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

kikuyu: Othe nĩmagarũrũkĩte, makoora, othe hamwe magatuĩka kĩndũ gĩtarĩ bata; gũtirĩ mũndũ wĩkaga wega, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe.”
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”*

kikuyu: Nowe Jesũ, tondũ nĩamenyaga ũrĩa meeciiragia, akĩĩra mũndũ ũcio wonjete guoko atĩrĩ, “Ũkĩra ũrũgame mbere ya andũ othe.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩũkĩra akĩrũgama hau.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

kikuyu: Wĩra wothe wa hinya ũrehaga uumithio, no mĩario mĩtheri ĩrehaga o ũthĩĩni.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

kikuyu: Nĩngũthondeka kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa kĩrĩ kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa gũtũũra tene na tene gatagatĩ gakwa nawe na njiaro ciaku iria igooka thuutha waku, na nginya njiarwa ciaku cia thuutha, nĩguo nduĩke Ngai waku na Ngai wa njiaro iria igooka thuutha waku.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Esaũ maarĩ: Elifazu, na Reueli, na Jeushu, na Jalamu, na Kora.
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

kikuyu: Manyiitĩte mĩguĩ na matimũ; nĩ andũ ooru matarĩ tha. Mũrurumo wao magĩũka mahaicĩte mbarathi, nĩ ta wa ndiihũ cia iria rĩrĩa inene; maroka mehaarĩirie ta andũ moka mbaara nĩguo magũtharĩkĩre, wee Mwarĩ wa Zayuni.”
english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jesũ oimire gatarũ na akĩona andũ aingĩ, akĩmaiguĩra tha, na akĩhonia arũaru ao.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

kikuyu: Na gwakinya hwaĩ-inĩ, Jesũ agĩkinya kuo marĩ na arutwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

kikuyu: “Oya Alawii ũmeherie kuuma kũrĩ andũ arĩa angĩ a Isiraeli, ũmatherie mathirwo nĩ thaahu.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩwe Mũthamaki wa nginya tene; ndũrĩrĩ nĩigathira ciehere bũrũri-inĩ wake.
english: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

kikuyu: “Nĩnengeretwo maũndũ mothe nĩ Baba. Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũũĩ Mũriũ nũũ, tiga Ithe witũ, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũũĩ Ithe witũ nũũ o tiga Mũriũ na arĩa othe Mũriũ endaga kũguũrĩria.”
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Mũthamaki Herode aiguire ũguo, agĩtangĩka ngoro, o hamwe na andũ Jerusalemu othe.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

kikuyu: Hema yake ĩrĩ kũu Salemu, gĩikaro gĩake kĩrĩ Zayuni.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

kikuyu: Jehova arogoocwo, nĩgũkorwo nĩanyonirie wendo wake wa magegania rĩrĩa ndaarĩ itũũra inene rĩrigiicĩirio nĩ thũ.
english: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova ĩgĩkinyĩra Jeremia, akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

kikuyu: Mūrimū ūyū ūrehagwo nī fungi.
english: The disease is caused by the fungi

kikuyu: Hũthagĩrai ithimi cia kĩhooto, na mahiga ma gũthima ma kĩhooto, na eba ya kĩhooto, na hini ya kĩhooto. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu ũrĩa wamũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah,§ and a just hin.† I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Gūcinīra mahuti rungu rwa mūembe kahora nīguo mūtī ūtogererwo na wītīkīre kūruta mahūa.
english: - Smudging (moist organic material – grass, leaves etc. is slowly burnt under the tree canopies and the resulting smoke induces flowering)

kikuyu: Mũgeeka atĩa mũthenya wa ciira, rĩrĩa mũgaakorererwo nĩ mwanangĩko uumĩte kũraya? Mũkoorĩra kũrĩ ũ amũteithie? Ũtonga wanyu mũkaaũtiga kũ?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

kikuyu: Handũ ha ũguo-rĩ, ngũhe Alawii icunjĩ cia ikũmi iria andũ a Isiraeli marehaga irĩ maruta kũrĩ Jehova ituĩke igai rĩao. Nĩkĩo ndoigire igũrũ rĩao atĩrĩ: ‘Matikagĩa na igai thĩinĩ wa andũ a Isiraeli.’ ”
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’ ”

kikuyu: ciana cia ndungata ciake nĩigakũgaya, nao arĩa mendete rĩĩtwa rĩake nĩmagatũũra kuo.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo o na watho ũtanaheanwo, mehia maarĩ kuo gũkũ thĩ. No gũtarĩ watho mũndũ ndangĩtuuo mwĩhia.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmeeta hamwe, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Nĩmũũĩ atĩ aathani a Ndũrĩrĩ nĩ metũũgagĩria igũrũ rĩa andũ ao, na anene ao nĩmamaathaga na hinya.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: Gitīra beji na njīra ya kūhanda nyeki ta mūthemba wa Blue grass (Paspulum notatum) mīthia-inī.
english: Protect bench terraces by planting grasses e.g. Blue grass (Paspulum notatum) on the bench faces

kikuyu: Mũrũ wa Mũndũ ookire akĩrĩĩaga na akĩnyuuaga, nao makiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Onei mũndũ mũkoroku na mũrĩĩu, nĩ mũrata wa etia mbeeca cia igooti na “andũ ehia”.’ No ũũgĩ wonekaga nĩ wa ma nĩ ũndũ wa ciĩko ciaguo.”
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”‡

kikuyu: Moragia atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte twĩhinge kũrĩa irio, nawe ũkaaga kuona? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte twĩnyiihie, nawe ũkaaga kũrũmbũiya ũhoro ũcio?’ “No rĩrĩ, mũthenya wanyu wa kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio mwĩkaga o ũrĩa mũkwenda, na aruti othe anyu a wĩra mũkamahinyĩrĩria.
english: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.

kikuyu: Ũritũ wa mĩcumarĩ ya thahabu warĩ wa cekeri mĩrongo ĩtano.* Ningĩ agĩcooka akĩgemia mĩena ya na igũrũ ya hau Hatheru-Mũno na thahabu.
english: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels§ of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

kikuyu: Nĩtũrehei ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro rĩa Ngai witũ tũrĩcookie kũrĩ ithuĩ, nĩgũkorwo tũtiatuĩragia ũhoro harĩ rĩo hĩndĩ ya ũthamaki wa Saũlũ.”
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

kikuyu: rĩrĩa ndoigire atĩrĩ, ‘Ũkinyage o haha na ndũkanahakĩre; makũmbĩ maku macio metĩĩi-rĩ, hau nĩho marĩĩkinyaga’?
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

kikuyu: Mawega ma mūthemba wa maembe ma Kent nī marīkū?
english: What are the advantages of kent mango fruit variety?

kikuyu: Warū nīcībatiī gūkūrio wega ūkīrūmīrīra ūtīganu ūria ubatīe, gūkū ūgithema kurīma na maaī na njīra cia mītaro.
english: Potatoes should also be grown using the correct spacing, and furrow irrigation should be avoided.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio athĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩmarĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩakwa kũrĩ andũ a Isiraeli, na niĩ nĩndĩĩ- marathimaga.”
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

kikuyu: Nao othe makĩigua momĩrĩria, makĩoya irio makĩrĩa.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

kikuyu: “Kũrĩ mũndũ ũngĩhota kwĩhitha kũrĩa kwĩhithĩte mũno, ũndũ itangĩhota kũmuona?” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekũũria. “Githĩ ndiyũrĩte kũndũ guothe, igũrũ na thĩ?” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekũũria.
english: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa ũguo-rĩ, Jehova ekuuga ũũ: “Atĩrĩrĩ, niĩ nĩngũkũrũĩrĩra na ngũrĩhĩrie; nĩngahũithia iria rĩake, na ndũme ithima ciake ihũe.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

kikuyu: Kũngĩkĩhaana ũguo-rĩ, mwene iruga ũrĩa ũmwĩtĩte inyuĩ eerĩ no ooke, akwĩre atĩrĩ, ‘Eherera mũndũ ũyũ gĩtĩ kĩu.’ Hĩndĩ ĩyo, nĩũgaaikara thuutha biũ ũconokete.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ maiguire ciugo ciake, amwe makiuga atĩrĩ, “Ti-itherũ mũndũ ũyũ nĩ we Mũnabii ũrĩa.”
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

kikuyu: Nĩmahatĩrĩirio maikarage mĩkuru-inĩ ya tũrũũĩ tũhũu, kũu ndwaro-inĩ cia mahiga na marima-inĩ marĩa marĩ thĩ.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩmũgathaahia mĩhianano yanyu ya kũhooywo ĩrĩa ĩgemetio na betha igũrũ, na mĩhiano yanyu ĩrĩa ĩgemetio na thahabu igũrũ; mũkaamĩte ta taama ũrĩ thaahu wa mũndũ-wa-nja hĩndĩ ya mweri, mũmĩĩre atĩrĩ, “Thiĩi na kũu muume haha!”
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

kikuyu: na itina mĩrongo ĩna cia betha o igĩrĩ igaikarĩrwo nĩ rũbaũ rũmwe.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Ndūgathondeke itara njaa ya ciūmba cia ngūkū nīūndū matumbī no marīo nī nyamū kana ona maiyūo
english: Avoid building nests on the ground outside the chicken houses as eggs outside houses are more exposed to predators and thieves

kikuyu: “Ndũkanoragane.
english: “You shall not murder.

kikuyu: Ha ũhoro wa mĩrimũ ya mangũ, mwĩmenyagĩrĩrei mũno gwĩka o ũrĩa athĩnjĩri-Ngai, o acio Alawii, makaamũruta. No nginya mũrũmĩrĩre wega ũrĩa ndĩmathĩte.
english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ nĩmwaiguire ũhoro wake, na mũkĩrutwo mũrĩ thĩinĩ wake kũringana na ũhoro wa ma ũrĩa ũrĩ thĩinĩ wa Jesũ.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ mũrakararanĩria nao?”
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

kikuyu: “Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ wahota gwĩka maũndũ mothe; gũtirĩ mũbango waku ũngĩgirĩrĩka.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

kikuyu: nĩguo akũũre andũ arĩa matũire mathagwo nĩ watho, nĩgeetha tũgĩe na kĩhooto gĩa gũtuĩka ciana ciake,
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

kikuyu: “No rĩu-rĩ, ndamũthaitha mwĩtĩkĩre kũndora. Anga no ngĩheenanie o maitho-inĩ manyu?
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

kikuyu: Nĩũtũmĩte tũtuĩke a kuunagwo thimo nĩ ndũrĩrĩ; tũgagĩtuĩka a kũinainagĩrio mĩtwe nĩ andũ.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

kikuyu: Hihi nĩ harĩ ũndũ mũndũ angiuga atĩrĩ: “Ta rora! Ũyũ nĩ ũndũ ũtarĩ wonekana”? Ũndũ ũcio warĩ kuo hĩndĩ ndaaya hĩtũku; warĩ kuo tũtarĩ twaciarwo.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold,† this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

kikuyu: Hagĩkorwo harĩ na tũhiga ikũmi na twĩrĩ, o kamwe karũgamĩrĩre marĩĩtwa ma ariũ a Isiraeli, o kamwe gakururwo rĩĩtwa rĩa mũhĩrĩga ũmwe wa ĩrĩa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ ya Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa kahengere ka mũhũũri gakururagwo.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, ndĩragũkaĩra ndĩ o kũrĩa kũriku;
english: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩngamũiguĩra tha, nĩguo o nake ndũme amũiguĩre tha, amũcookie bũrũri ũyũ wanyu kĩũmbe.’
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

kikuyu: Agĩthuura andũ marĩ na ũhoti kuuma Isiraeli guothe, akĩmatua atongoria a andũ acio; akĩmatua anene a ikundi cia ngiri, na ikundi cia magana, na ikundi cia mĩrongo ĩtano, na ikundi cia makũmi.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũndũ mũrũme angĩcemania na mũirĩtu ũrĩĩtio ahikio arĩ na kũu nja ya itũũra, na amũnyiite na hinya, mũndũ mũrũme ũcio wĩkĩte ũguo nowe wiki ũgaakua.
english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

kikuyu: Gileadi nĩ gwakwa, o na Manase no gwakwa; Efiraimu nĩ ngũbia yakwa ya kĩgera, na Juda nĩ mũthĩgi wakwa wa ũthamaki.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Ahazia mũrũ wa Ahabu aatuĩkire mũthamaki wa Isiraeli kũu Samaria mwaka-inĩ wa ikũmi na mũgwanja wa Jehoshafatu, mũthamaki wa Juda, nake agĩthamakĩra Isiraeli mĩaka ĩĩrĩ.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe ũngĩoya ciimba ciacio no nginya athambie nguo ciake, na atiinde arĩ na thaahu o nginya hwaĩ-inĩ. Icio irĩ thaahu harĩ inyuĩ.
english: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

kikuyu: Mũtikagĩe na kĩrĩkanĩro nao kana na ngai ciao.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

kikuyu: Manjĩhotoreire mũthenya ũrĩa ndaarĩ na mũtino, no Jehova nĩwe warĩ mũtiirĩrĩri wakwa.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

kikuyu: honokiai guoko-inĩ gwa thũ, ngũũrai kuuma moko-inĩ ma arĩa matarĩ tha’?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

kikuyu: Nĩnduĩte atĩ nĩngũgera itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene ngero njũru, na ndirĩ wega ingĩrĩĩka, ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. Nĩrĩkũneanwo moko-inĩ ma mũthamaki wa Babuloni, nake arĩniine na mwaki.’
english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says Yahweh. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.” ’

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, unanga magego marĩa marĩ tũnua twao; Wee Jehova, munya mĩthangiri ya mĩrũũthi ĩyo!
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo aaririe, thĩ ĩkĩgĩa kuo; aathanire, ĩkĩĩhaanda, ĩkĩrũma wega.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa kuuma Sukothu maambire kambĩ ciao Ethamu ndeere-inĩ cia werũ.
english: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio oraga tondũ we nĩ wa kwandĩkwo, na ndarũmbũyanagia na ũhoro wa ngʼondu.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩndamwĩra ũhoro o rĩu na inyuĩ mũtinathikĩrĩria. Mũrenda kũigua rĩngĩ nĩkĩ? O na inyuĩ nĩmũkwenda gũtuĩka arutwo ake?”
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

kikuyu: na Jokimeamu, na Bethi-Horoni,
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Kūrī kaunti 13 nene iria ikūragia waru ta Meru, Nyeri, Nyandarua, Kiambu, Taita-Taveta, Nakuru, Narok, Bomet, Elgeyo-Marakwet Trans-Nzoia, Bungoma, Uasin-Gishu na West Pokot
english: There are 13 major potato-producing counties which are: Meru, Nyeri, Nyandarua, Kiambu, Taita-Taveta, Nakuru, Narok, Bomet, Elgeyo-Marakwet, Trans-Nzoia, Bungoma, Uasin- Gishu and West Pokot

kikuyu: andũ a Alawii maarĩ 4,600;
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe ũngĩhutia kĩimba kĩa mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ na aage gwĩtheria, ũcio nĩathaahĩtie Hema-ĩrĩa-Nyamũre ya Jehova. Mũndũ ũcio no nginya aingatwo oime Isiraeli. Tondũ ndaminjaminjĩirio maaĩ ma kũniina thaahu, mũndũ ũcio arĩ na thaahu; thaahu wake ndũthirĩte.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

kikuyu: onangīkorūo gūtīīrī dawa yūikaine ya kugīrīrīa gūthegea kwa bacteria wilt harī warū rī, arīmī nīmarahoywo, kūhūthīra njīra īrīa ciuīkaine cia kugīrirīa guthegea kwa mīrīmu
english: Though bacterial wilt has no known chemical control measure, farmers are encouraged to implement integrated disease management practices.

kikuyu: inyuĩ mwagũrirwo na thogora. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, tĩĩithagiai Ngai na mĩĩrĩ yanyu.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

kikuyu: Ngai arĩ hamwe na ithuĩ; we nĩwe mũtongoria witũ. Athĩnjĩri-Ngai ake na tũrumbeta twao nĩo marĩgambia mũgambo wa mbaara ya kũmũũkĩrĩra inyuĩ. Andũ a Isiraeli, tigai kũrũa na Jehova, Ngai wa maithe manyu, nĩgũkorwo mũtingĩhootana.”
english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

kikuyu: No kuoneke ta ndĩreraha mũno nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoti ũrĩa Mwathani aatũheire. No rĩrĩ, ũhoti witũ nĩ wa kũmuongerera hinya na ti wa kũmũhinyĩrĩria. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndingĩconoka nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩka ũguo.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

kikuyu: Nake agĩathana ngaari ĩyo ya mbarathi ĩrũgame. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Filipu na mũndũ ũcio mũhakũre magĩikũrũka, magĩtoonya maaĩ-inĩ, nake Filipu akĩmũbatithia.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jesũ nĩaingataga ndaimono yume thĩinĩ wa mũndũ ũtaaragia. Rĩrĩa ndaimono ĩyo yoimire, mũndũ ũcio ũtaaragia akĩaria, nakĩo kĩrĩndĩ kĩa andũ gĩkĩgega.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

kikuyu: Mũgaakoragwo o mũkĩrĩa magetha ma mwaka mũthiru nginya rĩrĩa mũkaamaruta nja nĩguo mũgĩe na handũ ha kũiga magetha marĩa maragethwo.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, ndongoria na ũthingu waku; nĩ ũndũ wa thũ ciakwa-rĩ, rũngaria njĩra yaku mbere yakwa.
english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

kikuyu: Ĩĩ baba angĩĩhaambata? Ingĩonekana ngĩmũheenia na niĩ ndĩĩreherere kĩrumi handũ ha kĩrathimo.”
english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

kikuyu: “Itũũra o rĩothe kana gatũũra karĩa mũngĩtoonya-rĩ, tuĩriai mũmenye mũndũ ũrĩa mwagĩrĩru kuo, mũikare gwake nginya rĩrĩa mũkoima kuo.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

kikuyu: Ndũkanamaitĩrĩrie mĩĩrĩ ya arũme, na ndũkanathondeke maguta mangĩ na mũthondekereũcio. Nĩmatherunanĩwegaũmatuageatĩnĩmatheru.
english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

kikuyu: Jakubu agĩcooka akĩrathima Firaũni na akĩehera akiuma hau Firaũni aarĩ.
english: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Rīmwe na rīmwe ngūkū nī cikagīrio irio ingīiria iria ironeka o kūu ta matigari ma ngīma na mbembe, arīcia kuongerera kīrīa irīire mūthenya-inī īkīmathīra.
english: Feeding is occasionally supplemented with locally available materials such as remnants of ugali, maize grain etc

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũiyaga, nĩatige gũcooka kũiya, nĩ kaba arute wĩra, akenogagia, na ekage maũndũ mega na moko make, nĩgeetha agĩe na kĩndũ angĩgayana na arĩa mabataire.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ inyuĩ andũ arĩa mũrĩ kũraya, ta thikĩrĩriai mũigue ũrĩa njĩkĩte; na inyuĩ mũrĩ gũkuhĩ umbũrai ũhoro wa hinya wakwa.
english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

kikuyu: Handa mbegū ngurani kwa ihinda rītanyihīire mīaka ītatu
english: • Crop rotation (at least 3 years)

kikuyu: No nyende inyuothe mwaragie na thiomi, no makĩria ingĩenda inyuothe mũrathage mohoro. Mũndũ ũrĩa ũrathaga ũhoro nĩakĩrĩte ũrĩa waragia na thiomi, tiga no akorirwo nĩegũtaũra thiomi icio, nĩguo kanitha wongererwo hinya.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

kikuyu: Na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa riũa rĩarire, rĩgĩcina mĩmera ĩyo, nayo ĩkĩũma tondũ ndĩarĩ na mĩri.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

kikuyu: “Andũ arĩa athĩĩni na abatari methaga maaĩ ma kũnyua, no gũtirĩ; nĩmĩ ciao nĩcingʼarĩtio nĩ nyoota. No rĩrĩ, niĩ Jehova nĩngamacookeria ũhoro; niĩ Ngai wa Isiraeli, ndirĩ hĩndĩ ngaamatiganĩria.
english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

kikuyu: Igūaga nīūndū wa kūrwara kana kwaga irio ciakūigana
english: Coffee Berry Disease or nutrients deficiency.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Aburamu akĩĩra Loti atĩrĩ, “Nĩtũtige kũgĩa na ngũĩ gatagatĩ gaitũ nawe, kana gatagatĩ ka arĩithi aku na arĩithi akwa, nĩ tondũ tũrĩ andũ a nyũmba ĩmwe.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

kikuyu: Icookio rĩa ũhooreri nĩrĩeheragia mangʼũrĩ, no kiugo kĩa ũũru kĩarahũraga marakara.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

kikuyu: O na angĩonganĩrĩria betha ta rũkũngũ, na agĩe na nguo nyingĩ ta hĩba cia rĩũmba,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

kikuyu: Na harĩa iria rĩa Misiri rĩcomokete ta rũrĩmĩ-rĩ, Jehova nĩakarĩhũithia biũ; ningĩ nĩakahuruta rũhuho rũhiũ na guoko gwake rũhũithie Rũũĩ rwa Farati. Nĩakarũgayania rũtuĩke tũrũũĩ mũgwanja, nĩgeetha andũ mahote kũringaga matekũruta iraatũ.
english: Yahweh will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

kikuyu: Njīra njega ya gūkua maembe nī īrīkū?
english: What is the best way to transport mango fruits?

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova ĩkĩnginyĩrĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: O ũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũngĩtuĩka nĩguo, ũũgĩ-rĩ, nĩũraihĩrĩirie mũno na nĩmũhithe makĩria: nũũ ũngĩũmenya?
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

kikuyu: Nake Roho wa Jehova agaakorwo igũrũ rĩake: Roho wa ũũgĩ na wa ũmenyo, Roho wa ũtaarani na wa hinya, Roho wa ũmenyo na wa gwĩtigĩra Jehova:
english: Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ũhoro ũrĩa waarĩtio na kanua ka mũnabii Jeremia ũkĩhinga, rĩrĩa oigire atĩrĩ:
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

kikuyu: Nuhu aakinyia ũkũrũ wa mĩaka magana matano-rĩ, akĩgĩa na ariũ ake na nĩo Shemu, na Hamu na Jafethu. 6
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. 6

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa ĩnana wakinya, magĩũka nĩguo maruithie kaana kau, nao meendaga gũgatua Zakaria o ta ũrĩa ithe eetagwo,
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, inyuĩ arĩithi-rĩ, iguai kiugo kĩa Jehova:
english: “ ‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word:

kikuyu: No Mũfarisai ũcio ona ũguo akĩgega nĩ ũndũ Jesũ ndaambire gwĩthamba moko atanarĩa irio.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

kikuyu: Ahumbagĩra ũthiũ wa mweri rĩrĩa waiganana, agatambũrũkia matu make igũrũ rĩaguo.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

kikuyu: No Musa akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ ũkũigua ũiru nĩ ũndũ wakwa? Niĩ ingĩenda andũ othe a Jehova makorwo marĩ anabii, na atĩ Jehova amekĩre Roho wake!”
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

kikuyu: Ngai agĩĩta wariĩ ũcio “matu mairũ.” Na gũkĩgĩa hwaĩ-inĩ na gũkĩgĩa rũciinĩ. Ũcio ũgĩtuĩka mũthenya wa keerĩ.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki nĩakenagio nĩ ndungata njũgĩ, no nĩangʼũrĩkagio nĩ ndungata ĩrĩa ĩmũconorithagia. 15
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame. 15

kikuyu: Na inyuĩ nĩmũgeeka o ta ũguo niĩ njĩkĩte. Mũtikehumbĩra kanua kana mũrĩe irio cia mũtugo wa hĩndĩ ya macakaya.
english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

kikuyu: Ndikwenda kuonana na inyuĩ hĩndĩ ĩno ndĩrahĩtũkĩra kũu, tondũ ngwĩhoka atĩ nĩtũgaikarania na inyuĩ kwa ihinda, Mwathani etĩkĩra.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

kikuyu: Aarĩkia gwĩka ũguo-rĩ, Mũriũ we mwene nĩagatuĩka wa gwathagwo nĩ ũcio waigire indo ciothe rungu rwake, nĩguo Ngai akorwo nĩ we maũndũ mothe thĩinĩ wa maũndũ mothe.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩmũgethaahia na maũndũ maya; ũrĩa wothe ũngĩhutia ciimba ciatuo agaatinda arĩ na thaahu o nginya hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: “ ‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Jehova nĩ mũthingu; nĩanjohorithĩtie harĩ mĩhĩndo ya andũ arĩa aaganu.
english: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

kikuyu: Mũhĩrĩga wa Isakaru ũkaamba hema ciao mariganĩtie na andũ a Juda. Mũtongoria wa andũ a Isakaru nĩ Nethaneli mũrũ wa Zuaru.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ wee Sidoni, o nawe, kĩĩhitho kĩrũmu kĩa iria-inĩ, conokai, nĩgũkorwo iria nĩrĩarĩtie rĩkoiga atĩrĩ: “Niĩ ndirĩ ndagĩa na ruo rwa kũrũmwo, kana ngaciara; ndirĩ ndaarera aanake, kana ngarera airĩtu.”
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa athĩĩni mathũũragwo o na nĩ andũ a itũũra rĩao, no itonga irĩ arata aingĩ.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

kikuyu: Ta thikĩrĩria mbu ĩyo ĩroigwo kũu Horonaimu, mbu nĩ ũndũ wa kũniinanwo kũnene na mwanangĩko.
english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

kikuyu: nake Ahazu aarĩ mũriũ wa Jothamu, nake Hezekia aarĩ mũriũ wa Ahazu, nake Manase aarĩ mũriũ wa Hezekia,
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

kikuyu: Gũkũũra marigithathi macio 273 ma andũ a Isiraeli, acio makĩrĩte mũigana wa Alawii-rĩ,
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

kikuyu: Mũthamaki na anene ake na kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe kũu Jerusalemu magĩtua atĩ megũkũngũĩra Bathaka mweri wa keerĩ.
english: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩagakũhũũra na mahũha marĩa ma bũrũri wa Misiri, na mĩrimũ ya ngaaĩ, na ironda iratogota, na ũhere, na ndũkahona.
english: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ũkĩra ũikũrũke, ũthiĩ nao na ndũkagĩe na nganja nĩgũkorwo nĩ niĩ ndĩmatũmĩte.”
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

kikuyu: Nao makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũthuuri ũyũ, kuuma rĩu tũheage mũgate ũcio.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

kikuyu: nake nĩagathamakĩra nyũmba ya Jakubu nginya tene; ũthamaki wake ndũgaathira o na rĩ.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Mīrimū īrehagwo nī matumbī: īno nī mīrimū īrīa ītambagio nī matumbī kuuma kūrī ngūkū iria ndwaru nginya kūrī njui. Mīrimū īno īmwe no īkorwo īrī thīinī wa ītumbī kana igūrū wa ikorogosha ta mūrimū wa Salmonellosis
english: Egg-borne diseases: these are passed from infected hen to new hatched chicks. Some diseases are carried inside the egg shell while others are just on the shell surface e.g. Salmonellosis

kikuyu: Potassium īteithagia kūnenehia mbegū na kūmīhe mūcamo na njīra ya gūcitwarīra cukari kuuma mathangū-inī.
english: Potassium has a crucial role to play in improving coffee berry size and quality through its role in the movement of sugars from the leaf for accumulation in the fruit.

english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing. 30

english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.” ’

english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

kikuyu: Nake we mwene akĩmatongoria, na rĩrĩa aakuhĩrĩirie mũrũ wa nyina, akĩinamĩrĩra, agĩturumithia ũthiũ wake thĩ maita mũgwanja.
english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

kikuyu: Edeni, na Miniamini, na Jeshua, na Shemaia, na Amaria, na Shekania nĩo maamũteithagĩrĩria marĩ na wĩhokeku kũu matũũra-inĩ ma athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na makagayagĩra athĩnjĩri- Ngai arĩa angĩ o ta ũrĩa ikundi ciao ciatariĩ, makagaĩra arĩa akũrũ na arĩa anini o ũndũ ũmwe.
english: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

kikuyu: Nĩndĩrĩkũrutaga na ngakuonereria njĩra ĩrĩa wagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũgera; ndĩrĩgũtaaraga na ngũmenyagĩrĩre.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

kikuyu: O ũrĩa Solomoni aathiire agĩkũraga, noguo atumia ake maaguucagĩrĩria ngoro yake kũrũmĩrĩra ngai ingĩ, nake akĩaga kũheana ngoro yake kũna kũrĩ Jehova Ngai wake, ta ũrĩa ngoro ya ithe Daudi yatariĩ.
english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father was.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ, Afilisti magĩthiĩ gũcuuma ciimba, magĩkora Saũlũ na ariũ ake makuĩte kũu Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Giliboa.

english: Remove all bedding and equipment before soaking and cleaning.

english: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

english: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

english: Feeding high quality fiber is preferred over minimal fiber diets during hot weather.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ ciama tũringagĩrwo mahinda maya; anabii nĩmathirĩte, na gũtirĩ witũ ũũĩ nĩ nginya rĩ gũgũikara ũguo.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Akoiga atĩrĩ, “Wee mwarĩ gathirange wa Sidoni ikeno ciaku cia ũrĩĩu nĩ thiru, rĩu ũrĩ mũhehenje! “Ũkĩra ũringe, ũthiĩ ũkinye Kitimu; no rĩrĩ, o na kũu ndũkoona ũhurũko.”
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

kikuyu: Mũrũ wakwa, wĩtigĩre Jehova na wĩtigĩre mũthamaki, na ndũkagĩe na ngwatanĩro na andũ arĩa aremi,
english: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

kikuyu: Andũ nĩmakahiinyanĩrĩria: o mũndũ akaahinyĩrĩria ũrĩa ũngĩ, mũndũ wa itũũra okĩrĩre mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake. Arĩa anini nĩmagookĩrĩra arĩa akũrũ, nao arĩa matarĩ ngumo mokĩrĩre mũndũ ũrĩa mũtĩĩku.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, nĩngwenda mũmenye atĩ ũhonokio wa Ngai nĩũtũmĩtwo kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ, nao nĩmegũthikĩrĩria!”
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

kikuyu: O na ũngĩĩthamba na igata, o na ũhũthĩre thabuni mũingĩ mũno-rĩ, kĩmeni kĩa wĩhia waku ndingĩtiga gũkĩona,” ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

kikuyu: Meere atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: Nderi nene ĩrĩ na mathagu marĩ hinya, na njoya ndaaya, na macoya ma marangi maingĩ nĩyokire Lebanoni. Ĩkĩnyiita gacũmbĩrĩ ka mũtarakwa,

english: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

english: Females lay eggs on young fruit which hatch to the larva that enters the fruit by burrowing through the flesh into the seeds, where it feeds until pupation, destroying the seed, leading to premature fruit fall.

english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

kikuyu: Nakĩo kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro kĩu gĩtingĩtũũraga ngoro, tondũ Ngai nĩaitĩrĩirie wendani wake ngoro-inĩ ciitũ na ũndũ wa Roho Mũtheru, ũrĩa we aatũheire.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa mũrurumo wa mĩgambo yao, itugĩ cia mĩrango na hingĩro ciaguo ikĩenyenya, nayo hekarũ ĩkĩiyũra ndogo.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũrakarie nĩ mũrũ wa nyina nĩ hinya kwĩiguithania nake gũkĩra kwĩgwatĩra itũũra inene rĩirigĩre, nacio ngarari nĩ ta mĩgĩĩko ĩrĩa ĩhingaga njeera.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

kikuyu: Nake Maritha akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ĩĩ Mwathani, nĩnjĩtĩkĩtie atĩ wee nĩwe Kristũ, Mũrũ wa Ngai, ũrĩa wĩrĩtwo nĩagooka gũkũ thĩ.”
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, ĩtĩkĩra ũgooci wa kwĩyendera wa kanua gakwa, na ũkĩndute mawatho maku.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, andũ arĩa meamũrĩte na magetheria nĩguo mathiĩ marũmĩrĩire ũrĩa ũrĩ gatagatĩ nĩguo makinyemagongona-inĩmarĩamarutagĩrwomĩgũnda-inĩ, oaciomarĩĩaganyamaciangũrwenambĩa, na indo ingĩ irĩ thaahu, magaathiranĩra hamwe,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mwena wa gũthini, gũtwarana na mwena ũrĩa mũraihu wa rũthingo rũu rwa nja ya nyumĩrĩra, kũnyiitana na mwena wa nja ya hekarũ, na kũngʼethera rũthingo rwa nja, nĩ haarĩ na tũnyũmba
english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ndungata ĩyo ĩngĩkorwo nĩ njaganu, na ĩĩre na ngoroatĩrĩ, ‘Mwathiwakwanĩegũikaraihindairaayaatacookete,’
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

kikuyu: Nĩngahaanda mĩtarakwa na mĩgaa, na mĩhandathi na mĩtamaiyũ kũu werũ-inĩ. Na haande mĩbinde kũndũ kũrĩa gũtakũraga kĩndũ, na mĩthengera, na mĩkarakaba o hamwe,
english: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

kikuyu: Okire gwake mwene, no andũ ake mwene matiigana kũmwĩtĩkĩra.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mwĩhumbei Mwathani Jesũ Kristũ, na mũtigatũũre mwĩciiragia o ũrĩa mũngĩhingia merirĩria ma mĩĩrĩ ĩno ya mehia.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

kikuyu: Ria rīnyihagia magetha nīūndū wa gūtharana na mīmera irio, maaī na ūtheri.
english: Weeds reduce yields by direct competition for nutrients, water, and light.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩtũma ndungata ĩngĩ, ĩyo o nayo makĩmĩhũũra makĩmĩconorithia na makĩmĩingata ĩtarĩ na kĩndũ.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Andũ a Benjamini maarĩ: Salu mũrũ wa Meshulamu, mũrũ wa Hodavia, mũrũ wa Hasenua;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩyo ndũmĩrĩri ĩrĩa Jehova aaririe na kanua ka Jeremia ũcio mũnabii, ũhoro ũkoniĩ Babuloni na andũ a bũrũri wa Babuloni:
english: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

kikuyu: “Ndaigua ũguo ngoro yakwa ĩgatumatuuma, na ĩkambarara ĩkoima handũ hayo.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

kikuyu: “No ngũkwĩra atĩrĩ, ũhoro-inĩ ũyũ wee ndũrĩ na kĩhooto, nĩgũkorwo Ngai nĩ mũnene gũkĩra mũndũ.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

kikuyu: nĩwe waringire marigithathi ma Misiri, Wendo wake nĩ wa tene na tene.
english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: īno nī njīra ya kūrīithia ngūkū cia kūrīa na rīmwe kwendia īrīa kaingī īrūmangīrīrwo icagi-inī.
english: This is carried out mainly in rural areas mostly for household consumption and occasionally income generation

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩgacemania na mũirĩtu gathirange ũtoorĩtio ahikio, amũnyiite na hinya nao mamenyeke-rĩ,
english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

kikuyu: no ũndikirie irima rĩa gĩcoro nĩgeetha o na nguo ciakwa iithũũre.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo andũ a Amaleki na Akaanani nĩmakarũa na inyuĩ kũu. Nĩ ũndũ nĩ mũhutatĩire Jehova, nake ndegũkorwo hamwe na inyuĩ, na nĩmũkũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.”
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, we Mũteithia, na nĩwe Roho Mũtheru, ũrĩa Baba agaatũma thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, nĩakamũruta maũndũ mothe na amũririkanie ũrĩa wothe ndĩmwĩrĩte.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩĩrĩ wagũĩrĩire Gidaliti, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12;
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: Arũme anyu makooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora, nacio njamba cianyu cia ita ikaaniinĩrwo mbaara-inĩ.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

kikuyu: Magĩaga nda cia mathĩĩna, na magaciara waganu; nda ciao ithugundaga o maheeni.”
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

kikuyu: Wagarũrire kĩgirĩko gĩakwa gĩgĩtuĩka rwĩmbo rwa gĩkeno; ũkĩnduta nguo yakwa ya ikũnia, ũkĩhumba gĩkeno,
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa gĩtũmi gĩkĩ-rĩ, mũndũ-wa-nja agĩrĩirwo nĩgũkorwo na rũũri mũtwe rwa kuonania atĩ nĩ wa gwathwo nĩ ũndũ wa araika.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

kikuyu: Ũyũ nĩguo ũhoro wa Shemu. Mĩaka ĩĩrĩ thuutha wa mũiyũro wa maaĩ-rĩ, rĩrĩa Shemu aarĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka igana rĩmwe-rĩ, nĩguo aatuĩkire ithe wa Arafakasadi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

kikuyu: No andũ a Isiraeli arĩa maatũũraga matũũra-inĩ ma Juda-rĩ, Rehoboamu agĩthiĩ na mbere kũmathamakĩra.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ndungata ĩyo yakũrire ĩhaana ta mũtĩ mwĩthĩ, na ta mũri ũmerete kũndũ kũmũ. Ndĩarĩ kĩĩrorerwa o na kana ĩgathakara ũndũ tũngĩaguucĩrĩirio nĩyo, ĩkĩoneka-rĩ, gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩngĩatũmire tũmĩĩrirĩrie.
english: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

kikuyu: magĩtũma Jehova arakare nĩ ũndũ wa ciĩko ciao cia waganu, naguo mũthiro ũgĩtuthũka gatagatĩ-inĩ kao.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

kikuyu: makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo we tiwe Kristũ, na tiwe Elija, o na kana Mũnabii ũrĩa-rĩ, ũkĩbatithanagia nĩkĩ?”
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩmoimia na nja, akĩũria atĩrĩ, “Athuuri aya, njagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩka atĩa nĩguo honoke?”
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

kikuyu: Aathiiaga na mĩthiĩre ya athamaki a Isiraeli, o na ningĩ agĩthondeka mĩhianano ya Baali ya gũtwekio ya kũhooyagwo.
english: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jesũ oonire wĩtĩkio wao, akĩĩra mũndũ ũcio wakuĩte ciĩga atĩrĩ, “Mũriũ, nĩwarekerwo mehia maku.”
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Na mũkuue betha maita meerĩ, tondũ no nginya mũcookie betha iria ciacooketio mĩromo-inĩ ya makũnia manyu. No gũkorwo ũndũ ũcio wekirwo na mahĩtia.
english: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩ wandĩkĩte maũndũ marũrũ ma kũnjũkĩrĩra, na ũkaangaĩra igai rĩa mehia ma ũnini wakwa.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

kikuyu: Wee mwene nĩũkũrũara mũno, ũrũare mũrimũ wa mara ũtangĩhona, nginya mũrimũ ũcio ũtũme mara maku mathire biũ.’ ”
english: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’ ”

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio matũũra mao manene marĩa marĩ hinya, marĩa maatiganĩirio makĩũrĩra andũ a Isiraeli, makahaana ta kũndũ gũtiganĩrie gũgatuĩka gĩthaka, na gũgakũra mahuti. Namo matũũra macio magaakira ihooru.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

kikuyu: “ ‘Hamwe na mwĩhĩtwa na maruta manyu ma kwĩyendera-rĩ, haaragĩriai indo icio nĩ ũndũ wa Jehova ciathĩ-inĩ cianyu iria ciathanĩtwo: na nĩcio maruta manyu ma njino, na maruta ma mũtu, na maruta ma kũnyuuo, na maruta ma ũiguano.’ ”
english: “ ‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’ ”

kikuyu: No mũndũ ũcio nĩeendaga gwĩtua mwega, nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩũria Jesũ atĩrĩ, “Nake mũndũ wa itũũra nũũ?”
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

kikuyu: Nĩtũcookagĩria Ngai ngaatho hĩndĩ ciothe nĩ ũndũ wanyu inyuothe, tũkĩmũgwetaga mahooya-inĩ maitũ.
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

kikuyu: Thutha-inī ītheremaga mathangū-inī mothe
english: In time, the bacterium spreads in the vascular system of the leaf and stem.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mwĩmenyererei! Mũtigakorokere maũndũ; nĩgũkorwo muoyo wa mũndũ ndũthimagwo na mũigana wa indo iria arĩ nacio.”
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo tũgondu nĩtũgaatũma ũgĩe na nguo, nacio mbũri itũme ũgĩe na gĩa kũgũra mũgũnda.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

kikuyu: Daudi agĩtiga Asafu na athiritũ ake hau mbere ya ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa Jehova nĩguo matungatage kuo hĩndĩ ciothe, kũringana na mabata ma o mũthenya.
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

kikuyu: Mūtī nīūnenehaga na kwoguo nīūbataraga kūrengwo;
english: The tree grows tall and requires cutting back;

kikuyu: nĩgeetha ngooka kũrĩ inyuĩ ngenete, Ngai enda, na tũcanjamũke tũrĩ hamwe.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

kikuyu: No nginya mũheage mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai kĩero kĩa ũrĩo kĩa maruta manyu ma ũiguano kĩrĩ kĩheo kĩanyu kũrĩ o.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

kikuyu: Aamaleki matũũraga kũu Negevu; Ahiti, na Ajebusi, na Aamori matũũraga bũrũri ũrĩa ũrĩ irĩma; Akaanani nao matũũraga ndwere-inĩ cia iria na hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani.”
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Nake akĩona mũkũyũ warĩ haraaya ũrĩ na mathangũ maruru agĩthiĩ kũrora kana warĩ na ngũyũ. Aakinya harĩ guo, agĩkora ndwarĩ na ngũyũ tiga o mathangũ, tondũ ndĩarĩ hĩndĩ ya mĩkũyũ gũciara.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

kikuyu: Na ithuĩ- rĩ, twĩtoonyagia ũgwati-inĩ o ithaa o ithaa nĩkĩ?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

kikuyu: Baalathu, na Tadimori rĩa werũ-inĩ, thĩinĩ wa bũrũri wake,
english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

kikuyu: No matiamenyaga atĩ Jusufu nĩaiguaga ũrĩa moigaga, tondũ we aatũmagĩra mũtabuti akĩmaarĩria.
english: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

kikuyu: nĩngakũrathima na ũmaathi mũingĩ mũno; athĩĩni akuo ndĩmahũũnie na irio.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũthĩĩni athaithanaga aiguĩrwo tha, no gĩtonga gĩcookagia ũhoro na ũũru.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

kikuyu: O na niĩ no njarie ta inyuĩ, korwo nĩ inyuĩ mũrĩ harĩa ndĩ; niĩ no njarie mĩario mĩega ya kũmũciirithia na ndĩmũinainĩrie mũtwe.*
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

kikuyu: Nīguo kahinda gaka kanyihe, kūrora ndariri cia mūrukī kahinda-inī ka wiki ithatū thutha wa kūhe mbegū nīūndū ūrī bata.
english: Inter-service intervals of more than 40 days is common. To shorten it heat detection three weeks after insemination is useful.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Firaũni arĩmwĩta na amũũrie atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ mũrutaga wĩra ũrĩkũ?”
english: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩaku-rĩ, ndekera mehia makwa, o na gũtuĩka nĩ manene.
english: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, atũmwo, na ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ arĩa maarĩ Judea guothe makĩigua atĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ o nao nĩmarĩkĩtie kwamũkĩra kiugo kĩa Ngai.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers† who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ andũ arĩa marĩ muoyo nĩmooĩ nĩmagakua, no arĩa makuĩte matirĩ ũndũ mooĩ; na matirĩ kĩheo kĩngĩ metereire, o na matiririkanagwo, nĩmariganĩire.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

kikuyu: Rũmena rwake no rũhithwo na maheeni, no waganu wake ũkaaguũrio kĩũngano-inĩ.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ya gũcaria na hĩndĩ ya kũũrĩrwo nĩ indo, hĩndĩ ya kũiga, na hĩndĩ ya gũte,
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

kikuyu: Ūritū wa kūgucīa njaū ndwagīrīirūo gūkorūo ūrī mūnene gūkīra hinya wa mūndū ūmwe anyitīte kūgūrū na īgūcio ītegūkūjwo
english: Type and amount of traction should be no more than the force of one person per leg and the direction of pull should be straight out

kikuyu: Mũtararĩko wa Cara ũkuraga ũrĩ na ũraihu mũnene,ĩrũgamĩte wega na ĩrakũra thutha.
english: Cara variety grows tall in height, very upright and late maturing.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki Solomoni aarĩ na ũtonga na ũũgĩ mũingĩ gũkĩra athamaki arĩa angĩ othe a thĩ.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

kikuyu: Hihi mūbango mwega wa gūciarithania ng'ombe ūratwarana na muoroto wa mūgūnda wakwa na mahinya makwa ingīūthondeka atia?
english: How do I develop a breeding plan or strategy tailored to my farm's goals and resources?

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa akĩĩgu manyũrũragia horohio ya mehia, no ũtugi wonekaga harĩ arĩa arũngĩrĩru.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

kikuyu: Ũmũthĩ itũũra-inĩ rĩa Daudi, nĩmũciarĩirwo mũhonokia; nake nĩwe Kristũ ũrĩa Mwathani.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ† the Lord.

kikuyu: Gatagatĩ ka arĩa mooragire nĩ Evi, na Rekemu, na Zuru, na Huri, na Reba, athamaki arĩa atano a Midiani. O na ningĩ nĩmooragire Balamu mũrũ wa Beori na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

kikuyu: Athĩkĩrai Jehova Ngai wanyu na mũrũmĩrĩre maathani make na kĩrĩra kĩa watho wake wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo ũrĩa ndĩramũhe ũmũthĩ.”
english: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

kikuyu: “Tũnua twao tũiyũrĩte irumi na ũrũrũ.”
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”*

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩngamuonia ũtugi wakwa, na ndũme mũciarane na mũingĩhe, na nĩngatũũria kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa na inyuĩ.
english: “ ‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka ndwari yakwa yarĩ magerio kũrĩ inyuĩ, mũtianyararire kana mũkĩĩmena, no mwanyiitire ũgeni ta ndaarĩ mũraika wa Ngai, o na ta ndaarĩ Jesũ Kristũ we mwene.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Roho wa ũtheru nĩonanirie na ũhoti atĩ Jesũ Kristũ nĩ Mũrũ wa Ngai tondũ wa ũrĩa aariũkire akiuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ: o we Jesũ Kristũ Mwathani witũ.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

kikuyu: Jehova agĩcinwo nĩ marakara mũthenya ũcio, akĩĩhĩta na mwĩhĩtwa ũyũ:
english: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

kikuyu: Hihi no wendekīthie harī mūrīmi gūītīīrīrīa maaī mūgūnda wake angīkoruo niarīīre mūcing'i?
english: Would you recommend a farmer to water his or her banana plantation even after mulching?

kikuyu: Mīmera mīega na īrī umithio ībatiī kūhandanīrio na kahūa nī waru, nyanya hamwe na mboco.
english: The technically and economically viable intercrops for coffee were potatoes, tomatoes, beans, and tomatoes in combination with beans.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Shobali maarĩ: Alivani, na Manahathu, na Ebali, na Shefo, na Onamu.
english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

kikuyu: Mũrĩmi nĩoimagarire akahure mbeũ ciake. Na rĩrĩa aahuraga mbeũ icio, imwe ikĩgũa mũkĩra-inĩ wa njĩra; ikĩrangĩrĩrio na magũrũ, nacio nyoni cia rĩera-inĩ igĩũka igĩcirĩa.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

kikuyu: Ngūrani ya ūrugarī gīito-inī na mūgūnda.
english: Temperature differences between the seedling nursery and the farm.

kikuyu: Ng'ombe irī na iria rīingī no inyue lita 150 nginya 200 cia maaī o mūthenya rīrīa kwīna rīua rīhiū.
english: High yielding milking cows may drink 150 to 200 L water/d during the hot season.

kikuyu: Nao Afarisai makĩmũkararia, makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “We ũraheana ũira waku wee mwene; ũira waku ti wa ma.”
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

kikuyu: O rũciinĩ na hwaĩ-inĩ nĩmarutagĩra Jehova maruta ma njino na ũbumba ũrĩa ũnungaga wega. Nĩmaigagĩrĩra mĩgate metha-inĩ ĩrĩa theru, na makagwatia matawa marĩa maigĩrĩirwo mũtĩ-inĩ wa thahabu wamo o hwaĩ-inĩ. Ithuĩ nĩtũrũmĩtie maũndũ marĩa Jehova Ngai witũ endaga. No inyuĩ nĩmũmũtiganĩirie.
english: They burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ ihiga rĩkarutwo harĩwe rĩtuĩke rĩa koine, o na kana ihiga o rĩothe rĩa mũthingi, nĩ ũndũ ũgũtũũra ũkirĩte ihooru nginya tene,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma nyũmba yaku ĩhaane o ta ya Jeroboamu mũrũ wa Nebati, na ta ya Baasha mũrũ wa Ahija, tondũ nĩũndakarĩtie na ũgatũma Isiraeli mehie.’
english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a Rehabia: nĩ Ishia na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

kikuyu: Nderi nĩwe ũmĩathaga yũmbũke na igũrũ, na ĩkeyakĩra gĩtara kĩayo igũrũ mũno?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

kikuyu: Nake aamarutire nduma-inĩ, akĩmaruta kũu nduma-inĩ nene mũno, na agĩtuanga mĩnyororo ĩrĩa moohetwo nayo.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

kikuyu: Magĩthiĩ nginya Ofiri, na makĩrehe taranda magana mana ma mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ† cia thahabu, iria maatwarĩire Mũthamaki Solomoni.
english: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents,§ and brought it to King Solomon.

kikuyu: No ithuĩ- rĩ, tũtingĩĩraha makĩria ma ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire, no tũkwĩraha kũringana na gĩcunjĩ kĩa wĩra ũrĩa Ngai atũheete, o na inyuĩ mũrĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa wĩra ũcio witũ.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

kikuyu: na magakinya Keriothu, na Bozara: ĩĩ, nginya matũũra mothe ma Moabi, marĩ kũraya na marĩ gũkuhĩ.
english: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

kikuyu: na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũkaahuna kana atuĩke thaata bũrũri-inĩ wanyu. Nĩndĩĩmũkinyagĩria matukũ marĩa mwathĩrĩirio ma gũtũũra muoyo.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

kikuyu: “Thondeka kĩgongona kĩa mbaũ cia mũgaa gĩa gũcinagĩra ũbumba.
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

kikuyu: Rĩu nĩtũcaayaga, tũkĩĩriragĩria kũhumbwo na nyũmba ĩyo ĩngĩ iitũ ya kuuma igũrũ,
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

kikuyu: Guthũkai, inyuĩ mbarathi ici! Matengʼeriei hatarĩ itherũ, inyuĩ mũtwarithagia ngaari cia ita. Umagarai, inyuĩ njamba ici cia ita: inyuĩ andũ a Kushi na a Putu, inyuĩ mũũĩ kũrũmia ngo, na inyuĩ andũ a Ludu, inyuĩ mũgeetaga ũta.
english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

kikuyu: “Oya mahuti maya manungi wega: cekeri 500§ cia manemane ĩrĩa ndwekie, nuthu yamo (nacio icio nĩ cekeri 250) cia ndarathini nungi wega, na cekeri 250 cia karamathi nungi wega,
english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels;‡ and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩũria anene acio a Firaũni, o acio moohetwo hamwe nake nyũmba-inĩ ya mwathi wake, atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte mũtukie ithiithi cianyu ũmũthĩ?”
english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo athamaki arĩa maikarĩire gĩtĩ kĩa ũthamaki kĩa Daudi nĩmagatoonyera ihingo cia itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene marĩ na anene ao. O, hamwe na anene ao, nĩmagooka makuuĩtwo nĩ ngaari cia ita, na mahaicĩte mbarathi, marĩ hamwe na andũ a Juda, na andũ arĩa matũũraga Jerusalemu, narĩo itũũra rĩu-rĩ, nĩrĩgatũũrwo nĩ andũ nginya tene.
english: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.

kikuyu: Nĩatũranirie mahiga kũu werũ-inĩ, na akĩmahe maaĩ maingĩ o ta ma iria;
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo honge imwe cia mũtamaiyũ wa mũgũnda nĩciakahũrirwo, nawe, o na watuĩka ũrĩ rũhonge rwa mũtamaiyũ wa gĩthaka-rĩ, ũgĩciarithanio na honge icio ingĩ, na rĩu nĩũgayanaga ũnoru na icio ingĩ kuuma mũri wa mũtamaiyũ ũcio-rĩ,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

kikuyu: Tondũ nĩmathũũrire ũmenyo, na matiigana gũthuura gwĩtigĩra Jehova,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

kikuyu: Jesũ agĩcooka akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Wĩtagwo atĩa?” Nake akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Njĩtagwo Legioni, nĩgũkorwo tũrĩ aingĩ.”*
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

kikuyu: Kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe kĩa andũ a Isiraeli gĩkiuma kũu Kadeshi na magĩkinya Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Horu.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, ndigũtua atĩ niĩ mwene nĩndĩkĩtie kwĩnyiitĩra ũndũ ũcio. No rĩrĩ, ũndũ ũrĩa njĩkaga no ũmwe: Nĩkũriganĩrwo ndiganagĩrwo nĩ maũndũ marĩa mahĩtũku, na ngerutanĩria mũno gũkinyĩra maũndũ marĩa marĩ mbere,
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akĩĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Onei, Jehova nĩathuurĩte Bezaleli mũrũ wa Uri ũrĩa mũriũ wa Huri, wa mũhĩrĩga wa Juda,
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, angĩikara akirĩte-rĩ, nũũ ũngĩmũtua muhĩtia? Angĩhitha ũthiũ wake-rĩ, nũũ ũngĩmuona? Nowe arĩ igũrũ rĩa mũndũ na igũrũ rĩa rũrĩrĩ o ũndũ ũmwe,
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

kikuyu: Kahūa nogakūre tīīri-inī ūtiganīte no ūrīa mwega mūno nī tīīri ūrīa wīna ūnoru, mūtune kana volcanic red soil, na sandy-loam.
english: Coffee can be grown on many different soil types, but the ideal is a fertile, volcanic red earth or a deep, sandy loam.

kikuyu: “Hĩ! Kaĩ arĩithi arĩa maniinaga na makahurunja mbũri cia rũũru rwakwa marĩ na haaro- ĩ!” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ, Mũrungu ndathikagĩrĩria mathaithana mao ma tũhũ; ũcio Mwene-Hinya-Wothe ndarũmbũyagia mathaithana macio.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Wee ndũrĩ Mũrungu wa gũkenera ũũru; ningĩ andũ arĩa aaganu ndũngĩtũũrania nao.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘Nĩngũtũma ũtuĩke ta ũndũ wa kũguoyohia kũrĩ wee mwene o na wa kũmakia arata aku othe;* nĩũkeyonera na maitho maku rĩrĩa andũ acio makooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora rwa thũ ciao. Nĩnganeana andũ a Juda othe kũrĩ mũthamaki wa Babuloni, nake amatahe amatware Babuloni, kana amooragithie na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

kikuyu: Mũgaaciĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩ igongona rĩa Bathaka rĩa kũrutĩra Jehova, ũrĩa waagararire nyũmba cia andũ a Isiraeli kũu bũrũri wa Misiri, na akĩhonokia andũ a nyũmba ciitũ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ooragire andũ a Misiri.’ ” Nao andũ makĩinamĩrĩria mothiũ mao, makĩhooya.
english: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’ ” The people bowed their heads and worshiped.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Andĩka ũndũ ũyũ ibuku-inĩ rĩa gĩkũnjo ũrĩ ũndũ wa gũtũũra ũririkanagwo na ũreke Joshua aũigue, tondũ nĩngeheria rĩĩtwa rĩa Amaleki biũ nao matigacooka kũririkanwo gũkũ thĩ.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

kikuyu: No Jerusalemu, itũũra rĩrĩa rĩa kũũrĩa igũrũ, rĩtirĩ ũkombo-inĩ, na nĩrĩo nyina witũ,
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

kikuyu: Nĩnjookagĩria Ngai ngaatho hĩndĩ ciothe nĩ ũndũ wanyu, nĩ ũndũ wa wega wake ũrĩa mũheetwo thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ.
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Tungatagai na ngoro yothe mũtarĩ na kĩnyiria, taarĩ Mwathani mũratungatĩra, no ti andũ,
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

kikuyu: Hūthīra tūng'ang'i mūthemba wa igi(Diadegma spp) kana dawa īthondeketwo kuuma mūtī-inī wa mūthandū ta azadirachtin (Neemraj Super 3000®) etc.
english: Use of parasitic wasp (Diadegma spp.).Use of neem products, such as azadirachtin (Neemraj Super 3000®) etc.

kikuyu: O na ndakorwo ndirĩ hamwe na inyuĩ kũu, ndĩ hamwe na inyuĩ thĩinĩ wa roho, na nĩndĩkĩtie gũtuĩra mũndũ ũcio wĩkĩte ũguo ciira, o ta ndĩ hamwe na inyuĩ.
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

kikuyu: Ngũtũũra ngũgoocaga nginya tene nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa wĩkĩte; ndĩrĩĩhokaga rĩĩtwa rĩaku, nĩgũkorwo rĩĩtwa rĩaku nĩ rĩega. Ndĩrĩkũgoocaga ndĩ mbere ya andũ aku arĩa aamũre.
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa uunagĩra andũ riitho akoragwo agĩthugunda waganu, ũrĩa ũtembanagia mĩromo akoragwo agĩthugunda ũũru.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

kikuyu: Munya na ūcīne mītī yothe īrīa īna mūrimū ūyū.
english: Uproot and burn all infected trees having die bark from Collar rot.

kikuyu: Wee njamba ĩno ĩrĩ hinya, ũreegana nĩ ũndũ wa maũndũ mooru nĩkĩ? Ũtindaga wĩrahĩte mũthenya wothe nĩkĩ, o wee ũtuĩkĩte gĩconoko maitho-nĩ ma Ngai?
english: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gĩtonga gĩkĩmwĩta gĩkĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Iburahĩmu, Baba, njiguĩra tha, ũtũme Lazaro atobokie mũthia wa kĩara gĩake maaĩ-inĩ ooke aahehie rũrĩmĩ, tondũ ndĩ na ruo rũnene gũkũ mwaki-inĩ ũyũ.’
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

kikuyu: Acio othe maarĩ ariũ a Daudi, ariũ a thuriya ciake matatarĩtwo. Nake Tamaru nĩwe warĩ mwarĩ wa ithe wao.
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndakwĩrire maũndũ maya o tene; ngĩkwĩra ũhoro wamo mataanekĩka, nĩgeetha ndũkanoige atĩrĩ, ‘Mĩhianano yakwa ya kũhooywo nĩyo ĩĩkĩte maũndũ macio; mũhianano wakwa wa gwacũhio, na ngai yakwa ya kĩgera nĩcio ciathanire ũhoro wamo.’
english: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’

kikuyu: Gĩkĩ nĩkĩo gĩtũmaga mũndũ mũrũme atige ithe na nyina, na anyiitane na mũtumia wake, nao magatuĩka mwĩrĩ ũmwe.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

kikuyu: Nake Daudi akĩrora igũrũ akĩona mũraika wa Jehova arũngiĩ gatagatĩ ka igũrũ na thĩ acomorete rũhiũ rwa njora, arũnyiitĩte na guoko gwake gũtambũrũkĩirio Jerusalemu. Nake Daudi na athuuri, mehumbĩte nguo cia makũnia, makĩgũa magĩturumithia mothiũ mao thĩ.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩamenyagĩrĩra njĩra ya andũ arĩa athingu, no andũ arĩa aaganu marĩ njĩra-inĩ ya kũũra.
english: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova Ngai akĩũria mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio atĩrĩ, “Atĩ nĩ atĩa wĩkĩte?” Mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio akiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ nyoka ĩheenirie na niĩ ndarĩa matunda macio.”
english: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

kikuyu: Ũmũthĩ-rĩ, nĩndagũtua ta itũũra rĩirige na hinya, na ta gĩtugĩ gĩa kĩgera, na ta rũthingo rwa gĩcango, nĩgeetha wĩyũmie ũũkĩrĩre bũrũri wothe: ũũkĩrĩre athamaki a Juda, na anene, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai akuo, o na andũ othe a bũrũri ũyũ.
english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

kikuyu: Agaagwĩka atĩa, na nĩ atĩa ũngĩ makĩria ya ũguo, wee rũrĩmĩ rũrũ rũheenanagia?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

kikuyu: Andũ marokũgooca, Wee Ngai; andũ othe marogũkumia.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Mītī īcehagwo tene ītacanūkīte nīguo kūruta mahūa na matunda maria matarendeka na ningī thutha wa kūgetha.
english: Pruning is done at the early stages before flowering to remove premature flowers and fruits and after harvesting.

kikuyu: Andũ ao kũringana na nyũmba ciao maarĩ: Mikaeli, na Meshulamu, na Sheba, na Jorai, na Jakani, na Zia, na Eberi, othe maarĩ andũ mũgwanja.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

kikuyu: Waambagīrīria na karoro kanini kerū.
english: Usually starts off as white spots.

kikuyu: Agĩaka kĩgongona kũu, na agĩĩta handũ hau Eli-Betheli, tondũ hau nĩho Ngai aamwĩguũrĩirie rĩrĩa ooragĩra mũrũ wa nyina.
