english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

kikuyu: Ũtũmĩte matukũ makwa makuhĩhe ta rũhĩ; mũigana wa mĩaka yakwa ti ta kĩndũ harĩwe. Mũndũ o wothe ũrĩ muoyo o na rĩrĩa ehaandĩte wega nĩ kĩndũ gĩa tũhũ.
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩndamũcookeria ũhoro ũcio ũmũthĩ, no rĩrĩ, mũtiathĩkĩire Jehova Ngai wanyu harĩ maũndũ macio mothe aandũmĩte ndĩmwĩre.
english: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed Yahweh your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.

kikuyu: Rĩĩrĩ nĩrĩo rĩathani rĩakwa: Endanagai.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Isiraeli arĩa maarĩ nyabaara magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Firaũni kũmũthaitha, makĩmũũria atĩrĩ: “Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte wĩke ndungata ciaku maũndũ maya?
english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

kikuyu: Ningĩ-rĩ, caragiai thayũ na ũgaacĩru wa itũũra rĩu inene kũu ndĩmũthaamĩirie. Hooyagai Jehova nĩ ũndũ warĩo, tondũ rĩngĩgaacĩra-rĩ, o na inyuĩ no mũkũgaacĩra.”
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova akĩĩra Nuhu atĩrĩ, “Nĩnduĩte itua kũniina andũ aya othe, nĩgũkorwo thĩ nĩ ĩiyũrĩtwo nĩ maũndũ ma ũhinya nĩ ũndũ wao. Ti-itherũ nĩngũmaniinanĩria hamwe na thĩ.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu, ũrĩa wamũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri nĩguo ndĩmũhe bũrũri wa Kaanani na nduĩke Ngai wanyu.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

kikuyu: nao andũ a Juda makiugĩrĩria na mũgambo wa mbaara. Hĩndĩ ĩyo maanagĩrĩra na mũgambo wa mbaara, Ngai akĩharagania Jeroboamu na Isiraeli rĩothe mbere ya Abija na andũ a Juda.
english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩnjũũĩ mahĩtia makwa, namo mehia makwa makoragwo mbere yakwa hĩndĩ ciothe.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa moonire njata ĩyo, magĩkena gĩkeno kĩnene mũno.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

kikuyu: Aaririe, nacio ngigĩ igĩũka, na ndaahi itangĩtarĩka;
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova Ngai wakwa, ndagũkaĩire ũndeithie nawe ũkĩĩhonia.
english: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

kikuyu: Nĩmwakire handũ ha kũhingĩrĩria maaĩ gatagatĩ ga thingo cierĩ, nĩgeetha maaĩ ma Karia ga Tene mathiiage ho, no mũtiigana kũrongooria Ũrĩa wagathondekire, kana mũrũmbũiye Ũrĩa watũmire kagĩe ho kuuma o tene.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

kikuyu: Na mũtĩ-inĩ ũcio wa kũigĩrĩra matawa hagĩe ikombe inya cia mũhiano wa mahũa ma mũrothi irĩ na tũkonyo na mahũa.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: O na inyuĩ, o ũndũ ũmwe mwĩonagei atĩ nĩmũkuĩte ũhoro-inĩ wa mehia, na atĩ mũtũũraga muoyo mũrĩ ngwatanĩro na Ngai thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũrĩmaga mũgũnda wake nĩarĩkoragwo na irio nyingĩ, no ũrĩa ũhanyũkanagia na maũndũ ma tũhũ nĩagĩte gũkũũrana maũndũ.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Tiga Jehova aandeithirie-rĩ, ingĩakuire o narua, ngatũũre kũu ũkiri-inĩ.
english: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ingĩĩra mũndũ ũrĩa mwaganu atĩrĩ, ‘Ti-itherũ nĩũgũkua,’ nowe agarũrũke atigane na mehia make, eke maũndũ marĩa marĩ ma kĩhooto na magĩrĩire,
english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩ kwarĩ andũ aingĩ maarĩ na mangũ thĩinĩ wa Isiraeli ihinda rĩa Elisha ũrĩa mũnabii, no gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe wao wahonirio tiga Naamani ũrĩa Mũsuriata.”
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

kikuyu: Ti-itheru o ta ũrĩa Jehova Ngai waku atũũraga muoyo-rĩ, gũtirĩ rũrĩrĩ kana ũthamaki mwathi wakwa atarĩ aatũmana ũgacario. Na rũrĩrĩ kana ũthamaki o wothe woiga ndũrĩ kuo, nake akehĩtithia andũ akuo moige na ma atĩ matikuonete.
english: As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova mũmũnenehie mũrĩ hamwe na niĩ; rekei tũtũũgĩrie rĩĩtwa rĩake tũrĩ hamwe.
english: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

kikuyu: Mũtikanarĩe nyama irĩ njĩthĩ kana itherũkĩtio na maaĩ, no ihĩhio na mwaki, mũtwe, na magũrũ o na nyama cia nda.
english: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wao haarĩ Mariamu Mũmagidali, na Mariamu ũrĩa nyina wa Jakubu na Jose, na nyina wa ariũ a Zebedi.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

kikuyu: o na rĩrĩa twacambio, tũcookagia ũhoro na ũhooreri. Nginya ihinda rĩĩrĩ tũtuĩkĩte gĩko gĩa thĩ, tũgatuĩka mahuti ma gũkũ thĩ.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

kikuyu: Mũirĩtu ũcio aarĩ mũthaka mũno; nake akĩmenyerera mũthamaki na akĩmũtun- gatĩra, no mũthamaki ndaigana gũkoma nake.
english: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu agaakorwo aniinĩte ndũrĩrĩ iria ekũmũhe bũrũri wacio, na rĩrĩa na inyuĩ mũgaakorwo mũrĩkĩtie kũingata ndũrĩrĩ icio, na mũgaatũũra matũũra ma cio na nyũmba ciacio,
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

kikuyu: mũigana wao warĩ andũ 8,580.
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, tũma andũ mathiĩ Jopa magĩĩre mũndũ wĩtagwo Simoni, na nowe wĩtagwo Petero.
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

kikuyu: na ũngayagĩre mũthenya wa mĩnyamaro; na nĩndĩrĩkũhonokagia, nawe ũngoocage.”
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

kikuyu: na Pathirusimu, na Kasuluhimu (nĩwe warĩ kĩhumo kĩa Afilisti), o na Kafitorimu.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: “Thuutha ũcio gũkĩgĩa ngʼaragu bũrũri-inĩ wothe wa Misiri, na Kaanani, na ĩkĩrehe gũthĩĩnĩka kũingĩ mũno, namo maithe maitũ makĩaga irio.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

kikuyu: Ningī kūndū kūrī na ūrugari wa ikīro cia ndigirii ikūmi na ithano nginya mīrongo īrī na ithano na mbura ya ikīro icia milimita 900-200.
english: Temperatures range from 15 to 24 degrees and average rainfall ranges from 900–1200mm.

kikuyu: Nīkīī kīngītūma tūthuranie maembe?
english: Why sort mango fruits?

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Thuutha wa gũtoonya bũrũri ũrĩa ngũmũhe ũtuĩke mũciĩ wanyu,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, Jehova arooka arĩ na mwaki, na ngaari ciake cia ita ihaana ta kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene; akaamũikũrũkĩria marakara make arĩ na mangʼũrĩ, na amũkũũme na ikũũmana rĩhaana ta nĩnĩmbĩ cia mwaki.
english: For, behold, Yahweh will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

kikuyu: mũngĩaga kũhinyĩrĩria mũndũ wa kũngĩ, kana mwana wa ngoriai, kana mũtumia wa ndigwa-rĩ, na mwage gũitithia thakame ya mũndũ ũteehĩtie kũndũ gũkũ-rĩ, o na ningĩ mwage kwĩgerithia ngero nĩ ũndũ wa kũrũmĩrĩra ngai ingĩ-rĩ,
english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

kikuyu: No inyuĩ nĩmwĩkĩte maũndũ ma waganu mũgakĩra maithe manyu. Ta rorai muone ũrĩa o ũmwe wanyu arũmĩrĩire ũremi wa ngoro yake thũku, handũ ha kũnjathĩkĩra.
english: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me.

kikuyu: Ndũrĩrĩ nĩikamooya, imacookie kũndũ kwao. Nayo nyũmba ya Isiraeli nĩĩkegwatĩra ndũrĩrĩ, ituĩke ndungata ciao cia arũme na cia airĩtu kũu bũrũri wa Jehova. Nĩmagataha andũ arĩa maamatahĩte tene, na macooke gwatha andũ arĩa maamahinyagĩrĩria.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

kikuyu: Wee Misiri, nĩwe watũmire thĩinĩ waku kũringwo ciama na morirũ, agĩũkĩrĩra Firaũni na ndungata ciake ciothe.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa oonire rũhuho, agĩĩtigĩra, na akĩambĩrĩria gũtoonyerera maaĩ-inĩ, agĩkaya, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, honokia!”
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

kikuyu: na mũtongoria wa gĩkundi gĩa thigari mĩrongo ĩtano, na mũheani kĩrĩra, na mũbundi mũũgĩ, o na mũndũ-mũgo mũũgĩ.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

kikuyu: Nīguo kūhūrana na mūrimū ūyū, hebata gūceha mītī, kūruta mbegū iria ndwaru na kūhūra dawa mūthemba wa fungicide.
english: To control the disease, it is important to prune and remove infected leaves and apply a fungicide.

kikuyu: No nĩnjũũĩ atĩ wee na anene aku mũtirĩ mũretigĩra Jehova Ngai.”
english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear Yahweh God.”

kikuyu: “No mũtigeciirie atĩ nĩngamũthitanga mbere ya Baba. Musa ũrĩa inyuĩ mwĩhokeete nĩwe mũmũthitangi.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

kikuyu: na ndundu ĩrĩa ĩrĩ rũhĩa, na ndundu ĩrĩa ĩgambaga, na nyoni ya iria-inĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ mathagu maraaya, na mũthemba o wothe wa rwĩgĩ,
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

kikuyu: ũngĩkaaga kĩndũ gĩa kũrĩha nakĩo-rĩ, ũgaatunywo ũrĩrĩ waku o ũũkomeire.
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

kikuyu: Nũũ ũngĩhota kũmĩaũra nguo yayo ya igũrũ? Nũũ ũngĩmĩkuhĩrĩria amĩĩkĩre matamu?
english: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

kikuyu: na ariũ a Hashemu ũrĩa Mũgizoni, na Jonathani mũrũ wa Shage ũrĩa Mũharari,
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

kikuyu: Andũatanoanyumakaahũũraandũigana, nao andũ anyu igana makaahũũra andũ ngiri ikũmi, nacio thũ nĩ mũgaacihoota mũciũrage na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: Nĩ niĩ Paũlũ, ndungata ya Kristũ Jesũ, o niĩ njĩtĩĩtwo nduĩke mũtũmwo, na ngaamũrwo hunjagie Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega wa Ngai,
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ,† called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

kikuyu: Nao nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova; niĩ ndiamamakagia tũhũ ngiuga atĩ nĩngamarehere mũtino ũyũ.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.” ’

kikuyu: Nyama na matumbī mega: Ngūkū icio nī ciūīkaine mūno nīūndū wa nyama īrī cama na matumbī marī mūruru mūnene, ningī ngūkū ici nīirī goro ūkīringithania na mithemba ingī īrīa īreragwo irī ya biacara.
english: Superior Meat and Eggs: Renowned for their flavorful meat and rich-yolked eggs, indigenous breeds command premium prices compared to commercial chickens.

kikuyu: Anene mangĩigua atĩ nĩtwaranĩirie nawe, nao moke kũrĩ we makũũrie atĩrĩ, ‘Twĩre ũrĩa wĩrĩte mũthamaki, na ũrĩa nake mũthamaki akwĩrĩte; ndũgatũhithe ũndũ kana tũkũũrage,’
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Amazia akĩrekereria thigari icio ciokĩte kũrĩ we kuuma Efiraimu, agĩciĩra ciinũke. Nacio ikĩrakarĩra andũ a Juda mũno, na ikĩinũka irĩ na marakara maingĩ.
english: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

kikuyu: Nīkūrī mĩthemba īhotaga gwītiria mūrimū wa mboga kūbutha kana black rot.
english: Varieties tolerant to black rot are available.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩro kĩroiguuo kuuma nyũmba-inĩ ciao rĩrĩa ũkaarehe andũ a kũmatharĩkĩra hi na hi, nĩ ũndũ nĩmanyenjeire irima nĩguo maanyite, na makanyumbĩkĩra mĩtego ya kũnyiita magũrũ makwa.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.

kikuyu: No kĩgongona gĩa gĩcango kĩrĩa gĩathondeketwo nĩ Bezaleli mũrũ wa Uri, mũrũ wa Huru, kĩarĩ Gibeoni mbere ya hema ĩrĩa nyamũre ya Jehova; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Solomoni na kĩũnganokĩu magĩthiĩ hau gũtuĩria ũhorokuuma kũrĩ Jehova.
english: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before Yahweh’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

kikuyu: namo magũrũ manyu mũmahaarĩrie gũthiĩ kũhunjia Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega wa thayũ.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

kikuyu: Jehova arokũhe ũbaarĩrĩri na ũmenyo rĩrĩa agaakũnengera ũthamaki wa Isiraeli, nĩgeetha ũrũmie watho wa Jehova Ngai waku.
english: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.

kikuyu: “Kaĩ mũrĩ na haaro-ĩ, inyuĩ arutani a watho na Afarisai, hinga ici! Mũrutaga gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa nyeni; na nĩcio terere, na bitharĩ, na thuu. No nĩmũtiganĩirie maũndũ marĩa ma bata makĩria marĩa makoniĩ watho na nĩmo kĩhooto, na kũiguanĩra tha, na wĩhokeku. Maya-rĩ, nĩmo mwagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩka mũtegũtiganĩria macio mangĩ.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin,† and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩcooka agĩatha athondekani arĩa maarĩ ndungata ciake mathondeke mwĩrĩ wa ithe Isiraeli nĩguo ndũkabuthe. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio athondekani makĩmũthondeka,
english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jesũ agĩthiĩ harĩa aarĩ, akĩmũnyiita guoko akĩmũũkĩria. Mũrimũ ũcio wa kũhiũha mwĩrĩ ũkĩmũtiga na akĩambĩrĩria kũmatungatĩra.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately,† and she served them.

kikuyu: Nĩmatumire gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio kĩa ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njogothe wega, na gĩkĩgemio na makerubi nĩ mũbundi mũũgĩ.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: “Eleazaru mũrũ wa Harũni, ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, nĩwe ũrĩmenyagĩrĩra maguta ma gwakia tawa, na ũbumba ũrĩa ũnungaga wega, na mũtu ũrĩa ũrutagwo hĩndĩ ciothe, o na maguta marĩa maitanagĩrĩrio. Nĩwe ũrĩmenyagĩrĩra Hema-ĩyo-Nyamũre ĩrĩ yothe na indo iria ciothe irĩ thĩinĩ wayo, nĩcio indo iria nyamũre ciĩkĩrĩtwo kuo, na indo cia wĩra.”
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

kikuyu: nake Ahija akĩoya nguo ĩyo njerũ eehumbĩte, akĩmĩtarũra icunjĩ ikũmi na igĩrĩ.
english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai mũthingu, o Wee ũthuthuuragia meciiria na ngoro, kinyia ũhinya wa andũ arĩa aaganu mũthia, na ũtũme andũ arĩa athingu matũũre na thayũ.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

kikuyu: Mathandūkū no mūhaka mekīrwo marima mīena ma kūhehia na gwītīkīria rīera gūcera
english: The boxes should have holes to allow for effective cooling and air circulation.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ũrĩrĩ wanyu ndũngĩmũigana gwĩtambũrũkĩria ho nĩ gũkuhĩha, naguo mũrĩngĩti nĩ mũceke mũno ndũngĩmũigana kwĩhumbĩra.
english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

kikuyu: nao andũ aingĩ magĩũka kũrĩ we. Nao makiuga atĩrĩ, “O na gũtuĩka Johana ndarĩ kĩama aaringire, ũhoro ũrĩa wothe Johana oigire ũkoniĩ mũndũ ũyũ warĩ wa ma.”
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

kikuyu: Hebata wa gūcenjia ithimo cia irio kūringana na mabataro ma ng'ombe.
english: Adjust the ratio accordingly to meet the changing needs of the cows and optimize performance.

kikuyu: Labani agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Nĩ kaba ndĩmũheanĩte kũrĩ we gũkĩra ndĩmũhe mũndũ ũngĩ. Ikara gũkũ na niĩ, ũndungate.”
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

kikuyu: O rũciinĩ mũndũ o mũndũ nĩoyaga ĩrĩa abatairio nĩyo, narĩo riũa rĩahiũha ĩgatweka.
english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

kikuyu: Na akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Mũtigekuuĩre kĩndũ o nakĩ rũgendo-inĩ tiga o mũtirima; na mũtigakuue mũgate, kana mondo, kana mbeeca ibeeti-inĩ cianyu.
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

kikuyu: Igongona rĩanyu rĩa mũtu rĩngĩgakorwo nĩ mũgate ũkarangĩirwo igũrũ rĩa rũgĩo-rĩ, igongona rĩu nĩrĩthondekwo na mũtu ũrĩa mũhinyu mũno na maguta.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

kikuyu: Nĩngamarehithĩria ngʼaragu ya kũmahinyaria, ndĩmarehithĩrie gĩthĩĩna gĩa kũmaniina na mũthiro wa kũmooraga; Ngaamarehithĩria nyamũ cia gĩthaka irĩ magego moogĩ, ndĩmarehithĩrie ũrũrũ wa nduĩra iria inyororokaga rũkũngũ-inĩ.
english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

kikuyu: “Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ arata akwa, tigagai gwĩtigĩra arĩa mooragaga mwĩrĩ na thuutha ũcio gũtirĩ ũndũ mangĩhota gwĩka.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

kikuyu: Tumĩra ariũ a Harũni kanjũ, na mĩcibi, na tũmĩcibi twa kĩongo, cia gũtũma manenehagio na maheagwo gĩtĩĩo.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: Gūitīkīra kūrūgama yahutio mūgongo-inī na īkahorera, kwonania atī nī ihinda riayo ria kūheo ndume. Murimi ni abatiī kūmenya mūtugo wa ng'ombe irenda ndume.
english: Standing Heat: When pressure is applied to the cow’s back, she stands still, indicating she is in heat and receptive to mating. A farmer should be keen to detect the signs by understanding the behaviours of the cows.

kikuyu: Matirĩ ũndũ mooĩ, na matirĩ ũndũ mamenyaga; maitho mao nĩmahumbĩre, nĩ ũndũ ũcio matingĩona, na meciiria mao nĩmahingĩtwo makaaga kũmenya maũndũ.
english: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gũkĩgĩa na gĩkeno kĩnene itũũra-inĩ rĩu.
english: There was great joy in that city.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩmatiga, akiuma itũũra rĩu inene, agĩthiĩ Bethania, akĩraara kuo.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

kikuyu: No nyende kũmenya ũrĩa angĩĩnjookeria, ndĩcũũranie ũrĩa angĩnjĩĩra.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

kikuyu: Twarana na mūtaratara wa kūhuhīra nīūndū ūngīhūthīra dawa mūno no gūcūngīrīrie tūtambi na tūrūgi tūgie ūkirīrīria wa dawa ici na tūkaga kūhuka.
english: Adhere to the spray programme. Improper use of fungicides may lead to development of resistance by the pathogen.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘Ndĩ hakuhĩ gũkweheria thĩ. Mwaka-inĩ o ro ũyũ nĩũgũkua, tondũ nĩũhunjĩtie ũremi wa gũũkĩrĩra Jehova.’ ”
english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’ ”

kikuyu: Ciana ciake ciarahũkaga, cikoiga arorathimwo; o nake mũthuuri wake nĩamũgaathagĩrĩria, akamwĩra atĩrĩ:
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Daudi eerirwo ũhoro ũcio, agĩcookanĩrĩria ita rĩa Isiraeli rĩothe, makĩringa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani, nake akĩmakinyĩra na akĩiga mbũtũ ciake imangʼetheire. Daudi akĩhaarĩria mbũtũ ciake nĩguo itũngane na Asuriata acio mbaara-inĩ, nao Asuriata makĩrũa nake.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

kikuyu: agĩathana Jeremia ũcio mũnabii ahũũrwo na oohererwo magũrũ ndungu-inĩ hau Kĩhingo-inĩ kĩa Rũgongo kĩa Benjamini, o kũu hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, thĩinĩ wa matũũra manene ma ndũrĩrĩ marĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu ekũmũhe matuĩke igai rĩanyu, mũtikanatigie kĩndũ o nakĩ, kĩhihagia kana kĩrĩ muoyo.
english: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

kikuyu: Njīra īno no īrūmīrīrwo kūrera njui irī na ūkūrū wa kuuma mūthenya wa mbere.
english: Can be used to rear day-old chicks

kikuyu: “Mwathani Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ; ‘Tondũ Afilisti nĩmekire maũndũ ma kwĩrĩhĩria, na makĩĩrĩhĩria marĩ na rũmena ngoro-inĩ ciao na marĩ na muku wa matukũ maingĩ magĩtua atĩ nĩmekwananga Juda,
english: “ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

kikuyu: Nao andũ othe magĩthiĩ hekarũ-inĩ ya Baali na makĩmĩtharia. Makiunanga igongona na mĩhianano na makĩũragĩra Matani ũrĩa warĩ mũthĩnjĩri-ngai wa Baali hau mbere ya igongona icio.
english: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

kikuyu: Mũngĩgaakora nyamũ ĩkuĩte, kana ĩkooragwo nĩ nyamũ cia gĩthaka, maguta mayo no mahũthĩrwo na ũndũ ũngĩ o wothe, no mũtikanamarĩe.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩagatũma ũhootwo nĩ thũ ciaku. Ũgaacihithũkĩra na njĩra ĩmwe, no ũciũrĩre na njĩra mũgwanja, na nĩ ũgaatuĩka kĩndũ kĩ magigi harĩ mothamaki mothe ma thĩ.
english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũtiambatĩte mũthiĩ rũthingo-inĩ kũrĩa gũtharũkĩte, mũrũcookererie nĩ ũndũ wa nyũmba ya Isiraeli nĩgeetha rũgetiiria hĩndĩ ya mbaara mũthenya ũrĩa wa Jehova.
english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.

kikuyu: Kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri makĩheo Mashali, na Abidoni,
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: na inyuĩ nĩmũiyũrĩtwo nĩ muoyo thĩinĩ wa Kristũ, ũrĩa arĩ weMũneneigũrũrĩa hinya o wothe na ũhoti o wothe.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

kikuyu: Ũrĩa wothe ũkoina rĩathani o na rĩmwe rĩa marĩa manini, na arute arĩa angĩ gwĩka ũguo, nĩagatuuo mũnini makĩria thĩinĩ wa ũthamaki wa igũrũ, no ũrĩa wothe wĩkaga naakarutanamaathani maya-rĩ, nĩagatuuomũneneũthamaki-inĩwa igũrũ.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Githĩ ti kũgayanaga irio ciaku na andũ arĩa ahũtu, na ũrehage athĩĩni arĩa matarĩ ũikaro gwaku mũciĩ, na rĩrĩa wona mũndũ arĩ njaga ũkamũhumba nguo, na ndũkanahutatĩre andũ arĩa mũrĩ a mũthiimo ũmwe nao?
english: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?

kikuyu: Mũthamaki aahũthĩrire mĩthandari ĩyo gwaka itugĩ cia gũtiirĩrĩra hekarũ ya Jehova na cia nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na gũthondekera aini inanda cia mũgeeto o na cia kĩnũbi. Kuuma mũthenya ũcio gũtirĩ kwarehwo kuuma na nja kana gũkooneka mĩthandari mĩingĩ ũguo.)
english: The king made of the almug trees pillars for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

kikuyu: na Beria, na Shema arĩa maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba cia arĩa maatũũraga Aijaloni, na nĩo maingatire andũ arĩa maatũũraga Gathu.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kikuyu: “Ha ũhoro wa mĩhĩrĩga ĩyo ĩngĩ ĩtigarĩte: Benjamini akaaheo gĩcigo kĩmwe; nakĩo gĩgaatam- bũrũka kuuma mwena wa irathĩro nginya mwena wa ithũĩro.
english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũthũire kĩhooto-rĩ, no ahote gwathana? Ũrĩa ũrĩ kĩhooto, o Ũcio kĩhoti-rĩ, no ũmũtue mwĩhia?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio niĩ nĩngameka maũndũ na marakara; ndikamaiguĩra tha kana ndĩmacaaĩre. O na mangĩkaanĩrĩra matũ-inĩ makwa, ndikamathikĩrĩria.”
english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩyo ndũmĩrĩri nditũ ĩkoniĩ bũrũri wa Arabia: Inyuĩ ikundi cia agendi a Adedani, o inyuĩ mwambĩte hema ithaka-inĩ cia Arabia-rĩ,
english: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

kikuyu: Nacio ndũrĩrĩ nĩikamenya atĩ andũ a Isiraeli maatahĩtwo nĩ ũndũ wa wĩhia wao, tondũ nĩmagire kũnjĩhoka. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩmahitha ũthiũ wakwa, ngĩmaneana kũrĩ thũ ciao, nao othe makĩũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

kikuyu: Kweheria mathangū makūrū nīgūteithagia kūnyihia mūrimū wa Sigatoka na gūtamba kūrī mathangū marīa manini kana mīmera ingī, kūrūta mīraba mīkūru nīgūteithagia kweheria kūrīa mboca cia marīgu cīngīhitha.
english: Removal of old leaves helps in management of the Sigatoka leaf spots, limiting its spread to young leaves and plants, while the removal of old sheaths eliminates hiding places for adult banana weevils.

kikuyu: Jehova akaamũcookia bũrũri wa Misiri na meeri, rũgendo rũrĩa ndoigire mũtikanarũthiĩ rĩngĩ. Mũrĩ kũu nĩkuo mũkeneana mũgũrwo nĩ thũ cianyu, mũrĩ ngombo cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja, no gũtirĩ mũndũ ũkaamũgũra.
english: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

kikuyu: Calcium yonekanaga kuuma mahīndī-inī na dicalcium phosphate, kana DCP.
english: Sources of calcium include bone meal and dicalcium phosphate.

kikuyu: Magĩthiĩ na mbere kũũrania atĩrĩ, “Arenda kuuga atĩa rĩrĩa aroiga atĩ, ‘Kahinda kanini’? Ithuĩ tũtiramenya ũrĩa aroiga.”
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

kikuyu: Mbeũ ingĩ nacio ikĩgũa tĩĩri-inĩ mũnoru. Igĩkũra, igĩciara maita igana ma iria ciahaandĩtwo. Aarĩkia kuuga ũguo, akĩanĩrĩra, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũrĩa ũrĩ na matũ ma kũigua, nĩaigue.”
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: Musa agĩĩta Mishaeli na Elizafani, ariũ a Uzieli, ithe mũnini wa Harũni, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ũkai haha, muoye ciimba cia ariũ a ithe wanyu, mũciumie nja ya kambĩ haraihu na itoonyero rĩa handũ-harĩa- haamũre.”
english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ũmwe wao onire nĩahonio, akĩhũndũka akĩgooca Ngai na mũgambo mũnene,
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

kikuyu: “Atanambĩrĩria kũrũmwo-rĩ, nĩaciarĩte: na ataanarũmwo nĩ ruo-rĩ, agagĩciara mwana wa kahĩĩ.
english: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

kikuyu: Gūcera kwa ngari na andū thīinī wa mūgūnda wa natharī gūbatiī kūnyihanyihio.
english: - Movement of vehicles and personnel through the nursery should be limited

kikuyu: Gooca Jehova, wee ngoro yakwa; kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wakwa, gooca rĩĩtwa rĩake itheru.
english: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

kikuyu: Nake agĩkĩrĩrĩria kũhooya, arĩ na ruo rũnene ngoro-inĩ, nayo thithino yake yahaanaga ta matata manene ma thakame magĩtaata thĩ.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

kikuyu: gũcumĩkĩra na kũrĩĩo nĩ njoohi, na maruga marĩa mainagwo nyĩmbo iria itaagĩrĩire, o na maũndũ mangĩ ta macio. Nĩndamũkaanirie, o ta ũrĩa ndamũkaanirie hĩndĩ ya mbere, atĩ andũ arĩa mekaga maũndũ ta macio matikagaya ũthamaki wa Ngai.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa athingu nĩmagakena maarĩhĩrio, rĩrĩa magathambia nyarĩrĩ ciao thakame-inĩ ya arĩa aaganu.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

kikuyu: Thikagĩrĩria thoguo, we ũrĩa wagũciarire, na ndũkanyarare maitũguo, o na aakorwo nĩ mũkũrũ.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

kikuyu: Ririkanai ũũ: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũhaandaga tũnini akaagetha o tũnini, nake ũrĩa ũhaandaga nyingĩ akaagetha nyingĩ.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, ũndũ ũrĩa wĩtĩkĩtie ũkoniĩ maũndũ macio-rĩ, nĩũmenyeke gatagatĩ gaku na Ngai. Kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũtarĩ ũndũ angĩĩcuukĩra nĩ ũndũ wa kĩndũ kĩrĩa onaga kĩrĩ kĩega agĩĩka.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

kikuyu: ndĩkoina kamũrangi kagondoku, kana ĩhorie rũtambĩ rũrĩa rũgũtooga, nginya rĩrĩa ĩgaatũma itua rĩakwa rĩhootane.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

kikuyu: Ũtonga na gĩtĩĩo ciumaga kũrĩ we; Wee nĩwe wathaga indo ciothe. Hinya na ũhoti wa gũtũũgĩria o na kũhe andũ othe hinya irĩ moko-inĩ maku.
english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

kikuyu: na nguo ndaihu iria njega, na ngũbia, na tũbuti, na nguo cia igũrũ, na tũmondo,
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe ũngĩkoma kana arĩĩre irio nyũmba ĩyo, no nginya athambie nguo ciake.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo o ta ũrĩa andũ othe makuaga nĩ ũndũ wa Adamu-rĩ, no taguo andũ othe magaacookio muoyo thĩinĩ wa Kristũ.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

kikuyu: Njathĩkagĩra kĩrĩra gĩaku, nĩgũkorwo nĩndĩkĩendete mũno.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa ũraruta iruta rĩa njino rĩa mũndũ o wothe we no arigie na rũũa.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, ũngĩkahutatĩra na ũtiganĩrie kĩrĩra kĩa watho wakwa wa kũrũmĩrĩrwo, na maathani marĩa ngũheete, na ũthiĩ gũtungatĩra ngai ingĩ na gũcihooya-rĩ,
english: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

kikuyu: Gĩa na ũũgĩ, gĩa na kũmenya maũndũ; ndũkanariganĩrwo nĩ ciugo ciakwa, kana wahũke kuuma harĩ cio.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩo ndũmĩrĩri ĩrĩa Jeremia aaheire Seraia mũrũ wa Neria, mũrũ wa Maaseia, o ũcio warĩ mũnene ũrĩa mũrori wa maũndũ ma nyũmba ya mũthamaki, rĩrĩa aathiire Babuloni marĩ na Zedekia mũthamaki wa Juda mwaka-inĩ wa ĩna wa ũthamaki wake.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

kikuyu: Mĩromo ya arĩa athingu ĩhũnagia andũ aingĩ, no andũ akĩĩgu makuaga nĩ kwaga gũkũũrana maũndũ.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

kikuyu: We no ruo rwa mwĩrĩ wake aiguaga, nake atũũraga o ecaayagĩra.”
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

kikuyu: Ũtheri nĩ mwega, namo maitho nĩmakenagĩra kuona riũa.
english: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.

kikuyu: Ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, ‘Mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ angĩkaaruma Ngai wake, no nginya agaacookererwo nĩ ũũru ũcio ekĩte:
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

kikuyu: Thenge ĩyo nĩĩgakuuithio mehia mao mothe, ĩmatware kũndũ kũrĩa gũtatũũragwo nĩ Andũ; nake mũndũ ũcio nĩakarekereria thenge ĩyo na kũu werũ-inĩ.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthenya ũmwe Jesũ arũngiĩ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria rĩa Genesareti, nakĩo kĩrĩndĩ kĩa andũ aingĩ nĩkĩahatĩkanaga kĩmũkuhĩrĩrie nĩguo gĩthikĩrĩrie ũhoro wa Ngai,
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: Gūtwara ng'ombe kūri ndūme, kūhe mūbira wa AI, kana kūhe mūbira wa embryo
english: Natural mating, artificial insemination (AI), or embryo transfer

kikuyu: Nao arutani a watho arĩa maikũrũkĩte kuuma Jerusalemu makiuga atĩrĩ, “Aiyũrĩtwo nĩ Beelize- buli! Araingata ndaimono na hinya wa mũnene wa ndaimono.”
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa ĩnana wakinya, Musa agĩĩta Harũni na ariũ ake, na athuuri a Isiraeli.
english: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

kikuyu: “Kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ arĩa athĩĩni ngoro, nĩgũkorwo ũthamaki wa igũrũ nĩ wao.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.*

kikuyu: nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngũcookanĩrĩria endwa aku othe arĩa wanekenia nao, arĩa wendete o na arĩa ũthũire. Nĩngũmacookanĩrĩria magũũkĩrĩre kuuma mĩena yothe, na niĩ ngũguũrie nguo mbere yao, nao mone njaga yaku yothe.
english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

kikuyu: Potassium īngīnyīha harī mūmera nīgiragīrīria mboga gūkūmba wega na īngīingīha no yatūke
english: Potassium (K) deficiency can result in marginal necrosis and lower head quality, but its excess can cause the heads to open.

kikuyu: Mūmera ūyū nī wa mīthemba mīingī īrūgīte na igūrū (mīigana ītarī na ūraihu wa mita īmwe) wī na mīri mīrūmu na mathangū ma rangi wa riūa, manini na ma gatagatī.
english: The plant is a semi-erect tall variety (slightly below 1 meter in height) with strong stems and light green, small to medium sized leaves.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akiuma agacarie Ahazia, nao andũ a Jehu makĩnyiita Ahazia rĩrĩa eehithĩte Samaria. Akĩrehwo kũrĩ Jehu na akĩũragwo. Nao makĩmũthika nĩgũkorwo moigire atĩrĩ, “Aarĩ ũmwe wa ariũ a Jehoshafatu, ũrĩa warongoragia Jehova na ngoro yake yothe.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gũkĩaga mũndũ thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Ahazia warĩ na ũhoti mũiganu wa kũrũgamĩrĩra ũthamaki ũcio.
english: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahweh with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũyũ nĩwathiire na mbere ihinda ta rĩa mĩaka ĩĩrĩ, o nginya Ayahudi na Ayunani othe arĩa maatũũraga bũrũri wa Asia makĩigua kiugo kĩa Mwathani.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

kikuyu: Njamuthi mūthemba wa virus īrīa īrehaga mūrimū ūyū nī irī hinya kweheria ciarīkia kūnyita rūūru rwa ngūkū.
english: The virus causing this disease is stable in the environment and particularly difficult to eradicate once it infects a flock.

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘Angĩkorwo ndiigĩte kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa na mũthenya na ũtukũ, o na mawatho marĩa marũmu ma igũrũ na thĩ-rĩ,
english: Yahweh says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,

kikuyu: Ūkinyanīria wa barabara;
english: Accessibility to the road;

kikuyu: “Niĩ-rĩ, ndaakĩhota atĩa kũmũkararia? Ingĩruta kũ ciugo cia kũmũcookeria?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

kikuyu: No Jehova akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Meere ũũ, ‘Tigai kwambata mũkarũe, tondũ ndigũkorwo hamwe na inyuĩ. Nĩmũgũtoorio nĩ thũ cianyu.’ ”
english: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’ ”

kikuyu: Na kũu bũrũri ũcio, nĩ kwarĩ arĩithi maikaraga mĩgũnda-inĩ, maikarĩtie mahiũ mao ũtukũ.*
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ĩra andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ: ‘Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, na nĩngamwaũra icooki rĩu mũigĩrĩirwonĩandũaMisiri. Nĩngamuohoramũtigegũcookagũtuĩkangombociao, nanĩngamũkũũra ndambũrũkĩtie guoko na ciĩko nene cia ũtuanĩri ciira.
english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

kikuyu: No ndĩ na ũbatithio ndĩrĩbatithio naguo, no kaĩ nĩngũthĩĩnĩka mũno ũngĩgaakinya-ĩ!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Jobabu aakuire, Hushamu wa kuuma bũrũri wa Atemani agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Nake akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Kanyũmba kau karorete mwena wa gũthini- rĩ, nĩ ka athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa maikaragia hekarũ,
english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

kikuyu: Solomoni agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Angĩona atĩ nĩ mũndũ wagĩrĩire, gũtirĩ rũcuĩrĩ rwake rwa mũtwe rũkaagũa thĩ; no angĩoneka na ũũru no agaakua.”
english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

kikuyu: Maithe manyu ma tene arĩa maikũrũkire magĩthiĩ bũrũri wa Misiri maarĩ andũ mĩrongo mũgwanja, na rĩu Jehova Ngai waku nĩakũingĩhĩtie o ta njata cia matu-inĩ.
english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ nĩwathĩrĩrio ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Ĩkai ũũ: Oyai makaari mamwe kuuma gũkũ Misiri nĩ ũndũ wa ciana na atumia anyu, mũgĩĩre ithe wanyu mũũke.
english: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

kikuyu: Ndeheragia maitho make harĩ arĩa athingu; amaikaragĩria gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene hamwe na athamaki, na akamatũũgĩria nginya tene.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jesũ akĩũria athĩnjĩrĩ-Ngai arĩa anene, na anene a arangĩri a hekarũ, o na athuuri, arĩa mookĩte kũmũnyiita atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ ndĩ mũtongoria wa akararia a watho, atĩ nĩkĩo muoka kũũnyiita mũrĩ na hiũ cia njora na njũgũma?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

kikuyu: nĩguo wega wake ũrĩa ũrĩ riiri ũkumagio, wega ũcio atũheete o ũguo tũhũ thĩinĩ wa Mũriũ wake ũrĩa endete mũno.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

kikuyu: Isaaka agĩthaitha Jehova nĩ ũndũ wa mũtumia wake tondũ aarĩ thaata. Nake Jehova akĩigua mahooya make, na Rebeka mũtumia wake akĩgĩa nda.
english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

kikuyu: Mũndũ atũrĩkagia irima thĩ kũraya na kũrĩa andũ matũũraga, agakinya kũndũ kũrĩa mũndũ aariganĩirwo nĩgũthiiaga; kũu kũraihanĩrĩirie na andũ nĩkuo acunjuuraga akĩereeraga.*
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Rakeli onire atĩ ndaraciarĩra Jakubu ciana-rĩ, akĩiguĩra mwarĩ wa nyina ũiru. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩĩra Jakubu atĩrĩ, “He ciana kana ngue!”
english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

kikuyu: Ndĩ na kĩeha mũno tondũ gũkuoneka atĩ wĩra ũrĩa wothe ndanenogia naguo nĩ ũndũ wanyu nĩ wa tũhũ!
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

kikuyu: Nao atũmwo makiuma Kĩama-inĩ makenete tondũ wa ũrĩa maatuĩtwo aagĩrĩru a gũconorithio nĩ ũndũ wa Rĩĩtwa rĩu.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, guoko kwa Jehova nĩ kwagĩire igũrũ rĩakwa, ngĩoywo nĩ Roho wa Jehova akĩndwara handũ gĩtuamba-inĩ gatagatĩ; nakĩo kĩaiyũrĩte mahĩndĩ.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

kikuyu: We aatũũrĩte na Ngai kuuma o kĩambĩrĩria.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

kikuyu: na gategwa kamwe, na ndũrũme ĩmwe, na gatũrũme kamwe ka mwaka ũmwe, Nĩ ũndũ wa iruta rĩa njino;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: Tũma ũtheri waku na ũhoro waku wa ma, ũreke indongorie arĩ cio; reke inginyie kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩaku kĩrĩa kĩamũre, o kũu gĩikaro-inĩ gĩaku.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ andũ arĩa mũtũũraga mabũrũri mothe ma thĩ, o inyuĩ mũtũũraga gũkũ thĩ-rĩ, rĩrĩa bendera ĩkaahaandwo irĩma-igũrũ, nĩmũkamĩona, na rĩrĩa karumbeta gakaahuhwo, nĩmũgakaigua.
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

kikuyu: “Wenda gwĩtana, ĩtana, no rĩrĩ, nũũ ũngĩgwĩtĩka? Nĩ ũrĩkũ wa arĩa atheru ũngĩũrĩra kũrĩ we?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

kikuyu: Harũni na ariũ ake marĩĩthambaga moko mao na nyarĩrĩ na maaĩ macio.
english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

kikuyu: Oya mahiga ma gĩthĩi, ũthĩe mũtu; eheria gĩtambaya gĩa kwĩhumbĩra ũthiũ. Heta nguo ciaku na ũguũrie magũrũ maku, ũtoboke maaĩ-inĩ ũringe tũrũũĩ.
english: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.

kikuyu: Maciaro ma ũthingu ũcio nĩ thayũ; naguo uumithio wa ũthingu ũgaakorwo ũrĩ ũhooreri na kwĩhoka Ngai nginya tene.
english: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

kikuyu: nake angĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Nyua na nĩngũtahĩra ngamĩĩra ciaku o nacio,” nĩagĩtuĩke nĩwe mũndũ-wa-nja ũrĩa Jehova athuurĩire mũriũ wa mwathi wakwa.’
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

kikuyu: Aragania njĩra iria magũrũ maku marĩthiiagĩra, na ũthiiagĩre o njĩra iria ngiindĩrĩku.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa ũguo mũndũ ũcio akĩngereria itoonyero-inĩ rĩa mwena wa kĩhingo gĩa tũnyũmba tũu twamũre tũrĩa twarĩ twa athĩnjĩri-Ngai, tũrĩa twarorete mwena wa gathigathini, na akĩnyonia handũ haarĩ mũthia-inĩ wa mwena wa ithũĩro.
english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

kikuyu: Natharī ya mīkorobia ībatiī gūthondekwo atīa?
english: How should a nursery be established?

kikuyu: Rĩu-rĩ, nĩumagarĩte nĩ ũndũ nĩũrerirĩria gũcooka nyũmba-inĩ ya thoguo. No rĩrĩ, ũrakĩiyire ngai ciakwa nĩkĩ?”
english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

kikuyu: Tigīrīra niwahe mīmera īrio irīa ībatiī nigūo gūkūra wega
english: Ensure proper crop nutrition

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩngũcanjamũka na ngenage nĩ ũndũ wa wendo waku, nĩgũkorwo nĩwonire mĩnyamaro yakwa, na ũkĩmenya ruo rũnene rwa ngoro yakwa.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

kikuyu: No Jehova akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ndũngĩona ũthiũ wakwa, nĩgũkorwo gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩona ũthiũ wakwa na acooke atũũre muoyo.”
english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

kikuyu: “Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘Mũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũgũikara itũũra-inĩ rĩĩrĩ inene nĩakooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora, kana ngʼaragu, kana mũthiro, no ũrĩa ũgwĩtwara kũrĩ andũ a Babuloni nĩagatũũra muoyo. Nĩakahonokia muoyo wake; nĩagatũũra muoyo.’
english: “Yahweh says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’

kikuyu: Nĩ kwagĩire na ngarari gatagatĩ-inĩ ka arutwo amwe a Johana na Mũyahudi ũmwe ũhoro-inĩ wa mĩtugo yao ya gwĩtheria.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

kikuyu: ūngīhota atīa kūgirīrīria mūrimū wa Fusarium Bark?
english: How to control Fusarium Bark Disease?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩthĩnja ndegwa icio, nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai makĩoya thakame yacio makĩmĩminjaminjĩria kĩgongona; magĩcooka magĩthĩnja ndũrũme icio na makĩminjaminjĩria kĩgongona thakame yacio; magĩcooka magĩthĩnja tũtũrũme tũu na makĩminjaminjĩria kĩgongona thakame yatuo.
english: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

kikuyu: Andũ amwe makiuga atĩ aarĩ we. Nao arĩa angĩ makiuga atĩrĩ, “Aca, no kũhaana amũhaana.” Nowe agĩkĩrĩrĩria kuuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩ niĩ mũndũ ũcio.”
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

kikuyu: Hakĩrĩ ũguo-rĩ, tũkiuge atĩa? Nĩ tũtũũre o twĩhagia nĩgeetha wega wa Ngai ũingĩhage?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

kikuyu: Kwambĩrĩria haaro nĩ ta kũhingũrĩra maaĩ mahingĩrĩrie; nĩ ũndũ ũcio tiganaga na ũhoro ũcio ngarari itaanagĩa.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

kikuyu: Ada agĩciarĩra Esaũ Elifazu, na Basemathu agĩciara Reueli,
english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

kikuyu: Na o rĩngĩ andũ arĩa ahooreri nĩmagakenera Jehova; nao andũ arĩa athĩĩni nĩmagakenera Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli.
english: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Githĩ ndikwandĩkĩire thimo mĩrongo ĩtatũ, thimo cia ũtaarani na ũmenyo,
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

kikuyu: Ngoro ya mũndũ mũũgĩ nĩyo ĩtongoragia kanua gake, nayo mĩromo yake ĩtũũgagĩria ũtaaro.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ ũtarĩ na thaahu nĩoe mũthobi aũtobokie maaĩ-inĩ macio, na aminjaminjĩrie hema ĩyo na indo ciayo ciothe, na andũ arĩa maarĩ kũu thĩinĩ. Ningĩ no nginya aminjaminjĩrie mũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũhutĩtie ihĩndĩ rĩa mũndũ, kana mbĩrĩra, kana mũndũ ũragĩtwo, kana mũndũ ũkuĩte gĩkuũ kĩa ndũire.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra mũingĩ wothe wa andũ a Isiraeli atĩrĩ, “Ũũ nĩguo Jehova aathanĩte:
english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,

kikuyu: Nĩngaragania ciimba cia andũ a Isiraeli hau mbere ya mĩhianano ĩyo yao, na nĩngahurunja mahĩndĩ manyu gũthiũrũrũkĩria igongona cianyu.
english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

kikuyu: Thīinī wa matunda, nīkūrī tūindo tūītagwo enzymes.
english: Trapped inside the tissue of fruits are molecules known as enzymes.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ũhoro ũrĩkũ ũcio mũrathiĩ mũkĩaragia?” Nao makĩrũgama matukĩte mothiũ.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: Mwĩmenyererei mũtikanakuue mũrigo mũthenya wa Thabatũ, kana mũũtoonyerie ihingo-inĩ cia Jerusalemu.
english: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mūtararīko wa waru ya Asante ūciaraga kilo 14,000-18,000 harī acre īmwe.
english: The Asante potato variety yields 14,000-18,000 kg per īka.

kikuyu: Mahĩtũkaga na ihenya mũno ta tũtarũ twa irura,* kana ta nderi igũcuuhũkĩra kĩndũ gĩa kũrĩa.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, rĩrĩa mũthamaki Mũkaanani wa Aradi, ũrĩa watũũraga Negevu, aiguire atĩ Isiraeli nĩokagĩra njĩra ya Atharimu, agĩthiĩ agĩtharĩkĩra andũ a Isiraeli, na agĩtaha amwe ao.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

kikuyu: Nahashoni nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Salimoni, nake Salimoni aarĩ ithe wa Boazu,
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

kikuyu: Ukihada mīūngūrwa rī, nī ubatīe ūthūre njīra ya kuhada, no uhande na njira ya mathadūkū kana kūnyagia.
english: When planting seedlings a choice can be made between the square method and the staggered method of planting.

kikuyu: Nake Judasi aarĩkia kwamũkĩra mũgate ũcio, akiuma nja. Na kwarĩ ũtukũ.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

kikuyu: Ngũkaĩra Ngai-Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno, o kũrĩ Mũrungu, ũrĩa ũũhingagĩria maũndũ.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, harĩ nyamũ iria ĩcookagia ithagumia kana irĩ mahũngũ maatũku marekanĩtie biũ, mũtikanarĩe ngamĩĩra, kana mbũkũ, kana ikami. O na gũtuĩka nĩicookagia ithagumia, mahũngũ ma cio ti maatũku, icio irĩ thaahu harĩ inyuĩ.
english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

kikuyu: No niĩ ngĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩmũkegwatĩra bũrũri wao; nĩngamũhe guo ũtuĩke igai rĩanyu, bũrũri ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ.” Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu, ũrĩa wamwamũrire kuuma kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ arĩa mũrageria gũtuĩka athingu nĩ ũndũ wa watho-rĩ, nĩmũtigithanĩtio na Kristũ; inyuĩ nĩmũgwĩte mũgatigana na wega wa Ngai.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

kikuyu: Ningĩ o itũũra-inĩ rĩothe rĩa Juda agĩaka kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru gwa kũrutĩra ngai ingĩ magongona ma njino, nake agĩthirĩkia Jehova, Ngai wa maithe make, agĩtũma arakare.
english: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Javani maarĩ: Elisha, na Tarishishi, na Kitimu, na Rodanimu.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Balaki aiguire atĩ Balamu nĩarooka, agĩthiĩ kũmũtũnga itũũra-inĩ rĩa Moabi, mũhaka-inĩ wa Arinoni, o kũu mũhaka wa bũrũri wake.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

kikuyu: “Nake Mwathani akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Thiĩ, tondũ nĩngũgũtũma kũndũ kũraya kwa andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ.’ ”
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

kikuyu: ūrigiti wa kūhoreria na kūgīrīrīria kūrwara rīngī nīkwabata harī ngūkū iria hūtie.
english: There is no cure for the disease but comfort therapy and preventive measures for secondary infections can be given to affected birds.

kikuyu: Nī mīmera īrīkū īngīhandwo mīembe-inī?
english: What are the best intercrops for mangoes?

english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

kikuyu: Ngai ũrĩa ũheanaga ũkirĩrĩria na ũũmanĩrĩria aromũhe roho wa ũiguano o mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ rĩrĩa mũkũrũmĩrĩra Kristũ Jesũ,
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Musa agĩcooka kũrĩ, Jehova akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte ũrehithĩrie andũ aya thĩĩna? Gĩkĩ nĩkĩo gĩatũmire ũndũme?
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

kikuyu: Wee hinga ĩno, amba ũrute mũgogo ũcio ũrĩ riitho rĩaku, nĩguo wone wega na ũhote kũruta kĩhuti kĩrĩa kĩrĩ riitho rĩa mũrũ wa thoguo.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: Mūthemba wa maembe wa maya ūkorago na mūtugo ūrīkū?
english: What are the characteristics of maya mango fruit variety?

kikuyu: Ningĩ riiri wa Jehova ũkĩehera hau igũrũ rĩa hingĩro ya hekarũ na ũkĩrũgama igũrũ rĩa akerubi acio.
english: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma mathũũrwo mũno, matuĩke kĩndũ gĩa gũthirĩkia mothamaki mothe ma gũkũ thĩ, na mameneke na matuĩke a kuunagwo thimo, na matũũre mathekagĩrĩrwo na manyiitagwo nĩ kĩrumi kũrĩa guothe ngaamathaamĩria.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

kikuyu: Nĩndĩcũũranĩtie ũhoro wa mĩthiĩre yakwa, ngagĩcookia makinya makwa kũrĩ kĩrĩra gĩaku.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Gadi maarĩ: Zifioni, na Hagi, na Shuni, na Eziboni, na Eri, na Arodi, na Areli.
english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, nĩwe ndĩrakaĩra, Wee Rwaro rwakwa rwa Ihiga; ndũkarege gũũthikĩrĩria. Nĩgũkorwo ũngĩngirĩra, ingĩhaana ta arĩa maikũrũkĩte magatoonya irima.
english: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Warĩkia gũthoma ibuku rĩu rĩa gĩkũnjo-rĩ, ũrĩoherere ihiga, ũrĩikie Rũũĩ rwa Farati.
english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

kikuyu: ũrĩa wamũrũmĩrĩire nĩ Jehohanani, na aarĩ na thigari 280,000;
english: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

kikuyu: ‘Baba nĩatũmire ndĩĩhĩte na mwĩhĩtwa, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ndĩ hakuhĩ gũkua; na ndakua ũgaathika mbĩrĩra-inĩ ĩrĩa niĩ mwene ndeyenjeire bũrũri-inĩ wa Kaanani.” Rĩu rekei nyambate thiĩ ngathike baba; na nĩngũcooka hũndũke.’ ”
english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’ ”

kikuyu: mũkĩhũthagĩra mweke o wothe mũrĩ naguo tondũ matukũ maya nĩ mooru.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

english: Kitovu mango is a local mango variety commonly grown in Uganda and Tanzania.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũu thĩinĩ wa mbĩrĩra, atongoriaarĩamarĩhinyanĩmakaaragiaũhoroũkoniĩbũrũriwaMisirinaarĩamarĩngwatanĩronaguo, moige atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩmaikũrũkĩtio, na makometio hamwe na arĩa mataruĩte, o hamwe na arĩa maanooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.’
english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol† with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngamunya Isiraeli kuuma bũrũri wakwa, ũrĩa ndĩmaheete, na ndiganĩrie hekarũ ĩno nyamũrĩte ĩtanio na Rĩĩtwa rĩakwa. Ngaamĩtua o kĩndũ gĩa kuunagwo thimo na gĩa gũthekererwo nĩ andũ othe.
english: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

kikuyu: Tukiko, mũrũ wa Ithe witũ ũrĩa mwende na ndungata ĩĩhokekete wĩra-inĩ wa Mwathani, nĩwe ũkũmwĩra maũndũ mothe, nĩgeetha o na inyuĩ mũmenye ũrĩa ndariĩ na ũrĩa njĩkaga.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

kikuyu: (Nĩmonete Tirofimo ũrĩa Mũefeso marĩ na Paũlũ kũu itũũra-inĩ, no magĩĩciiria atĩ Paũlũ nĩamũtoonyetie hekarũ-inĩ.)
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ mũrũũthi ũgaakorwo njĩra-inĩ ĩyo, o na kana nyamũ o yothe ndĩani ĩmĩgerere; nyamũ icio itikoonekana njĩra-inĩ ĩyo. No rĩrĩ, andũ arĩa makũũrĩtwo nĩo oiki makaamĩgerera,
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

kikuyu: Marigithathi mothe, marĩ ma andũ kana ma nyamũ, marĩa marĩrutagĩrwo Jehova nĩ maku. No rĩrĩ, no nginya ũkũũrithagie irigithathi rĩothe rĩa kahĩĩ, na ũkũũrithagie irigithathi rĩa njamba rĩa nyamũ iria irĩ thaahu.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

kikuyu: Wee, na andũ aya marooka kũrĩ we nĩmũkwĩnogia na mĩnoga. Wĩra ũyũ nĩ mũritũ mũno makĩria harĩwe; ndũngĩũhota ũrĩ wiki.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

kikuyu: Ningĩ agĩthima ũraihu wa handũ-harĩa-haamũre kũu thĩinĩ; naho haarĩ ha mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ, naguo wariĩ waho warĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ gũtuĩkania nginya mũthia wa nja ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre. Nake akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Haha nĩho Handũ- harĩa-Hatheru-Mũno.”
english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Rĩrĩa mũgaatoonya bũrũri ũcio wa Kaanani, na mũhaande mĩtĩ ya mĩthemba yothe ĩciaraga maciaro-rĩ, nĩ mũgaatua atĩ maciaro macio marĩ na thaahu. Ihinda rĩa mĩaka ĩtatũ nĩmũkamatua atĩ marĩ na thaahu, na matikanarĩĩo.
english: “ ‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden.‡ For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Tiga kwĩonaga ũrĩ mũũgĩ maitho-inĩ maku mwene; wĩtigĩre Jehova na ũtheemage maũndũ marĩa mooru.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

kikuyu: Harĩ nyamũ ciothe iria ithiiaga na magũrũ mana-rĩ, iria ikinyaga na ithu irĩ thaahu harĩ inyuĩ; mũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũkaahutia ciimba ciacio agaatinda arĩ na thaahu o nginya hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Isaaka eendete Esaũ tondũ nĩ eendete nyama cia ũguĩmi, no Rebeka eendete Jakubu.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akiuma kũu, agĩthiĩ Birishiba.
english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

kikuyu: Matukũ-inĩ macio Hezekia akĩrwara, hakuhĩ akue. Mũnabii Isaia mũrũ wa Amozu agĩthiĩ kũrĩ we, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Thondeka maũndũ ma mũciĩ waku, tondũ nĩũgũkua, ndũkũhona.”
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’ ”

kikuyu: Kanua gakwa karĩganaga ũthingu waku, ndindage o ngĩgana ũhonokio waku mũthenya wothe, o na gũtuĩka ndiũĩ mũigana waguo.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

english: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

english: Antibiotic dry cow therapy used according to label specifications

english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: ũtharia waku o na mĩĩto ĩrĩa wanagĩria, o na ũmaraya waku ũrĩa ũtarĩ thoni! Nĩndĩĩoneire ciĩko ciaku cia ũũra-thoni kũu tũrĩma-inĩ na mĩgũnda-inĩ. Kaĩ ũrĩ na haaro, wee Jerusalemu-ĩ! Ũgũtũũra wĩthaahĩtie nginya-rĩ?” 14
english: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?” 14

english: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Nĩ niĩ Paũlũ, mũtũmwo wa Kristũ Jesũ nĩ ũndũ wa kwenda kwa Ngai, tũrĩ na Timotheo mũrũ wa Ithe witũ, Twatũma marũa maya kũrĩ kanitha wa Ngai ũrĩa ũrĩ Korinitho, o hamwe na andũ othe aamũre arĩa marĩ Akaia guothe:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ† Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
