english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Joeli ciarĩ: Mũriũ Shemaia, na mũriũ Gogu, na mũriũ Shimei,
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

kikuyu: Nĩhookire andũ, makĩmũrehera mũndũ warũarĩte mũrimũ wa gũkua ciĩga, akuuĩtwo nĩ andũ ana.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

kikuyu: Ndĩ hakuhĩ gwĩta andũ othe a mothamaki ma gathigathini,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. “Athamaki ao nĩmagooka mahaande itĩ ciao cia ũthamaki matoonyero-inĩ ma ihingo cia Jerusalemu; nĩmagooka mathiũrũrũkĩrie thingo ciothe cia Jerusalemu, na mokĩrĩre matũũra mothe ma Juda.
english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

kikuyu: Ngūkū cia gīcenji iria njiarithanie no ihūthīke gūthondeka ngūkū cia gīcenji itarī njiarithanie
english: Improved indigenous chickens can be used to improve indigenous chickens (kienyeji)

kikuyu: Mĩhũmũ ya Mũrungu nĩĩthondekaga mbarabu, namo maaĩ harĩa maaramĩire makanyiitana.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Tũtingĩĩka ũguo o nginya ndũũru ciothe icookanĩrĩrio, narĩo ihiga rĩgaragario kuuma mũromo wa gĩthima, tũcooke tũhe ngʼondu maaĩ.”
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

kikuyu: Kwarīra gūtiongagīrīra maaī tīīri-inī no nīkūgītīra marīa marī tīīri-inī matikore rīera-inī
english: Mulching does not add water to the soils but only conserves water which is already there by reducing the rate at which the soil loses water to the atmosphere.

kikuyu: acooke aũtwarĩre ariũ a Harũni acio athĩnjĩri-Ngai. Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakarũma ngundi ya mũtu ũcio mũhinyu mũno ũrĩ na maguta hamwe na ũbani ũcio wothe, na aũcinĩre igũrũ rĩa kĩgongona ũtuĩke gĩcunjĩ gĩa kĩririkano, ũrĩ iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki, rĩrĩ na mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ wa ũguo mwĩrĩ wakwa nĩũiyũrĩtwo nĩ ruo, ruo rũnene nĩrũũnyiitĩte, o ta ruo rwa mũtumia akĩrũmwo; ngagĩtururio nĩ maũndũ marĩa ndĩraigua, na ngagegeario nĩ maũndũ marĩa ndĩrona.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

kikuyu: Matiegwatĩire bũrũri ũcio na hinya wa rũhiũ rwao, o na ti icoka ciao ciamaheire ũhootani; no nĩ guoko gwaku kwa ũrĩo, ĩĩ nĩ gĩcoka gĩaku, na ũtheri wa gĩthiithi gĩaku, nĩgũkorwo nĩwamendete.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

kikuyu: Nītūtambi tūrīkū tūgūmagīra kabici?
english: What are the pests that attack cabbages at seedling stage?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa na Harũni magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Firaũni, nao magĩĩka o ta ũrĩa maathĩtwo nĩ Jehova. Harũni agĩikia rũthanju rwake thĩ mbere ya Firaũni na anene ake, naruo rũgĩtuĩka nyoka.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

kikuyu: Nĩndarũmbũyagia ũhoro wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa itheru, rĩrĩa rĩathaahirio nĩ nyũmba ya Isiraeli ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ kũrĩa maathiĩte.
english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

kikuyu: Ndungata ĩyo na andũ arĩa yarĩ nao makĩrĩa na makĩnyua, na makĩraara kũu ũtukũ ũcio. Na rĩrĩa mookĩrire mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ rũciinĩ tene, ĩkiuga atĩrĩ, “Rekei ndĩthiĩre kũrĩ mwathi wakwa.”
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

kikuyu: nake ũngĩ akaheo wĩtĩkio nĩ Roho o ro ũcio, na ũngĩ akaheo iheo cia kũhonania nĩ Roho o ro ũcio,
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

kikuyu: Mũtumia ũcio, matukũ mothe ma muoyo wake, no maũndũ mega ekaga mũthuuriwe, na ndangĩmwĩka ũũru.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

kikuyu: We nĩwe Mũrungu ũrĩa ũndĩhagĩria, agatooria ndũrĩrĩ, agaciiga rungu rwakwa,
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

kikuyu: Solomoni aahumbĩrire hekarũ thĩinĩ na thahabu therie, na agĩkĩrania irengeeri cia thahabu mbere ya itoonyero rĩa hau thĩinĩ haamũre harĩa haagemetio na thahabu.
english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũndũ-wa-nja angĩĩtwarĩrĩra harĩ nyamũ nĩguo akome nayo-rĩ, nĩmũkooraga mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio hamwe na nyamũ ĩyo. No nginya mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio ooragwo na nyamũ ĩyo yũragwo; thakame yake nĩĩkamũcookerera, na thakame ya nyamũ ĩyo ĩmĩcookerere.
english: “ ‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

kikuyu: Kaĩ mũrĩ akĩĩgu atĩa? Mwambĩrĩirie na Roho wa Ngai, na rĩu mũrenda kũrĩkĩrĩria na hinya wa mwĩrĩ?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngagĩteanĩria njiaro cia Jakubu na cia Daudi ndungata yakwa, na njage gũthuura ũmwe wa aanake ake atuĩke wa gũthamakĩranjiarociaIburahĩmu, naciaIsaaka, naciaJakubu. Nĩgũkorwonĩngamacookeriaũgaacĩru wao na ndĩmaiguĩre tha.’ ” 34
english: then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to be rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed and will have mercy on them.” 34

kikuyu: Twenderiei irio cia kũrĩa na maaĩ ma kũnyua, tũrĩhe na betha. No rĩrĩ, ũtwĩtĩkĩrie tũtuĩkanĩrie kũu na magũrũ,
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩona njaũ ya ndigiri, akĩmĩikarĩra, o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

kikuyu: Akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, mũrutani wa watho o wothe ũrĩa ũrutĩtwo ũhoro wa ũthamaki wa igũrũ-rĩ, ahaanaine na mwene nyũmba ũrĩa ũrutaga mũthiithũ-inĩ wake indo iria njerũ o na iria ngũrũ.”
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

kikuyu: Ngaamarĩhia maita meerĩ nĩ ũndũ wa waganu wao na mehia mao, nĩ ũndũ nĩmathaahĩtie bũrũri wakwa na mĩhaano ĩtarĩ muoyo mĩmeneku mũno, na makaiyũria igai rĩakwa na mĩhianano ĩrĩ magigi.”
english: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, erekeria ũthiũ waku Kĩrĩma gĩa Seiru: kĩrathĩre ũhoro wa gũgĩũkĩrĩra,
english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

kikuyu: Nĩmenyete ũhoro wa gũikara ndĩ mũkĩaru, na ngamenya ũhoro wa gũikara ndĩ mũtongu. Nĩndĩrutĩte hitho ya gũikara njiganĩire ũndũ-inĩ o wothe na maũndũ-inĩ mothe, kana nĩ kũhũũna, kana nĩ kũhũũta, kana nĩ kũingĩhĩrwo, o na kana nĩ kwaga.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ kana mwarĩ wa thoguo angĩkũhĩtĩria-rĩ, thiĩ ũmuonie ihĩtia rĩake mũrĩ o inyuĩ eerĩ. Angĩgũthikĩrĩria-rĩ, nĩmwacookanwo nake.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma o magĩe na ũrũmwe wa ngoro o na mĩthiĩre-inĩ yao, nĩgeetha matũũre manjĩtigĩrĩte nĩgeetha matũũre moonaga wega o ene na ciana ciao iria igooka thuutha wao.
english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio ngiuga atĩ andũ arĩa akuũ, o acio marĩkĩtie gũkua, nĩmakenaga gũkĩra arĩa marĩ muoyo, o acio marĩ muoyo o na rĩu.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũthamaki nĩagakena nĩ ũndũ wa Ngai; andũ arĩa othe mehĩtaga makĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩa Ngai nĩmakamũgooca, natuo tũnua twa arĩa maaragia maheeni nĩtũgaakirio.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

kikuyu: nao Elihorefu na Ahija, ariũ a Shisha, nĩo maarĩ aandĩki-marũa; na Jehoshafatu mũrũ wa Ahiludu, ũrĩa waandĩkaga maũndũ ma ihinda rĩu;
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

kikuyu: Ta njĩĩrai, inyuĩ arĩa mũrenda gũkorwo mũgĩathwo nĩ watho-rĩ, kaĩ mũtooĩ ũrĩa watho uugaga?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

kikuyu: Jehova nĩwe mũnene, na nowe wagĩrĩire kũgoocwo mũno; ũnene wake gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩhota kũũtuĩria.
english: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Mũtino nĩũmũhũũtĩire; mwanangĩko wetereire agwe.
english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo gũtigacooka kũgĩa cioneki cia maheeni, kana ũragũri wa kũheenanĩrĩria gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ a Isiraeli.
english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Rĩciiria rĩu ngĩona rĩ-rĩega; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngĩthuura andũ ikũmi na eerĩ thĩinĩ wanyu, o mũhĩrĩga hakiuma mũndũ ũmwe.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

kikuyu: Mbeeca itarĩ cia wĩhokeku ithiiaga igĩthiraga, no ũrĩa ũcookanagĩrĩria mbeeca tũnini o tũnini nĩatũmaga ciongerereke.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

kikuyu: Musa arĩ kũu mwena wa irathĩro wa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani bũrũri-inĩ wa Moabi, nĩambĩrĩirie gũtaarĩria ũhoro wa watho ũyũ, akiuga atĩrĩ:
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

kikuyu: No ithuĩ-rĩ, tũrehokaga atĩ ũcio nĩwe ũgũkũũra andũ Isiraeli. Makĩria ma ũguo, rĩu nĩ mũthenya wa ĩtatũ kuuma maũndũ maya mothe mekĩka.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jehova ekuuga ũũ: “ ‘Arata a Misiri nĩmakooragwo, naguo hinya wake ũrĩa etĩĩaga naguo nĩũgaathira. Kuuma Migidoli o nginya Aswani, makooragĩrwo kuo thĩinĩ na rũhiũ rwa njora, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: “ ‘Yahweh says: “They also who uphold Egypt will fall. The pride of her power will come down. They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh,” says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: ĩkiuna thuuna ya gacũmbĩrĩ kau, na ĩkĩmĩtwara bũrũri wa onjoria, nayo ĩkĩmĩhaanda thĩinĩ wa itũũra inene rĩa onjoria.
english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

kikuyu: Cūbicles nī iteithagia kūhūthīra handū hanini na njīra njega.
english: Placing cubicles in buildings is an efficient use of space and bedding.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Iziharu: nĩ Shelomothu; na kuuma ariũ a Shelomothu: nĩ Jahathu.
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akiuma nja, akĩĩra andũ acio ũrĩa Jehova oigĩte. Nake agĩcookanĩrĩria athuuri amwe ao mĩrongo mũgwanja, akĩmarũgamia marigiicĩirie Hema ĩyo.
english: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

kikuyu: Nake Ngai agĩathana, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Maaĩ marĩa marĩ thĩ ya matu mairũ nĩ mongane handũ hamwe na kũgĩe thĩ nyũmũ.” Na gũgĩtuĩka o ũguo.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ndikamaingata o mwaka ũmwe, tondũ bũrũri wahota gũcooka gĩthaka, nacio nyamũ cia gĩthaka imũingĩhĩre mũno.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Mũthamaki Asa akĩruta watho kũu Juda guothe, gũtirĩ mũndũ watigĩrĩirwo, nao magĩkuua mahiga na mbaũ iria Baasha aahũthagĩra Rama. Indo icio nĩcio Mũthamaki Asa aakire nacio Geba kũu Benjamini, o na agĩaka kũu Mizipa.
english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

kikuyu: Nake aarĩ hamwe na Daudi kũu Pasi-Damimu hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Afilisti moonganĩte marũe nao. Maarĩ handũ haarĩ mũgũnda waiyũire cairi, nacio thigari ikĩũrĩra Afilisti.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ agĩaka makũmbĩ ma kũiga ngano yagethwo, na ma kũiga ndibei ya mũhihano, na maguta; na agĩaka ciugũ nĩ ũndũ wa ngʼombe na ndũũru cia ngʼondu.
english: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo nĩagatuĩka mũndũ mũnene maitho-inĩ ma Mwathani. Ndarĩ hĩndĩ akaanyua ndibei o na kana kĩndũ o kĩngĩ kĩgagatu kĩngĩtũma mũndũ arĩĩo, na nĩakaiyũrwo nĩ Roho Mũtheru kuuma o gũciarwo gwake.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe Mũisiraeli ũrĩĩrutaga igongona rĩa ndegwa, kana rĩa gatũrũme, kana rĩa mbũri thĩinĩ wa kambĩ kana nja ya kambĩ,
english: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo athĩnjĩri-Ngai na anabii makĩĩra anene acio na andũ othe atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũyũ agĩrĩire atuĩrwo kũũragwo, tondũ nĩarathĩte maũndũ mooru makoniĩ itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene. Nĩmũmeiguĩrĩire na matũ manyu!”
english: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”

kikuyu: Jezebeli aarĩkia kũigua atĩ Nabothu nĩahũrĩtwo na mahiga nyuguto agakua-rĩ, akĩĩra Ahabu atĩrĩ “Ũkĩra wĩgwatĩre mũgũnda wa mĩthabibũ wa Nabothu ũrĩa Mũjezireeli ũcio araregete gũkwenderia. Ndarĩ muoyo, nĩakuĩte.”
english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

kikuyu: Ingīhota atīa gūtungata natharī ya kahūa?
english: How do I raise coffee nursery?

kikuyu: No Ngai akĩmahutatĩra, na akĩmarekereria mahooyage ciũmbe cia igũrũ. Ũhoro ũyũ ũtwaranĩte na ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa anabii, atĩrĩ: “ ‘Nĩmwandutĩire magongona na maruta mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna kũu werũ-inĩ, inyuĩ nyũmba ya Isiraeli?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky,§ as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

kikuyu: Eherai njĩra-inĩ ĩno, muume gacĩra-inĩ gaka, na mũtige gũtwĩra ũhoro wa Ũrĩa Mũtheru wa Isiraeli!”
english: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

kikuyu: Nĩngũrĩra na ngirĩke nĩ ũndũ wa irĩma, o na njakaye nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩithio wa werũ. Nĩgũkirĩte ihooru na gũkaaga mũndũ ũngĩtuĩkanĩria kuo, na mwanio wa ngʼombe ndũraiguĩka kuo. Nyoni cia rĩera-inĩ na nyamũ cia gĩthaka nĩciũrĩte, igeethiĩra.
english: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can’t hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone.

kikuyu: “Mbere ya gũkũũmba nda-inĩ ya maitũguo-rĩ, no ndaakũũĩ, o na ũtanaciarwo-rĩ, nĩndakwamũrĩte; nĩndagũtuire mũnabii wa kũrathagĩra ndũrĩrĩ.”
english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

kikuyu: Nake Solomoni nĩaheaga Hiramu ngano ya kũrĩĩo gwake mũciĩ ya kori ngiri mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ,* hamwe na mbathi ngiri mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ† cia maguta ma mĩtamaiyũ mahihe wega. Solomoni agĩthiĩ na mbere gwĩka Hiramu ũguo mwaka o mwaka.
english: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors† of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors‡ of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

kikuyu: Ningĩ gũkĩra maũndũ macio mothe mega- rĩ, gĩai na wendani, tondũ nĩguo wohanagia maũndũ mothe hamwe nĩguo magĩrĩre kũna.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

kikuyu: Ūcoke ūhande thīinī wa tūnyūngū na ūige tīīri na ūgūnyu mūnini.
english: Then, plant the cutting in a small pot of soilless potting mix, and keep the soil slightly moist.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Paũlũ agĩkinya Deribe agĩcooka akiuma kuo agĩthiĩ Lisitera, kũrĩa mũrutwo wetagwo Timotheo aatũũraga, ũrĩa nyina aarĩ Mũyahudi mũtumia wetĩkĩtie Ngai, no ithe aarĩ Mũyunani.
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

kikuyu: Nĩ icookio rĩrĩkũ rĩkaaheanwo kũrĩ andũ arĩa matũmĩtwo a rũrĩrĩ rũu? Magaacookerio atĩrĩ, “Jehova nĩahaandĩte Zayuni, na thĩinĩ wakuo andũ ake arĩa anyamaarĩku nĩmakona rĩũrĩro.”
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

kikuyu: “Anene othe a gathigathini, na andũ othe a Sidoni marĩ kũu; maaharũrũkirio hamwe na arĩa maanooragwo maconokete, o na kwarĩ na kũguoyohania kwarehetwo nĩ ũhoti wao. Makometio matarĩ aruu, marĩ hamwe na arĩa maanooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora, na maikaraga maconokete marĩ hamwe na arĩa maharũrũkagio irima.
english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

kikuyu: Nĩaririkanaga kĩrĩkanĩro gĩake nginya tene, nĩkĩo kiugo kĩrĩa aathanire, kĩrũmagĩrĩrwo nĩ njiarwa ngiri,
english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: Makĩhĩtũka arangĩri a mbere na a keerĩ na magĩkinya kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa kĩgera kĩrĩa gĩa gũtoonya itũũra inene. Nakĩo kĩhingo kĩu gĩkĩĩhingũra nĩ ũndũ wao, nao makĩgerera ho. Rĩrĩa maathiire ũraihu wa gacĩra kamwe-rĩ, o rĩmwe mũraika ũcio akĩmũtiga.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

kikuyu: O na gũtuĩka mationire gĩtũmi kĩiganu gĩa gũtũma ooragwo, nĩmathaithire Pilato aathane ooragwo.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mbaara nĩyaneneheire Saũlũ mũno, na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aikia a mĩguĩ maamũkinyĩrire, makĩmũguraria.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Matiigana kũũria atĩrĩ: ‘Jehova arĩ ha, ũrĩa watũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri, agĩtũgereria werũ-inĩ ũtaarĩ kĩndũ, tũkĩgerera bũrũri warĩ wa werũ na iharũrũka, bũrũri ũtoiraga mbura, na warĩ nduma ta ya gĩkuũ, bũrũri ũtaageragĩrwo na ũtaatũũragwo nĩ mũndũ?’
english: They didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no one passed through, and where no man lived?’

kikuyu: Hihi ingītūrīkia njui nyingī hamwe atīa?
english: How to hatch many chicks at once?

kikuyu: “ ‘Ndũkanahikie mwarĩ wa nyina na mũtumia waku atuĩke mũiru wa mũtumia waku, ũkomage nake mũtumia waku arĩ muoyo.
english: “ ‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa gwatariĩ matukũ-inĩ ma Nuhu, noguo gũkahaana hĩndĩ ya gũũka kwa Mũrũ wa Mũndũ.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: “Kurusu, mũthamaki wa Perisia, oiga ũũ, “ ‘Jehova, Ngai wa igũrũ, nĩaheete mothamaki mothe ma thĩ, na nĩanyamũrĩte ndĩmwakĩre hekarũ kũu Jerusalemu bũrũri wa Juda. Mũndũ wake o na ũrĩkũ ũrĩ thĩinĩ wanyu, Jehova Ngai wake aroikara hamwe nake, rĩu no aambate athiĩ kuo.’ ”
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’ ”

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ũmũthĩ nĩngũkuohora mĩnyororo ĩno ũrĩ nayo moko. Ũka tũthiĩ nawe Babuloni, akorwo nĩũkwenda, na niĩ nĩndĩkũmenyagĩrĩra; no ũngĩkorwo ndũkwenda tũthiĩ nawe, tiga gũũka. Atĩrĩrĩ, bũrũri ũyũ wothe ũrĩ mbere yaku; thiĩ o harĩa hothe ũngĩenda.”
english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”

kikuyu: Nao metanaga makerana atĩrĩ: “Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe nĩwe mũtheru, ĩĩ nĩwe mũtheru, ti-itherũ nĩwe mũtheru; thĩ yothe ĩiyũrĩtwo nĩ riiri wake.”
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

kikuyu: O mahinda-inĩ macio Jeremia aarĩ muohe kũu nja-inĩ ya arangĩri, ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova nĩyamũkinyĩire riita rĩa keerĩ, akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova. Kaĩ nĩ ũndũ mwega kũgooca Ngai witũ na rwĩmbo-ĩ, kaĩ nĩ ũndũ mwega na mwagĩrĩru kũmũgooca-ĩ!
english: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio mũtugani na ũheanaga o ũguo tũhũ, o ũcio wĩkaga maũndũ make na kĩhooto-rĩ, nĩarĩonaga maũndũ mega.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo irĩma no ithingithio, natuo tũrĩma tweherio, no rĩrĩ, wendo wakwa ũrĩa ũtathiraga ũrĩa ngwendete naguo-rĩ, ndũkeenyenyio, o na kana kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa gĩa thayũ kĩeherio harĩwe,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ũrĩa ũkũiguagĩra tha ekuuga.
english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.

kikuyu: Indo ciothe iria Mũthamaki Solomoni aanyuuagĩra ciarĩ cia thahabu, na indo ciothe cia nyũmba iria ciarĩ Nyũmba ya Ũthamaki ĩrĩa yetagwo Mũtitũ wa Lebanoni ciarĩ cia thahabu therie. Gũtiarĩ kĩndũ gĩathondeketwo na betha, nĩgũkorwo betha yatuagwo kĩndũ gĩtarĩ bata mũno matukũ-inĩ macio ma Solomoni.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

kikuyu: Nake akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, mahĩndĩ maya nĩmo andũ a nyũmba yothe ya Isiraeli. Moigaga atĩrĩ, ‘Mahĩndĩ maitũ nĩmomũ, naguo mwĩhoko witũ nĩmũthiru; na ithuĩ nĩtũeheretio.’
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

kikuyu: Niĩ njũragĩra harĩ Jehova. Mwahota atĩa kũnjĩĩra atĩrĩ: “Ũmbũka ta nyoni ũũrĩre kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩaku.
english: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

kikuyu: Ndũgathikagĩrĩrie ũrĩa wothe andũ maraaria, tondũ wahota kũigua ndungata yaku ĩgĩkũruma:
english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa acidosis umanaga na irio kūgagata ūru thīinī wa nda ya ng'ombe ūgacungīrīria nda gūthondeka acidi kwa wūingī makīria iria ītūmaga pH īthiī thī wa githimo kia 5.5.
english: Acidosis is a syndrome related to a fermentative disorder of the rumen resulting in overproduction of acid, which lowers rumen pH below pH 5.5.

kikuyu: Norĩrĩ, kiugokĩaNgaigĩgĩkinyĩraShemaiamũndũwaNgaiakĩĩrwoatĩrĩ:
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

kikuyu: Mũndũ o wothe angĩona atĩ nĩarahĩtĩria mũirĩtu ũrĩa orĩtie, nake mũirĩtu ũcio akorwo matukũ make ma ũirĩtu wake nĩmarahĩtũka-rĩ, mũndũ ũcio angĩigua nĩagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũhikania-rĩ, nĩeke o ũguo ekwenda. Ti kwĩhia ekwĩhia. Nĩmagĩrĩirwo mahikanie.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

kikuyu: Ũguo noguo. No rĩrĩ, honge icio ciakahũrirwo tondũ wa kwaga gwĩtĩkia, nawe wĩhaandĩte nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia. Ndũkae gwĩtĩĩa, no wĩtigagĩre.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

kikuyu: No nĩngũũka kũrĩ inyuĩ narua, akorwo nĩ kwenda kwa Mwathani, na hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngatuĩria ũrĩa andũ aya etĩĩi maaragia, o hamwe na ũhoti ũrĩa marĩ naguo.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

kikuyu: Mwathani arotũma wendani wanyu wongerereke na ũiyũrĩrĩre harĩ o mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ, na harĩ andũ arĩa angĩ othe, o ta ũrĩa o na ithuĩ tũmwendete.
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

kikuyu: Mũinĩrei, mũmũinĩre mũkĩmũgoocaga; heanai ũhoro wa ciĩko ciake ciothe cia magegania.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Petero aamuonire-rĩ, akĩũria atĩrĩ, “Mwathani, nake mũndũ ũyũ ũhoro wake nĩ atĩa?”
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

kikuyu: Tondũ-rĩ, angĩkorwo kwĩhia kwa mũndũ ũmwe gwatũmire gĩkuũ gĩthamake nĩ ũndũ wa mũndũ ũcio ũmwe-rĩ, githĩ arĩa maamũkagĩra wega mũingĩ wa Ngai na kĩheo kĩu kĩa ũthingu matigũtũũra mathamakaga makĩria marĩ muoyo-inĩ nĩ ũndũ wa mũndũ ũmwe, o we Jesũ Kristũ!
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Nake Musa akĩruta watho, nao magĩtwara ũhoro ũcio kambĩ-inĩ guothe: “Gũtirĩ mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja ũgũcooka kũrehe iruta rĩngĩ nĩ ũndũ wa handũ-harĩa- haamũre.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ makĩrigĩrĩrio gũcooka kũrehe indo ingĩ,
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ngoro cia andũ aya itirĩ tha; matũ mao matingĩhota kũigua, na nĩmahingĩte maitho mao. Tondũ maahota kuona na maitho mao, na maigue na matũ mao, nacio ngoro ciao igĩe na ũmenyo, nao manjookerere, na niĩ ndĩmahonie.’
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’*

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo iheo iria Ngai aheanaga na gwĩtana kũrĩa etanaga nakuo ndacookaga kwĩricũkwo.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Acũhia ihengere igĩrĩ cia mahiga ihaana ta iria cia mbere, ũcooke wambate gũkũ kũrĩ niĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ. Na ũcooke ũthondeke ithandũkũ rĩa mbaũ.
english: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩcookeria arĩa maatũmĩtwo atĩrĩ, “Cookai mũkeere Johana maũndũ marĩa muonete na mũkaigua: atĩ atumumu nĩ marona, na ithua nĩiretwara, na arĩa marĩ na mangũ nĩ marahonio, na andũ arĩa mataiguaga nĩmaraigua, na arĩa akuũ nĩmarariũkio, na Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega nĩũrahunjĩrio arĩa athĩĩni.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Ĩtanarĩkia kũhooya-rĩ, Rebeka agĩũka akuuĩte ndigithũ kĩande-inĩ. Aarĩ mũirĩtu wa Bethueli mũrũ wa Milika, ũrĩa warĩ mũtumia wa Nahoru mũrũ wa nyina na Iburahĩmu.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa njugire mbu ndeithio, yatiga nguo ĩno harĩ niĩ, yoima nyũmba na yora.”
english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: “Ũkai kũrĩ niĩ, inyuothe anogu na mũkuuĩte mĩrigo mĩritũ, na nĩngũmũhurũkia.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

kikuyu: No Esaũ akĩhanyũka agatũnge Jakubu na akĩmũnyiita, akĩmũhĩmbĩria, akĩmũmumunya. Nao makĩrĩranĩra.
english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

kikuyu: Musa akĩrakarĩra anene a mbũtũ icio cia ita na atongoria a mbũtũ cia o ngiri, ngiri, na atongoria a mbũtũ cia o igana, igana, arĩa moimĩte mbaara-inĩ.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

kikuyu: īngīhota kūmenya atīa wagīrīru wa silage na mahuti marīa mangī ma ng'ombe?
english: How do I evaluate the quality of silage and other stored forages for dairy cow diets?

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio gatũrũme kau, na iruta rĩu rĩa ngano, na maguta macio nĩirĩrutagwo rũciinĩ o rũciinĩ rĩrĩ iruta rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe.
english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

kikuyu: Mūthemba ūyū wīkūranite nīūndū nīūrī mathangū marī rangi wa gītīri gīcamu na ngirini.
english: It is majorly characterized by dark bronze shoot tipped plants with a few green-tipped strains.

kikuyu: niĩ na niĩ nĩngamũũkĩrĩra na marakara na niĩ mwene ngĩrĩrĩrie kũmũherithia maita mangĩ mũgwanja nĩ ũndũ wa mehia manyu.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Nĩatĩĩtwo gũkĩra arĩa Mĩrongo Ĩtatũ, no ndaataranĩirio na acio Atatũ. Nake Daudi akĩmũtua mũnene wa arĩa maamũrangagĩra.
english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

kikuyu: nake ũrĩa wothe ũkwenda gũtuĩka wa mbere thĩinĩ wanyu, no nginya atuĩke ngombo ya andũ othe.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

kikuyu: Mũthenya o ro ũcio maathiire, ndungata cia Isaaka igĩũka, ĩkĩmwĩra ũhoro wa gĩthima kĩrĩa cienjete, ikiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩtwakinyĩra maaĩ!”
english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

kikuyu: Ngoma thũku nĩcioimaga andũ aingĩ igĩkayũrũrũkaga, na andũ aingĩ maarũarĩte mũrimũ wa gũkua ciĩga, na andũ arĩa maarĩ onju makĩhonio.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

kikuyu: na ũrĩa eekire mbũtũ cia ita cia bũrũri wa Misiri, na mbarathi ciao, na ngaari ciao cia ita, na ũrĩa aamahubĩkanirie na maaĩ ma Iria Itune hĩndĩ ĩyo maathingatanĩte nao, na ũrĩa Jehova aamarehithĩirie mũthiro wa gũtũũra.
english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;

kikuyu: Akĩrutĩra ngai cia Dameski iria ciamũhootete magongona, nĩgũkorwo eeciiragia atĩrĩ, “Kuona atĩ ngai cia athamaki a Suriata nĩcimateithĩtie-rĩ, nĩngũcirutĩra igongona nĩguo cindeithie o na niĩ.” No icio nĩcio ciamũniinire na ikĩniina Isiraeli rĩothe.
english: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

kikuyu: na ndigiri 61,000
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

kikuyu: No tondũ wa ũrĩa ũmaraya ũingĩhĩte-rĩ, o mũndũ mũrũme nĩagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũgĩa na mũtumia wake mwene, na mũndũ-wa-nja agĩe na mũthuuri wake mwene.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

kikuyu: Kĩũngano kĩu gĩothe gĩgĩcooka gĩkĩiguanĩra gĩkũngũĩre gĩathĩ kĩu mĩthenya ĩngĩ mũgwanja; nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩkũngũĩra mĩthenya ĩngĩ mũgwanja makenete mũno.
english: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

kikuyu: O rĩngĩ agĩtũma ndungata ya gatatũ, nao makĩmĩtiihangia na makĩmĩingata.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, nĩuugĩte ngĩiguaga, ngaigua ciugo icio ũkiuga atĩ,
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

kikuyu: Nĩmateithirio kũmahũũra, nake Ngai akĩneana Ahagari moko-inĩ mao, marĩ hamwe na arĩa othe maamateithagia, tondũ nĩmamũkaĩire marĩ mbaara-inĩ. Nĩamacookeirie mahooya mao, nĩ ũndũ nĩmamwĩhokete.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

kikuyu: nao Ayahudi aingĩ nĩmokĩte kũu kwa Maritha na Mariamu kũmomĩrĩria nĩ ũndũ wa gũkuĩrwo nĩ mũrũ wa nyina wao.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

kikuyu: njamba na nga-rĩ, igĩũka kũrĩ Nuhu igĩtoonya thabina, o ta ũrĩa Ngai aathĩte Nuhu.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

kikuyu: “Kaĩ mũrĩ na haaro-ĩ, tondũ mũtariĩ ta mbĩrĩra itarĩ rũũri iria andũ mageragĩra igũrũ rĩacio matekũmenya.”*
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

kikuyu: Nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakoya gatũrũme kau ka iruta rĩa mahĩtia, hamwe na kabakũri ka maguta, acithũngũthĩrie mbere ya Jehova ituĩke iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa agĩtara marigithathi mothe ma andũ a Isiraeli, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte.
english: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Handa handū hakinyagīrwo nī riūa wega na hatangīaraha maaī.
english: Choose a location that receives plenty of sunlight and has well-drained soil.

kikuyu: Akĩeheria magongona ma ngai cia mabũrũri ma kũngĩ, na kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru, na agĩthethera mahiga marĩa maamũre, na agĩtemenga itugĩ cia Ashera.
english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

kikuyu: Ũguo noguo mangĩgwĩkĩra, aya mwanarutithania wĩra na mũkonjorithia nao kuuma rĩrĩa warĩ mũnini. O mũndũ wao athiiaga o na mbere kũhĩtia; gũtigakorwo mũndũ o na ũmwe ũngĩgĩkũhonokia.
english: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.

kikuyu: Hĩ! Ĩ meciiria maku matikĩrĩ ma bata harĩ niĩ, Wee Mũrungu! Kaĩ mũigana wamo nĩ mũnene-ĩ!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

kikuyu: Na to ũguo wiki, o nacio ciana cia Rebeka ciarĩ cia ithe o ũmwe, na nĩwe ithe witũ Isaaka.
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

kikuyu: Makoragwo marī magucūku na ithimo cia sentimita 14.2 na 6.6.
english: They elongated in shape measuring 14.2cm and 6.6 cm.

kikuyu: Nake agĩĩka maũndũ mooru maitho-inĩ ma Jehova, o ta ũrĩa Jehoiakimu eekĩte.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ nĩũiguĩte ũrĩa athamaki a Ashuri mekĩte mabũrũri-inĩ mothe, ũrĩa maamaniinire biũ. Inyuĩ mũgũkĩhonoka atĩa?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

kikuyu: Niĩ-rĩ, githĩ ndianarĩrio nĩ arĩa marĩ na thĩĩna? Githĩ ngoro yakwa ndĩanaiguĩra arĩa athĩĩni kĩeha?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

kikuyu: Moima Libina, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Risa.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

kikuyu: Kĩgũũta gĩikagia guoko gwakĩo o thaani-inĩ; kĩnogagio nĩgũcooka gũkuoya gĩgũkinyie kanua-inĩ.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

kikuyu: Tondũ-rĩ, angĩkorwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa twarĩ thũ cia Ngai nĩtwaiguithanirio nake na ũndũ wa gĩkuũ kĩa Mũriũ, na tondũ rĩu tũrĩ aiguithanie na Ngai-rĩ, nĩtũrĩkĩragĩrĩria kũhonokio nĩ ũndũ Kristũ arĩ muoyo.
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

kikuyu: Daudi agĩthiĩ kũmatũnga, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo mũrooka kũrĩ niĩ na thayũ kũndeithia- rĩ, nĩndĩhaarĩirie kũmwamũkĩra tũtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe; no angĩkorwo mũũkĩte kũngunyanĩra kũrĩ thũ ciakwa o rĩrĩa itarenda haaro-rĩ, Ngai wa maithe maitũ arorora ũndũ ũcio na amũtuĩre ciira.”
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

kikuyu: Hūthīra thūū cia kīīmerera ta cryptolaemus montrouzieri, Verticillium Lecanii iria inyihagia ngūcī.
english: Introduce natural enemies such as. Cryptolaemus montrouzieri, Verticillium lecanii to reduce population of scales in the ecosystem.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maamũkorire mũrĩmo ũũrĩa ũngĩ wa iria makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Rabii, ũkinyire gũkũ rĩ?”
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

kikuyu: No Wee Jehova-rĩ, mathekerere; ndũrĩrĩ icio ciothe nĩũcinyararĩte.
english: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũcio no nginya akue. Kĩũngano gĩothe kĩa Isiraeli no nginya kĩmũhũũre na mahiga nyuguto nja ya kambĩ.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

kikuyu: Legumes īkoragwo na Calcium na Phosphorus nyingī gūkīra nyeki.
english: Legumes tend to have more Calcium and Phosphorus than grasses.

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, hũthagĩrai ũtonga wa gũkũ thĩ na gũthondeka ũrata na andũ, nĩguo rĩrĩa ũtonga ũcio ũgaathira, mũkaamũkĩrwo ciikaro-inĩ iria cia tene na tene.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩa mũthamaki aatoonyire nĩguo one ageni-rĩ, akĩona kuo mũndũ ũmwe ũtehumbĩte nguo cia ũhiki.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

kikuyu: Kūgarūrira mīmera īria īrahandwo kahūa-inī nīkūnyihagia wūingī wa tūtambi hamwe na gūtheria mūgūnda na kūrīmīra kahūa.
english: Practising rotations and intercropping to reduce pest population, Maintenance of field sanitation, Proper weed control

kikuyu: Mĩromo ya mũthamaki yaragia ũhoro taarĩ ndũmĩrĩri, na kanua gake gatiagĩrĩirwo kuogomia kĩhooto.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩũkahaanda mĩgũnda ya mĩthabibũ kũu irĩma-inĩ cia Samaria; arĩmi nĩmakamĩhaanda, na makenere maciaro mayo.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.

kikuyu: Moimagara kuuma kũu makĩamba hema kũrigania na Rũũĩ rwa Arinoni, kũu werũ ũrĩa ũthiĩte nginya bũrũri wa Aamori; nĩgũkorwo Rũũĩ rwa Arinoni nĩruo rwarĩ mũhaka wa Moabi na Aamori.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

kikuyu: no mwaka wa mũgwanja ũkarekaga mũgũnda ũikare ũguo ũtarĩmĩtwo na ũtekũhũthĩrwo. Nao arĩa athĩĩni gatagatĩ ka andũ anyu makonaga irio kuuma mũgũnda ũcio, nacio nyamũ cia gĩthaka ikarĩĩaga kĩrĩa marĩtigagia. Ĩkaga o ũguo na mũgũnda waku wa mĩthabibũ na wa mĩtamaiyũ.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Hiramu agĩtũmana kũrĩ Solomoni, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ: “Nĩnyiitĩte ndũmĩrĩri ĩrĩa wandũmĩire, na nĩngwĩka ũrĩa wothe ũkwenda harĩ kũrehithia mĩgogo ya mĩtarakwa na ya mĩthengera.
english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli matingĩenda gũkũigua, nĩ ũndũ matiendaga kũnjigua, nĩgũkorwo nyũmba yothe ya Isiraeli nĩyũmĩtie ngoro na ĩkangʼathia.
english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate† and hard-hearted.

kikuyu: O rĩmwe agĩtiga kuura, na akĩigua nĩehererio thĩĩna mwĩrĩ-inĩ wake.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

kikuyu: ‘Niĩ ndimatũmĩte,’ nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. ‘Mararatha ũhoro wa maheeni, makĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩakwa. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngamũingata, na inyuĩ mũniinwo biũ, wee hamwe na anabii acio makũrathagĩra mohoro.’ ”
english: For I have not sent them,” says Yahweh, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”

kikuyu: “Zebuluni agaatũũra hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria, na atuĩke handũ hega ha gũikaragwo nĩ marikabu; mĩhaka yake ĩgaakinya o Sidoni.
english: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

kikuyu: Rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova nĩ mũthiringo ũrĩ hinya; arĩa athingu moragĩra ho, nao magaikara marĩ agitĩre.
english: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa makwĩhĩria, nĩgũkorwo gũtirĩ mũndũ ũtehagia, nawe ũmarakarĩre ũmaneane kũrĩ thũ, nacio imatahe imatware bũrũri wacio, ũrĩ kũraya kana ũrĩ gũkuhĩ;
english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio wamũrĩte mũgũnda wake angĩenda kũũkũũra, nĩakongerera gĩcunjĩ kĩngĩ gĩa ithano harĩ thogora waguo, mũgũnda ũcio ũcooke ũtuĩke wake rĩngĩ.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

kikuyu: Agĩthiĩ na mbere, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ĩtĩkĩra kũũria Mũthamaki Solomoni, nĩ ũndũ wee ndan- gĩkũregera, aahe Abishagi ũrĩa Mũshunami atuĩke mũtumia wakwa.”
english: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

kikuyu: Andũ ao kũringana na mbarĩ ciao, mandĩkĩtwo kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao maarĩ aya: Jeieli ũrĩa mũnene, na Zekaria,
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

kikuyu: Mūrimū ūyū ungītherema mūno nīūnyihagia maciaro ma mūtī.
english: In severe attacks, the entire blossom panicle may be involved and fruit fail to set (affecting yields).

kikuyu: Kũrĩ maũndũ matandatũ mathũirwo nĩ Jehova, ĩĩ, o na nĩ mũgwanja marĩa onaga marĩ magigi, nĩmo:
english: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kikuyu: Angīkorwo nī kūhanda marigū na kahūa, nī īhinda rīrīku riega rīa gūthura harīa marīma ma kahūa makwenjwo?
english: If intercropping banana and coffee, when is it best to demarcate the planting holes for coffee?

kikuyu: Nī ūkuona mīthemba īno kwa wūingī matūra-inī ma gīcūa-inī ta Mombasa, Kilifi, Tana-River na Lamu.
english: You will find their huge populations in Mombasa, Kilifi, Tana-River and Lamu areas.

kikuyu: we ũrĩa ũnyararithagia andũ arĩa marĩ igweta-rĩ, agĩtũma morũũre kũndũ gũtaarĩ njĩra.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, Wee Jehova Ngai wakwa nĩũtuĩte ndungata yaku mũthamaki handũ ha baba Daudi. No niĩ ndĩ o mwana mũnini* na ndirĩ na ũmenyo wa kũruta wĩra wakwa.
english: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ta rora ũrĩa o ũmwe wa athamaki* a Isiraeli arĩa marĩ thĩinĩ waku ahũthagĩra hinya wake ũũru agĩitithia thakame.
english: “ ‘ “Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo mwĩrĩ nĩwĩriragĩria maũndũ marĩa matangĩendwo nĩ Roho, nake Roho nĩareganaga na maũndũ marĩa meriragĩrio nĩ mwĩrĩ. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Roho na mwĩrĩ itũũraga irũaga, na nĩkĩo mũtahotaga gwĩka ũrĩa mwendaga gwĩka.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

kikuyu: Hanyũkaga o na njĩra ya maathani maku, nĩgũkorwo nĩwohorithĩtie ngoro yakwa.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

kikuyu: Nĩngarathima arĩa magaakũrathima, na ũrĩa o wothe ũgaakũruma na niĩ nĩngatũma anyiitwo nĩ kĩrumi; nao andũ othe a thĩ nĩmakarathimwo nĩ ũndũ waku.”
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

kikuyu: na Kozu, ũrĩa warĩ ithe wa Anubu, na Hazobeba, na wa mĩhĩrĩga ya Ahariheli mũrũ wa Harumu.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

kikuyu: Namo maaĩ magĩthiĩ makĩhũũaga, magĩthiraga thĩ. Thuutha wa matukũ igana na mĩrongo ĩtano-rĩ, maaĩ magĩkorwo manyihanyiihĩte,
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

kikuyu: arĩa moigire atĩrĩ, “Nĩtwĩgwatĩrei bũrũri wa ũrĩithio wa Ngai ũtuĩke witũ.”
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

kikuyu: makaarĩa maciaro ma mĩthiĩre yao, na mahũũnio nĩ maciaro ma mathugunda mao.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, wandutire kuuma mbĩrĩra-inĩ; ũkĩgiria njikũrũke, ndoonye irima.
english: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol.† You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

kikuyu: “Andũ othe nĩmagĩte meciiria na makaaga ũmenyo, nake mũturi wa thahabu o wothe nĩaconorithĩtio nĩ mĩhianano ĩyo yake. Nĩ ũndũ mĩhianano ĩyo yake nĩ ya maheeni; ndĩrĩ mĩhũmũ thĩinĩ wayo.
english: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

kikuyu: Ũngĩathĩkĩra Jehova Ngai waku kũna na ũmenyerere maathani make mothe marĩa ngũkũhe ũmũthĩ, Jehova Ngai waku nĩagagũtũũgĩria igũrũ rĩa ndũrĩrĩ ciothe cia thĩ.
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ hagĩĩtwo Mizipa, tondũ oigire atĩrĩ, “Jehova arotũmenyagĩrĩra rĩrĩa tũraihanĩrĩirie.
english: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Isiraeli agaatũũra arĩ wiki atarĩ na ũgwati; gĩthima kĩa Jakubu nĩkĩgitĩre o kũu bũrũri wa ngano, na ndibei ya mũhihano, kũrĩa ime rĩa igũrũ rĩtataga.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

kikuyu: na Obadia mũrũ wa Shemaia, mũrũ wa Galali, mũrũ wa Jeduthuni; na Berekia mũrũ wa Asa, mũrũ wa Elikana, arĩa maaikaraga matũũra-inĩ ma Anetofathi.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

kikuyu: Arata akwa, mũtikanerĩhĩrie, no tigagĩriai mangʼũrĩ ma Ngai handũ, nĩgũkorwo nĩ kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “Kũrĩhanĩria nĩ gwakwa; nĩ niĩ ngaarĩhanĩria,” ũguo nĩguo Mwathani ekuuga.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”*

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũngĩaka nyũmba njerũ, ũkaamĩĩkĩra rũirigo rũmĩthiũrũrũkĩirie igũrũ nĩgeetha ndũkarehithĩrie andũ a nyũmba yaku ũũru wa ũiti wa thakame, mũndũ angĩkaagũa kuuma nyũmba igũrũ.*
english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

kikuyu: Niĩ thirĩte ngatigara o gĩkonde na mahĩndĩ; niĩ ndigarĩirwo no kĩni kĩa magego giiki.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

kikuyu: Norĩu, tondũhatirĩhandũhangĩingĩrutawĩrangʼongo-inĩici, natondũmĩakamĩingĩnĩngoretwo ngĩĩrirĩria kũmuona-rĩ,
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

kikuyu: Ngĩrĩkĩrĩria nguuga atĩrĩ, gũtikagĩe mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ũkũndehere thĩĩna, nĩgũkorwo nĩnjoretwo njoro cia Jesũ mwĩrĩ-inĩ wakwa.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Isiraeli makiumagara kuuma Werũ wa Sinai magĩthiĩ kuuma handũ hamwe nginya harĩa hangĩ, o nginya rĩrĩa itu rĩu rĩarũgamire Werũ-inĩ wa Parani.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

kikuyu: na Meraiothu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Amaria, na Amaria nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Ahitubu,
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova nĩakameka o ta ũrĩa eekire Sihoni na Ogu, athamaki a Aamori, arĩa aaniinire hamwe na bũrũri wao.
english: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

kikuyu: Nao arutwo magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Jesũ keheri-inĩ, makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Tũremirwo nĩkũingata ndaimono ĩyo nĩkĩ?”
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

kikuyu: Na tondũ Judasi nĩwe waigaga mbeeca-rĩ, amwe magĩĩciiria Jesũ aamwĩraga agũre kĩrĩa kĩabataranĩtie nĩ ũndũ wa Gĩathĩ, kana aheane kĩndũ nĩ ũndũ wa arĩa athĩĩni.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Solomoni agĩkorwo na gĩathĩ hĩndĩ ĩyo arĩ hamwe na andũ a Isiraeli, maarĩ kĩũngano kĩnene, andũ kuuma Lebo-Hamathu nginya Karũũĩ ka Misiri. Magĩkũngũĩra gĩathĩ kĩu mbere ya Jehova Ngai witũ mĩthenya mũgwanja, na mĩthenya ĩngĩ mũgwanja, yothe yarĩ mĩthenya ikũmi na ĩna.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

kikuyu: Atĩ ũngiumbũra na kanua gaku atĩ, “Jesũ nĩ Mwathani,” o na gwĩtĩkia wĩtĩkie na ngoro yaku atĩ Ngai nĩamũriũkirie oime kũrĩ arĩa akuũ-rĩ, no ũhonoke.
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

kikuyu: Rũngʼathio rũũragaga kĩrimũ, naguo ũiru ũkooraga mũndũ ũrĩa mũkĩĩgu.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ ngombo-rĩ, athĩkagĩrai aathani anyu a gũkũ thĩ, mũkĩmatĩĩaga na mũkĩmetigĩraga, mũtarĩ na ũhinga ngoro-inĩ, o taarĩ Kristũ mũrathĩkĩra.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

kikuyu: Hihi njui itūrīkithagio na njīra irīkū?
english: Which types of brooding exist?

kikuyu: Ariũ a Perezu maarĩ: Hezironi na Hamula.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

kikuyu: Camai muone atĩ Jehova nĩ mwega; kũrathimwo nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũragĩra harĩ we.
english: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

kikuyu: Ngūkū ikahingīrwo mathaa ma ūtukū na mūthenya irekwo ciīyethere irio mūthenya wothe.
english: Chicken are housed at night but allowed to roam freely during the day.

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa makoraga mũndũ no mo makoraga nyamũ; mũndũ na nyamũ makoragwo nĩ ũndũ o ro ũmwe: O ta ũrĩa mũndũ akuuaga, noguo nyamũ ĩkuaga. Mĩhũmũ ya mũndũ na nyamũ no ĩmwe; mũndũ ndarĩ handũ akĩrĩte nyamũ. Ũndũ o wothe nĩ wa tũhũ.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmũkamũra matũũra matatũ marĩ handũ gatagatĩ ka bũrũri ũrĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu ekũmũhe mũwĩgwatĩre.
english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki wa Isiraeli nĩakoretwo eera anene ake atĩrĩ, “Githĩ mũtiũĩ atĩ Ramothu-Gileadi nĩ itũũra riitũ, na gũtirĩ ũndũ tũreka wa kũrĩoya rĩngĩ kuuma kũrĩ mũthamaki wa Suriata?”
english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

kikuyu: ũguo nĩ kuuga njiaro ciao iria ciatigarĩte bũrũri-inĩ, iria andũ a Isiraeli mataaniinĩte, acio nĩo maandĩkithirio nĩ Solomoni matuĩke ngombo ciake cia kũrutithio wĩra na hinya, na noguo gũtũire nginya ũmũthĩ.
english: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.

kikuyu: Macūngīrīro nī ng'ombe kūremwo kūrūgama, ūrugarī wa mwīrī ūgaikūrūka thī ona kūūmīrwo nī kīoro
english: Eventually, the cow is unable to rise, body temperature falls, and constipation occurs.

kikuyu: nuthu ĩrĩa yaheirwo kĩrĩndĩ ciarĩ ngʼondu 337,500,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

kikuyu: Matũũra mothe marĩa mũkaahe Alawii no nginya magaakorwo marĩ mĩrongo ĩna na manana, hamwe na ithaka cia kũrĩithia mahiũ mao.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Ngūkū iria ciarīkia kūhona: Imwe ya ngūkū ici, cionekaga irī na ūgima mwega wa mwīrī no no ithiaga na mbere kūruta tūhengereta tūrīa tūrehaga mīrimū kūgerera kioro, ūndū ūrī ūrehaga ūgwati makīria harī tūcui.
english: Recovered carriers: they appear healthy but they continue to shed germs causing diseases in faeces and discharges that can be a risk especially to chicks

kikuyu: “Nĩwe ũguĩmagĩra mũrũũthi wa mũgoma wone gĩa kũrĩa, kana nĩwe ũniinagĩra mĩrũũthi ngʼaragu
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

kikuyu: Rũciinĩ gwakĩa-rĩ, andũ acio makiumagario hamwe na ndigiri ciao.
english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

kikuyu: Mūtararīko wa Annet ūrīa ūkūragwo kūndū kūrīa kūraihu mūno ta mita 1300-2000 igūrū rīa thī.
english: Annet variety grown in Medium to high altitude of 1300-2000 M.A.S.L.

kikuyu: Mũtigatuĩke tao, nĩgũkorwo Ithe wanyu nĩoĩ kĩrĩa kĩmũbatairie o na mũtanamũhooya.
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

kikuyu: inyuĩ njiaro cia Iburahĩmu ndungata yake, o inyuĩ ciana cia Jakubu, inyuĩ ake athuure.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Ihinda rĩu nĩrĩkinyu, mũthenya ũcio nĩũkinyĩte. Mũgũri nĩatige gũkena kana mwendia aigue kĩeha, nĩgũkorwo mangʼũrĩ nĩmakinyĩrĩire kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩothe.
english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa ndaatuĩrĩire maithe manyu ciira kũu werũ-inĩ wa bũrũri wa Misiri-rĩ, ũguo noguo ngaamũtuĩra ciira, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.
english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

kikuyu: Musa akĩhũndũka, agĩikũrũka kuuma kĩrĩma igũrũ akuuĩte ihengere icio igĩrĩ cia Ũira na moko make. Ciarĩ nyandĩke mĩena yeerĩ, mbere na thuutha.
english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

kikuyu: Mīembe īkūrīirio nyūngū-inī thīinī wa nyūmba nī yendaga kuumio nja yote riūa.
english: Place pot-grown mango trees outside in summer if possible, to give them sufficient sunlight

kikuyu: Arĩria andũ aya a nyũmba ĩno nemi na ngerekano, ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “ ‘Hagĩra nyũngũ ya kũruga; mĩhagĩre na ũmĩitĩrĩre maaĩ.
english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.

kikuyu: rĩmwe tũgatuuo nĩtũũĩkaine, no rĩrĩa rĩngĩ tũgatuuo ta tũtoĩkaine; ningĩ tũkahaana ta tũraakua, no tũrĩ o muoyo; tũhũũragwo, no tũtiũragagwo;
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jesũ akĩmahe ngerekano ĩngĩ, akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Ũthamaki wa igũrũ ũhaana ta mũndũ ũrĩa wahaandire mbeũ njega mũgũnda wake.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

kikuyu: Nĩngũcookeria Ngai ngaatho nĩgũkorwo niĩ nĩnjaragia na thiomi makĩria manyu inyuothe.
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

kikuyu: Karĩkoragwo karĩ thiithi-inĩ wa Harũni, nake agakuuaga mahĩtia makoniĩ iheo iria theru, iria andũ a Isiraeli mangĩkorwo mamũrĩire Jehova, o na irĩ cia mũthemba o na ũrĩkũ. Gatanji kau gakoragwo karĩ thiithi-inĩ wa Harũni hĩndĩ ciothe nĩgeetha magetĩkĩrĩkaga nĩ Jehova.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Moima Iria Itune, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao werũ-inĩ wa Sini.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩĩra mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio atĩrĩ, “Nĩngũkũingĩhĩria ruo mũno hĩndĩ ya gũciara; ũrĩciaraga ciana na ruo. Merirĩria maku marĩkoragwo marĩ harĩ mũthuuriguo, nake nĩarĩgwathaga.”
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

kikuyu: Ramu nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Aminadabu, nake Aminadabu aarĩ ithe wa Nahashoni, ũrĩa warĩ mũtongoria wa andũ a Juda.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

kikuyu: Andũ matimenaga mũici angĩkorwo aiyĩte nĩguo eniinĩre ngʼaragu rĩrĩa arĩ mũhũũtu.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

kikuyu: Igũrũ nĩrĩkene, thĩ nĩĩcanjamũke; iria nĩrĩrurume, na indo iria ciothe irĩ thĩinĩ warĩo;
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

kikuyu: Mathĩĩna ma ngoro yakwa nĩmaingĩhĩte; niinĩra ruo rũrĩa ndĩ naruo.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

kikuyu: Nake Harũni akĩmũcookeria, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Tiga kũrakara, mwathi wakwa; wee nĩũũĩ ũrĩa andũ aya mendete gwĩka ũũru.
english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

kikuyu: ningĩ mariũko ma njũũĩ nĩmanyiite, na kũrĩa kũrĩ marura gũgaacinwo na mwaki, nacio thigari ikanyiitwo nĩ guoya.”
english: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”

kikuyu: “Ikũrũka ũgatũnge Ahabu mũthamakiwaIsiraeli, ũrĩawathanagaSamaria. Rĩuarĩmũgũnda-inĩwamĩthabibũwaNabothukũrĩa athiĩte kwĩgwatĩra mũgũnda ũcio ũtuĩke wake.
english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

kikuyu: Mūrīmi angībanga wega, amenye akagetha maembe maigana atīa, na amenye akendia kū, ūrīmi wa maembe no ūkorwo ūrī biashara ya kwīrirīrio.
english: If you plan early, project your harvest, and identify a target market, then mango farming will be a lucrative venture.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ kĩndũ o na kĩmwe kĩa indo icio ituĩrĩirwo kũniinwo gĩgaakorwo kĩrĩ moko-inĩ manyu, nĩgeetha Jehova atige gũcinwo nĩ marakara make mahiũ; nake acooke amũiguĩre tha, na amwĩke maũndũ ma ũtugi, na atũme mũingĩhe, o ta ũrĩa erĩire maithe manyu ma tene na mwĩhĩtwa,
english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

kikuyu: Hihi mīkorobia nībataraga gūitīīrīrio maaī?
english: Do avocados need irrigation?

kikuyu: Mũisiraeli ũcio woragirwo marĩ na mũndũ-wa-nja Mũmidiani eetagwo Zimuri mũrũ wa Salu, mũtongoria wa nyũmba ya Asimeoni.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

kikuyu: na Ofiri, na Havila, na Jobabu. Acio othe nĩo maarĩ ariũ a Jokitani.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

kikuyu: Kũngĩgaakorwo na mũndũ mũthĩĩni gatagatĩ-inĩ ka ariũ a ithe wanyu itũũra-inĩ o rĩothe kũu bũrũri-inĩ ũcio Jehova Ngai wanyu ekũmũhe-rĩ, mũtikanamũmĩrie ngoro, kana mũtuĩke akarĩ kũrĩ mũrũ wa ithe wanyu ũcio mũthĩĩni.
english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

kikuyu: MambatirematuĩkanĩirieNegevunamagĩkinyaHebironikũrĩaAhimani, na Sheshai, na Talimai, njiaro cia Anaki, maatũũraga. (Itũũra rĩa Hebironi rĩakĩtwo mĩaka mũgwanja mbere ya itũũra rĩa Zoani gwakwo bũrũri-inĩ wa Misiri.)
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

kikuyu: “Jusufu nĩ mũthabibũ ũrĩa ũciaraga, mũthabibũ ũrĩa ũciaraga ũrĩ hakuhĩ na gĩthima, ũrĩa honge ciaguo itambagĩrĩra rũthingo.
english: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

kikuyu: Namo maũndũ macio nĩ ma ngerekano, nĩ ũndũ atumia acio marũgamĩrĩire irĩkanĩro igĩrĩ. Kĩrĩkanĩro kĩmwe nĩ gĩa Kĩrĩma gĩa Sinai nakĩo gĩciaraga ciana cia ũkombo: Nakĩo kĩgerekanĩtio na Hagari.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

kikuyu: Wee nĩwe ũkũrũgamĩrĩra nyũmba yakwa ya ũthamaki, na andũ akwa othe marĩathĩkagĩra watho waku. Ũndũ ngũgũkĩra naguo no atĩrĩ, niĩ nĩ niĩ Mũthamaki.”
english: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

kikuyu: Nĩ niĩ Kilaudio Lisia, Kũrĩ mũgaathe Barũthi Felike: Nĩndakũgeithia.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova. Cookeriai Jehova ngaatho, nĩgũkorwo nĩ mwega; wendo wake ũtũũraga nginya tene.
english: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: No angĩrega maũndũ macio thuutha hanini, aarĩkia kũmaigua, nĩwe ũngĩcookererwo nĩ mahĩtia ma mũtumia wake.”
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

kikuyu: Mbuĩ nĩ thũmbĩ ya riiri; cionekaga nĩ ũndũ wa mũtũũrĩre wa ũthingu.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

kikuyu: “ ‘Na rĩrĩ, gũtirĩ mũndũ wamũrĩirwo kũũragwo ũngĩkũũrwo; no nginya ooragwo.
english: “ ‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Tuma nguo ndaaya ya ebodi ya taama wa bururu mũtheri,
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ agĩtoonya kũu hekarũ-inĩ akĩrutũrũra andũ othe arĩa maagũraga na meendagia indo kuo, akĩngʼaũrania metha cia arĩa maakũũranagia mbeeca, na akĩngʼaũrania itĩ cia arĩa meendagia ndutura.
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa Jesũ oimaga hekarũ-inĩ, ũmwe wa arutwo ake akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrutani, ta rora! Mahiga maya kaĩ nĩ manene-ĩ!* Kaĩ nyũmba ici nĩ thaka-ĩ!”
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

kikuyu: Hakuhī na maaī mega.
english: Nearness to quality water source

kikuyu: Wee nĩwĩkĩte maũndũ maingĩ mooru, gũkĩra andũ arĩa othe makoretwo marĩ mbere yaku. Nĩwĩthondekeire ngai ingĩ, o na mĩhianano ya kũhooywo ĩthondeketwo na kĩgera. Nĩũtũmĩte ndakare na ũkaahutatĩra.
english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

kikuyu: Nĩmatũũrĩte kuo o na magaaka hekarũ kuo ĩrĩa ĩtanĩtio na Rĩĩtwa rĩaku, makiugaga atĩrĩ,
english: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

kikuyu: Nake agĩthiĩ nja, akĩrĩra arĩ na ruo rũingĩ.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo amunyũkĩte njuĩrĩ ĩrutĩtie na thiithi akagĩa kĩhara kĩa na mbere, ũcio ndarĩ na thaahu.
english: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

kikuyu: Mũtumia wa Makiru, Maaka nĩaciarire mwanake na akĩmũtua Pereshu. Mũrũ wa nyina na Pereshu eetagwo Shereshu, na ariũ a Shereshu maarĩ Ulamu na Rakemu.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

kikuyu: Jehova ndarĩ hĩndĩ akenda kũmũrek- era; marakara make na kĩyo gĩake nĩikarĩrĩmbũkĩra mũndũ ũcio. Irumi ciothe iria ciandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩĩrĩ nĩikamũkinyĩrĩra, nake Jehova nĩakahuura rĩĩtwa rĩake rĩehere gũkũ thĩ.
english: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũrĩ na mũrimũ ta ũcio ũngĩgwatanio-rĩ, no nginya ehumbe nguo ndarũku, na arekererie njuĩrĩ yake, na ahumbĩre kanua gake, athiĩ akĩanagĩrĩra akiugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Ndĩ na thaahu! Ndĩ na thaahu!’
english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

kikuyu: No ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, Elija nĩarĩkĩtie gũũka na andũ makamwĩka o ũrĩa wothe meendaga kũmwĩka, o ta ũrĩa ũhoro wake wandĩkĩtwo.”
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

kikuyu: Nĩmũgaikara mwĩohete iremba mĩtwe na mwĩkĩrĩte iraatũ magũrũ. Mũtigacakaya kana mũrĩre, no nĩmũkahwererekera tondũ wa mehia manyu na mũcaayage thĩinĩ wanyu.
english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Merari: kuuma kũrĩ Jaazia: maarĩ Beno, na Shohamu, na Zakuri, na Ibiri.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

kikuyu: Wee nyũmba ya Harũni, wĩhokage Jehova: we nĩwe ũteithio wao o na ngo yao.
english: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Mothiũ mao maahaanaga ta marĩa ndoonete hau Rũũĩ-inĩ rwa Kebari. O ũmwe wao aathiiaga arũngĩrĩirie na mbere.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jesũ akĩarĩria andũ amwe arĩa meĩhokaga o ene, magetuaga athingu na makahũthagia andũ arĩa angĩ othe, akĩmahe ngerekano, akĩmeera atĩrĩ:
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

kikuyu: mũhaandĩtwo na mũgaakwo thĩinĩ wake, na mũkĩongagĩrĩrwo hinya thĩinĩ wa wĩtĩkio o ta ũrĩa mwarutirwo, na mũkĩrĩrĩrie gũcookia ngaatho.
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩa akaaruta agaakĩrehe na moko make we mwene gĩtuĩke iruta rĩa kũrutĩrwo Jehova na gũcinwo na mwaki; nĩakarehe maguta, hamwe na gĩthũri, na agĩthũngũthie mbere ya Jehova gĩtuĩke iruta rĩa gũthũngũthio.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ o wothe ũnyuuaga maaĩ maya nĩanyootaga rĩngĩ,
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

kikuyu: kuuma Matana magĩthiĩ Nahalieli, kuuma Nahalieli magĩthiĩ Bamothu,
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

kikuyu: Na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩhota gũtoonya nyũmba ya mũndũ njamba na amũtunye indo ciake, tiga ambire kuoha mũndũ ũcio njamba. Hĩndĩ ĩyo no rĩo angĩhota kũmũtunya indo cia nyũmba yake.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Ndaamũheire igai gũkũ, o na ikinya rĩmwe. No Ngai nĩamwĩrire atĩ we hamwe na njiaro ciake nĩmakegwatĩra bũrũri ũyũ, o na gũtuĩka hĩndĩ ĩyo Iburahĩmu ndaarĩ na mwana.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

kikuyu: Maũndũ maya ndĩmaririkanaga o ngĩitũrũraga ngoro yakwa: ngaririkana ũrĩa ndatwaranaga na kĩrĩndĩ, ndongoretie mũtongoro nginya nyũmba-inĩ ya Ngai, tũkĩanagĩrĩra na gĩkeno na tũgĩcookagia ngaatho, ndĩ kĩrĩndĩ-inĩ hĩndĩ ya ciathĩ.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩũria Shaitani atĩrĩ, “Uuma kũ?” Nake Shaitani agĩcookeria Jehova atĩrĩ, “Nyuma kũriũnga thĩ, o na gũcangacanga kuo kũndũ na kũndũ.”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Menya na ma atĩ njiaro ciaku nĩigatũũra irĩ ageni bũrũri ũtarĩ wacio, na nĩigatuuo ngombo na inyariirwo mĩaka magana mana.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

kikuyu: Mĩthĩnje, woe thakame ĩmwe yayo ũmĩhake moni cia matũ ma ũrĩo ma Harũni na ariũ ake o na ciara iria nene cia moko mao ma ũrĩo, na ciara iria nene cia magũrũ mao ma ũrĩo. Ũcooke ũminjaminjĩrie kĩgongona thakame mĩena yothe.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Ingīrūa na tūtambi mūthemba wa thrips mīembe-inī atīa?
english: How to manage and control Thrips in mangoes?

kikuyu: Ta thikĩrĩria! Niĩ nĩngwĩkĩra roho wa mũthemba mũna thĩinĩ wake, nĩguo rĩrĩa arĩigua ũhoro mũna, acooke bũrũri wake, na arĩ kũu ndũme ooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.’ ”
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.” ’ ”

kikuyu: No Ahazu akiuga atĩrĩ, “Niĩ ndigwĩtia; niĩ ndikũgeria Jehova.”
english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Ũkai, tũikũrũke tũkahĩngĩcanie rũthiomi rwao, nĩgeetha matigacooke kũiguithania mĩario mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ.”
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

kikuyu: Hihi waru iria njega mūno cia gūkima kana cia kūrīa irī na cumbī mūingī?
english: Best potatoes for mashing or table have a high content of starch?

kikuyu: No makĩgĩa ndundu mamũũkĩrĩre, nao maathĩtwo nĩ mũthamaki-rĩ, makĩmũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto, agĩkuĩra o nja-inĩ ya hekarũ ya Jehova.
english: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Tigīrīra mīharatī ya maaī nī mīiganu nīguo ngūkū ciothe inyue hīndī īmwe. Thambia na ūkamūre mīharatī yothe ya maaī mbere ya kūhūthīra. Ndūkaigīre maaī kwa ihinda rīa ithaa rīmwe kana meerī mbere ya kūhe maaī marī na njanjo nīguo ikorwo inyotiī.
english: Provide sufficient drinkers so that all the chickens can drink at one time. Clean and rinse all the waterers thoroughly before use. Withdraw water from the chickens for 1-2 hours prior to vaccination to stimulate thirst (30-60 minutes in hot climates; 60-90 minutes in cool climates)

kikuyu: Nĩwe wathaga kĩhuhũkanio kĩa iria rĩrĩa inene; rĩrĩa makũmbĩ marĩo mookĩra na igũrũ, nĩũmahooreragia.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

kikuyu: Ningĩ hagĩũka itu, rĩkĩmahumbĩra, na mũgambo ũkiuma itu-inĩ rĩu, ũkiuga atĩrĩ, “Ũyũ nĩwe Mũrũ wakwa, ũrĩa nyendete. Mũiguagei!”
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

english: 9. Mulch with wheat straw or clear/transparent polyethylene sheet as reflectors of UV light discourage aphids from landing on the crop.

english: During dry spells, water the seedlings at least two times a week until they are well established.

kikuyu: Ndionaga thayũ, o na kana ngahoorera; ndionaga ũhurũko, no mĩnyamaro.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
