english: These plants remain stunted and the veins in the stem are black. Heads developed from these plants deteriorate rapidly after harvest.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Isaia aaririe ma rĩrĩa aarathire ũhoro wanyu, inyuĩ hinga ici; o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “ ‘Andũ aya maaheaga gĩtĩĩo na mĩromo, no ngoro ciao ikoragwo irĩ kũraya na niĩ.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jakubu agĩtungata mĩaka mũgwanja nĩguo aheo Rakeli, no harĩ we yarĩ o ta matukũ manini nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa aamwendete.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

kikuyu: Nĩndĩĩhĩtĩte mwĩhĩtwa na ngagwatĩria, atĩ nĩndĩrĩrũmagĩrĩra mawatho maku ma ũthingu.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Athalia aaiguire inegene rĩa andũ makĩhanyũka magĩkũngũyagĩra mũthamaki, agĩthiĩ kũrĩ o kũu hekarũ-inĩ ya Jehova.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Ngai aamaiguire, nĩarakarire mũno; nake agĩtiganĩria Isiraeli o biũ.
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

kikuyu: “Nĩnganeana Zedekia mũthamaki wa Juda na anene ake kũrĩ thũ ciao iria ciendaga kũmaruta muoyo, ndĩmaneane kũrĩ mbũtũ cia ita cia mũthamaki wa Babuloni, icio ciambĩte kũmweherera.
english: “I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army, who has gone away from you.

kikuyu: Kuuma njiaro-nĩ cia Dani: Arũme othe arĩa maakinyĩtie mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, arĩa mangĩahotire gũthiĩ ita-inĩ, makĩandĩkwo o mũndũ o mũndũ na rĩĩtwa rĩake, kũringana na maandĩko ma mbarĩ ciao na nyũmba ciao.
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Aarĩ mũguĩmi warĩ hinya mbere ya Jehova; na nĩkĩo kwĩragwo atĩrĩ, “O ta Nimurodi, mũguĩmi ũrĩ hinya mbere ya Jehova.”
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa akerubi acio maathiiaga, magũrũ macio maarĩ mĩena-inĩ yao namo magathiĩ; na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa akerubi acio maambararia mathagu mao mombũke, magũrũ macio matioimaga mĩena- inĩ yao.
english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

kikuyu: Ngai wa andũ a Isiraeli nĩathuurire maithe maitũ; agĩtũma andũ acio matheereme hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maatũũraga Misiri, na akĩmaruta bũrũri ũcio na hinya mũnene,
english: The God of this people† chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa andũ arĩa othe maarũgamĩte hau kwĩrorera moonire ũrĩa gwekĩka, makĩinũka methikĩire, na makĩĩhũũraga ithũri nĩ kĩeha.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

kikuyu: Musa aikarire na Jehova hau matukũ mĩrongo ĩna, mũthenya na ũtukũ, atekũrĩa irio kana akanyua maaĩ. Na agĩkĩandĩka ihengere-inĩ icio ciugo cia kĩrĩkanĩro kĩu, na nĩcio Maathani marĩa Ikũmi.
english: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

kikuyu: Nao makĩĩrana atĩrĩ, “Ti-itherũ tũraherithio nĩ ũndũ wa mũrũ wa ithe witũ. Nĩtuonire ũrĩa aarĩ na thĩĩna rĩrĩa atũthaithaga tũhonokie muoyo wake, no tũkĩrega kũmũigua; na no kĩo tũnyiitĩtwo nĩ thĩĩna ũyũ.”
english: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

kikuyu: “ ‘No nĩ kwarĩ na nderi ĩngĩ nene yarĩ na mathagu maarĩ na hinya, na maiyũrĩte njoya. Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũthabibũ ũcio ũgĩtwara mĩri yaguo yerekeire na kũrĩ nderi ĩyo uumĩte hau wahaandĩtwo, naguo ũgĩtambũrũkia honge ciaguo harĩ yo nĩguo wone maaĩ.
english: “ ‘ “There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩtũma okĩrĩrwo nĩ andũ, na athuuri, na arutani a watho. Makĩnyiita Stefano makĩmũrehe mbere ya Kĩama.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

kikuyu: Nacio ciama ici nĩ igatwaranaga na arĩa metĩkĩtie: Nĩmakaingata ndaimono thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa; na nĩmakaaria na thiomi njerũ;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Inũka. Mũrũguo nĩekũhona.” Mũndũ ũcio agĩĩtĩkia ũguo Jesũ aamwĩrire, na akĩinũka.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

kikuyu: na angĩkorwo ũgumu ũcio ũrĩ nguo-inĩ, kana rũũa- inĩ, kana taama-inĩ wa ndigi njogothe, kana taama-inĩ o wothe mũtume, kana kĩndũ-inĩ o gĩothe gĩtumĩtwo na rũũa-rĩ, ũgumu ũcio ũngĩkorwo na rangi ta wa nyeki nduru kana mũtune, ũcio nĩ ũgumu ũrathegea, na no nginya wonio mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
english: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

kikuyu: Jehudi aathoma icigo ithatũ kana inya cia ibuku rĩu rĩa gĩkũnjo-rĩ, mũthamaki nake agacitinia na kahiũ ka mwandĩki, agacikia riiko-inĩ, o nginya rĩrĩa ibuku rĩu rĩa gĩkũnjo rĩacinirwo rĩothe.
english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, Wee ũrĩ Mũtheru, Wee ũikarĩire gĩtĩ kĩa ũnene; Wee nĩwe ũgoocagwo nĩ Isiraeli.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

kikuyu: Gĩtarũrũ gĩake akĩnyiitĩte na guoko, na nĩagatheria kĩhuhĩro gĩake, na acookanĩrĩrie ngano yake ikũmbĩ, acooke acine mahuti na mwaki ũtangĩhoreka.”
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Kungīkinyīrīra atī mathangū nīmacurīte mūno, noūhūthīre dawa cia mūhianīre ya fungicide ta Alto na Bayleton iria irutaga wīra wega makīria.
english: In case the infection is severe (20% of leaves have rust), it is necessary to use a systemic fungicide such as Alto or Bayleton.

kikuyu: Jehova agĩtũma andũ acio metĩkĩrĩke nĩ andũ a Misiri nao makĩmahe kĩrĩa gĩothe meetirie; nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩtaha indo cia andũ a Misiri.
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mbere wa kwambĩrĩria kũrĩa Mĩgate ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ Mĩĩkĩre Ndawa ya Kũimbia-rĩ, arutwo magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Jesũ makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Ũkwenda tũkahaarĩrie irio cia Bathaka kũ?”
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Ngʼombe ciao aaciũragire na mbura ya mbembe, na mahiũ mao akĩmahũũra na ngwa.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

kikuyu: “ ‘Na tondũ ndwaririkanire matukũ ma ũnini waku, no kũndakaria wandakaririe na maũndũ macio mothe-rĩ, ti-itherũ nĩngatũma ũcookererwo nĩ ũrĩa wĩkĩte, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga. Githĩ nduongereire ũũra-thoni harĩ maũndũ marĩa mangĩ wĩkaga marĩ magigi?
english: “ ‘ “Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa oimagio-rĩ, agĩtũma ndũmĩrĩri kũrĩ ithe wa mũthuuriwe, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Niĩ ndĩ na nda ya mũndũ ũrĩa mwene indo ici.” Agĩcooka akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ta rora kana no ũmenye nũũ mwene gĩcũhĩ gĩkĩ kĩ na mũhũũri, na rũrigi rũrũ, o na rũthanju rũrũ.”
english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

kikuyu: nĩathaithanagĩrĩra mũndũ kũrĩ Ngai, o ta ũrĩa mũndũ athaithanagĩrĩra mũratawe.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

kikuyu: Ti inyuĩ mwathuurire, no nĩ niĩ ndamũthuurire, na ngĩmwamũra mũthiĩ mũgaciare maciaro, namo maciaro macio matũũre. Nake Baba nĩakamũhe kĩrĩa gĩothe mũkahooya thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

kikuyu: Nake Jusufu agĩkĩĩgũithia thĩ mbere ya ithe, akĩmũrĩrĩra na akĩmũmumunya.
english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

kikuyu: Magĩcooka makĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Twagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩka atĩa nĩgeetha tũrutage mawĩra marĩa Ngai endaga?”
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

kikuyu: Jesũ aarĩkia kũbatithio o ũguo-rĩ, akiumĩra maaĩ-inĩ. Kahinda o kau igũrũ rĩkĩhingũka, nake akĩona Roho wa Ngai agĩikũrũka ta ndutura, akĩũmba igũrũ rĩake.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

kikuyu: Mũnene ũtarĩ na ũtaũku nĩahinyagĩrĩria andũ mũno, no mũndũ ũrĩa ũthũire uumithio ũtagĩrĩire nĩagakenera matukũ maingĩ ma muoyo wake.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩaheire Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni rĩathani rĩrĩ: “Gĩa na hinya na ũũmĩrĩrie, nĩgũkorwo nĩwe ũgũkinyia andũ a Isiraeli bũrũri ũrĩa ndamerĩire na mwĩhĩtwa, na Niĩ mwene nĩngũkorwo ndĩ hamwe nawe.”
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

kikuyu: Cutworms
english: Cutworm

kikuyu: Tũma ũthiũ waku warĩre ndungata yaku; honokia nĩ ũndũ wa wendo waku ũtathiraga.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Nake Reu aakinyia mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ na ĩĩrĩ, agĩtuĩka ithe wa Serugu.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

kikuyu: Weka ũguo-rĩ, nĩũkũmĩigĩrĩra makara ma mwaki mũtwe, nake Jehova nĩagakũrĩha.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa akĩĩra Harũni atĩrĩ, “Oya rũgĩo rwaku ũrwĩkĩre ũbumba hamwe na mwaki wa kuuma kĩgongona-inĩ, na ũthiĩ narua kĩũngano-inĩ kĩu ũkĩhoroherie. Mangʼũrĩ moimĩte kũrĩ Jehova; mũthiro nĩwambĩrĩirie kũmaniina.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Ngai nĩwe ũtũmaga ithuĩ hamwe na inyuĩ twĩhaande wega thĩinĩ wa Kristũ. Nĩwe watũitĩrĩirie maguta,
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

kikuyu: No ndaariũka, nĩngamũtongoria gũthiĩ Galili.”
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: nĩgeetha, “ ‘matũũre maroraga no makaaga kuona, na matũũre maiguaga na matimenye ũndũ; nĩguo hihi matikae kũgarũrũka marekerwo mehia mao!’ ”
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’ ”*

kikuyu: Ariũ a Esheku, mũrũ wa nyina, maarĩ: Ulamu irigithathi rĩake, na Jeushu wa keerĩ, na Elifeleti wa gatatũ.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ-rĩ, atongoria othe a athĩnjĩri-Ngai na andũ nĩmathiire na mbere kwaga wĩhokeku, makĩrũmĩrĩra mĩtugo ĩrĩ magigi ya ndũrĩrĩ, na magathaahagia hekarũ ya Jehova ĩrĩa aamũrĩte kũu Jerusalemu.
english: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted Yahweh’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Maaī no ma bata hari gūthīa irio, gūteithia kūiga mwīrī gīthimo-inī kīega kīa ūrugarī
english: for feed to be digested, to cool the body when it is too hot

kikuyu: Akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Aca, mwathi wakwa, thikĩrĩria; nĩndakũhe gĩthaka kĩu, na nĩndakũhe ngurunga ĩyo ĩrĩ thĩinĩ wakĩo. Ndakũhe andũ akwa makĩonaga. Thika mũtumia waku.”
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, marakara ma Jehova magĩkora Juda na Jerusalemu; nake agĩtũma matuĩke ta kĩndũ gĩa kũmakania na kĩa magigi, na gĩa kũnyũrũrio, o ta ũrĩa mũreyonera na maitho manyu.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

kikuyu: o ta andũ metereire mwathi wao acooke kuuma iruga-inĩ rĩa kĩhikanio, nĩguo rĩrĩa agaacooka, aaringaringa mũrango mamũhingũrĩre o narua.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka agĩtinangia ndũrũme ĩyo icunjĩ, na agĩcina mũtwe na icunjĩ icio na maguta.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

kikuyu: O na ha ũhoro ũkoniĩ indo iria itarĩ muoyo iria igambaga, indo ta mũtũrirũ kana kĩnanda kĩa mũgeeto- rĩ, mũndũ angĩgĩkũũrana atĩa rwĩmbo rũrĩa rũrenda kũinwo, tiga hakorirwo na ngũũrani njega ya mĩgambo?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

kikuyu: Ũhoro ũkoniĩ andũ a Amoni: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Kaĩ Isiraeli atarĩ na aanake? Ndarĩ na andũ a kũmũgaya? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgĩtũmĩte Moleku egwatĩre bũrũri wa Gadi? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte andũ ake matũũre matũũra-inĩ makuo?”
english: Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?

kikuyu: Nĩnjathĩte andũ akwa arĩa atheru, nĩndũmanĩire njamba ciakwa, o icio ikenagĩra ũhootani wakwa, ciũke ikinyanĩrie marakara makwa.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

kikuyu: akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ngaathikĩrĩria ciira waku andũ arĩa magũthitangĩte mooka.” Agĩcooka agĩathana Paũlũ aikare arangĩrĩtwo kũu nyũmba-inĩ ya ũthamaki ya Herode.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

kikuyu: Agĩtũma Eliakimu mũrori wa maũndũ ma nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na Shebina ũrĩa mwandĩki-marũa, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai arĩa atongoria, othe mehumbĩte nguo cia makũnia, mathiĩ kũrĩ mũnabii Isaia mũrũ wa Amozu.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩigua ihooya rĩa Hezekia, akĩhonia andũ acio.
english: Yahweh listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai aarĩkia kũrũgamia mũtumia ũcio mbere ya Jehova, nĩakamuohora njuĩrĩ yake, acooke amũnengere iruta rĩu rĩa kĩririkano rĩa mũtu nĩ ũndũ wa ũiru arĩnyiite na moko, nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai we mwene akorwo anyiitĩte maaĩ macio marũrũ marĩa marehaga kĩrumi.
english: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

kikuyu: Nĩngamũherithia kũringana na ciĩko cianyu, ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. Nĩngaakia mwaki mĩtitũ-inĩ yanyu, ũrĩa ũkaaniina kĩrĩa gĩothe kĩmũrigiicĩirie.’ ” 22
english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.’ ” 22

kikuyu: O na niĩ nĩngwaria; o na niĩ nĩnguuga ũrĩa njũũĩ.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

kikuyu: Nao athĩnjĩri- Ngai magĩcooka magĩthĩnja thenge icio hamwe na thakame yacio, magĩcirutĩra hau kĩgongona-inĩ irĩ maruta ma kũhoroheria mehia nĩguo ihoroherie andũ a Isiraeli othe, nĩ tondũ mũthamaki nĩathanĩte kũrutwo iruta rĩa njino na iruta rĩa kũhoroheria mehia rĩrĩ rĩa andũ othe a Isiraeli.
english: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

kikuyu: Tondũ rĩĩrĩ, ũndũ ũrĩa Ngai endete nĩ atĩ mũtuĩke andũ aamũre: atĩ mwĩtheemage ũmaraya;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

kikuyu: Dukaciaríre waru ciaku ríuaní kahinda karaihu niguo citikome narua na citikagie rangī wa ngirini kuma rangu mweru úria uri rangi wa míthemba mííngi ya waru. No cicenjie úgacíru na gúítíkíríka thoko-ini
english: Do not expose harvested tubers to sunlight for a long time to prevent them from drying out too quickly and avoid greening of the white skin varieties, which would reduce their keeping quality and consumer acceptance.

kikuyu: Musa akĩĩra Jehova atĩrĩ,
english: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

kikuyu: Anjikĩtie ndoro-inĩ, ngatuĩka ta rũkũngũ na ta mũhu.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

kikuyu: Mĩhiano ĩngĩ ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ ya mĩrũũthi yarũgamĩtio ngathĩ-inĩ ĩyo ya makinya matandatũ. O ikinya rĩa ngathĩ rĩarĩ na mũhiano wa mũrũũthi o mwena. Gũtirĩ gĩtĩ kĩngĩ ta kĩu gĩathondeketwo mbere ĩyo gĩa ũthamaki ũngĩ o na ũrĩkũ.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Daudi nĩahũũranire na Hadadezeri mũthamaki wa Zoba, akĩmũingata akĩmũkinyia Hamathu, rĩrĩa mũthamaki ũcio aathiiaga gũtũma wathani wake ũrũme wega ndwere-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Farati.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Jehova nĩakahingia muoroto wake harĩ niĩ; wendo waku, Wee Jehova, nĩ wa tene na tene; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndũgatiganĩrie wĩra wa moko maku.
english: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

kikuyu: Arĩa othe mamwĩtigagĩra nĩamahingagĩria mabataro mao; nĩaiguaga kĩrĩro kĩao na akamahonokia.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, akĩona gĩthima werũ-inĩ, na ndũũru ithatũ cia mbũri ikomete hakuhĩ nakĩo, tondũ cianyuithagio maaĩ kuuma gĩthima-inĩ kĩu. Narĩo ihiga rĩrĩa rĩakunĩkĩte mũromo wa gĩthima kĩu rĩarĩ inenemũno.
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jehova ũrĩa wahonokirie Iburahĩmu ekwĩra nyũmba ya Jakubu atĩrĩ: “Jakubu ndagaaconorithio rĩngĩ; na matigacooka gũtukia ithiithi ciao rĩngĩ.
english: Therefore Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

kikuyu: Mũrutani ekuuga atĩrĩ, “Ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo menyete: “Ngĩringithania ũndũ ũmwe na ũrĩa ũngĩ nĩguo menye mũtabarĩre wa maũndũ-rĩ,
english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩmarutithia wĩra wa hinya; nao makĩhĩngwo na gũkĩaga wa kũmateithia.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

kikuyu: Nĩnjeheretie mahĩtia maku magathira biũ, o ta ũrĩa itu rĩa mbura rĩthiraga, mehia maku ngamaniina ta kĩbii kĩa rũciinĩ. Njookerera tondũ nĩngũkũũrĩte.”
english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

kikuyu: Rĩandĩkithia rĩao, kũringana na nyũmba ciao, rĩatariĩ ta ũũ: Kuuma Juda, anene a ikundi cia 1,000: Adina nĩwe warĩ mũnene wao, aarĩ na andũ 300,000 a kũrũa;
english: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

kikuyu: ndiarĩ na meciiria magima, na ndiarĩ na ũmenyo; ndahaanaga o ta nyamũ ndĩ mbere yaku.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

kikuyu: icio magĩciigĩrĩra ithũri-inĩ, nake Harũni agĩcinĩra maguta macio kĩgongona-inĩ.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

kikuyu: Petero akĩmakiria na guoko na akĩmataarĩria ũrĩa Mwathani aamũrutĩte njeera. Akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ĩrai Jakubu na ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ ũhoro ũcio,” agĩcooka agĩthiĩ kũndũ kũngĩ.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

kikuyu: Andũ etigĩri Ngai magĩthika Stefano na makĩmũcakaĩra mũno.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

kikuyu: nĩgeetha matigari marongoragie Mwathani, o na andũ othe a Ndũrĩrĩ arĩa metanagio na rĩĩtwa rĩakwa, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani ũrĩa wĩkaga maũndũ macio ekuuga’
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’*

kikuyu: Menyagĩrĩra niĩ ta kĩũma kĩa riitho rĩaku; hitha kĩĩruru-inĩ kĩa mathagu maku
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

kikuyu: Ningĩ akĩhumbĩra thĩ ya tũnyũmba twa thĩinĩ na twa nja ya hekarũ na thahabu.
english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

kikuyu: Harí o oúgúo ph ya kuma 5 no íkúrie waru no úcoke wongerere lime tírí íni
english: However, from a soil with pH of 5.0 you can still grow potatoes, but then add lime to the soils.

kikuyu: Ningĩagĩthima mwena wa gathigathini; mũigana waho warĩ mĩkono magana matano ũthimĩtwo na rũthanju rũu rwa gũthima.
english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

kikuyu: Jehova andĩhĩte kũringana na ũthingu wakwa, akandĩha kũringana na ũtheru wa moko makwa maitho-inĩ make.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

kikuyu: Geithiai Mariamu, ũrĩa warutire wĩra na kĩyo kĩnene mũno nĩ ũndũ wanyu.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ĩra Finehasi atĩrĩ, nĩ ngũthondeka kĩrĩkanĩro gĩakwa gĩa thayũ nake.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa andũ othe maakomete-rĩ, thũ yake ĩgĩũka, ĩkĩhura itindiĩ thĩinĩ wa ngano, na ĩgĩĩthiĩra.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds† also among the wheat, and went away.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa gũtigana na kĩrĩndĩ na gũtoonya nyũmba, arutwo ake makĩmũũria ũhoro wa ngerekano ĩyo.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

kikuyu: Nĩngacirĩithagia kũrĩa kũrĩ na ũrĩithio mwega, na irĩma-inĩ cia bũrũri wa Isiraeli nĩkuo gũgaatuĩka bũrũri wacio wa ũrĩithio. Kũu nĩkuo ikaarahaga, bũrũri ũrĩ ũrĩithio mwega, na irĩĩage ũrĩithio-inĩ mũnoru, kũu irĩma-inĩ cia bũrũri wa Isiraeli.
english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

kikuyu: Nĩngũmahurunja ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ iria o ene matooĩ, o na kana maithe mao, njooke ndĩmaingatithie na rũhiũ rwa njora nginya ndĩmaniine biũ.”
english: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”

kikuyu: Arũme othe a ũkũrũ wa kuuma mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ nginya mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtano arĩa mookire gũtungata wĩra-inĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo,
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Makĩanĩrĩra mũthenya wa kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio, na magĩikarĩria Nabothu handũ ekuoneka, gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũrĩa ũmwamũkagĩra, nĩ niĩ amũkagĩra. Nake ũrĩa ũnyamũkagĩra, amũkagĩra ũrĩa wandũmire.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ya ngʼaragu nĩagagũkũũra kuuma kũrĩ gĩkuũ, ningĩ hĩndĩ ya mbaara agũkũũre ndũkooragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

kikuyu: Ithuĩ nĩtũũĩ atĩ Ngai nĩarĩirie Musa, no ha ũhoro wa mũndũ ũyũ-rĩ, tũtiũĩ o na kũrĩa oimĩte.”
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: ũrĩa wamũrũmĩrĩire nĩ Jehozabadu, na aarĩ na andũ 180,000 arĩa maarĩ na indo cia mbaara.
english: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

kikuyu: Athamaki a thĩ nĩmatuĩte itua, na aathani magacookania ndundu, nĩguo mokĩrĩre Mwathani, na mokĩrĩre Ũrĩa wake Mũitĩrĩrie Maguta.’
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’†*

kikuyu: Githĩ Hezekia we mwene ndeheririe kũndũ kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru kwa ngai ĩyo, o na akĩeheria igongona ciayo, na akĩĩra Juda na Jerusalemu atĩrĩ, ‘No nginya mũhooere kĩgongona-inĩ kĩmwe na mũcinagĩre magongona ho’?
english: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio Jakubu agĩthiĩ na mbere na rũgendo rwake, agĩkinya bũrũri wa andũ a mwena wa irathĩro.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jusufu akĩambata agĩthiĩ gũthika ithe. Nao anene othe a Firaũni magĩthiĩ nake, andũ a gĩtĩĩo othe a kĩama kĩa Firaũni o na andũ arĩa atĩĩku a Misiri othe,
english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

kikuyu: “Hĩndĩ ĩyo kĩmenyithia kĩa Mũrũ wa Mũndũ nĩgĩkooneka kũu igũrũ, na ndũrĩrĩ ciothe cia thĩ nĩigacakaya. Nĩikoona Mũrũ wa Mũndũ agĩũka arĩ igũrũ rĩa matu, na arĩ na hinya na riiri mũingĩ.
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Mathiiaga magĩthiũrũrũkaga o kũrĩa angĩmeerekeria thĩ yothe, mageeke o ũrĩa wothe angĩmaatha.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

kikuyu: O na akorwo marĩ na anene kũu Zoani, na mabarũthi mao nĩmakinyĩte Hanesi-rĩ,
english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

kikuyu: Gĩtũmi kĩa Baba kũnyenda nĩ ũndũ nĩndutĩte muoyo wakwa nĩgeetha njooke ndĩwoe rĩngĩ.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, * that I may take it again.

kikuyu: Endaga Jehova Ngai waku na ngoro yaku yothe, na muoyo waku wothe, na hinya waku wothe.
english: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ a nyũmba ya Daudi nĩ meerirwo atĩrĩ, “Andũ a Suriata nĩmanyiitanĩte na andũ a Efiraimu”; nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngoro ya Ahazu o na ngoro cia andũ ake ikĩinaina o ta ũrĩa mĩtĩ ya mũtitũ ĩinainagio nĩ rũhuho.
english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

kikuyu: “No Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli, nĩathuurire kuuma kũrĩ nyũmba iitũ yothe nduĩke mũthamaki wa Isiraeli nginya tene. Nĩathuurire Juda atuĩke mũtongoria, na kuuma nyũmba ya Juda agĩthuura nyũmba ya baba, na kuuma kũrĩ ariũ a baba akĩona kwagĩrĩire aandue niĩ mũthamaki wa Isiraeli yothe.
english: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

kikuyu: Gutheria mūgūnda
english: Maintain field hygiene

kikuyu: Hau hakuhĩ nao nĩ haarĩ na ndigithũ ithathatũ cia maaĩ ciathondeketwo na ihiga, mũthemba ũrĩa wahũthagĩrwo nĩ Ayahudi magongona-inĩ mao ma gwĩtheria,† na o ĩmwe yaiyũragio nĩ ngeereni kuuma mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ nginya mĩrongo ĩtatũ.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes† apiece.

kikuyu: Teithũra muoyo wakwa kuuma harĩ rũhiũ rwa njora, ũteithũre muoyo wakwa wa goro harĩ hinya wa magui.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

kikuyu: 25% mūthanga: wa kūrigīrīria kwaraha kwa maaī ma mbura
english: 25% sand: For that just-right drainage

kikuyu: mũrore ũrĩa kũirigĩtwo na hinya, na mũrore ciikaro iria ngitĩre cia mũthamaki, nĩgeetha mũkeeraga rũciaro rũrĩa rũgooka ũhoro wacio.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

kikuyu: Nake Jehoshafatu nĩaakire marikabu nyingĩ cia wonjoria, cia gũthiĩ kũgĩĩra thahabu Ofiri, no itiigana gũthiĩ, tondũ nĩcioinĩkangĩire kũu Ezioni-Geberi.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: Ihinda rĩa mĩthenya mũgwanja, mũkaarĩĩaga mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia. Mũthenya wa mbere mũkeeheria ndawa ya kũimbia kuuma nyũmba cianyu,† nĩgũkorwo mũndũ o wothe ũngĩrĩa kĩndũ kĩrĩ ndawa ya kũimbia kuuma mũthenya wa mbere nginya wa mũgwanja-rĩ, nĩakaingatwo eherio harĩ andũ a Isiraeli.
english: “ ‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

kikuyu: Na nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũgĩikara kũu Kadeshi matukũ maingĩ, ihinda rĩu rĩothe mwaikarire kuo.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa maamwĩrire maũndũ marĩa mothe Jusufu aamerĩte, na rĩrĩa onire makaari marĩa Jusufu aatũmĩte ma kũmũkuua mamũtware Misiri-rĩ, roho wa Jakubu ithe wao ũkĩarahũka.
english: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

kikuyu: Ituda riri rīa gikīro kia igūru, mbegu ni ya saizi nini/gatagatī-inī na rītirī fibre.
english: Early cultivar of excellent fruit quality, small/medium seed size, free from fibres

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũndũ mũrũme angĩkoma na mũtumia wa ithe, nĩaconorithĩtie ithe. Mũndũ mũrũme ũcio na mũtumia ũcio eerĩ no nginya mooragwo; thakame yao nĩĩkamacookerera.
english: “ ‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

kikuyu: Kana no niĩ tũrĩ na Baranaba arĩ o nginya tũrutage wĩra nĩguo tuone ũteithio witũ?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

kikuyu: “Atĩrĩrĩ, wee itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene inyamarie, o wee ũthukathukĩtwo nĩ ihuhũkanio, na ũkaaga wa gũkũhooreria, nĩngagwaka na mahiga ma rangi wa mĩthemba mĩingĩ, nayo mĩthingi yaku ndĩmĩake na mahiga ma yakuti.
english: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

kikuyu: Akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Thiĩi thĩ yothe mũkahunjĩrie andũ othe Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ andũ matiakagia tawa magacooka kũũkunĩkĩrana mbakũri; handũ ha ũguo, maũigagĩrĩra igũrũ handũ haguo, naguo ũkamũrĩkĩra andũ othe arĩa marĩ thĩinĩ wa nyũmba.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

kikuyu: Mũtumia ũcio akĩinũka mũciĩ agĩkora kaana gake gakomete ũrĩrĩ-inĩ na ndaimono ĩrĩkĩtie gũthiĩ.
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, rĩu Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Mĩaka ĩtatũ ĩtanathira, ĩtarĩtwo ta ũrĩa mĩaka ya mũndũ wandĩkĩtwo wĩra ĩrĩkanagĩrwo-rĩ, riiri wa Moabi hamwe na andũ ake othe nĩũkanyararwo, namo matigari make makorwo marĩ manini mũno na makahinyara.”
english: But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa tũrumbeta tweerĩ twahuhwo hamwe, kĩrĩndĩ gĩothe gĩkongana harĩwe hau itoonyero-inĩ rĩa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Mũira mwĩhokeku ndaheenanagia, no mũira wa maheeni aaragia o maheeni.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Ithe wao akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Agereire njĩra ĩrĩkũ?” Nao ariũ ake makĩmuonia njĩra ĩrĩa mũndũ ũcio wa Ngai woimĩte Juda aagereire.
english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Hebironi maarĩ: Kora, na Tapua, na Rekemu, na Shema.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

kikuyu: Monganaga hamwe nĩguo mokĩrĩre mũndũ ũrĩa mũthingu, na magatuĩra mũndũ ũtehĩtie ooragwo.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

kikuyu: Rĩĩtwa rĩake rĩrotũũra nginya tene; rĩrotũũra o ta ũrĩa riũa rĩgũtũũra. Ndũrĩrĩ ciothe nĩikarathimwo nĩ ũndũ wake, nacio imwĩtage mũndũ mũrathime.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo nĩũgatũma mahũndũke moore rĩrĩa makoona ũgeetete ũta waku ũmarathe.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

kikuyu: “ ‘No nginya mwehanĩrĩrie andũ a Isiraeli na indo iria ingĩmagwatia thaahu, nĩgeetha matikanakue marĩ na thaahu nĩ ũndũ wa gũthaahia gĩikaro gĩakwa kĩrĩa kĩrĩ gatagatĩ kao.’ ”
english: “ ‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’ ”

kikuyu: “Nĩnengeretwo maũndũ mothe nĩ Baba. Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũũĩ Mũriũ tiga Ithe, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũũĩ Ithe tiga Mũriũ, na arĩa Mũriũ, endaga kũguũrĩria.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

kikuyu: O rũbaũ-inĩ rũkorwo rũrĩ rwa mĩkono ikũmi† kũraiha na mũkono ũmwe na nuthu‡ kwarama,
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

kikuyu: “ ‘Watho wa iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia na wa iruta rĩa irĩhi rĩa mahĩtia no ũmwe: nyama ciamo nĩ cia mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa ũkũhorohanĩria nacio.
english: “ ‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

kikuyu: Nake Mariamu Mũmagidali na Mariamu ũrĩa nyina wa Jose makĩona harĩa aigirwo.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

kikuyu: Mbere ya gūthura mbeū, mūndū nīarabatara gūthura na gūīkīra rūūri mītī īrīa mīega īrīhūthagīrwo kūruta mbeū na mīrūri ya gūciarithania.
english: Prior to seed collection, one needs to select and mark good mango mother trees to use as sources of high quality seed and scions.

kikuyu: Kuuma kũrĩ andũ a Iziharu: Kenania na ariũ ake nĩmaheirwo mawĩra na kũu nja ya hekarũ matuĩke anene na aciirithania a Isiraeli.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

kikuyu: Maembe macagūranagio na irathi kūringana na ithimi iria ciītīkīrītwo cia thoko.
english: Grade mangoes based on the standard criteria accepted by the industry.

kikuyu: magĩtũmana, makiuga Jeremia arutwo kũu thĩinĩ wa nja ĩrĩa ya arangĩri. Nao makĩmũneana harĩ Gedalia mũrũ wa Ahikamu, mũrũ wa Shafani, nĩguo amũinũkie gwake mũciĩ. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩtũũrania na andũ arĩa angĩ ao.
english: sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should bring him home. So he lived among the people.

kikuyu: Itambaya ciothe cia gũcuurio iria ciathiũrũrũkĩirie nja ciarĩ cia gatani yogothetwo wega.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Mūkamo mūnene wonanagia iria rīingī. Ningī wīgayanitie maita mana maiganaine na ūhūaga wega thutha wa gūkamwo.
english: A large udder indicates high milk production. Ideally, quarters are evenly balanced, soft, and well-collapsed after milking.

kikuyu: Na ithuĩ tũgĩgũcookeria atĩrĩ, ‘Tũrĩ na ithe witũ mũthuuri mũkũrũ mũno, na kũrĩ kamwana kanini aaciarĩirwo ũkũrũ-inĩ wake. Mũrũ-wa-nyina na kamwana kau nĩ mũkuũ, na nowe wiki wa ariũ a nyina ũtigarĩte, na ithe nĩamwendete mũno.’
english: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

kikuyu: nake Jehova agĩĩka ũrĩa Musa aamũhoire; nacio ngi ikĩeherera Firaũni, na anene ake, na andũ ake, na gũtirĩ ngi yatigarire.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ndũkanakome na mũtumia wa mũndũ ũngĩ, ndũgethaahie nake.
english: “ ‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa mwehĩria ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ na njĩra ĩyo, na mũgatiihia thamiri ciao icio itarĩ hinya-rĩ, nĩ Kristũ mwehĩria.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

kikuyu: Nyumba īno ībatiī gūkorwo īrī ya futi 100-150 harī o ng'ombe, nayo floo īkorwo īitītwo mūthanga, tīiri ūtarī mūnyitu kana wa rīumba nīguo kūhotithia ūtherū na ng'ombe kūrūgama wega.
english: The pen should provide 100-150 ft2 for each cow with flooring preferably of sand, dirt, or clay to aid in clean up and footing of the cow

kikuyu: Mwaka ũwĩkĩrĩte thũmbĩ ya wega waku, namo makaari maku makaiyũrĩrĩra bũthi mũingĩ.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

kikuyu: tũkamũmagĩrĩria, na tũkamũhooreragia, o na tũkamũringagĩrĩria mũtũũre mĩtũũrĩre yaganĩrĩire na ũrĩa Ngai endaga, o we ũmwĩtaga mũtoonye thĩinĩ wa ũthamaki wake, na mũgĩe na riiri wake.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

kikuyu: Nũũ ũkũnginyia itũũra rĩrĩa inene rĩirigĩre? Nũũ ũkũndongoria andware Edomu?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũtongu ũtarĩ na ũmenyo atariĩ o ta nyamũ iria ikuuaga igathira.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Rĩrĩa mũkũhooya, ugagai atĩrĩ: “ ‘Ithe witũ (ũrĩ Igũrũ), rĩĩtwa rĩaku nĩrĩamũrwo, ũthamaki waku nĩũũke. (Ũrĩa wendete nĩwĩkagwo gũkũ thĩ, o ta ũrĩa gwĩkagwo kũu igũrũ.)
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: O rĩngĩ kiugo kĩa Jehova nĩkĩanginyĩrĩire, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: Ingĩũmbũka na mathagu ma gũgĩkĩa, ingĩthiĩ gũtũũra mũrĩmo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa iria, kũndũ kũraya mũno,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

kikuyu: Geithiai Anderoniko na Juniasi, andũ a mũhĩrĩga witũ arĩa tuohetwo hamwe. Nao nĩ marĩ igweta gatagatĩ-inĩ ka atũmwo, o na ningĩ nĩmatuĩkire a Kristũ mbere yakwa.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

kikuyu: Nao eerĩ makĩoya mwĩrĩ wa Jesũ, makĩwoha na mataama ma gatani hamwe na mĩtukanio ĩyo mĩnungi wega, kũringana na mĩtugo ya Ayahudi ya gũthikana.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

kikuyu: “Tiira maitho wĩrorere mĩena yothe: One ũrĩa andũ othe monganĩte magooka harĩwe, nao ariũ aku makoima kũndũ kũraya, nao airĩtu aku magooka makuuĩtwo na moko.
english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

kikuyu: Ngui nĩikarĩa andũ a Baasha arĩa magaakuĩra itũũra-inĩ inene, nacio nyoni cia rĩera-inĩ irĩe arĩa magaakuĩra mĩgũnda-inĩ.”
english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

kikuyu: Rĩu nĩndĩhaarĩirie kũmũceerera ihinda rĩa gatatũ, na ndigũkorwo ndĩ mũrigo harĩ inyuĩ, tondũ ti indo cianyu ndĩrenda, no nĩ inyuĩ ndĩrenda. Tondũ-rĩ, ciana itiagĩrĩirwo nĩ kũigĩra aciari a cio mũthithũ, no aciari nĩo magĩrĩirwo nĩ kũigĩra ciana ciao mũthithũ.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

kikuyu: o nginya rĩrĩa ngaatua thũ ciaku gaturwa ka makinya maku.” ’
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.” ’*

kikuyu: Mũnyũrũrania acaragia ũũgĩ na ndangĩwona, no kũgĩa na ũmenyo nĩ ũhũthũ kũrĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũkũũranaga maũndũ.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũrĩa wothe ũngĩona wa gwĩka na guoko gwaku-rĩ, wĩke na hinya waku wothe, tondũ mbĩrĩra-inĩ kũrĩa ũrorete, gũtirĩ kũruta wĩra kana gwĩciiria, kana kũmenya maũndũ, o na kana ũũgĩ.
english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol,† where you are going.

kikuyu: Nī maūndū marīkū mangībatara gwīcūrania rīrīa tūratua ngūrani cia waru?
english: What are some of the factors to consider in potato grading?

kikuyu: Moima Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Sheferu, magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Harada.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

kikuyu: Akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, haha nĩho handũ ha gĩtĩ gĩakwa gĩa ũthamaki, o na nĩho handũ ha gũkinyithia makinya makwa. Haha nĩho ngũtũũra ndĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ a Isiraeli nginya tene. Nyũmba ya Isiraeli ndĩrĩ hĩndĩ ĩngĩ ĩgaacooka gũthaahia rĩĩtwa rĩakwa itheru, o ene o na kana athamaki ao marĩthaahie na ũndũ wa ũmaraya wao na kũhooya mĩhianano ĩtarĩ muoyo ya athamaki ao kũndũ kwao kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ngʼondu ikaarĩĩaga ta irĩ ũrĩithio-inĩ wacio; natuo tũgondu tũkaarĩithagio kũndũ kũrĩa kwanangĩku gwa itonga.
english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

kikuyu: Mahuti mothe ma mīmera ya hau kabere yagīrīirwo nīgūcinwo kana gūthikuo irima-inī rīriku.
english: All crop residues should be removed and destroyed by burning or burying in deep pits.

kikuyu: Mũtumia wake Hushimu akĩmũciarĩra Ahitubu na Elipaali.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

kikuyu: nginya akaaya gũtheecwo ini nĩ mĩguĩ, akahaana ta nyoni ĩguthũkĩte mũtego-inĩ, ĩtekũmenya o na hanini atĩ ũndũ ũcio no ũmĩrute muoyo.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

kikuyu: Na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ a kũu maamenyire atĩ nĩ Jesũ, makĩhunjia ũhoro ngʼongo ciothe iria ciamarigiicĩirie. Nao makĩmũrehera andũ othe arĩa maarĩ arũaru,
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

kikuyu: nĩmahĩtĩtie ũhoro-inĩ wa ũthingu, nĩgũkorwo ndĩrathiĩ kũrĩ Baba kũrĩa mũtangĩcooka kũnyona;
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio tũgĩikara kũu gĩtuamba-inĩ hakuhĩ na Bethi-Peori.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

kikuyu: Niĩ ndĩ na ũmenyo mũingĩ gũkĩra arutani akwa othe, nĩgũkorwo ndaranagia ũhoro wa mawatho maku.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

kikuyu: Na makĩria ma ũguo-rĩ, tondũ mationire bata wa gũtũũra mamenyete Ngai, nake akĩmarekereria magĩe na meciiria ma ũmaramari, mekage maũndũ marĩa mataagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩkwo.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

kikuyu: Nao makĩĩra Harũni atĩrĩ, ‘Tũthondekere ngai iria irĩtũtongoragia. Nĩgũkorwo mũndũ ũyũ ũgwĩtwo Musa, ũrĩa watũtongoririe tũkiuma bũrũri wa Misiri, tũtiũĩ ũrĩa onete!’
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’*

kikuyu: Ariũ a Elipaali maarĩ: Eberi, na Mishamu, na Shemedi (ũrĩa wakire Ono, o na Lodi na matũũra marĩa maakũrigiicĩirie),
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

kikuyu: No arĩ o muoyo-rĩ, akĩhe ariũ a thuriya* ciake iheo, agĩcooka akĩmeheranĩria na mũriũ Isaaka magĩthiĩ na kũu bũrũri wa irathĩro.
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio wothe na ũtukũ, na mũthenya ũcio ũngĩ wothe, andũ acio makiumagara makĩũngania tũmakia-arũme. Gũtirĩ mũndũ wonganirie thuutha wa homeri ikũmi.* Ningĩ magĩtwanĩka gũthiũrũrũkĩria kambĩ yothe.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers;† and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

kikuyu: Kũu nĩkuo Jehova Mwene-Hinya agaakorwo hamwe na ithuĩ. Nakuo kũu gũgaatuĩka ta kũndũ kwa njũũĩ njariĩ, o na tũrũũĩ, njũũĩ itakagererio marikabu cia mbaara, kana igererio marikabu iria nene cia iria-inĩ.
english: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

kikuyu: Nake Jakubu agĩĩka o ũguo. Akĩrĩkia kiumia kĩa Lea, nake Labani akĩmũnengera mwarĩ Rakeli atuĩke mũtumia wake.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio mũrũ wa nyina agĩciarwo guoko gwake kũnyiitĩte ndiira ya Esaũ; tondũ ũcio agĩtuuo Jakubu. Isaaka aarĩ na mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtandatũ rĩrĩa Rebeka aaciarire twana tũu.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ moe indo ciothe iria ihũthagĩrwo ũtungata-inĩ wa handũ-harĩa-haamũre, macikũnje na gĩtambaya kĩa rangi wa bururu, macihumbĩre na gĩthii kĩa njũũa cia pomboo, na maciigĩrĩre igũrũ rĩa gĩkuui gĩacio.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩũria arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ atĩrĩ, “O na inyuĩ kaĩ mũrenda gũthiĩ?”
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

kikuyu: na Azamavethu ũrĩa Mũbahurimu, na Eliahaba ũrĩa Mũshaaliboni,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

kikuyu: Gīkīro gia kana: Ūcoke ūbure mathangū kuuma nathī ūgītigagia manini.
english: Step 4: Remove the leaves from the bottom third of the cutting.

kikuyu: Wohaga magũrũ makwa na mĩnyororo; ũrangagĩra njĩra ciakwa ciothe na ũndũ wa gũcora njoro makinya ma magũrũ makwa.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

kikuyu: Thondeka itugĩ cia mũgaa nĩ ũndũ wa kĩgongona na ũcigemie na gĩcango.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ ũcio akĩnjĩĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, ta rora na maitho maku, na ũigue na matũ maku, na ũrũmbũiye wega maũndũ mothe marĩa ngũkuonia, nĩgũkorwo nĩkĩo gĩtũmĩte wee ũrehwo gũkũ. Ĩra andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli maũndũ mothe marĩa ũkuona.”
english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Mũirĩtu ũrĩa mũkũrũ agĩciara kahĩĩ na agĩgatua Moabi, na nĩwe ithe wa andũ a Moabi gwata ũmũthĩ.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

kikuyu: Aatũranirie rwaro rwa ihiga, namo maaĩ magĩtothoka; magĩgĩtherera ta rũũĩ kũu werũ-inĩ.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

kikuyu: nĩũgaatua irĩhi rĩa mũndũ mũrũme wa kuuma mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ nginya mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtandatũ rĩkorwo rĩrĩ cekeri mĩrongo ĩtano cia betha,* kũringana na cekeri† ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre,
english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel† of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩa aakinyire Kĩhingo- inĩ kĩa Benjamini, mũnene wa arangĩri ũrĩa wetagwo Irija mũrũ wa Shelemia, mũrũ wa Hanania, akĩmũnyiita, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Wee nĩ kũũra ũroora ũthiĩ ũkeneane kũrĩ andũ a Babuloni!”

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu; mwĩamũrei na mwĩtherie, tondũ niĩ ndĩ mũtheru. Mũtikanethaahie na kĩũmbe o gĩothe kĩrĩa gĩtambaga thĩ.
english: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

kikuyu: Nduĩkĩte mũrũ wa nyina na mbwe, ngatuĩka mũthiritũ wa ndundu.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ aatoonya Jerusalemu, agĩthiĩ hekarũ-inĩ. Na aarĩkia kwĩrorangĩra maũndũ mothe, akiumagara agĩthiĩ Bethania hamwe na arutwo arĩa ikũmi na eerĩ, tondũ kwarĩ hwaĩ-inĩ.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo, Wee Jehova, nĩũngenetie nĩ ũndũ wa ciĩko ciaku; nĩngũina ngenete nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wa moko maku.
english: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Nĩguo ndikanae gwĩtũũgĩria nĩ ũndũ wa ũguũrio mũnene ũguo-rĩ, nĩndekĩrirwo mũigua thĩinĩ wa mwĩrĩ wakwa, ũrĩ mũtũmwo wa Shaitani, nĩguo ũũnyariirage.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩagacooka arute ĩyo ĩngĩ ĩrĩ iruta rĩa njino o ta ũrĩa gũtuĩtwo, na amũhoroherie mehia marĩa ekĩte, nake nĩakarekerwo.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Ningĩ no agĩcookerie ndungata ĩyo ngaatho nĩ gwĩka ũrĩa ĩĩrĩtwo ĩĩke?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

kikuyu: “Gũtwarana na rũgongo rũu rwa athĩnjĩri-Ngai-rĩ, Alawii nĩmakagaya gĩcigo kĩa mĩkono 25,000, na wariĩ wa mĩkono 10,000. Ũraihu wakĩo wothe ũgaakorwo ũrĩ mĩkono 25,000, naguo wariĩ wakĩo ũkorwo ũrĩ wa mĩkono 10,000.
english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

kikuyu: īīnīyagīrīire, tiga angīkorwo mūkorobia ūrakūra kūndū kuraga mbura makīria ma iji 40 kana milimita 1061 cia mbura o mwaka.
english: Yes they do, unless the crop is growing in an area that receives 0ver 40 inches or 1,016mm of rain annually.

kikuyu: Akĩigaikundiciathigarimatũũra-inĩmanenemothemarĩamairigĩtwonathingociahinya ma Juda, na agĩaka kambĩ cia thigari kũu Juda na matũũra-inĩ ma Efiraimu marĩa ithe Asa aatunyanĩte.
english: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

kikuyu: Andũ ao arĩa maangĩarũire mbaara kuuma mĩhĩrĩga-inĩ yothe ya Isakaru, kũringana na maandĩko ma njiarwa ciao, maarĩ 87,000 marĩ othe.
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma ũthiũ wakwa ũmoomĩre. O na angĩkorwo nĩmoimĩte mwaki- inĩ-rĩ, no nginya mwaki ũcio ũkaamacina ũmaniine. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩguo inyuĩ mũkaamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, rĩrĩa ngatũma ũthiũ wakwa ũmoomĩre.
english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.

kikuyu: Maũndũ macio mathondeketwo o rĩu, na ti ma tene; ndũrĩ waigua ũhoro ũcio, waũigua ũmũthĩ. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndũngiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Maũndũ macio nĩndamenyete ũhoro wamo.’
english: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aakinyire-rĩ, mũthamaki akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Mikaya, tũthiĩ tũkahũũranĩre itũũra rĩa Ramothu-Gileadi, kana tũtigaathiĩ?” Nake Mikaya akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Rĩtharĩkĩre na ũhootane, tondũ Jehova nĩekũrĩneana moko-inĩ ma mũthamaki.”
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova na kĩnanda kĩa mũgeeto; mũinĩrei na kĩnanda kĩrĩa kĩgeete na nga ikũmi.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, tũticũthagĩrĩria kĩrĩa kĩroneka, no tũcũthagĩrĩria kĩrĩa gĩtonekaga. Nĩgũkorwo kĩrĩa kĩonekaga nĩ gĩa kahinda, no kĩrĩa gĩtonekaga nĩ gĩa gũtũũra tene na tene. 5
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

kikuyu: Tukania gīcunji kimwe kīa Ammonia na maaī icunjī mugwanja
english: Ammonia spray • Mix 1 part ammonia with 7 parts water.

kikuyu: Mĩrumbĩ ya ciũmbe iria irĩ muoyo nĩĩgatũũra muoyo kũrĩa guothe rũũĩ rũu rũgaathereragĩra. Nĩgũkaagĩa thamaki nyingĩ, tondũ maaĩ macio nĩkuo mathereragĩra, magatũma maaĩ macio marĩ na cumbĩ magĩre; nĩ ũndũ ũcio kũrĩa rũũĩ rũu rũthereragĩra, ciũmbe ciothe nĩigatũũra muoyo.
english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, ha ũhoro wa andũ arĩa ngoro ciao ciĩyamũrĩire mĩhiano ĩyo mĩũru na mĩhianano ĩyo ĩrĩ magigi, nĩngatũma o ene macookererwo nĩ ũũru ũrĩa mekĩte, ũguo nĩguo Mwathani Jehova ekuuga.”
english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Maithe manyu ma tene maarĩĩaga mana marĩ werũ-inĩ, na no maakuire.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

kikuyu: Thoguo na maitũguo marocanjamũka nĩ ũndũ waku; mũtumia ũrĩa wagũciarire arokena!
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

kikuyu: “Rũgamai handũ harĩa hatheru mũrĩ na gĩkundi kĩa Alawii, kĩrũgamĩrĩire o gakundi ka nyũmba cia andũ a bũrũri wanyu arĩa matarĩ Alawii.
english: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.

kikuyu: Mīharatī īno ībatiī gūtūra, īkorwo īrī mīrūmu, mīhūthū gūthambia na kūihūria maaī. Mīthemba nīta ikombe, ikombe cia plastiki ingīcurio, kama mīnyonyi ya kūnyuīra.
english: Should be durable, strong, stable, easy to clean and fill Troughs, cups, hanging plastic containers or nipple drinkers can be used.

kikuyu: Niĩ nĩngenagĩra Jehova mũno; ngoro yakwa ĩcanjamũkaga nĩ ũndũ wa Ngai wakwa. Nĩgũkorwo nĩahumbĩte ũhonokio ta nguo, na akaahumba nguo ndaaya ya ũthingu, o ta ũrĩa mũhikania agemagia mũtwe wake na kĩremba taarĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na ta ũrĩa mũhiki egemagia na mathaga make ma goro.
english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

kikuyu: Igũrũ rĩa kĩgongona kĩa Jehova kĩrĩa Solomoni aakĩte mbere ya gĩthaku, hau nĩho Solomoni arutĩire Jehova maruta ma njino,
english: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on Yahweh’s altar which he had built before the porch,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, reke ngũtaare ũrĩa ũngĩhota kũhonokia muoyo waku na muoyo wa mũrũguo Solomoni.
english: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩ, andũ arĩa aaganu marekagwo matũũre muoyo nĩkĩ, magakũra o na magakĩrĩrĩria kũgĩa na ũhoti?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

kikuyu: “ ‘Ngombo cianyu cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja iriumaga ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ iria imũrigiicĩirie; kuuma kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ icio no mũgũrage ngombo.
english: “ ‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

kikuyu: Ũtũtuĩte kĩndũ gĩa kũrũagĩrwo nĩ arĩa tũriganĩtie nao, nacio thũ ciitũ igatũnyũrũria.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

kikuyu: SL 28 yacagūrirwo kuuma mūgūnda-inī wa Scott Laboratories īrīa rīū niyo National Agricultural Laboratories, NARL Kabete na waciarithanirio kuuma kūrī mūthemba ūngī warutītwo Tanzania ya rūgongo mwaka-inī wa 1931 ūrīa ūrī ūhoti wa gūītiria wagi wa maaī.
english: The SL 28 cultivar was selected at the former Scott Laboratories (now the National Agricultural Laboratories, NARL situated at Kabete) on a single tree basis from the Tanganyika Drought Resistant variety selected in Northern Tanzania in 1931.

kikuyu: Musa akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Etererai nyambe nduĩrie ũhoro wa ũrĩa Jehova egwathana ũhoro wanyu.”
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

kikuyu: Mĩthiithũ yumanĩte na ungumania ndĩrĩ kĩguni, no ũthingu ũkũũraga mũndũ kuuma kũrĩ gĩkuũ.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, matiigana kũnjigua kana kũrũmbũiya ũhoro ũcio; handũ ha gwĩka ũguo-rĩ, maarũmĩrĩirie ũremi wa ngoro ciao njũru. Nao maacookire na thuutha, makĩaga gũthiĩ na mbere.
english: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

kikuyu: Endiai indo iria mũrĩ nacio mũcooke mũteithie athĩĩni. Mwĩthondekerei ibeeti cia mbeeca iria itangĩtarũka, na mwĩgĩĩre na kĩgĩĩna igũrũ kĩrĩa gĩtangĩthira, kũrĩa gũtarĩ mũici ũngĩkuhĩrĩria na gũtirĩ memenyi cia gũkĩananga
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

kikuyu: hamwe na athamaki na aheani kĩrĩra a gũkũ thĩ arĩa meeyakĩire kũndũ kũrĩa kwanangĩku rĩngĩ,
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

kikuyu: Mũkoinanga igongona ciacio, na mũharaganie mahiga mao marĩa maamũre, na mũcine itugĩ cia Ashera ciacio; mũtemange mĩhianano ya ngai ciao, na mũtharie marĩĩtwa ma cio mehere kũndũ kũu.
english: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

kikuyu: Nī ngumo irīkū cia mīthemba ya waru ya Kerr wa pink?
english: What are the features Kerr’s pink potato variety?

kikuyu: Nĩ kũrĩ ngai yanageria kwĩyoera rũrĩrĩ ĩrũrutĩte thĩinĩ wa rũrĩa rũngĩ, na ũndũ wa magerio, na kũringa ciama, na morirũ, na kũhũũrana mbaara, na gwĩka maũndũ na njara ĩrĩ na hinya na guoko gũtambũrũkĩtio; o na kana ciĩko ingĩ nene na cia gwĩtigĩrwo ta maũndũ marĩa mothe Jehova Ngai wanyu aamwĩkĩire kũu bũrũri wa Misiri mũkĩĩonagĩra na maitho?
english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

kikuyu: Nake Ngai Mwene-Hinya-Wothe arotũma mũiguĩrwo tha nĩ mũndũ ũcio, nĩgeetha etĩkĩre mũcooke na mũrũ wa thoguo wanyu ũcio ũngĩ o na Benjamini. Hakwa-rĩ, akorwo nĩ ngũkuĩrwo-rĩ, nĩ nguĩrwo.”
english: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Sarai aarĩ thaata; ndaarĩ na ciana.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa mookire harĩ Jesũ, makĩona mũndũ ũrĩa warĩ na Legioni ya ndaimono aikarĩte thĩ hau, ehumbĩte nguo na arĩ na meciiria mega; nao magĩĩtigĩra.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Afarisai amwe maarĩ gĩkundi-inĩ kĩu makĩĩra Jesũ atĩrĩ, “Mũrutani, kaania arutwo aku!”
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

kikuyu: Kūruta mahuti mothe mbere ya kūgetha ti wega tondū nī gūtumaga marigū meruhe na ihenya mūmera ūtagimarīte wega.
english: Complete deleafing of the plant prior to harvesting is not recommended as this starts the ripening process, before the plant is actually ready

kikuyu: Aakuire arĩ mũkũrũ mũno, arĩkĩtie gũkenera gũtũũra gwake matukũ maingĩ, na arĩ mũtongu, na agatĩĩo. Mũriũ Solomoni nĩwe wathamakire ithenya rĩake.
english: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: No Solomoni ndaatuire andũ a Isiraeli ngombo cia wĩra wake; acio nĩo maarĩ andũ ake a kũrũa mbaara, o na aathi a anene ake, na aathi a ngaari ciake cia ita, na atwari a ngaari icio.
english: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ũthondeke ngathĩka mĩrongo ĩtano cia gĩcango, na ũcitoonyie ciana-inĩ nĩgeetha hema ĩyo ĩtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmwe.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

kikuyu: Nīwega wa kūhe ngūkū irio ina ūtonga wa indio ciothe iria ibataranagia nīguo ikorwo na ūgima mwega wa mwīrī na irekie matumbī mega.
english: It’s important to provide a balanced diet to ensure the chickens are healthy and produce high-quality eggs.

kikuyu: Mīgūnda ya mīkorobia īrīa ītarī na ūgitīīrī no ītūme mītī īhome, maaī maingī kūūra na riūa na tīīrī gūkuo nī kīguū, mītī gūita mathangū, honge kunīkanga, matunda kūgīa ironda kana kūgīa rangi wa gītīri.
english: Unprotected avocado orchards will be affected by stunted growth, increased evaporation and erosion, defoliation, damaged branches, bruised or even blown off fruits.

kikuyu: Nao andũ othe makĩgega makĩũrania atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ ũrutani ũyũ ũhaana atĩa? Araatha ngoma thũku arĩ na wathani na hinya, nacio ikoima!”
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

english: Cock replaced after 2 years or less to avoid inbreeding

english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

english: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.
