kikuyu: Wee Jehova, hatũra kuuma moko-inĩ ma andũ arĩa ooru; ngitĩra harĩ andũ arĩa mahũthagĩra ũhinya,
english: Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

kikuyu: Andũ a Arivadi na Heleki nĩo maarangagĩra thingo ciaku mĩena yothe; nao andũ a Gamadi nĩo maakoragwo marĩ mĩthiringo-inĩ yaku ĩrĩa mĩraihu na igũrũ. Maacuuragia ngo ciao gũthiũrũrũkĩria thingo ciaku; magĩtũma ũthaka waku ũkinyanĩre.
english: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.

kikuyu: No tūthondeke rūrenda rwa kwīgitīra.
english: May spin protective silk web.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jakubu akĩheenia Labani ũcio Mũsuriata tondũ ndaamwĩrire nĩ kũũra aroora.
english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

kikuyu: Maitho ma mũndũ mwĩtĩĩi nĩmagaconorithio, naguo mwĩtĩĩo wa andũ nĩũkaharũrũkio; no Jehova we wiki nĩwe ũgaatũũgĩrio mũthenya ũcio.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

kikuyu: Gwika úú ní gwa bata níundu wa maundû matiganíte.
english: This practice is crucial for several reasons.

kikuyu: “Mũici angĩnyiitwo agĩtua nyũmba nake agũthwo akue-rĩ, mũmũgũthi ndarĩ na ihĩtia rĩa gũita thakame;
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

kikuyu: “Nĩtuonete mũndũ ũyũ arĩ mũndũ wa kũrehe thĩĩna, na nĩarehete ngũĩ gatagatĩ-inĩ ka Ayahudi kũndũ guothe thĩinĩ wa thĩ. We nĩ mũtongoria wa gĩkundi kĩrĩa gĩĩtagwo Anazari,
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

kikuyu: Nao acio aathĩrĩirie o mbere, nĩo eetire; nao acio eetire, nĩo aatuire athingu; nao acio aatuire athingu, nĩo aahumbire riiri.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

kikuyu: Niĩ ngwaria ũhoro-wa-ma ndĩ thĩinĩ wa Kristũ, ti maheeni ndĩraaria, o nayo thamiri yakwa nĩyo mũira wakwa thĩinĩ wa Roho Mũtheru,
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

kikuyu: Nguo ĩyo, kana ndigi icio njogothe, kana taama mũtume, kana kĩndũ kĩa rũũa kĩrĩa gĩthambĩtio gĩkaniinwo ũgumu ũcio no nginya gĩthambio rĩngĩ, na nĩ gĩgaathirwo nĩ thaahu.”
english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

kikuyu: na Atarothu-Shofani, na Jazeri, na Jogibeha,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

kikuyu: Mũgeni ũrĩa ũtũũranagia na inyuĩ no nginya atuagwo taarĩ mũndũ ũciarĩirwo bũrũri wanyu. Mwendei ta ũrĩa mwĩendete inyuĩ ene, nĩgũkorwo o na inyuĩ mwarĩ ageni bũrũri wa Misiri. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

kikuyu: Naguo riiri wa Jehova nĩũkaguũranĩrio, na andũ othe nĩmakawĩonera marĩ hamwe. Nĩgũkorwo nĩ kanua ka Jehova kaarĩtie ũhoro ũcio.”
english: Yahweh’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

kikuyu: nao mangĩĩcookera ngoro-inĩ ciao marĩ o kũu bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩa maatahĩirwo, na merire, na magũthaithe marĩ o kũu maatahĩirwo, na moige atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩtwĩhĩtie, na nĩtwĩkĩte mahĩtia na tũgeka maũndũ ma waganu’;
english: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

kikuyu: Thuutha wa ihinda inyinyi, thĩ ndĩgũcooka kũnyona, no inyuĩ nĩmũrĩnyonaga. Tondũ nĩndũũraga muoyo, o na inyuĩ nĩmũgũtũũra muoyo.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

kikuyu: na ũndũ wa gũkoma na mũndũ ũngĩ, na ũndũ ũcio ũhithwo mũthuuriwe na thaahu wake wage kũmenyeka (tondũ hatirĩ mũira wa kũmuumbũra, na ndaakorereirwo agĩĩka ũndũ ũcio-rĩ),
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

kikuyu: Kaĩ maũndũ ma ndũire matamũrutaga atĩ mũndũ-mũrũme gũkorwo arĩ na njuĩrĩ ndaaya nĩ ũndũ wa kũmũconorithia,
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

kikuyu: Ngoro yakwa ĩrĩ na ruo rũnene thĩinĩ wakwa, nganyiitwo nĩ imakania nene cia gĩkuũ.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ cia Kaisari.” Agĩcooka akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Rutagĩrai Kaisari kĩrĩa kĩrĩ gĩake, na mũrutagĩre Ngai kĩrĩa kĩrĩ gĩake.”
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Joabu nĩonire atĩ thigari nĩciaranĩtio mbere yake o na thuutha wake; nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩthuura mbũtũ imwe iria njega mũno kũu Isiraeli, agĩcitũma ikarũe na Asuriata.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, Ngai wakwa, ũrohingũra maitho maku, o namo matũ maku mathikĩrĩrie mahooya marĩa marĩhooyagĩrwo handũ haha.
english: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

kikuyu: Ndegwa ĩngĩtheeca ngombo ya mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja, mwene no nginya arĩhe cekeri mĩrongo ĩtatũ cia betha kũrĩ mwathi wa ngombo ĩyo,† nayo ndegwa ĩyo no nginya ĩhũũrwo na mahiga.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels† of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

kikuyu: na mũkehumba mũndũ ũngĩ mwerũ, ũrĩa werũhagio nginya agĩe na ũmenyo na agĩe na mũhianĩre wa ũrĩa wamũũmbire.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

kikuyu: Mawega ma gwakīra ng'ombe cia iria kiugū kīna kūndū gwa gūkoma harī o ng'ombe būrūri-inī wa Kenya nī marīkū?
english: What are the benefits of implementing a freestall housing system for dairy cattle in Kenya?

kikuyu: Andũ ageni nĩmanjũkĩrĩire; nao andũ matarĩ tha nĩmaracaria muoyo wakwa, o andũ acio matarũmbũyagia Ngai.
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

kikuyu: Mutheba wa tūtambī ungī harī waru ni potato tuber moth.
english: Another pest that you need to know about is the potato tuber moth.

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Adamu ciarĩ Sethi, na Enoshu,
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

kikuyu: Ni mawega marīku makoragwo na mūthemba wa maembe wa Keitt?
english: What are the advantages of keitt mango fruit variety?

kikuyu: Nyũmba ĩrĩa aakaga no ta nyũmba ya kĩĩhuruta, ningĩ no ta gĩthũnũ gĩakĩtwo nĩ mũrangĩri.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo maitho makwa nĩmonete ũhonokio waku,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

kikuyu: Mĩario ĩyo yanyu mĩingĩ ya mũhũhũtĩko-rĩ, ndĩrĩĩthira? Nĩ kĩĩ kĩramũthĩĩnia, gĩgatũma mũtinde mũgĩkararania?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

kikuyu: Ũkĩra ũthiĩ, ũtuĩkanie bũrũri ũyũ ũraihu waguo na wariĩ waguo, tondũ nĩngũkũhe guo.”
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ũũ nĩguo Jehova ekuuga ũhoro-inĩ ũkoniĩ andũ a Anathothu, acio marenda gũkũruta muoyo, makoiga atĩrĩ, ‘Tiga gũcooka kũratha mohoro ũkĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova, nĩgeetha tũtigakũũrage na moko maitũ’;
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in Yahweh’s name, that you not die by our hand’—

kikuyu: Ikoro rīa ikorobia rīīru nī rīirū, rīceke na inyoroku.
english: Skin of ripe fruit is black, thin and smooth.

kikuyu: Nĩmaingatirwo kuuma kũrĩ mũingĩ, makiugĩrĩrio ta maarĩ aici.
english: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

kikuyu: Mīthemba ya maembe īrīa rīa īī Kenya
english: Mango varieties in Kenya

kikuyu: Githĩ inyuĩ mũtiagĩrĩirwo nĩkũnjĩtigĩra?” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. “Githĩ inyuĩ mũtiagĩrĩirwo nĩkũinaina mũrĩ mbere yakwa? Ndaatũmire mũthanga ũtuĩke mũhaka wa iria rĩrĩa inene, ngĩũtua rũirigo rwa gũtũũra, rũtangĩagararwo nĩ iria rĩu. Makũmbĩ ma maaĩ no moyane, no matingĩrũtooria, no mahũyũke, no matingĩrwagarara.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

kikuyu: Mũniinani nĩagookĩrĩra itũũra o itũũra, na gũtirĩ itũũra rĩkahonoka. Gĩtuamba nĩgĩkaharaganio, naguo werũ ũrĩa mwaraganu wanangwo, tondũ Jehova nĩwe ugĩte ũguo.
english: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as Yahweh has spoken.

kikuyu: Daudi nĩmagĩire ndundu na anene ake a ita, arĩa maathaga ikundi cia thigari ngiri na ikundi cia thigari igana.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

kikuyu: Wendani wao, na rũmena rwao, o na ũiru wao nĩithirĩte biũ; na gũtirĩ hĩndĩ ĩngĩ magaacooka kũgĩa na handũ maũndũ-inĩ marĩa mothe mekagwo gũkũ thĩ kwaraga riũa.
english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

kikuyu: Ndaakwambĩire mũtego, wee Babuloni, nawe ũkĩgwatio nĩguo ũtekũmenya; wakorereirwo, ũkĩnyiitwo tondũ wa gũkararia Jehova.
english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nīnjīra irīkū irīcia bata makīria cia kūgirīrīria tūtambi na mīrimū?
english: What are the major pest and disease control methods?

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ mũngĩndaara atĩa? Andũ acio maranjĩĩra ũũ, ‘Tũhũthĩrie icooki rĩrĩa thoguo aatũigĩrĩire.’ Tũngĩmacookeria atĩa?”
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

kikuyu: kana mũhianĩre wa nyamũ o na ĩrĩkũ ĩtambaga thĩ, kana mũhianĩre wa thamaki o na ĩrĩkũ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ maaĩ-inĩ marĩa marĩ mũhuro wa thĩ.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

kikuyu: Oonekaga ahaana ta rũheni, na nguo ciake cierũhĩte o ta ira.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

kikuyu: Hau nĩho marĩ manyiitĩtwo nĩ guoya mũnene, nĩgũkorwo Ngai aikaraga hamwe na thiritũ ya arĩa athingu.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

kikuyu: akiuga atĩrĩ: “Wee Jehova, Ngai wa maithe maitũ, githĩ tiwe Ngai ũrĩa ũrĩ igũrũ? Nĩwe ũthamakagĩra mothamaki mothe ma ndũrĩrĩ. Hinya na ũhoti irĩ guoko-inĩ gwaku, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩgwĩtiiria.
english: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

kikuyu: Marīgu ma mūciarithanio nī marīkū?
english: What is banana tissue culture?

kikuyu: Meere ũũ, “Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “ ‘Ciimba cia andũ nĩikaragana ta rũrua rũrĩ mũgũnda, na ta itira iria itinĩtio igatigwo na thuutha nĩ mũgethi, itarĩ na mũndũ wa gũcicookanĩrĩria.’ ”
english: Speak, “Yahweh says, “ ‘The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.’ ”

kikuyu: Njiaro cia Shobali, ithe wa Kiriathu-Jearimu, ciarĩ: Haroe, na nuthu ya Amanahathi,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

kikuyu: Monganagia ngaragatha mĩgũnda-inĩ, na makahaara matigari mĩgũnda ya mĩthabibũ ya arĩa aaganu.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ndingĩconorithio rĩrĩa ngũcũũrania maathani maku mothe.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

kikuyu: Agĩtoonya gatarũ kamwe, nako kaarĩ ga Simoni, akĩmũthaitha agatoonyatoonyie maaĩ-inĩ, kehere hũgũrũrũ-inĩ. Agĩcooka agĩikara thĩ, akĩambĩrĩria kũruta andũ ũhoro arĩ gatarũ-inĩ kau.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

kikuyu: “Ta ambatai na mũikũrũke barabara-inĩ ciothe cia Jerusalemu, mũrore na mũcarie, na mũtuĩrie ihaaro-inĩ ciakuo. Hihi mwahota kuona mũndũ o na ũmwe wĩkaga maũndũ ma kĩhooto kana akarũmbũiya ũhoro wa ma; muona mũndũ ta ũcio, nĩngarekera itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu.
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

kikuyu: Mĩtugo-inĩ yaku yothe ĩrĩ magigi ĩrĩa wekire, na ũhũũri-inĩ waku wa ũmaraya, ndwaririkanire matukũ ma ũnini waku, rĩrĩa warĩ njaga na ũtaarĩ na nguo, o rĩrĩa wegaragaragia thakame-inĩ yaku.
english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩĩhũgũra na kũrĩ o, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ aarĩ a Jerusalemu, tigai kũndĩrĩra; mwĩrĩrĩrei inyuĩ ene na ciana cianyu.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

kikuyu: Ũndũ ũcio nĩguo ũtũmaga ndurie ndu ndĩ mbere ya Ithe witũ,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, igua mũgambo wakwa ngĩkwĩra mateta makwa; gitĩra muoyo wakwa harĩ kwĩhĩtĩrwo nĩ thũ.
english: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

kikuyu: na makĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Twarĩrie arĩ we, na nĩtũgũkũigua, no tiga kũreka twarĩrio nĩ Ngai, tũtigakue.”
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

kikuyu: Nĩngũheana ũhoro wa motugi ma Jehova, o na ciĩko ciake iria itũmaga agoocwo, kũringana na maũndũ mothe marĩa Jehova atwĩkĩire: ĩĩ, nĩngũheana ũhoro wa maũndũ maingĩ mega marĩa eekĩire nyũmba ya Isiraeli, kũringana na tha ciake, na motugi make maingĩ.
english: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Magĩcooka makĩhũũra andũ acio maarĩ nja ya mũrango wa nyũmba, ethĩ na akũrũ, na ũtumumu nĩgeetha mage kuona mũrango.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

kikuyu: hamwe na ariũ ake eerĩ. Mũriũ ũmwe eetagwo Gerishomu, nĩgũkorwo Musa oigire atĩrĩ, “Nĩnduĩkĩte mũgeni bũrũri-inĩ wene”;
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom,† for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

kikuyu: Ndikũgeria kwaria ũndũ o na ũrĩkũ tiga o ũrĩa Kristũ ahingĩtie na ũndũ wakwa harĩ ũhoro wa gũtongoria andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ ũhoro-inĩ wa gwathĩkĩra Ngai, nĩ ũndũ wakwa kũheana ũhoro na maũndũ marĩa mekirwo,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

kikuyu: na maikie arĩa aaganu icua-inĩ rĩa mwaki, kũrĩa gũgaakorwo na kĩrĩro na kũhagarania magego.”
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: nigūo kūgīrīrīria gūtharana ūtheri.
english: also to avoid competition for light.

kikuyu: Ũgũtũũra ũtũrakarĩire nginya tene? Marakara maku megũkinyĩra njiarwa na njiarwa?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ aakinya hau, agĩtiira maitho na igũrũ, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Zakayo, harũrũka narua, tondũ ũmũthĩ no nginya thiĩ gwaku mũciĩ.”
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

kikuyu: Nĩnyonete ũndũ ũngĩ gũkũ thĩ kwaraga riũa: Atĩ andũ arĩa marĩ ihenya tio mahootanaga ihenya-inĩ, na arĩa marĩ hinya tio mahootanaga mbaara-inĩ, o na arĩa oogĩ tio moonaga irio, na arĩa mooĩ maũndũ mũno tio magĩaga na ũtonga, o na kana andũ arĩa oogĩ makaheo gĩtĩĩo; no rĩrĩ, ihinda na mweke nĩ cia andũ othe.

english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

kikuyu: Matuagei atheru, tondũ nĩo marutagĩra Ngai wanyu irio iria arutĩirwo igongona. Matuagei atheru, tondũ niĩ Jehova ndĩ mũtheru, o niĩ ũrĩa ũmũtheragia.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

english: How many litres of water does an avocado tree need?

english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

kikuyu: Tondũ wa ũguo-rĩ, gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũ ũngĩtuuo mũthingu maitho-inĩ ma Ngai nĩ ũndũ wa kũrũmia watho; no rĩrĩ, watho nĩguo ũtũmaga andũ mamenye atĩ nĩmehĩtie.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo niĩ mwene nĩngetĩkania nawe atĩ guoko gwaku mwene kwa ũrĩo no gũkũhonokie.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Twamũhuhĩire mũtũrirũ, mũkĩaga kũina; o na twamũinĩire nyĩmbo cia macakaya, no mũtiacakaire.’
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

kikuyu: Nao magĩĩtĩkania na mĩario yake. Nao magĩĩta atũmwo matoonye makĩmahũũrithia iboko.* Magĩcooka makĩmaatha matikaarie thĩinĩ wa rĩĩtwa rĩa Jesũ, magĩcooka makĩmarekereria mathiĩ.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna‡ to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!” *

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, njũrĩire harĩwe; ndũkanakĩreke njonorithio.
english: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Arĩa mamwĩtigagĩra nĩamaheaga irio; egũtũũra aririkanaga kĩrĩkanĩro gĩake nginya tene.
english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

kikuyu: Ta rorai nyoni cia rĩera-inĩ; itihaandaga, kana ikagetha, kana ikaiga magetha ikũmbĩ, no Ithe wanyu ũrĩa ũrĩ Igũrũ nĩaciheaga irio. Githĩ inyuĩ mũtikĩrĩ a bata mũno gũkĩra icio?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

kikuyu: No nginya aneane ndegwa ĩyo mũromo-inĩ wa Hema-ya-Gũtũnganwo arĩ mbere ya Jehova. Nĩakaigĩrĩra guoko gwake igũrũ rĩa mũtwe wayo, na acooke amĩthĩnjĩre hau mbere ya Jehova.

english: Crucifers (cabbage, broccoli, cauliflower, etc) are particularly effective against colon cancer and also protect against cancers of the skin, breast, stomach, bladder, liver and lung;

english: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

english: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

english: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

kikuyu: na nĩguo ũhingũrage atumumu maitho, na wohorithagie arĩa mohetwo ũmarute moime njeera, o nao arĩa maikarĩte nduma-inĩ ũmarekererie, moime korokoro-inĩ.
english: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa kwaranĩria na andũ, Jehoshafatu agĩthuura andũ a kũinĩra Jehova na a kũmũgooca nĩ ũndũ wa riiri wa ũtheru wake, nao hĩndĩ ĩrĩa megũtongoria mbũtũ ĩyo ya ita, makiugaga atĩrĩ: “Cookeriai Jehova ngaatho, nĩgũkorwo wendo wake ũtũũraga nginya tene.”
english: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to Yahweh, for his loving kindness endures forever.”

kikuyu: Andũ acio magĩgĩikara o haraaya, nowe Musa agĩthengerera harĩa haarĩ nduma ndumanu, harĩa Ngai aarĩ.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

kikuyu: “Thondeka hema nyamũre ĩrĩ na itambaya ikũmi cia gũcuurio itumĩtwo na gatani yogothetwo wega ya ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na igemio na makerubi nĩ mũtumi mũũgĩ na wĩra ũcio.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Ciana ciao iria itooĩ watho ũyũ, no nginya ciũigue, na ciĩrute gwĩtigĩra Jehova Ngai wanyu rĩrĩa rĩothe mũgũtũũra bũrũri ũcio mũraringa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũthiĩ mũkawĩgwatĩre.”
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jesũ akiuma kũu gũkuhĩ na Turo agĩtuĩkanĩria Sidoni, agĩikũrũka nginya iria-inĩ rĩa Galili, agĩtoonya bũrũri wa Dekapoli.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Ayahudi acio maarĩ na Mariamu kũu nyũmba makĩmũũmĩrĩria monire ũrĩa okĩra na ihenya oimĩte nja, makĩmũrũmĩrĩra, magĩĩciiria atĩ aathiiaga mbĩrĩra-inĩ akarĩrĩre ho.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

kikuyu: Mũndũ mwĩthĩ-rĩ, angĩiga mũtũũrĩre wake ũrĩ mũtheru atĩa? Nĩ na ũndũ wa gũtũũra athĩkagĩra kiugo gĩaku.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

kikuyu: Goocai Jehova Ngai, o we Ngai wa Isiraeli, o we wiki wĩkaga maũndũ ma magegania.
english: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

english: • Average Length: 12.6 cm with a width of 9.9 cm • Average Weight: 522 g

kikuyu: Mwĩmenyagĩrĩrei mũtikanaguucĩrĩrio, mũgarũrũke mũhooe ngai ingĩ na mũciinamĩrĩre.
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

kikuyu: Irio cia mūtu cia njui hūre iheagwo kuuma thikū ya mīrongo ītano na mūgwanja(wiki ya kenda) nginya thikū ya igana rīmwe ria mīrongo ītatū na ithatū(wiki ya ikūmi na kenda), ikaheo grams mīrongo kenda o mūthenya ya irio ciīna ngarama ya shilingi mīrongo ītatū na ītano harīo kilo.

kikuyu: Gwĩtigĩra Jehova gũkinyagia mũndũ muoyo-inĩ: Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũndũ akahurũka aiganĩire, atarĩ na thĩĩna.
english: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

kikuyu: Ũhaataga andũ, ũkameeheria, magakoma toro wa gĩkuũ; andũ mahaana ta nyeki ĩrĩa ĩringũkaga rũciinĩ:
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

kikuyu: “Nake mũriũ akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Baba, nĩnjĩhĩirie Ngai o na ngakwĩhĩria. Ndiagĩrĩirwo nĩgũcooka gwĩtagwo mũrũguo rĩngĩ.’
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio-rĩ, Jehova nĩakaherithia maahinya ma kũu igũrũ, o kũu matu-inĩ, na aherithie athamaki a thĩ ĩno.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

kikuyu: Nī tūnyamū tūrīkū tūgūmagīra kabici rīrīa yarīkia gūkūra?
english: What are the pests that affect cabbages at maturation stage?

kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa agĩĩta Bezaleli na Oholiabu na mũndũ o wothe warĩ mũũgĩ, ũrĩa Jehova aheete ũhoti, na ũrĩa warĩ na wendo wa gũũka kũruta wĩra ũcio.
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

kikuyu: O mbere nĩngũcookeria Ngai wakwa ngaatho thĩinĩ wa Jesũ Kristũ nĩ ũndũ wanyu inyuothe, tondũ ũhoro wa wĩtĩkio wanyu nĩũmenyithanĩtio thĩ yothe.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, mũndũ ũrĩa ũkũregana na ũrutani ũyũ ti mũndũ araregana nake no nĩ Ngai, ũrĩa ũmũheaga inyuĩ Roho wake Mũtheru.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

kikuyu: Nī tūtambi tūrīkū twa marigū tūīkaine makīrīa būrūri-inī wa Kenya?
english: What are the common pests that affect banana plants in Kenya?

kikuyu: Nao maakinya Efeso, Paũlũ agĩtiga Pirisila na Akula kuo. We mwene agĩtoonya thunagogi na akĩaranĩria na Ayahudi.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

kikuyu: Nake mwathi ũcio wa ndungata ĩyo akĩmĩiguĩra tha, akĩmĩrekera thiirĩ ũcio akĩreka ĩthiĩ.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

kikuyu: Aaririe ũhoro ũcio atekũhitha, nake Petero akĩmũtwara keheri-inĩ, akĩambĩrĩria kũmũkaania.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

kikuyu: o na nĩ ũndũ wa wĩra wa thahabu na indo cia wĩra wa betha ũrĩa wothe ũkaarutwo nĩ mabundi. Na rĩrĩ, nũũ ũkwĩĩamũrĩra Jehova ũmũthĩ na kwĩyendera?”
english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to Yahweh?”

kikuyu: Nake Zimuri, ũmwe wa anene ake, ũrĩa waathaga nuthu ya ngaari ciake cia ita, agĩciirĩra ũrĩa ekũmũũkĩrĩra. Hĩndĩ ĩyo Ela aarĩ Tiriza, akĩnyua njoohi mũciĩ kwa Ariza ũrĩa warĩ mũrori wa nyũmba ya ũthamaki kũu Tiriza.
english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

kikuyu: Jehova akĩũmia ngoro ya Firaũni mũthamaki wa bũrũri wa Misiri, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio akĩrũmĩrĩra andũ a Isiraeli na ihenya arĩa moimagarĩte makinyũkĩtie na ũcamba.
english: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand.†

kikuyu: Kĩhuno kĩu gĩũkaga kĩrĩ tũhũ, na gĩgathiĩ nduma-inĩ, na rĩĩtwa rĩakĩo rĩkahumbĩrwo nĩ nduma o ro ĩyo.
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

kikuyu: Watho ũrĩa uumĩte kanua gaku nĩ wa bata mũno harĩ niĩ, gũkĩra ngiri cia icunjĩ cia betha na thahabu.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

kikuyu: Ngūkū ici ningī ikomaga igūithītie mūtwe kana ikaūroria nathutha kana ikaūhitha ithagu-inī.
english: The birds also sit with the head down or turned backward or rested in feathers around the wing.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ũkĩra rũciinĩ tene, uumĩrĩre Firaũni agĩthiĩ Rũũĩ rwa Nili, ũmwĩre atĩrĩ, ‘Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Rekereria andũ akwa mathiĩ nĩgeetha makandungatĩre.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

kikuyu: Mũtigaikare mũrĩ na thiirĩ na mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ, tiga o mwendanage hĩndĩ ciothe mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ, nĩgũkorwo mũndũ wendaga mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ nĩahingĩtie watho.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

kikuyu: naguo nĩ wĩtĩkio na wendani iria ciumanaga na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro kĩrĩa mũigĩirwo kũu igũrũ na kĩrĩa mũrĩkĩtie kũigua ũhoro wakĩo thĩinĩ wa ũhoro ũrĩa wa ma, na nĩguo Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

kikuyu: Mūrimū ūyū ūrigagīrīrio na njīra ya kūiga mūgūnda ūrī mūtheru na dawa cia kūnina fungi
english: It is controlled by proper orchard sanitation and use of fungicides.

kikuyu: Maũndũ macio meerĩ nĩmagagũkorerera o rĩmwe, mũthenya o ro ũmwe: nĩũgakuĩrwo nĩ ciana, na ũtuĩke mũtumia wa ndigwa. Maũndũ macio magaagũkorerera na ũiyũru biũ, o na gũtuĩka ũrĩ na ũrogi mũingĩ, na ũgo waku ũkaingĩha mũno.
english: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

kikuyu: Anabii nĩ a tũhũ ta rũhuho, nakĩo kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩtirĩ thĩinĩ wao; nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, ũguo moigĩte nĩguo mageekwo.”
english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

kikuyu: ũguo nĩ ta kuuga nyama icio ingĩ ciothe cia ndegwa ĩyo, no nginya agaaciruta nja ya kambĩ, acitware handũ hatarĩ thaahu, harĩa mũhu ũitagwo, na acicinĩre na mwaki wa ngũ hau mũhu-inĩ ũcio.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

kikuyu: Ngai nĩandooretie na akandembũranga nĩ ũrĩa arakarĩte, akaahagaranĩria magego; ũcio thũ yakwa nĩangũũrĩire maitho.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

kikuyu: Kĩiguei ndũmĩrĩri ya Jehova, inyuĩ matigari ma Juda. Ũũ nĩguo Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, Ngai wa Isiraeli, ekuuga: ‘Mũngĩkorwo nĩmũtuĩte atĩ nĩmũgũthiĩ bũrũri wa Misiri, na inyuĩ mũthiĩ mũgatũũre kuo- rĩ,
english: now therefore hear Yahweh’s word, O remnant of Judah! Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there,

kikuyu: Matũũra marĩa matũũragwo nĩ andũ nĩmakanangwo, naguo bũrũri ũkirio ihooru. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmũkamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.’ ”
english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.” ’ ”

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio angĩkorwo arĩ mũthĩĩni, ndũkanaraarie kĩu eeranĩire.
english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ kĩngĩtũma mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ wanyu atue atĩ nĩ ũndũ ũtangĩĩtĩkio, atĩ Ngai nĩariũkagia arĩa akuũ?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

kikuyu: Ũkĩrai, tũthiĩ! Ũrĩa ũkũngunyanĩra nĩarooka!”
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Ariũ arĩa maaciarĩrĩirwo Hezironi maarĩ: Jerameeli, na Ramu, na Kalebu.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

kikuyu: namo nĩ ndungata ĩtuĩkĩte mũthamaki, na mũndũ mũkĩĩgu ahũũnĩte irio,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

kikuyu: “Rĩu-rĩ, angĩkorwo mwendete o arĩa mamwendete-rĩ, mwakĩĩguna na kĩ? O na ‘ehia’ nĩmendaga arĩa mamendete.
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, inyuĩ andũ a gĩcigĩrĩra, na inyuĩ onjorithia a Sidoni, ta kirai o inyuĩ mũtongetio nĩ andũ arĩa mageragĩra iria-inĩ.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.

kikuyu: Cirutagei ciana cianyu, na mũciaragie rĩrĩa mũikarĩte kwanyu mĩciĩ na rĩrĩa mũrathiĩ na njĩra, na rĩrĩa mũkomete na rĩrĩa muokĩra.
english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

kikuyu: Andũ acio mekaga maũndũ mooru kaĩ matamenyaga, o acio marĩĩaga andũ akwa o ta ũrĩa andũ marĩĩaga irio, o acio matakayagĩra Jehova?
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa mũkuui wa indo cia mbaara onire atĩ Saũlũ nĩakua, o nake akĩgwĩra rũhiũ rwake rwa njora, agĩkua.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

kikuyu: Ithandũkũ rĩu rĩgemio na thahabu therie mĩena yeerĩ nja na thĩinĩ, na mũrĩtirihe na mũcibi wa thahabu mĩena yothe.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthamaki ũngĩ ũtooĩ ũhoro wa Jusufu akĩambĩrĩria gũthamaka kũu bũrũri wa Misiri.
english: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.

kikuyu: Ũcuuki wa mĩtĩ nĩũniinaga ngarari, na ũgateithũrana andũ eerĩ njamba.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

kikuyu: Nĩmathondekire gacaũ marĩ kũu Horebu, makĩhooya mũhianano ũtweketio kuuma kũrĩ kĩgera.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

kikuyu: Rūmīrīra njīra iria ciagīrīire wona mūmera ūmwe kana īrī yahutio nī tūtambi
english: • Institute control measures when 1 to 2 % of plants are infested

kikuyu: Nĩ mwanangĩko! Ĩĩ nĩ mwanangĩko! Nĩngarĩanangithia! Rĩtigacookererio nginya hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ũcio mwene rĩo agooka; ũcio nĩwe ngaarĩneana kũrĩ we.’
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.” ’

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩyo ndũmĩrĩri nditũ ĩkoniĩ nyamũ cia Negevu: Mabarũthi mao makuuaga ũtonga wao na ndigiri, na igĩĩna ciao magaaciigĩrĩra maguku-inĩ ma ngamĩĩra, magatuĩkanĩria bũrũri wa thĩĩna na wa mĩnyamaro, bũrũri ũrĩ mĩrũũthi ya njamba na ya nga, na nduĩra na nyoka iria ĩticũkaga, macitware bũrũri wa andũ matangĩmaguna o na atĩa.
english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo mũciĩ ũcio nĩwagĩrĩire-rĩ, ũrathimei na thayũ wanyu; angĩkorwo ndwagĩrĩire-rĩ, rekei kĩrathimo kĩanyu kĩmũcookerere.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “O na niĩ ndikũmwĩra njĩkaga maũndũ maya na ũhoti ũrĩkũ.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Jerameeli aarĩ na mũtumia ũngĩ wetagwo Atara, nake nĩwe warĩ nyina wa Onamu.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

kikuyu: No handũ ha ũguo agĩthiĩ, akĩambĩrĩria kwaria na kũmemerekia ũhoro ũcio. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Jesũ ndacookire kũhota gũtoonya itũũra thĩinĩ akĩonagwo nĩ andũ, no aikaraga na nja kũndũ gũtaarĩ andũ. No andũ no mookaga kũrĩ we moimĩte kũndũ guothe.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

kikuyu: Hihi njamba iciarithagio na gūtungatwo atīa?
english: How to breed and manage cocks?

kikuyu: Nao acio maatũmirwo magĩthiĩ, magĩkora maũndũ matariĩ o ta ũrĩa Jesũ aamerĩte.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

kikuyu: Iburahĩmu mbere ya Ahiti othe arĩa mookĩte kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa itũũra rĩu inene.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Natuo tũtũrũme twa Bathaka tũgĩthĩnjwo, nao athĩnjĩri-Ngai makĩminjaminja thakame ĩrĩa maanengeretwo, o Alawii magĩthĩnjaga nyamũ icio.
english: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩeheria ihiga. Jesũ agĩcooka agĩtiira maitho, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Baba, nĩndagũcook- eria ngaatho nĩ ũndũ nĩũnjiguaga.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying.§ Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

kikuyu: Mũcirutanĩrie na thenge ĩmwe ĩrĩ igongona rĩa kũhoroherio mehia, yongererwo harĩ igongona rĩa njino rĩa hĩndĩ ciothe, hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu na iruta rĩa kũnyuuo.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Meeraga mũtĩ atĩrĩ, ‘Wee nĩwe Baba,’ na makeera ihiga atĩrĩ, ‘Wee nĩwe wanjiarire.’ Nĩmahutatĩire, makaaga kũnyonia mothiũ mao; no rĩrĩa marĩ thĩĩna-inĩ manjĩĩraga atĩrĩ, ‘Ũka ũtũhonokie!’
english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face, but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us!’

kikuyu: Wee nĩwe rĩũrĩro rĩakwa na ngo yakwa; njigĩte mwĩhoko wakwa kiugo-inĩ gĩaku.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Makĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũmisiri ũmwe nĩatũteithũrire kũrĩ arĩithi; o na nĩwe ũtũtahĩire maaĩ na atũheera mbũri ciitũ maaĩ.”
english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”

kikuyu: “Hĩndĩ ĩyo Moabi nĩagaconoka nĩ ũndũ wa ngai ĩrĩa ĩtagwo Kemoshu, o ta ũrĩa nyũmba ya Isiraeli yaconokire, rĩrĩa meehokete Betheli.
english: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, rĩrĩa mũnganĩte mũrĩĩanĩre-rĩ, etanagĩrĩrai.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

english: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”

kikuyu: Jehova, o we Ngai ũcio Mwene-Hinya, nĩaraaria, ageeta thĩ yothe kuuma irathĩro rĩa riũa nginya kũrĩa rĩthũagĩra.
english: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, ũmũthĩ ũyũ nĩndaiga ũhoro wa gũtũũra muoyo na wa ũgaacĩru mbere yaku, o na wa gĩkuũ na wa mwanangĩko.
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

kikuyu: Andũ a Diboni nĩmambatĩte magathiĩ hekarũ-inĩ yao, mambatĩte kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru makarĩrĩre kuo; andũ a Moabi maraagirĩka nĩ ũndũ wa Nebo na Medeba. Mĩtwe yao yothe nĩyenjetwo, na nderu ciao ciothe ikenjwo.
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

kikuyu: No gũkorwo Jehova Ngai waku nĩekũigua ciugo ciothe cia mũnene ũcio wa mbũtũ cia ita, ũrĩa mwathi wake, mũthamaki wa Ashuri atũmĩte, nĩgeetha oke anyũrũrie Ngai ũrĩa ũrĩ muoyo, na amũkũũme nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoro ũcio Jehova Ngai waku aiguĩte. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio hoera matigari marĩa matigaire muoyo.”
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’ ”

kikuyu: Ĩrai mũthamaki wa Juda ũrĩa ũmũtũmĩte mũũke mũtuĩrie ũhoro kũrĩ Jehova atĩrĩ, ‘Jehova Ngai wa Isiraeli ekuuga atĩrĩ, ũhoro wĩgiĩ ciugo iria ũiguĩte:
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

english: for your partnership† in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

kikuyu: Ndirica ciayo ciekĩrĩtwo igũrũ, igagĩĩkĩrwo ithatũ ithatũ, ingʼethanĩire.
english: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

kikuyu: Nĩmakarũa nawe no matigaakũhoota, nĩgũkorwo ndĩ hamwe nawe na nĩndĩrĩkũhonokagia,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga. 2
english: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.” 2

kikuyu: Magĩthondeka mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu mũhuro wa mũcibi ũcio, ĩĩrĩ mwena ũmwe na ĩĩrĩ mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ. Mĩrĩnga ĩyo nĩyo yatoonyagio mĩtĩ ĩrĩa mĩraihu yatũmagĩrwo gũgĩkuua.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

english: Phosphorus is important for early growth and rooting, particularly in the nursery and at transplanting, as well as bean fill.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ rĩrĩa moimaga Bethania, Jesũ akĩigua ahũtiĩ.
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

kikuyu: No itua rĩakwa nĩ atĩrĩ, mũtumia ũcio angĩaga kũhika rĩngĩ, no akorwo arĩ na gĩkeno makĩria. Na ngwĩciiria atĩ niĩ o na niĩ ndĩ na Roho wa Ngai.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Nĩwanogirio nĩ mĩthiĩre yaku yothe, no rĩrĩ, ndũigana kuuga atĩrĩ, ‘Ũndũ ũyũ nĩ wa tũhũ.’ Ũkĩgĩa na hinya mwerũ, nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndũigana kũringĩka.
english: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, hĩndĩ ya magetha yakinya-rĩ, agĩtũma ndungata yake kũrĩ akombori acio ĩgĩĩre maciaro mamwe ma mũgũnda ũcio wa mĩthabibũ.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩ mũthingu, na nĩendete ciira wa kĩhooto; andũ arĩa arũngĩrĩru nĩo marĩonaga ũthiũ wake.
english: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

kikuyu: Mũtumia wa haaro ahaanaine na maaĩ maratata mategũtigithĩria hĩndĩ ya mbura;
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

kikuyu: Mbiro ĩyo nĩĩgatuĩka rũkũngũ rũhinyu, naruo rũiyũre bũrũri wothe wa Misiri, rũcooke rũtuĩke mahũha ma ironda mĩĩrĩ-inĩ ya andũ na ya nyamũ bũrũri-inĩ ũcio wothe.”
english: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

english: What are the signs of heat (estrus) in dairy cows, and how often do they come into heat?

english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Magĩtuĩkania bũrũri-inĩ ũcio wothe magakuuaga andũ arĩa maarĩ arũaru na ibarĩ, makĩmatwaraga kũrĩa guothe maiguaga atĩ nĩkuo arĩ.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

kikuyu: Nowe Jesũ nĩamenyaga ũrĩa meeciiragia na akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũreciiria maũndũ macio ngoro- inĩ cianyu nĩkĩ?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

kikuyu: na kĩgongona kĩa ũbumba na mĩtĩ yakĩo, na maguta ma gũitanĩrĩrio, na ũbumba mũnungi wega; na gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio mũrango-inĩ wa itoonyero-inĩ rĩa hema ĩyo nyamũre;

english: Management includes planting resistant varieties and maintaining strict sanitation practices.

english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

english: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

kikuyu: Wendani nĩũkiranagĩrĩria, na wendani nĩũtuganaga. Ndũiguanagĩra ũiru, na ndwĩgaathaga, o na ndũrĩ mwĩtĩĩo.

english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Bũrũri ũgĩkĩgĩa na ũhurũko wa Thabatũ ciaguo; ũkĩhurũka hĩndĩ ĩyo yothe wakirĩte ihooru, nginya mĩaka mĩrongo mũgwanja ĩgĩthira, nĩguo kiugo kĩa Jehova kĩrĩa kĩarĩtio nĩ Jeremia kĩhiinge.
english: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

english: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

english: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũgaacookera kĩhingo kĩrĩa atoonyeire, no mũndũ ariumagĩra kĩhingo kĩrĩa kĩngʼetheire kĩu atoonyeire.
english: “ ‘ “But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

kikuyu: Kuuma nyũmba thĩ nginya hau igũrũ rĩa itoonyero, nĩ ha kururĩtwo makerubi na mĩkĩndũ rũthingo-inĩ rwa nja ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre.
english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wa anene a mahinda maya wamenyire ũhoro ũcio, nĩgũkorwo mangĩaũmenyete-rĩ, matingĩaambire Mwathani wa riiri.
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

kikuyu: Githĩ nawe ndũkwagĩrĩirwo ũiguĩre ndungata ĩrĩa ĩngĩ tha o ta ũrĩa niĩ ngũiguĩrĩire tha?’
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

kikuyu: Kĩndũ kĩrĩa anogeire no nginya agagĩcookia atakĩrĩte; ndagakenera uumithio wa wonjoria wake.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Isiraeli magĩtũũra Misiri bũrũri-inĩ wa Gosheni. Makĩgĩa na indo kuo na magĩciarana, makĩingĩha mũno.
english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Rakeli agĩkua na agĩthikwo mũkĩra-inĩ wa njĩra ya gũthiĩ Efiratha (na nokuo Bethilehemu.)
english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

kikuyu: ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Mũthenya ũrĩa ndethuurĩire Isiraeli-rĩ, nĩndehĩtire harĩ njiaro cia andũ a nyũmba ya Jakubu njoete guoko na igũrũ, na ngĩmeguũrĩria kũu bũrũri wa Misiri. Ngĩmeera njoete guoko na igũrũ atĩrĩ, “Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai wanyu.”
english: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ngũmwĩra ũmũthĩ atĩ gũtirĩ thakame ya mũndũ o na ũmwe ngoorio.
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

kikuyu: “Andũ akwa makoretwo marĩ ngʼondu ciũrĩte; arĩithi ao nĩmamahĩtithĩtie njĩra, na magatũma morũũre irĩma igũrũ. Nao morũũrĩte kuuma kĩrĩma-inĩ nginya karĩma-inĩ, makariganĩrwo nĩ kũrĩa ũhurũko wao ũrĩ.
english: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.

kikuyu: Nao othe maarĩ ta andũ ikũmi na eerĩ.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

kikuyu: Ndĩramũtũma kũrĩ inyuĩ nĩ ũndũ wa gĩtũmi gĩkĩ kĩũmbe, nĩguo mũmenye ũhoro witũ ũrĩa tũtariĩ, na nĩguo amũũmĩrĩrie ngoro.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

kikuyu: Ndirĩ ndaaria na hitho, ndĩ handũ bũrũri-inĩ ũrĩ nduma; ndirĩ ndeera njiaro cia Jakubu atĩrĩ, ‘Nongoriai o ũguo tũhũ.’ Niĩ Jehova, njaragia ũhoro wa ma; nyumbũraga maũndũ marĩa magĩrĩire.
english: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, Yahweh, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.

kikuyu: Jesũ amenya atĩ arutwo ake nĩmangʼongʼoraga nĩ ũndũ wa ũhoro ũcio akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Kaĩ ũhoro ũcio wamũrakaria?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, andũ angĩ eerĩ ageri ngero, o nao nĩmatwarirwo hamwe nake makooragwo.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

kikuyu: O na mũngĩhoota mbũtũ ciothe cia ita cia andũ a Babuloni icio iramũtharĩkĩra, na gũtuĩke atĩ no andũ arĩa matiihangĩtio matigĩtwo hema-inĩ ciao-rĩ, no moime kũu hema-inĩ na macine itũũra rĩĩrĩ na mwaki.”
english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’ ”

kikuyu: Nao othe makĩrĩa makĩhũũna,
english: They all ate and were filled.

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, na ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Rĩrĩa mũkaaringa Rũũĩ rwa Jorodani mũtoonye Kaanani-rĩ,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mbere nĩ wa kĩũngano gĩtheru; mũtikanarute wĩra ũrĩa mũrutaga.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Galio aarĩ barũthi wa Akaia, Ayahudi makĩnyiitana magĩtharĩkĩra Paũlũ na makĩmũtwara igooti-inĩ.
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Daudi agĩathana atĩ ageni othe arĩa maatũũraga Isiraeli* macookanĩrĩrio, nake agĩthuura kuuma thĩinĩ wao mabundi a mahiga, nĩgeetha mahaarĩrie na maicũhie mahiga ma gwaka nyũmba ya Ngai.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũndũ ũcio akĩnjookia nginya kĩhingo-inĩ kĩa nyumĩrĩra ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre, kĩrĩa kĩangʼetheire mwena wa irathĩro, nakĩo kĩarĩ kĩhinge.
english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

kikuyu: na Pedaheli mũrũ wa Amihudu, ũrĩa mũtongoria kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Nafitali.”
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

kikuyu: Andũ amwe ao nĩmacaragia ũndũ mangĩthitangĩra Jesũ, nĩ ũndũ ũcio makĩmũrora mũno mone kana nĩekũhonia mũndũ ũcio mũthenya wa Thabatũ.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Mĩtaratara ya kūgirĩrĩria gūtherema kwa mūrimū ta kwaga mūhanda mūgūnda ūrīa mūrwaru kwa ihinda rīa mīaka īrī na kūhūthĩra mbeū kana mĩūngūrwa ĩrĩa mīhetūkie nīkūrehaga moimĩrĩra mega.
english: Disease management strategies such as crop rotation away from contaminated land for two years and use of certified seed or transplants are effective.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ-rĩ, ũhoro wa gũtũũgĩria mũndũ nduumaga na irathĩro kana ithũĩro, o na kana kuuma werũ-inĩ.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũhithaga rũmena rwake aaragia na mĩromo ya maheeni, na ũrĩa wothe ũcambanagia nĩ mũndũ mũkĩĩgu.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

kikuyu: No thiĩi mwĩre arutwo ake o na Petero atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩekũmũtongoria gũthiĩ Galili. Kũu nĩkuo mũkaamuona, o ta ũrĩa aamwĩrire’.”
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’ ”

kikuyu: “Kũgwatwo nĩ kĩrumi-rĩ, nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa ũhĩtithagia mũtumumu njĩra.” Hĩndĩ ĩyo nao andũ othe moige, “Ameni!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũrũme angĩnyiitwo akomete na mũtumia wa mũndũ ũngĩ, o eerĩ, mũndũ mũrũme ũcio na mũtumia ũcio, no nginya makue. No nginya mũniine ũũru ũcio wehere Isiraeli.
english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩenja irima, nĩwe ũkaagũa rĩo; mũndũ angĩgaragaria ihiga, rĩkaagaragara rĩmũcookerere.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

kikuyu: Na ũtoonye thĩinĩ na nyamũ mũgwanja mũgwanja cia mĩthemba yothe ĩrĩa ĩtarĩ thaahu, o njamba na nga yayo, na igĩrĩ igĩrĩ cia mĩthemba yothe ĩrĩa ĩrĩ thaahu, o njamba na nga yayo,
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

kikuyu: O na mbura ya mbembe ĩngĩgũithia mĩtĩ ya mũtitũ thĩ, narĩo itũũra inene rĩaraganio biũ-rĩ,
english: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mũndũ mũrũme angĩkoma na mũndũ-wa-nja hĩndĩ yake ya mweri, nĩaguũria riurĩro rĩake, o nake mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio agakĩguũria riurĩro rĩa thakame yake. Andũ acio eerĩ nĩmakaingatwo kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao.
english: “ ‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

kikuyu: Ndeerire Jehova atĩrĩ, “Wee nĩwe Mwathani wakwa; hatirĩ ũndũ mwega ingĩona ũtoimĩte harĩwe.”
english: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ciira wa kĩhooto ũrĩ kũraya na ithuĩ, naguo ũthingu ndũtũkinyagĩra. Tũcaragia ũtheri, no tuonaga o nduma; tũgacaria ũkengu, no tũkagerera kũrĩa kũrĩ na mairia matumanu.
english: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

kikuyu: Mīembe yendaga ūrugarī ūkīrīte 21⁰ C(70⁰ F) na ūtanyihīire 4⁰ C (40⁰F).
english: Mango trees need a warm environment with a temperature ideally above 21°C (70°F) and a minimum temperature of 4°C (40°F).

kikuyu: Nake Juda akĩĩra Onani atĩrĩ, “Koma na mũtumia wa mũrũ wa nyũkwa, ũmũhingĩrie ũrĩa wagĩrĩirwo nĩkũmwĩka ũrĩ mũrũ wa nyina na mũthuuri wake, nĩguo ũciarĩre mũrũ wa nyũkwa rũciaro.”
english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

kikuyu: Gĩcigo kĩrĩa gĩgaatigara, kĩhakanĩte na gĩcigo kĩu kĩamũre, na gĩtwaranĩte na ũraihu wakĩo, gĩgaakorwo kĩrĩ kĩa mĩkono 10,000 mwena wa irathĩro, na mĩkono 10,000 mwena wa ithũĩro. Maciaro makĩo nĩmo makaarĩĩagwo nĩ aruti wĩra a itũũra rĩu inene.
english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

kikuyu: Mĩbango ya andũ arĩa athingu nĩ ya kĩhooto, no ũtaaro wa andũ arĩa aaganu nĩ wa maheeni.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

kikuyu: Maikarĩte kwa ihinda-rĩ, Kaini akĩrehe maciaro mamwe ma mũgũnda marĩ igongona kũrĩ Jehova.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.

kikuyu: Thuutha ũcio Iburahĩmu nĩ aahikirie mũtumia ũngĩ, wetagwo Ketura.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

kikuyu: Mīmera ya Kenya mpya nī mīraihu, na īgakinya mita īmwe.
english: Kenya mpya variety stems are tall, rising to about 1 meter.

kikuyu: Nīteithagia marigū na kūhee īrio iria njega nīundu wa mīri yao.
english: They also benefit the banana by recycling nutrients from deep capture, because of their rooting system, via litter fall.

kikuyu: atĩKristũnĩakanyariirwo, na atuĩke wa mbere kũriũka kuuma kũrĩ arĩa akuũ, nĩguo ahunjie ũhoro wa ũtheri kũrĩ andũ aake kĩũmbe o na kũrĩ andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ.”
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

kikuyu: Nake mũrutani ũcio wa watho akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ũrĩa wamũiguĩrĩire tha.” Jesũ akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Thiĩ ũgeeke o ta ũguo.”
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

kikuyu: Nĩngerekeria marakara makwa ndĩ na ũiru ngũũkĩrĩre, nao nĩmagakũherithia marĩ na marakara manene. Nĩmagagũtinia maniũrũ na matũ, nao andũ anyu arĩa magaatigara nĩmakaniinwo na rũhiũ rwa njora. Magaataha ariũ anyu na aarĩ anyu, nao arĩa anyu magaatigara nĩmakaniinwo na mwaki.
english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩhithia mũndũ wa itũũra rĩake betha kana indo amũigĩre-rĩ, nacio indo icio ciywo kuuma nyũmba yake, mũici ũcio angĩnyiitwo no nginya arĩhe indo icio maita meerĩ.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: Na ti-itherũ nĩngarĩhanĩria gũitwo gwa thakame yanyu. Ndĩmĩrĩhanĩrie o na kuuma kũrĩ nyamũ o na ĩrĩkũ. Nake mũndũ angĩita thakame ya mũndũ ũngĩ, o nake nĩakarĩhio thakame ĩyo.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

kikuyu: Isiraeli agĩthiĩ o na mbere na rũgendo na akĩamba hema yake mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Migidali-Ederi.
english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo magũrũ mao mahanyũkaga mathiĩ mehia-inĩ, nao mahiũhaga magaite thakame.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

kikuyu: Tũũrai mũiguanĩte mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ. Tigagai gwĩtĩĩa, no mwĩtĩkagĩre kũgĩa ngwatanĩro na andũ arĩa matarĩ igweta. Tigagai kwĩona ta mũrĩ oogĩ.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

kikuyu: Juda, we ũrĩ kĩana kĩa mũrũũthi, mũrũ wakwa; we ũcookaga kuuma ũguĩmi-inĩ ũhũũnĩte ũguĩmi waku. O ta mũrũũthi-rĩ, ethunaga na agakoma thĩ, o ta mũrũũthi wa mũgoma-rĩ, nũũ ũngĩthĩgĩrĩria kũmwarahũra?
english: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

kikuyu: Gūkūmba kwa mboga nīkūnyihaga ūrugarī ūngīthiī makīria ma 25°C
english: Head formation reduced at temperatures higher than 25 degrees Celsius.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio magĩcookeria Jesũ atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ tũtiũĩ woimĩte kũ.”
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

kikuyu: na Aijaloni, na Gathi-Rimoni, hamwe na ũrĩithio wamo.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: “ ‘Angĩkorwo ekũruta nĩ ũndũ wa gũcookia ngaatho-rĩ, nĩ arutanĩrie iruta rĩu rĩa gũcookia ngaatho hamwe na tũmĩgate tũrugĩtwo tũtarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia tũtukanĩtio na maguta na tũmĩgate tũrĩa tũhũthũ tũrugĩtwo tũtarĩ na ndawa ya kũimbia tũrĩ tũhake maguta, na tũmĩgate twa mũtu ũrĩa mũhinyu mũno, ũkimanĩtio wega na ũgatukanio na maguta.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

kikuyu: Ciugo ciaku cianatiirĩrĩra arĩa manahĩngwo makenda kũgũa; nĩwe wanekĩra maru marĩa magondoku hinya.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Babuloni nĩgũgatahwo; andũ othe arĩa magaagũtaha nĩmagakuua indo cia kũmaigana,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo indo ciothe cioimire harĩ we, na nĩwe ũcitũũragia ciothe, na ciothe-rĩ, no ciake. Nake arogoocagwo nginya tene na tene! Ameni.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Akĩĩhũgũra, na hau mũtwe-inĩ wake haarĩ na mũgate wahĩhĩtio na makara mahiũ, na nĩ haarĩ na ndigithũ yarĩ na maaĩ. Akĩrĩa na akĩnyua, agĩcooka agĩkoma rĩngĩ.
english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

kikuyu: “Kaĩ mũrĩ na haaro-ĩ, inyuĩ arutani a watho na Afarisai, hinga ici! Mũhaana mbĩrĩra hake mũnyũ mwerũ, iria cionekaga irĩ thaka mwena wa nja, no thĩinĩ ciyũrĩte mahĩndĩ ma andũ akuũ, na gĩko kĩa mĩthemba yothe.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

kikuyu: Mūtī ūyū nīūrī mūtugo wa kwaga gūciara kīmera-inī kīmwe no ūgaciara kīu kīngī.
english: The tree has a tendency of alternate bearing.

kikuyu: Mĩhũmũ ya kanua gakwa nĩmĩnungu harĩ mũtumia wakwa; nduĩkĩte wa kũmenwo harĩ ariũ a maitũ.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

kikuyu: Nao ariũ a Benjamini maarĩ: Bela, na Bekeri, na Ashibeli, na Gera, na Naamani, na Ehi, na Roshu, na Mupimu, na Hupimu, na Aradi.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

kikuyu: “Mwathi ũcio nĩagathĩrĩirie mũrũgamĩrĩri ũcio wa indo ciake ũtaarĩ mwĩhokeku nĩ ũndũ wa kũgĩa na ũũgĩ. Nĩgũkorwo andũ a gũkũ thĩ nĩ oogĩ na maũndũ mao gũkĩra andũ a ũtheri.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

kikuyu: Nake mũgerania akĩmũkora, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Angĩkorwo wee nĩwe Mũrũ wa Ngai-rĩ, ĩra mahiga maya matuĩke mĩgate.”
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

kikuyu: Tonyerai ihingo ciake mũrĩ na ngaatho, mũtoonye nja ciake mũkĩmũgoocaga; mũcookeriei ngaatho na mũgooce rĩĩtwa rĩake.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

kikuyu: Mũcaayo wa arĩa marakua nĩũraiguuo ũkiuma itũũra inene, nayo mĩoyo ya arĩa agurarie no gũkaya ĩrakaya ĩkĩenda ũteithio. No Ngai gũtirĩ mũndũ aratuĩra ciira nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩka ũũru.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

kikuyu: na Elishama, na Beeliada, na Elifeleti.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Makĩhe Musa ũhoro ũyũ: “Nĩtwatoonyire bũrũri ũrĩa watũtũmire, naguo nĩ bũrũri ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ! Maya nĩmo maciaro maguo.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthamaki wa Isiraeli agĩĩta ũmwe wa anene ake, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndehera Mikaya mũrũ wa Imula narua.”
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Daudi nĩambatĩtie ithandũkũ rĩa Ngai kuuma Kiriathu-Jearimu akarĩiga harĩa aarĩthondekeire, tondũ nĩarĩambĩire hema kũu Jerusalemu.
english: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Gūthathaūra matunda mītī-inī
english: Thinning;

kikuyu: Ūtheru mwega wa mūgūnda; Matunda marwaru(marī mūtī-inī kana ona magwīte) mabatiī kweherio kaingī(maita merī o wiki) na mathikwo irima rīna ūriku wa 50cm kana maikio thīinī wa ibuba rīihūrītio maaī matukanīte ma oiro kwa ihinda ria wiki īmwe.
english: Proper orchard sanitation; Infested fruits (both on the tree and fallen) should be removed regularly (twice a week) and buried 50 cm or dipped in a drum filled with water mixed with used oil for 1 week.

kikuyu: Niĩ ndĩ mũgeni gũkũ thĩ; ndũkaahithe maathani maku.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

kikuyu: Thikĩrĩriai na mũtege matũ, tigai gwĩtĩĩa, nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩarĩtie.
english: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.

kikuyu: nayo njĩra ya thayũ matimĩũĩ.”
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”*

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩkĩnginyĩrĩra, ngĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

kikuyu: “Jehova, Ngai wa Isiraeli ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘O ta ngũyũ ici imwe njega-rĩ, ũguo noguo nyonaga andũ a Juda marĩ ega arĩa maatahirwo, acio ndaaru- tire gũkũ ngĩmatwara bũrũri wa Babuloni.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.
