kikuyu: “Ndungata ĩrĩa yaheetwo taranda igĩrĩ o nayo ĩgĩũka. Ĩkiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathi wakwa waheire taranda igĩrĩ! Atĩrĩrĩ, nĩthũkũmĩte ingĩ igĩrĩ.’
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa ithandũkũ rĩu gũtiarĩ na kĩndũ kĩngĩ tiga o ihengere iria igĩrĩ Musa aaigĩte ho rĩrĩa aarĩ Horebu, kũrĩa Jehova aarĩkanĩire kĩrĩkanĩro na andũ a Isiraeli maarĩkia kuuma Misiri.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, nĩ kwagĩire ngʼaragu ĩngĩ bũrũri-inĩ ũcio, tiga ĩrĩa ya mbere ya hĩndĩ ya Iburahĩmu, nake Isaaka agĩthiĩ Gerari kũrĩ Abimeleku mũthamaki wa Afilisti.*
english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

kikuyu: acio maiyũragwo nĩ gĩkeno magakena maakinya mbĩrĩra?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

kikuyu: Kũrathimwo nĩ mũndũ ũrĩa thiaka wake ũiyũrĩte mĩguĩ. Matigaaconorithio rĩrĩa magaakorwo magĩciira na thũ ciao hau kĩhingo-inĩ.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

kikuyu: Andũ amwe magĩũka makĩĩra Jehoshafatu atĩrĩ, “Mbũtũ nene ya ita kuuma Edomu nĩĩroka kũrũa nawe, yumĩte mũrĩmo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa iria. O na rĩu nĩĩkinyĩte Hazezoni-Tamaru” (na nokuo Eni-Gedi).
english: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo moko manyu nĩmathaahĩte nĩ ũiti wa thakame, nacio ciara cianyu ikaiyũra wĩhia. Tũnua twanyu nĩtwarĩtie ndeto cia maheeni, na nĩmĩ cianyu ikangʼungʼuaga o ndeto cia waganu.
english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

kikuyu: Ningĩ wĩkĩre Urimu na Thumimu† thĩinĩ wa gakuo kau ga gĩthũri, nĩgeetha ciikarage gĩthũri-inĩ kĩa Harũni rĩrĩa rĩothe arĩĩtoonyaga agathiĩ mbere ya Jehova. Ũguo nĩguo Harũni arĩkuuaga ũhoti wa gũtuagĩra andũ a Isiraeli ciira gĩthũri-inĩ gĩake arĩ mbere ya Jehova.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩkĩ nĩkĩo akaanangĩra taama ũrĩa wohanĩtie andũ othe, na cuka ũrĩa ũhumbĩrĩte ndũrĩrĩ ciothe;
english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo: “Atĩrĩrĩ, kũu Zayuni nĩnjigĩte ihiga rĩrĩa rĩtũmaga andũ mahĩngwo, na ngaiga rwaro rwa ihiga rũrĩa rũtũmaga magũe, nake mũndũ ũrĩa ũmwĩhokete ndarĩ hĩndĩ agaaconorithio.”
english: even as it is written, “Behold,§ I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”*

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa othe aamũre nĩmamũgeithia.
english: All the saints greet you.

kikuyu: Niĩ haana ta mũndũ gĩtaigua, ũrĩa ũtaiguaga, ngahaana ta mũndũ ũtaaragia, ũrĩa ũtangĩtumũra kanua gake;
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: “O na ningĩ korwo ndarehithia mũthiro bũrũri ũcio, na niĩ ndĩũitĩrĩrie mangʼũrĩ makwa na ũndũ wa gũitithia thakame, na njũragithie andũ akuo na mahiũ mao,
english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

kikuyu: Nĩwamaheire bũrũri ũyũ werĩire maithe mao na mwĩhĩtwa atĩ nĩũkamahe, bũrũri ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ.
english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ ũngĩiya mũndũ ũngĩ na hinya akamwendie, kana o na anyiitwo arĩ nake atanamwendia- rĩ, no nginya ooragwo.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo gũtirĩ o na ũmwe witũ ũtũũraga nĩ ũndũ wake mwene, na gũtirĩ o na ũmwe witũ ũkuaga nĩ ũndũ wake mwene.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

kikuyu: Mītī īno mīkuhī nī mīega mūno harī mīgūnda mīnini na nīūndū wa ūnyihu ūyū nī kuuga atī īgūkinya fiti 10 nginya 13 (MITA 3 nginya 4 harī ūraihu)
english: Dwarf mango trees are ideal for small backyard gardens and their compact nature means that they will only reach 10 to 13 feet (three to four metres) tall.

kikuyu: Maricani kana ngenyekenyi iria cia goro itiagĩrĩire kũgwetanio naguo; thogora wa ũũgĩ ũkĩrĩte wa ruru ĩrĩa ndune.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

kikuyu: “Kũrĩ indo ithatũ irĩ mũkinyũkĩrie mũgaacĩru, o na nĩ inya ngaacĩru rĩrĩa igũthiĩ:
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

kikuyu: Mbere ya kūoha, geria kūruta rīera kuuma gīkabu-inī ūcoke wūige gīkabu kīu handū hahehu, hena ndūma na hatarī na wūigū.
english: Squeeze any additional air out of the bag before closing the seal. Store coffee bags in a cool, dark, and dry area.

kikuyu: Ikoro itungu na nīrīrī thundo nini
english: Thick green skin with slight pebbling.

kikuyu: Cikĩmũtuĩra mata, cikĩoya kamũrangi kau, na cikĩmũhũũra nako mũtwe.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

kikuyu: Harĩ ũraihu wa gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio ũrĩa ũngĩtigara, nuthu ya gĩtambaya kĩrĩa gĩtigaire nĩ gĩcunjuure mwena wa thuutha wa hema ĩyo nyamũre.
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa irathĩro kũraihanĩrĩirie na ithũĩro-rĩ, ũguo no taguo atwehereirie mehia maitũ magatũraihĩrĩria.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

kikuyu: Mũtumia mũũgĩ nĩ gwaka akaga nyũmba yake, no mũtumia mũkĩĩgu nĩgũtharia atharagia nyũmba yake na moko make mwene.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

kikuyu: Rīrīa ūrūrū wa mūrimū wakīra,ndariri ingī cionekaga nī hamwe na kūiba kwa mūtwe, ngingo thiore na gūkua kwa magūrū
english: In severe illness, other symptoms include swelling of the head, twisted neck, and leg paralysis

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũngĩrĩ atumumu-rĩ, mũtingĩrĩ na mehia; no rĩu tondũ muugaga atĩ nĩmuonaga-rĩ, mũgũikara o na wĩhia wanyu.”
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

kikuyu: Mūthemba ūyū ūkūraga wega matūra-inī marīa matarī kūndū gūtarī irīma.
english: The variety is is best suited for cultivation in low altitude areas

kikuyu: Ha ũhoro ũkoniĩ bũrũri wa Misiri: Ĩno nĩyo ndũmĩrĩri ya gũũkĩrĩra mbũtũ cia ita cia Firaũni Neko, mũthamaki wa bũrũri wa Misiri, iria ciahooteirwo kũu Karikemishi, Rũũĩ-inĩ rwa Farati, nĩ Nebukadinezaru mũthamaki wa Babuloni, mwaka-inĩ wa kana wa wathani wa Jehoiakimu mũrũ wa Josia, mũthamaki wa Juda:
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

kikuyu: Hūra dawa onarua ungīona nding'oing'o na ngūnga ciatharīkīra mīmera yaku.
english: Spraying should be done after you notice beetles or cutworms consuming foliage.

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, gwatania ndaĩ na warĩrie andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli na ngerekano.
english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

kikuyu: Thũũrimaga mahiũ maku na kĩyo, ũmenyagĩrĩre wega ndũũru ciaku;
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

kikuyu: Nĩanyiihagia andũ arĩa maikaraga kũrĩa gũtũũgĩru, o na itũũra rĩrĩa itũũgĩru akarĩharũrũkia, akarĩharagania thĩ, agacooka akarĩtungumania rũkũngũ-inĩ.
english: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

kikuyu: Kĩrĩma kĩu kĩa Ngai nĩ gĩthaka na gĩkaraiha na igũrũ, na nĩkĩo gĩkeno gĩa thĩ yothe. O ta ũrĩa Zafoni gũtũgĩrĩte na igũrũ mũno, no taguo Kĩrĩma gĩa Zayuni kĩhaana, itũũra rĩu inene rĩa Mũthamaki ũrĩa Mũnene.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩũka kũrĩ niĩ ataguucĩrĩirio nĩ Baba ũrĩa wandũmire, na niĩ nĩngamũriũkia mũthenya wa kũrigĩrĩria.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndaarĩ kaana-rĩ, ndaaragia o ta kaana, na ndeeciiragia o ta kaana, na ndaataranagia maũndũ o ta kaana. No hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndaatuĩkire mũndũ mũgima-rĩ, ngĩtigana na maũndũ ma wana.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

kikuyu: Ti-itherũ Jehova nĩakahooreria Zayuni, o na ahoorerie kũndũ gwakuo kũrĩa kwanangĩtwo; werũ wakuo akaaũtua o ta Edeni, na rũngʼũrĩ rwakuo arũtue o ta mũgũnda wa Jehova. Kũu guothe gũkaiyũra gĩkeno, na gũcanjamũka ngoro, na gũcookagia ngaatho, o gũkĩinagwo nyĩmbo.
english: For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

kikuyu: nake Isiraeli akĩĩra Jusufu atĩrĩ, “O ta ũrĩa ũũĩ, ariũ a thoguo nĩmararĩithia mbũri gũkuhĩ na Shekemu. Ũka, nĩngũgũtũma kũrĩ o.” Nake akĩmũcookeria, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ũguo noguo.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ ũrogi ũngĩũraga Jakubu, gũtirĩ ũragũri ũngĩthũkia Isiraeli. Rĩu ha ũhoro wa Jakubu na wa Isiraeli kũrĩĩranagwo atĩrĩ, ‘Ta kĩonei ũrĩa Ngai ekĩte!’
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

kikuyu: Nake Mũthamaki Solomoni akĩruta igongona rĩa ngʼombe 22,000 na rĩa ngʼondu na mbũri 120,000. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũthamaki na andũ othe makĩamũra hekarũ ya Ngai.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

kikuyu: Kũroaga gũtuĩka ũguo! Ngai arotuĩka wa ma, na mũndũ o wothe atuĩke wa maheeni, o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “Nĩguo kuonekage atĩ rĩrĩa ũkwaria, wee waragia maũndũ ma kĩhooto, na ũhootanage rĩrĩa ũgũciirithania.”
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”*

kikuyu: “Ngaatua itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu hĩba ya mahiga, gũtuĩke kũndũ gwa gũtũũrwo nĩ mbwe; namo matũũra ma Juda nĩngamaharagania, kwage mũndũ o na ũmwe ũngĩtũũra kuo.”
english: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

kikuyu: Cookeriai Jehova ngaatho, nĩgũkorwo we nĩ mwega; wendo wake nĩ wa tene na tene.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Jokishani nĩwe warĩ ithe wa Sheba na Dedani; nacio njiaro cia Dedani nĩcio ciarĩ Aashuri, na Aletushi na Aleumi.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

kikuyu: Nake Shaitani agĩcookeria Jehova, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Gĩkonde kĩrĩhagwo na gĩkonde! Mũndũ no arute indo ciake ciothe nĩguo ahonokie muoyo wake.
english: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo agĩcooka kũrĩ arutwo ake, agĩkora makomete, akĩũria Petero atĩrĩ, “Mũtingĩhota gũikara ithaa rĩmwe mwĩiguĩte hamwe na niĩ?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

kikuyu: Ingĩkorwo ndĩ na kĩheo gĩa kũratha ũhoro, na ngorwo no hote kũmenya maũndũ mothe ma hitho na ngagĩa na ũmenyo wothe, na ingĩkorwo ndĩ na wĩtĩkio ũrĩa ũngĩhota gũthaamia irĩma, no ndirĩ na wendani-rĩ, ndirĩ bata o na hanini.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

kikuyu: Ūndū ūyū ūtigaga arīmi moko-inī na brokers iria ithukagia thogora wa maembe.
english: This leaves them at the mercy of brokers, who dictate meager prices.

kikuyu: Nao aanake magĩũka, makĩoha mwĩrĩ wake na cuka, makĩuumia nja na makĩũthika.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Solomoni agĩthamaka Isiraeli guothe.
english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

kikuyu: na wa ikũmi na kenda kũrĩ Pethahia, na wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ kũrĩ Jehezekeli,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

kikuyu: ‘Inyuĩ ene nĩmweyoneire ũrĩa Ndeekire bũrũri wa Misiri, o na ũrĩa ndahaanire ta ndamũkuuire na mathagu ma nderi, ngĩmũrehe harĩ niĩ.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

kikuyu: Wee nĩwe Mũrungu wakwa, nĩngũgũcookeria ngaatho; Wee nĩwe Ngai wakwa, nĩngũgũtũũgĩria.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

kikuyu: Mũndũ wa mbere aarĩ wa rũkũngũ rwa thĩ, no mũndũ wa keerĩ oimĩte igũrũ.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

kikuyu: “Ningĩ to aya oiki ndĩrahoera. Ndĩrahoera o na arĩa angĩ makaanjĩtĩkia nĩ ũndũ wa ndũmĩrĩri ya aya,
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

kikuyu: Ũhoro ũcio wothe wekĩkire ihinda-inĩ rĩa ta mĩaka magana mana ma mĩrongo ĩtano. “Thuutha wa ũguo, Ngai akĩmahe atiirĩrĩri bũrũri o nginya hĩndĩ ya Samũeli ũrĩa warĩ mũnabii.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

kikuyu: Hīndī īno,mīembe ndīkaheo maaī.
english: During this stage, stop giving them water.

kikuyu: Maūthī ma mbūga mūthemba wa F1 nī marīkū?
english: What are the characteristics of F1?

kikuyu: “No rĩrĩ, mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai angĩũka kũmĩrora akore atĩ ũgumu ũcio ndũthegeete thuutha wa nyũmba ĩyo gũthingwo rĩngĩ-rĩ, nĩagatua atĩ nyũmba ĩyo ndĩrĩ na thaahu, nĩgũkorwo ũgumu ũcio nĩũthirĩte.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

kikuyu: No ũhote kũmĩtoonyia rũrigi iniũrũ, kana ũmĩtũrĩkanie rũthĩa na ndwano?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

kikuyu: Jehova Ngai wanyu angĩkongerera mĩhaka ya bũrũri wanyu o ta ũrĩa erĩire maithe manyu na mwĩhĩtwa, amũhe bũrũri wothe ũrĩa aamerĩire,
english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

kikuyu: Makuuaga marĩ ethĩ, magakua hamwe na arũme arĩa maraya ma mahooero-inĩ.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

kikuyu: Nake Saũlũ akĩĩra mũkuui wa indo ciake cia mbaara atĩrĩ, “Comora rũhiũ rwaku rwa njora ũũthece naruo, nĩguo andũ aya mataruaga matigooke kũnyararithia.” No mũndũ ũcio mũkuui wa indo ciake cia mbaara agĩĩtigĩra mũno, akĩrega gwĩka ũguo; nĩ ũndũ ũcio Saũlũ akĩoya rũhiũ rwake rwa njora, akĩrũgwĩra.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mwaganu erũagĩrĩra na ũrũme, no mũndũ mũrũngĩrĩru nĩeciiragia ũhoro wa mĩthiĩre yake.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

kikuyu: Magĩtaha mahiũ ma Ahagari acio: ngamĩĩra 50,000, na ngʼondu 250,000, na ndigiri 2,000, ningĩ nĩmatahire andũ 100,000,
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

kikuyu: Nake akĩrũga na igũrũ, akĩambĩrĩria gwĩtwara. Agĩcooka agĩthiĩ nao hekarũ-inĩ, etwarĩte na magũrũ, akĩrũgarũgaga na akĩgoocaga Ngai.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Paũlũ aakinyire, Ayahudi arĩa maikũrũkĩte kuuma Jerusalemu makĩmũrigiicĩria, na makĩmũthitangĩra maũndũ maingĩ mooru, marĩa matangĩahotire kuonania atĩ nĩ ma ma.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

kikuyu: “Ũyũ nĩwe mũndũ ũrĩa wagire gũtua Ngai kĩĩhitho gĩake kĩa hinya, no eehokire ũtonga wake mũingĩ, na akĩgĩa hinya nĩ ũndũ wa kũniina andũ arĩa angĩ!”
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Ishumaeli nĩanyiitire mĩgwate andũ acio angĩ othe arĩa maikaraga Mizipa, akĩmataha: nao maarĩ airĩtu a mũthamaki, hamwe na andũ acio angĩ othe arĩa maatigĩtwo kuo, arĩa Nebuzaradani ũcio mũnene wa arangĩri a mũthamaki aatuĩte maroragwo nĩ Gedalia mũrũ wa Ahikamu. Ishumaeli mũrũ wa Nethania nĩamatahire akiumagara nao, agĩtuĩkania erekeire mũrĩmo wa andũ a Amoni akeeneane kũrĩ o.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all of the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩagacicinĩra kĩgongona-inĩ irĩ irio, rĩĩrĩ nĩ iruta rĩrutĩirwo Jehova rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Mũhĩrĩga wa Asheri ũkaamba hema ciao mariganĩtie nao. Mũtongoria wa andũ a Asheri nĩ Pagieli mũrũ wa Okirani.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa maakinyire harĩ arutwo arĩa angĩ, makĩona kĩrĩndĩ kĩnene kĩmarigiicĩirie, na arutani a watho magĩkararania nao.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

kikuyu: ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira na mĩtĩ mĩraaya yarĩo, hamwe na gĩtĩ gĩa tha;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

kikuyu: marigū mabataranaga mbura īīgana atīa?
english: How much rainfall do banana require?

kikuyu: Rĩĩtwa rĩega nĩrĩakwĩrirĩrio gũkĩra ũtonga mũnene; gũtĩĩka nĩ kwega gũkĩra betha kana thahabu.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

kikuyu: Kũu agĩthiĩ agĩtoonya ngurunga, akĩraara ho. Nakĩo kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩkĩmũkinyĩra, akĩũrio atĩrĩ, “Elija, ũreka atĩa haha?”
english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

kikuyu: Thũ ciakwa icookaga na thuutha, ikahĩngwo igathira irĩ mbere yaku.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

kikuyu: Nake mũtumia ũcio akĩmũhe rũgano rũu, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ngombo ĩrĩa ya Mũhibirania, ĩrĩa watũreheire ĩgũũkĩte kũrĩ niĩ kũnyarara.
english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Asa aiguire ciugo icio na akĩigua ũrathi wa Azaria mũrũ wa Odedi ũrĩa mũnabii-rĩ, akĩĩyũmĩrĩria. Akĩeheria mĩhianano ĩrĩa mĩmeneku kuuma bũrũri wothe wa Juda na Benjamini, o na kuuma matũũra-inĩ marĩa aatahĩte kũu irĩma-inĩ cia Efiraimu. Agĩcookereria kĩgongona kĩa Jehova kĩrĩa kĩarĩ mbere ya gĩthaku kĩa hekarũ ya Jehova.
english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh’s altar that was before Yahweh’s porch.

kikuyu: Anene a Amoni makĩmũciirĩrĩra, na makĩmũũragĩra o kũu nyũmba-inĩ yake ya ũthamaki.
english: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

kikuyu: Gūkorwo na ihinda iritū rīrīa īkūhuhia kana īkūrīa nīūndū mūrimū ūyū nīūhotomagia njīra ya kūhuhia, kanua na mūmero.
english: Difficulty in breathing and eating due to diseases affecting the respiratory system, mouth, and throat.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ mũrũme kana mũndũ-wa-nja angĩkorwo na kĩronda mũtwe kana kĩreru-rĩ,
english: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

kikuyu: Nake Jeremia agĩikara kũu kĩhingo-inĩ kĩa arangĩri nginya mũthenya ũrĩa itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu rĩatunyanirwo. 39 Na rĩrĩ, itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu rĩatunyanirwo ũũ:
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken. 39

kikuyu: Ũhoro wa kĩrĩra gĩaku nĩguo ũtuĩkĩte rwĩmbo rwakwa, o kũrĩa guothe ingĩikara.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

kikuyu: Joabu mũrũ wa Zeruia nĩambĩrĩirie gũtara andũ, no ndaarĩkirie. Mangʼũrĩ nĩmakinyĩire Isiraeli nĩ ũndũ wa itarana rĩu. Naguo mũigana wa itarana rĩu ndwandĩkirwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa maũndũ ma Mũthamaki Daudi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

kikuyu: “Ĩrai Hezekia mũthamaki wa Juda atĩrĩ: Ndũgetĩkĩrie Ngai ũcio wĩhokete akũheenie rĩrĩa ekuuga atĩrĩ, ‘Jerusalemu rĩtikũneanwo kũrĩ mũthamaki wa Ashuri.’
english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

kikuyu: Arĩa oogĩ ngoro-inĩ metagwo akũũrani maũndũ, na ciugo njega itũũgagĩria ũtaaro.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

kikuyu: Nawe ũgaatungumanio thĩ, waragie ũrĩ thĩ; ũtuĩke wa kũngʼungʼua ũrĩ hau tĩĩri-inĩ. Mũgambo waku ũgaatuĩka ta wa roho wa ũragũri ũroima na thĩ; naguo mũgambo waku ũkaaiguagwo ũrĩ wa mĩheehũ ũkiuma tĩĩri-inĩ.
english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

kikuyu: no gatarũ nĩkarĩkĩtie gũthiĩ itĩĩna iraiharaihu kuuma thĩ nyũmũ, gakĩhũũragwo nĩ makũmbĩ ma maaĩ tondũ kerekeire na kũrĩa rũhuho ruoimaga.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, mũndũ ũngĩ ũrĩ na hinya kũmũkĩra angĩmũtharĩkĩra amũtoorie, nĩamũtunyaga indo ciake cia mbaara iria ehokete, na akagaĩra andũ indo iria akoragwo atahĩte.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ndungata icio cia andũ-a-nja na ciana ciacio igĩkuhĩrĩria na makĩinamĩrĩra.
english: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: akĩrũnda mĩthabibũ yao, na mĩkũyũ, na akiunanga mĩtĩ ya bũrũri wao.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

kikuyu: Wariĩ wa itoonyero warĩ wa mĩkono ikũmi,† nacio thingo iria ciarĩ o mwena wa itoonyero rĩu ciarĩ cia mĩkono ĩtano‡ kwarama. Nĩacookire agĩthima nja ya handũ-hau-haamũre; handũ hau haarĩ na ũraihu wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩna,§ na wariĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ.*
english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits,† and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

kikuyu: “Ngũmũhe rĩathani rĩerũ: Endanagai mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ. O ta ũrĩa ndĩmwendete, o na inyuĩ no nginya mwendanage mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩ kwarĩ mũthenya ũngĩ araika maathiire kũrũgama mbere ya Jehova, na Shaitani o nake agĩthiĩ hamwe nao kũrũgama mbere yake.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Ningĩ Musa agĩaka nja gũthiũrũrũka hema ĩyo nyamũre na kĩgongona na agĩĩkĩra gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio itoonyero rĩa nja ĩyo. Na nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩrĩkia wĩra ũcio.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa mwaganu nĩakoona ũguo na arakare, nĩakahagarania magego make, acooke abuĩrie; merirĩria ma arĩa aaganu matigaakinyanĩra.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Rekodi ya ūgima wa mwīrī: mūthenya ūrīa njanjo yaheyanirwo, rītwa ria mūheani wa njanjo, mūthemba wa njanjo, rītwa ria mūrimū, njīra ya kūheana njanjo, na maūndū mangī.
english: Health record sheets: date of vaccination, name of the vaccinator, type of vaccine, name of the disease, method of vaccination, etc.

kikuyu: No mūhaka ng'ombe īcokie macumbī maria īkoragwo īhūthīrīte thutha wa gūciara mbere ya īciarite ringī nīūndū wa ūgima mwega wa mwīrī na kūruta iria wega.
english: Minerals mobilized during early lactation must be replenished prior to the next calving to maintain cow health and performance.

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa Gumboro: Ndariri nī ta kūharwo, kūremwo nī kūrīa na kūhorera. Mūrimū ūyū umanaga na virus na kuogwo na ūgirī rīirio na njanjo.
english: Gumboro Disease: Symptoms include diarrhea, loss of appetite, and depression. It’s caused by a virus and can be prevented by vaccination.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Eliakimu mũrũ wa Hilikia ũrĩa mũrori wa maũndũ ma nyũmba ya ũthamaki, na Shebina ũrĩa mwandĩki-marũa, na Joa mũrũ wa Asafu ũrĩa mwandĩki wa maũndũ ma ihinda rĩu, magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Hezekia, matembũrangĩte nguo ciao, makĩmwĩra ũrĩa mũnene ũcio wa mbũtũ cia ita oigĩte.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

kikuyu: Ndaneanire mũgongo wakwa kũrĩ andũ arĩa maahũũraga, kĩreru gĩakwa ngĩkĩnengera arĩa maangũũraga nderu; ndiahithire ũthiũ wakwa atĩ nĩguo ndikanyũrũrio, kana ndige gũtuĩrwo mata.
english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa maakinyire kĩhuhĩro-inĩ kĩa ngano gĩa Kidoni, Uza agĩtambũrũkia guoko nĩguo anyiitĩrĩre ithandũkũ rĩu rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro, tondũ ndegwa nĩciahĩngirwo.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa wĩkĩte ũguo mũigĩre mũndũ mũũru amũũkĩrĩre; mwena wake wa ũrĩo nĩkũrũgame mũndũ wa kũmũthitanga.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Ũũ nĩguo Jehova ekuuga: Nĩngũiyũria arĩa othe matũũraga bũrũri ũyũ na ũrĩĩu, o hamwe na athamaki acio maikaragĩra gĩtĩ kĩa ũthamaki kĩa Daudi, na athĩnjĩri-Ngai, na anabii, na arĩa othe matũũraga Jerusalemu.
english: Then tell them, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

kikuyu: Nĩngatũma kĩĩruru kĩa riũa gĩcooke na thuutha makinya ikũmi marĩa gĩikũrũkĩte ngathĩ-inĩ ya Ahazu.’ ” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ũtheri wa riũa ũgĩcooka na thuutha makinya ikũmi marĩa waikũrũkĩte.
english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.” ’ ” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.

kikuyu: “Nĩngakũhonokia kuuma moko-inĩ ma andũ arĩa aaganu, na ngũkũũre ngũrute moko-inĩ ma andũ arĩa matarĩ tha.” 16
english: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.” 16

kikuyu: na atĩ nĩathikirwo, na atĩ mũthenya wa gatatũ akĩriũkio kũringana na ũrĩa Maandĩko macio moigĩte,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Kūrigīrīria - Mūtungatire mwega nī wabata nīguo kūrigīrīria maūndū marīa mangītūma ng'ombe īharwo. Kīhumo gia kūharwo no mūhaka kīmenyeke na gīthondekwo.
english: Prevention—Good management practices are needed to prevent predisposing situations from occurring. The root problem must be found and corrected.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩĩhia eke ũndũ ũrĩa mũkananie thĩinĩ wa maathani mothe ma Jehova o na angĩkorwo ndaraũmenya-rĩ, nĩagacookererwo nĩ mahĩtia macio ekĩte.
english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa kambĩ ĩgũthaama-rĩ, Harũni na ariũ ake marĩtoonyaga thĩinĩ wa hema ĩyo makaruta gĩtambaya gĩa gũcuurio gĩa kũhakania na makahumbĩra ithandũkũ rĩa Ũira nakĩo.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

kikuyu: Mĩgate ĩyo nĩ ĩigagwo mbere ya Jehova hĩndĩ ciothe, o Thabatũ o Thabatũ, ĩrũgamagĩrĩre andũ a Isiraeli, ĩtuĩke kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa gũtũũra.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Nake Nuhu agĩĩka ũrĩa wothe Mwathani aamwathĩte eeke.
english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo, mũriũ ũrĩa waciarĩtwo na njĩra ya ndũire-rĩ, nĩanyariiraga mũriũ ũcio waciarĩtwo na ũndũ wa hinya wa Roho. Ũguo noguo kũhaana o na rĩu.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

kikuyu: “Mũndũ angĩgwatio nyamũ ya mũndũ ũngĩ, nayo ĩtihio kana ĩkue mwene atarĩ hakuhĩ, no nginya amĩrĩhe.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo ngĩririkana ũrĩa Mwathani oigĩte atĩrĩ, ‘Johana aabatithanagia na maaĩ, no inyuĩ mũkaabatithio na Roho Mũtheru.’
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Tondũ Wee nĩwe ũteithio wakwa-rĩ, nyinagĩra kĩĩruru-inĩ kĩa mathagu maku.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio makĩambata magĩthiĩ kũrĩ mũnene wa nyũmba ya Jusufu, makĩmwarĩria marĩ hau mũromo-inĩ wa nyũmba.
english: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

kikuyu: Esaũ akĩũria ithe atĩrĩ, “Baba, ndũrĩ na kĩrathimo o na kĩmwe ũndigĩirie? Ndaathima o na niĩ, baba!” Na hĩndĩ ĩyo Esaũ akĩrĩra anĩrĩire.
english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

kikuyu: “Githĩ mũthemba ũrĩa thuurĩte wa kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio ti ũyũ: kuohora arĩa moohetwo na njĩra ĩtarĩ ya kĩhooto, na kuohoraga mĩkwa ya icooki rĩa ngingo, na kũrekereria arĩa mahinyĩrĩirio, o na kuunanga macooki mothe ma ngingo?
english: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?

kikuyu: Naguo bũrũri ũcio nĩũgaciaraga maciaro maguo, na inyuĩ nĩmũkarĩĩaga mũkahũũna na mũtũũre kuo mũrĩ na thayũ.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

kikuyu: Nakuo irĩma-inĩ guothe kũrĩa kwanarĩmwo na icembe, mũtigacooka gũthiĩ nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtigĩra congʼe, na mĩtĩ ya mĩigua; kũndũ kũu gũgaatuĩka gwa kũrĩithagio ngʼombe, na gwa kũrangagwo nĩ ndũũru cia ngʼondu.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũyũ ũngĩ rũciinĩ tene-rĩ, Iburahĩmu agĩũkĩra na agĩcooka handũ harĩa aarũgamĩte mbere ya Jehova.
english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ ũrĩa wonire maũndũ macio nĩarutĩte ũira, naguo ũira wake nĩ wa ma. We nĩooĩ atĩ aaragia ũhoro wa ma, na oimbũraga nĩgeetha o na inyuĩ mwĩtĩkie.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

kikuyu: Maembe mendaga ihinda rīa mathaa manana o mūthenya ma riūa nīguo mahote kūruta kīro na matunda.
english: Mango trees ideally need 8 hours of sunlight per day to produce flowers and fruit.

kikuyu: Ngai nĩagatũrathima, nacio ituri ciothe cia thĩ nĩikamwĩtigĩra.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Pilato akĩoya Jesũ, akĩmũhũũrithia iboko.
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

kikuyu: “No angĩkorwo mũndũ mũthingu no agarũrũke atigane na ũthingu wake, na ehie na eke maũndũ marĩ magigi ta marĩa mekagwo nĩ mũndũ mwaganu-rĩ, anga nĩagagĩtũũra muoyo? Hatirĩ ũndũ o na ũmwe wa maũndũ ma ũthingu marĩa aaneka ũkaaririkanwo. Tondũ wa mahĩtia ma kwaga kwĩhokeka na tondũ wa mehia marĩa ekĩte-rĩ, no agaakua.
english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

kikuyu: Firaũni mũthamaki ũcio akĩrakario nĩ anene acio ake eerĩ, mũnene wa arĩa maamũtwaragĩra ndibei na mũnene wa arĩa maamũthondekagĩra mĩgate,
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, ikaragai mwĩiguĩte, tondũ mũtiũĩ mũthenya ũrĩa Mwathani wanyu agooka.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

kikuyu: Gemia mbaũ icio na thahabu, na ũthondeke mĩrĩnga ya thahabu ya kũnyiitĩrĩra mĩgamba ĩyo. O nayo mĩgamba ĩyo nĩĩgemio na thahabu.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Mĩbango ĩgaacagĩra nĩ ũndũ wa kũhooya kĩrĩra, ũngĩtua gũthiĩ mbaara-inĩ, heo ũtaaro.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

kikuyu: Ngũkwĩra atĩrĩ, ndũkoima kuo ũtarĩhĩte thiirĩ wothe, hatarĩ gathendi ũgũtigia.”
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.†”

kikuyu: Nao Ayahudi makiuga magwatĩirie atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ nĩtũrĩ watho; na kũringana na watho ũcio no nginya akue, tondũ nĩetuĩte Mũrũ wa Ngai.”
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

kikuyu: maitho maku nĩmonaga mwĩrĩ wakwa ũtanombwo biũ. Matukũ mothe marĩa nyamũrĩirwo nĩmandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩaku o na mbere ya ũmwe wamo kũgĩa.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

kikuyu: Nake Ngai akĩiga maũndũ mothe rungu rwa magũrũ make, na akĩmũtua mwathi wa gwathaga maũndũ mothe nĩ ũndũ wa kanitha.
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

kikuyu: “Ningĩ wĩre andũ atĩrĩ, ‘Mwĩtheriei, mwĩhaarĩrie nĩ ũndũ wa rũciũ, rĩrĩa mũkaarĩa nyama. Jehova nĩaramũiguire rĩrĩa mũrarĩraga, mũkiugaga atĩrĩ, “Naarĩ korwo tũrĩ na nyama cia kũrĩa! Maũndũ maitũ maarĩ mega rĩrĩa twarĩ bũrũri wa Misiri!” Rĩu-rĩ, Jehova nĩekũmũhe nyama, na nĩmũgũcirĩa.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.

kikuyu: Tũngĩgĩkua ũtwĩroreire nĩkĩ, ithuĩ na ithaka ciitũ hamwe? Tũgũranĩrie hamwe na ithaka ciitũ, ũtũhe irio, na ithuĩ na ithaka ciitũ tũtuĩke ngombo cia Firaũni. Tũhe mbeũ nĩgeetha tũtũũre muoyo, tũtigakue, na nĩguo bũrũri witũ ndũkanangĩke.”
english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

kikuyu: Makĩĩrana atĩrĩ, “Mũroti ũrĩa nĩokĩte!
english: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

kikuyu: nĩ bũrũri ũtakanyiihia irio, na inyuĩ mũtirĩ kĩndũ mũkaaga, bũrũri ũrĩa mahiga maguo arĩ igera, na no mwenje icango irĩma-inĩ ciaguo.
english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

kikuyu: Simoni Petero, na Toma (ũrĩa wetagwo Wa-mahatha), na Nathanieli wa kuuma Kana ya Galili, na ariũ a Zebedi, o na arutwo angĩ eerĩ maarĩ hamwe.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus,† Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Njiarwa-inĩ ciothe iria igooka, nĩmũgatumagĩrĩra ciohe cia ndigi koine-inĩ ka nguo cianyu, o kĩohe gĩkohererwo na rũrigi rwa rangi wa bururu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes‡ on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe§ of each border a cord of blue.

kikuyu: Nĩmathondekeire gakuo kau ga gĩthũri mĩgathĩ ya thahabu therie, ĩhaana ta mũkanda.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: na cia Gebali, na cia Amoni, na cia Amaleki, na cia Filistia, hamwe na andũ a Turo.
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Mwathani ndagakenio nĩ aanake, kana aiguĩre ciana cia ngoriai na atumia a ndigwa tha, nĩgũkorwo andũ othe matiĩtigĩrĩte Ngai na nĩ aaganu, natuo tũnua twao tuothe twaragia maũndũ mooru. No o na kũrĩ ũguo-rĩ, marakara make matirĩ maraahũahũa, guoko gwake no gũtambũrũkĩtio o na rĩu.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

kikuyu: ‘Atĩrĩrĩ, inyuĩ mũngĩikara gũkũ bũrũri ũyũ, nĩngatũma mũikare mũgaacĩire, na ndigacooka kũmũhurunja; nĩngamũhaanda na ndigacooka kũmũmunya, tondũ nĩndĩraigua kĩeha nĩ ũndũ wa mwanangĩko ũrĩa ndĩmũreheire.
english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

kikuyu: nake Jakubu aarĩ ithe wa Jusufu, mũthuuri wa Mariamu, ũrĩa waciarire Jesũ, ũrĩa wĩtagwo Kristũ.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus,§ who is called Christ.

kikuyu: Irigū rīoyaga kīndū mīeri 12-18 gūkūra. Marigū no magethuo thutha wa thīkū 90-150
english: A plant takes roughly 12 to 18 months to mature. Fruits are ready for harvesting 90 – 150 days after.

kikuyu: Andũ a Isiraeli moima Ramesese, maambire hema Sukothu.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo tũgĩtige gũtuĩka tũkenge, tũrĩa tũikanagio mwena na mwena, o na tũkĩhurutagwo haha na harĩa nĩ rũhuho o ruothe rwa ũrutani, na tũgĩtwaragĩrĩrio nĩ wara na ũhinga wa andũ ũrĩa maheenagĩrĩria andũ naguo makamahĩtithia.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

kikuyu: Nī ūndū wīkīkaga kwenja irima rīīgana 45cmx45cmx45cm
english: It is common practice to dig a hole measuring 45 cm × 45 cm × 45 cm.

kikuyu: Ningĩ nĩngũmwĩra o rĩngĩ atĩ mũndũ o wothe ũngĩtĩkĩra kũrua, ũcio amenye atĩ nĩagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwathĩkĩra watho ũrĩ wothe.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio mũgaathũngũthia kĩohe kĩu, no nginya mũkaarutĩra Jehova iruta rĩa njino rĩa gatũrũme ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe gatarĩ na kaũũgũ,
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Kaĩ inyuĩ mũtooĩ atĩ andũ arĩa mahĩtahĩtanaga ihenya-inĩ mahanyũkaga othe, no rĩrĩ, no ũmwe wao ũheagwo kĩheo? Kĩhanyũkei na njĩra ĩrĩa ĩngĩtũma mũkaaheo kĩheo.*
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

kikuyu: Na nũũ ũhaana ta andũ aku a Isiraeli, rũrĩrĩ rũmwe gũkũ thĩ rũrĩa Ngai waruo aakũũrire rũtuĩke andũ ake, nĩgeetha wĩgĩĩre igweta, na wĩke maũndũ manene na ma magegania ma gwĩtigĩrwo, nĩ ũndũ wa kũingata ndũrĩrĩ ciehere mbere ya andũ aku arĩa wakũũrire kuuma bũrũri wa Misiri?
english: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Tigai kwĩruta mĩthiĩre ya ndũrĩrĩ, kana mũguoyohio nĩ morirũ ma kũũrĩa igũrũ, o na gũtuĩka ndũrĩrĩ icio nĩiguoyohetio nĩmo.
english: Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

kikuyu: no nginya mũkooraga andũ arĩa othe matũũraga itũũra rĩu na rũhiũ rwa njora. Itũũra rĩu nĩmũkarĩniina biũ, mũniine andũ a rĩo o na mahiũ makuo.
english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Firaũni akĩĩra Jusufu atĩrĩ, “Kĩroto-inĩ gĩakwa-rĩ, ndĩrarũgamĩte hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Rũũĩ rwa Nili,
english: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

kikuyu: Ndaingatithirie thũ ciakwa ngĩcikinyĩra; ndiacookire na thuutha nginya rĩrĩa cianiinirwo.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo kĩrĩa haandĩte kĩrorĩĩo nĩ andũ angĩ, nacio irio cia mĩgũnda yakwa iromunywo.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

kikuyu: No matiarĩ ehokeku harĩ Ngai wa maithe mao, tondũ nĩmeheanĩte kũrĩ ngai cia andũ a bũrũri ũcio, arĩa Ngai aaniinĩte mehere mbere yao.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

kikuyu: Nake mũtumia ũcio, ona atĩ ndangĩhota kwĩhitha, agĩũka akĩinainaga, akĩĩgũithia magũrũ-inĩ make. Arĩ hau mbere ya andũ othe akĩheana gĩtũmi kĩrĩa gĩatũmĩte amũhutie na ũrĩa aahonirio o ro rĩmwe.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

kikuyu: Kūrigīrīria ngūkū kūnyitwo nī mīrimū mīna ta Newcastle, fowl pox, fowl typhoid na mīrimū mīthemba īngī.
english: To prevent chicken diseases such as Newcastle disease, fowl pox, fowl typhoid and other diseases

kikuyu: ūndū ūyū no ūhinge na njīra ya kūhiūrania na mathīna ma ūciari na gūtigīrīra atī ūracagūra ng'ombe cia gūciarithania iria irī na ngumo na maūthe mega ma ūciari,
english: This can be achieved by managing breeding challenges by ensuring you use a breeding stock that has desirable genetic traits,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aitĩrĩirie mwĩrĩ wakwa maguta macio manungi wega, eekire ũguo nĩgeetha aathagathage ũrĩa ngaathikwo.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

kikuyu: Mīkorobia mūthemba wa Hass nīīciarithanagia.
english: Hass avocado trees are self-pollinating.

kikuyu: Mwaiyũrwo nĩ kĩeha nĩ tondũ nĩndamwĩra maũndũ macio.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli othe moonire mwaki ũkiuma na igũrũ, na riiri wa Jehova ũrĩ igũrũ rĩa hekarũ, magĩturia maru hau haarĩtwo mahiga, maturumithĩtie mothiũ mao thĩ, makĩhooya Jehova na makĩmũcookeria ngaatho, makiugaga atĩrĩ, “Jehova nĩ mwega; wendo wake ũtũũraga nginya tene.”
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

kikuyu: “O na gũtuĩka ũthiũ wake nĩ mũnoru, na njohero yake ĩkaneneha nĩ kũnora-rĩ,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

kikuyu: No ihinda nĩrĩgakinya rĩrĩa mũhikania akeeherio kuuma kũrĩ o, na hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakehinga kũrĩa irio.”
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

kikuyu: Ikia irio ciaku igũrũ rĩa maaĩ, nĩ ũndũ thuutha wa matukũ maingĩ nĩũgaaciona rĩngĩ.
english: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

kikuyu: Nĩngahaanda ũthamaki wake nginya tene angĩtũũra arũmĩtie maathani na mawatho makwa ta ũrĩa kũrekwo ihinda rĩĩrĩ.’
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Rebeka eerirwo ũrĩa Esaũ mũriũ ũcio wake mũkũrũ oigĩte, agĩtũmanĩra Jakubu mũriũ wake ũrĩa mũnini, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Esaũ mũrũ wa nyũkwa arehooreria marakara na gwĩciiria ũrĩa egũkũũraga.
english: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

kikuyu: Musa agĩĩka o ta ũrĩa Jehova aamwathĩte; makĩambata Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Horu makĩonagwo nĩ kĩrĩndĩ kĩu gĩothe.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo andũ arĩa aaganu na a maheeni nĩmathamĩtie tũnua nĩguo manjũkĩrĩre; nĩmarĩtie ũhoro wakwa na rũrĩmĩ rwa maheeni.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

kikuyu: “Mũthenya ũcio nĩmũgakena na mũrũgarũge, tondũ mũcaara wanyu nĩ mũingĩ Igũrũ. Nĩgũko- rwo ũguo noguo maithe mao meekire anabii.
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

kikuyu: Mũnene wa ikũmi na eerĩ, mweri wa ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, aarĩ Helidai ũrĩa Mũnetofathi, wa kuuma nyũmba ya Othinieli. Gĩkundi gĩake kĩarĩ na andũ 24,000.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo aathani ti a kũmakia arĩa mekaga ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire, no nĩ a kũmakia arĩa mekaga ũũru. Nĩũkwenda wagage gwĩtigagĩra ũrĩa wathanaga? Gĩĩkage ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire, nake nĩarĩkũgathagĩrĩria.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

kikuyu: Andũ a Jerusalemu na anene ao matiakũũranire Jesũ, no nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa maamũtuĩrĩire ciira, makĩhingia ciugo cia anabii iria ithomagwo o mũthenya wa Thabatũ.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

kikuyu: Nĩnjũũĩ atĩ ũndũ ũrĩa wothe Ngai ekaga nĩ wagũtũũra nginya tene; ndũngĩongerereka kana ũnyihanyiihe. Ngai awĩkaga nĩgeetha andũ mamwĩtigagĩre.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkaagĩa kĩrĩro kĩnene bũrũri wa Misiri wothe, kĩrĩro kĩũru gĩtarĩ gĩakorwo kuo, na gĩtakagĩa kuo rĩngĩ o na rĩ.
english: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa Musa gũcookia mũtumia wake Zipora, mũthoni-we Jethero nĩamwamũkĩrire,
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

kikuyu: Ūrugarī ūngīkīra, njui cieheragīra kīhumo kiagūo.
english: At high temperature the chicks will move away from the heat source

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩa mĩanangĩko mĩingĩ na moritũ maingĩ makaamakora, rwĩmbo rũrũ nĩrũgatuĩka ũira wa kũmookĩrĩra, nĩ ũndũ njiaro ciao itikariganĩrwo nĩruo. Nĩnjũũĩ ũrĩa maciirĩire gwĩka, o na itarĩ ndĩramatoonyia bũrũri ũrĩa ndaamerĩire na mwĩhĩtwa.”
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

kikuyu: Firaũni akuhĩrĩria-rĩ, andũ a Isiraeli makĩĩhũgũra, makĩona andũ a Misiri mamoimĩte thuutha makĩmaka mũno, magĩkaĩra Jehova.
english: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Maūndū mangī mabata mahutagia mūciarīre wa kahūa nī hamwe na gūcokia ngore cia kahūa kuuma iganda mūgūnda-inī wa kahūa nīguo ikahūthīka ta mūceng'i o hamwe na kūhe mītī irio ciarīkia kūbutha.
english: Other Crop Management Practices Influencing Coffee Yield The return of composed pulp or trash will serve as a mulch to conserve moisture as well as providing a source of nutrients.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa yarahũka, arĩa marĩ hinya nĩmamakaga; mooraga ĩtanamahũũra.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

kikuyu: Ningī nī īhotaga kūrūa na Mūrimū wa Yn na no īhote kūrūa na Mūrimū wa Yntn.
english: It is also immune to Virus Yn and quite resistant to Virus Yntn.

kikuyu: Tani īmwe ya kahua no īgūrūo KES 350,000, iria ingirehe maumirira ma mbeca mūigana wa KES 350,000 nginya KES 525,000 harīīka īmwe
english: One ton of coffee can be sold at KES 350,000, translating to a potential income of KES 350,000 to KES 525,000 per īka

kikuyu: Ndarĩ na kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro gĩa gwĩthara kuuma nduma-inĩ; etereirio kũũragwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

kikuyu: na ndigi cia rangi wa bururu, na cia rangi wa ndathi, na cia rangi mũtune ta gakarakũ, na gatani ĩrĩa njega, o na guoya wa mbũri;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Agiripa akĩĩra Fesito atĩrĩ, “No nyende kwĩiguĩra mũndũ ũcio akĩaria.” Nake Fesito agĩcookia atĩrĩ, “Nĩũkamũigua rũciũ.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ ũcooke woe indo icio kuuma moko-inĩ mao, ũcicinĩre kĩgongona-inĩ igũrũ hamwe na iruta rĩa njino, ituĩke mũtararĩko mwega harĩ Jehova, rĩrĩ iruta rĩrutĩirwo Jehova rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Maakũũranirie Riiri wa Ngai na mũhianano wa ndegwa ĩrĩa ĩrĩĩaga nyeki.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo muoyo wa kĩũmbe ũrĩ thĩinĩ wa thakame, na nĩyo ndĩmũheete mwĩhorohagĩrie nayo kĩgongona-inĩ; thakame nĩyo ĩhorohagĩria muoyo wa mũndũ.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

kikuyu: Nake Jehova akĩĩra Gadi ũrĩa woonagĩra Daudi maũndũ atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

kikuyu: “Mũthenya wa ikũmi wa mweri ũyũ wa mũgwanja, nĩguo Mũthenya wa Kũhoroherio Mehia. Mũgĩage na kĩũngano gĩtheru na mwĩimage irio, na mũrutagĩre Jehova iruta rĩa gũcinwo na mwaki.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nayo mbũtũ ya ita ya Babuloni ĩkĩnyiita Mũthamaki Zedekia. Makĩmũtwara kũrĩ mũthamaki wa Babuloni ũrĩa warĩ kũu Ribila, bũrũri-inĩ wa Hamathu, na kũu nĩkuo aamũtuĩrĩire ciira.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

kikuyu: Ndariri cia mūrimū wa ring spot nī irīkū?
english: What are the symptoms of ring spot in cabbages?

kikuyu: Ningĩ ngĩona ũũgĩ gũkũ thĩ kwaraga riũa ũrĩa wamakirie mũno, watariĩ ũũ:
english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

kikuyu: Agĩcooka akĩoya maguta, maguta ma mũtingʼoe mũnoru, na maguta mothe marĩamahumbĩirenyamacianda, namarĩamahumbĩireini, nahigocierĩnamagutamacio, onakĩero kĩa mwena wa ũrĩo.
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

kikuyu: Igũrũrĩamĩtweyaciũmbeicioirĩmuoyonĩhaarĩkĩndũkĩaraganukĩahaanagatawariĩwakengaga ta mbarabu, na warĩ wa kũmakania.
english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Reke arĩa akuũ mathikage akuũ ao ene, no wee thiĩ ũkahunjie ũhoro wa ũthamaki wa Ngai.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Na niĩ nĩ njoete Alawii ithenya rĩa marigithathi mothe ma ciana cia tũhĩĩ thĩinĩ wa Isiraeli.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mahinda macio, Daudi nĩatharĩkĩire Afilisti na akĩmatooria biũ, na agĩtunyana Gathu na matũũra marĩa maarĩrigiicĩirie kuuma watho-inĩ wa Afilisti.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Ũige gĩtara kĩu rungu wa muoho wa kĩgongona nĩgeetha rũkinye nuthu ya ũraihu wa kĩgongona.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

kikuyu: Nake akĩnyiita njaũ ĩyo maathondekete, akĩmĩcina na mwaki, agĩcooka akĩmĩthĩa, ĩgĩtuĩka mũtu, akĩũikia maaĩ-inĩ na agĩatha andũ a Isiraeli manyue maaĩ macio.
english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

kikuyu: o na hamwe na kĩũmbe gĩothe kĩrĩ muoyo kĩa iria mũraarĩ nacio; nĩcio nyoni, na mahiũ o na nyamũ cia gĩthaka ciothe iria cioimire thabina hamwe na inyuĩ, ici nĩcio ciũmbe ciothe irĩ muoyo gũkũ thĩ.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

kikuyu: Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: “Maciaro ma bũrũri wa Misiri, na indo cia wonjorithia cia Kushi, o na andũ acio araihu a Sabea, nĩmagooka kũrĩ we matuĩke aku; nĩmagakuuma thuutha, na moke kũrĩ we mohetwo na mĩnyororo. Nĩmagakũinamĩrĩra, magũthaithe, makwĩre atĩrĩ, ‘Ti-itherũ Mũrungu arĩ hamwe nawe, na gũtirĩ ũngĩ tiga we; ti-itherũ gũtirĩ ngai ĩngĩ.’ ”
english: Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.

kikuyu: Nake akĩnjũũria atĩrĩ, “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, mahĩndĩ maya-rĩ, no macooke muoyo?” Na niĩ ngĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Mwathani Jehova, wee nowe wiki ũũĩ.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”

kikuyu: “Arĩria kĩũngano gĩothe kĩa Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ, ‘Tuĩkai atheru tondũ niĩ, Jehova Ngai wanyu, ndĩ mũtheru.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.

kikuyu: Hema ciao na ndũũru ciao cia mbũri nĩigatahwo; ciandarũa ciao nĩigakuuo, hamwe na indo ciao ciothe, na ngamĩĩra ciao ciothe. Andũ nĩmakanĩrĩra, mameere atĩrĩ, ‘Kĩmako kĩnene kiumanĩte na mĩena yothe!’
english: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

kikuyu: “Ũthamaki wa igũrũ ũhaanaine na mũthiithũ wahithĩtwo mũgũnda. Na rĩrĩa mũndũ aawoonire, akĩũhitha rĩngĩ, na nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa akenete, agĩthiĩ akĩendia indo ciothe iria arĩ nacio akĩgũra mũgũnda ũcio.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

kikuyu: Mũthĩgi wa hinya waku-rĩ, Jehova nĩakaũtambũrũkia kuuma Zayuni; nĩũgaathana ũrĩ gatagatĩ ga thũ ciaku.
english: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

kikuyu: “Edomu gũgaatuĩka kũndũ gwa kũmakania; arĩa othe makaahĩtũkĩra kuo nĩmakamaka na makũnyũrũrie, nĩ ũndũ wa ũrĩa gũgaakorwo kwanangĩtwo.
english: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

kikuyu: Magĩĩtana, makĩũria kana Simoni ũrĩa wĩtagwo Petero aaikaraga kũu.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

kikuyu: Ĩka ũrĩa ũkuona kwagĩrĩire kũringana na ũũgĩ waku, no ndũkanareke mũtwe ũcio wake ũrĩ mbuĩ ũkinye mbĩrĩra-inĩ na thayũ.
english: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol† in peace.

kikuyu: Nake Kristũ nĩatũkũũrire agĩtũruta kĩrumi-inĩ kĩa watho na ũndũ wake mwene gũtuĩka kĩrumi ithenya riitũ, nĩgũkorwo nĩ kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ, “Kũgwatwo nĩ kĩrumi nĩ mũndũ o wothe wambĩtwo mũtĩ-igũrũ.”
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”*

kikuyu: Kūruta kīro na gūciara nīigomagīruo rīrīa ikīro cia rūgarī irī thīī wa 750F
english: Growth and flower bud differentiation and fruit development were adversely affected, when the average temperature was below 750 F

kikuyu: Ta ririkanai mũtumia wa Loti!
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ĩyo nĩ Jubilii, na nĩyo ĩgaatuĩka theru kũrĩ inyuĩ; rĩĩagai o kĩrĩa gĩĩkũrĩtie mĩgũnda-inĩ.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

kikuyu: Ũraihu wa nyũmba ĩrĩa nene yarĩ mbere ya kanyũmba kau warĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩna§ kũraiha.
english: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

kikuyu: Kigunyū kīa mbegū cia kahūa kīngīninwo atia?
english: How to control coffee berry borer?

kikuyu: Wee Mwathani, tumũra mĩromo yakwa, nako kanua gakwa koimbũre ũgooci waku.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

kikuyu: Ũngĩtoonya mũgũnda wa ngano wa mũndũ ũngĩ, no ũbute magira mayo na moko, no ndũkanagethe ngano ĩyo yake.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

kikuyu: Mahuti ma lucerne īrīa īkoragwo na calcium na phosphorus kwa wūingī, ndībatiī kūheo ng'ombe iria cikuhīrīirie gūciara kwa wūingī nīguo calcium ndīgakīre haria yagīrīire mbere ya gūciara.
english: Lucerne, a feed high in calcium and potassium, should thus not be a major ingredient in close-up dry cow diets to avoid too high calcium levels before calving.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, nĩ kwarĩ na Ayunani gatagatĩ-inĩ ka arĩa maathiĩte gũthathaiya Ngai Gĩathĩ-inĩ kĩu.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

kikuyu: Gūthika mbegū irīa ndwaru cia kahūa irima-inī iriku kana gūcicina.
english: Destroying the attacked berries by burying them deep in soil or by burning.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa maiguire ũguo, makĩambĩrĩria kwehera hau ũmwe kwa ũmwe, maambĩrĩirie na arĩa akũrũ, nginya hagĩtigara o Jesũ na mũtumia ũcio arũngiĩ o hau.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

kikuyu: Oigire ũguo tondũ moigaga atĩrĩ, “Arĩ na ngoma thũku.”
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ngũmuurĩria mĩgate kuuma igũrũ ta mbura. Andũ mariumaga nja o mũthenya makongania mĩgate ya kũmaigana o mũthenya ũcio. Ngũmageria na njĩra ĩyo nyone kana nĩmekũrũmĩrĩra ũrutani wakwa.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

kikuyu: “Niĩ nĩ niĩ mũthabibũ ũrĩa wa ma nake Baba nĩwe mũrĩmĩri.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

kikuyu: Njīra īno nīīrī ūtheru, ngūkū ikaiganīra na igakorwo irī ngitīre kuumana na thūū.
english: Hygienic, comfortable and safe to birds

kikuyu: No andũ arĩa aaganu matihaana ũguo! Mahaana ta mũũngũ ũrĩa ũmbũragwo nĩ rũhuho.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo andũ arĩa aaganu matingĩkoma nginya meeke ũũru; mooragwo nĩ toro nginya matũme mũndũ ahĩngwo, agwe.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio indo cia Alawii no ikũũrwo, ũguo nĩ ta kuuga atĩ, nyũmba nyendie itũũra-inĩ o rĩothe rĩao, nĩĩgacookio Mwaka wa Jubilii, tondũ nyũmba iria irĩ matũũra-inĩ ma Alawii nĩcio igai rĩao thĩinĩ wa andũ a Isiraeli.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmooria riita rĩa gatatũ atĩrĩ, “Nĩkĩ? Nĩ ũũru ũrĩkũ mũndũ ũyũ eekĩte? Ndionete gĩtũmi gĩa gũtũma ooragwo. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ngũmũhũũrithia, njooke ndĩmuohore.”
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Kaĩ atumia arĩa magaakorwo marĩ na nda, na arĩa magaakorwo makĩongithia twana matukũ macio nĩmagathĩĩnĩka-ĩ! Nĩgũkorwo bũrũri ũyũ nĩũkagĩa na kĩnyariirĩko kĩnene na mangʼũrĩ ma gũũkĩrĩra andũ aya.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

kikuyu: Nĩ mahĩtia na mehia maigana niĩ njĩkĩte? Nyonia ihĩtia na rĩĩhia rĩakwa.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

kikuyu: No mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai angĩkoona atĩ hatirĩ na ũgarũrũku na nĩhamerete njuĩrĩ njirũ, ũhere ũcio nĩũhonete. Mũndũ ũcio ndarĩ na thaahu, nake Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakamũtua ndarĩ na thaahu.
english: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

kikuyu: Makorobia nīmahakagwo mūhūra na magacoka kūniario rīera-inī ihiū. Makorobia maigagwo kūndū kwīna heho ya githimo cia 5°C
english: The fruits are waxed, and dried in hot air. Avocado fruits are stored in cold storage (5°C).

kikuyu: Makorobia magīrīire gūtuo na magathī kuuma mītī-inī, na gūtigia kamūtī kanini kenyitīīrīire itunda-inī(ta 0.5cm).
english: Avocado fruits should be clipped from the trees with secateurs, leaving a portion of the stalk attached on the fruit (about 0.5cm long).

kikuyu: Ndĩ mũmocu na ngathuthĩka biũ; ndĩracaaya nĩ ruo rwa ngoro.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

kikuyu: Gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe ũrĩ na kaũũgũ ũgaakuhĩrĩria: mũndũ mũtumumu kana gĩthua, kana mũndũ mũthũku ũthiũ, kana ũrĩ na wonje,
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

kikuyu: Ngwĩka ũguo, nĩ tondũ nĩmandiganĩirie, makainamĩrĩra Ashitorethu ngai ya nga ya Asidoni, na Kemoshu ngai ya andũ a Moabi, na Moleku ngai ya andũ a Amoni, na magatiga gũthiĩ na njĩra ciakwa, o na makarega gwĩka ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire maitho-inĩ makwa, o na matirũmagia irĩra ciakwa na mawatho ta ũrĩa Daudi ithe wa Solomoni ekaga.
english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũcio gũkooraganwo mũno, rĩrĩa mĩthiringo ĩrĩa mĩraihu na igũrũ ĩkaamomoka, tũrũũĩ nĩtũgaatherera kuuma kĩrĩma-inĩ o gĩothe kĩraihu na karĩma o gothe gatũũgĩru.
english: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

kikuyu: Ũrĩmwaragĩria na ũkamwĩra ũrĩa ekuuga, na nĩngamũhotithia inyuĩ eerĩ kwaria, na ndĩmũrute ũrĩa mũgeeka.
english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

kikuyu: Wee ũringĩkaga nĩ ũrugarĩ wa nguo ciaku rĩrĩa bũrũri ũkirĩte ki hĩndĩ ya rũhuho rwa gũthini-rĩ,
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

kikuyu: Wee Jehova-rĩ, wendani waku ũkinyĩte o igũrũ, naguo wĩhokeku waku ũgakinya o matu-inĩ.
english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: nĩguo agitĩre roho wake kuuma gĩkuũ-inĩ, na agitĩre muoyo wake ndũkaniinwo na rũhiũ rwa njora.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

kikuyu: “No mũndũ ũcio akĩmũcookeria, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathi ũyũ, nĩtũreke ũikare mwaka ũngĩ ũmwe, ndĩũrĩmĩre na ndĩwĩkĩre thumu.
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

kikuyu: Judasi aarĩkia kũrĩa mũgate ũcio, Mũcukani akĩmũingĩra. Nake Jesũ akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ũrĩa ũkiriĩ gwĩka-rĩ, ĩka narua.”
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

kikuyu: Na kũngĩkorwo kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro giitũ thĩinĩ wa Kristũ no kĩa muoyo-inĩ ũyũ tũrĩ-rĩ, twagĩrĩirwo nĩkũiguĩrwo tha gũkĩra andũ othe.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

kikuyu: Ningĩ ũhumbe Harũni nguo iria theru, ũmũitĩrĩrie maguta, na ũmwamũre nĩguo andungatĩre arĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: hamwe na iruta rĩa mũtu gĩcunjĩ gĩa ikũmi kĩa eba ĩmwe* ya mũtu mũhinyu mũno, ũtukanĩtio na gĩcunjĩ gĩa kana kĩa hini ĩmwe† ya maguta mahihĩtwo kuuma kũrĩ ndamaiyũ.
english: with one tenth of an ephah† of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin‡ of beaten oil.

kikuyu: O rĩngĩ akĩgĩa nda na rĩrĩa aaciarire kahĩĩ, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ihinda rĩĩrĩ mũthuuri wakwa no ekwĩohania na niĩ tondũ nĩndĩmũciarĩire ihĩĩ ithatũ.” Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩgatua Lawi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

kikuyu: Mũnabii ũcio kana mũroti ũcio no nginya ooragwo, tondũ nĩahunjĩtie ũhoro wa kũremera Jehova Ngai wanyu, ũrĩa wamũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri, akĩmũkũũra kuuma bũrũri wa ũkombo; nĩageretie kũmũgarũra mwehere njĩra ĩrĩa Jehova Ngai wanyu aamwathire mũrũmagĩrĩre. No nginya mũniine ũũru ũcio wehere gatagatĩ-inĩ kanyu.
english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Elihu aambĩte gweterera acio angĩ maarie atanaaria na Ayubu, tondũ o maarĩ akũrũ kũmũkĩra.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

kikuyu: Ng'ombe ibataraga maaī nīguo mwīrī wayo ūhote kūruta wīra wega.
english: Animals need water for normal functioning of their body.

kikuyu: Nao Eliakimu, na Shebina, na Joa makĩĩra mũnene ũcio wa mbũtũ cia ita atĩrĩ, “Twagũthaitha arĩria ndungata ciaku na rũthiomi rwa Asuriata, tondũ nĩtũrũũĩ.* Tiga gũtwarĩria na rũthiomi rwa Kĩhibirania andũ aya marĩ rũthingo-inĩ makĩiguaga.”
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

kikuyu: Nao andũ a Misiri nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova, rĩrĩa ngataambũrũkia guoko gwakwa njũkĩrĩre bũrũri wa Misiri na ndute andũ a Isiraeli moime kuo.”
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

english: Hence cross pollination leads to higher yields than self -pollination.

kikuyu: Nĩ kaba kũũrĩra harĩ Jehova, gũkĩra kwĩhoka anene.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.

kikuyu: Mĩbango nĩĩthaataga nĩ kwaga kĩrĩra, no kũrĩ na ataarani aingĩ mĩbango nĩĩgaacagĩra.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

english: Field sanitation prevents diseases and is done by the removal of all early disease inoculum in field before planting

english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

kikuyu: Matukũ mothe ma andũ arĩa ahatĩrĩrie nĩ ma thĩĩna, no ngoro ĩrĩa njanjamũku ĩkoragwo na ndĩa hĩndĩ ciothe.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

kikuyu: Firaũni akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Mũrutaga wĩra ũrĩkũ?” Nao magĩcookeria Firaũni atĩrĩ, “Ithuĩ ndungata ciaku tũrĩ arĩithi, o ta ũrĩa maithe maitũ maarĩ.”
english: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

kikuyu: “Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩĩta mũndũ o wothe warĩ na thiirĩ wa mwathi wake. Akĩũria mũndũ wa mbere atĩrĩ, ‘Wee ũrĩ na thiirĩ ũigana atĩa wa mwathi wakwa?’
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

kikuyu: Nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩagaciruta igongona, ĩmwe ĩrĩ iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia na ĩrĩa ĩngĩ irĩ iruta rĩa njino. Ũguo nĩguo akaahoroheria mũndũ ũcio hau mbere ya Jehova, nĩ ũndũ wa kuura gwake.
english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

kikuyu: meciiria marĩa mehagia marĩ ũthũ na Ngai. Meciiria macio matiathĩkagĩra watho wa Ngai, o na matingĩhota gwĩka ũguo.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũcooke mwambate nake, oke aikarĩre gĩtĩ gĩakwa kĩa ũnene, na athamake handũ hakwa. Nĩndĩmũthuurĩte aathanage Isiraeli na Juda.”
english: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

kikuyu: Na mũtikanaage kũmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Jakubu ndungata yaku arĩ thuutha witũ agĩũka.’ ” Tondũ eeciiririe atĩrĩ, “Ngũmũhooreria na iheo ici ngũtũma mbere yakwa; thuutha-inĩ ndamuona-rĩ, hihi ahota kũnyamũkĩra.”
english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’ ” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Mweri wa mbere, mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩna wa mweri o ũcio nĩguo mũrĩgĩaga na gĩathĩ kĩa Bathaka, ihinda rĩa mĩthenya mũgwanja, ihinda rĩrĩa mũrĩrĩĩaga mĩgate ĩtarĩ mĩĩkĩre ndawa ya kũimbia.
english: “ ‘ “In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

english: Loose, sandy or loamy soils, well-draining with pH ranging 5-7;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio andũ acio makĩnegenia Musa, makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Tũhe maaĩ ma kũnyua.” Nake Musa akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Mũranegenia nĩkĩ? Nĩ kĩĩ gĩgũtũma mũgerie Jehova?”
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test Yahweh?”

kikuyu: Ariũ a Ezeri maarĩ: Bilihani, na Zaavani, na Akani. Ariũ a Dishani maarĩ: Uzu, na Arani.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

kikuyu: Mũthia-inĩ akĩmatũmĩra mũrũwe, akiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩmagatĩĩa mũrũ wakwa.’
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: Mũtikanathaahie rĩĩtwa rĩakwa itheru. No nginya andũ a Isiraeli mamenyage atĩ ndĩ mũtheru. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova ũrĩa ũmũtheragia,
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũhũthũ ngamĩĩra kũhungura irima rĩa cindano gũkĩra gĩtonga gũtoonya ũthamaki-inĩ wa Ngai.”
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Ndĩrĩthiiaga ndĩ na wĩyathi, nĩgũkorwo nĩmaathaga mawatho maku.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

No rĩrĩ, rekei andũ a nyũmba yanyu, nyũmba yothe ya Isiraeli, macakaĩre acio Jehova aniinĩte na mwaki.
english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Yahweh has kindled.

english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,”† “You shall not covet,”* and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”*

kikuyu: Bũrũri ũngĩĩhia, nĩũgĩaga na aathani aingĩ, no mũndũ ũrĩ na ũtaũku na akagĩa na ũmenyo nĩatũmaga bũrũri ũkindĩrie.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio-rĩ, wee mũndũ ũyũ ndũrĩ na kĩĩgwatio, wee ũtuagĩra mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ ciira, nĩgũkorwo rĩrĩa ũgũtuĩra mũndũ ũngĩ ciira, nĩwe mwene ũretuĩra ciira, tondũ wee ũratuanĩra ciira wĩkaga maũndũ o macio ekaga.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

english: In chicks, gasping coughing and sneezing is observed, nasal discharge, depression, and diarrhea.

english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Ndehĩta njoete guoko na igũrũ ndoiga atĩ ndũrĩrĩ icio imũthiũrũrũkĩirie o nacio nĩikanyararwo.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

english: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
