kikuyu: Ngĩcooka ngĩĩciiria atĩrĩ, “Ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo ngwĩtiiria naguo: kũririkana mĩaka ya guoko kwa ũrĩo kwa Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno.”
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

kikuyu: Kũu ndũnyũ-inĩ yaku-rĩ, nĩmoonjorithanagia nawe nguo iria thaka, na itambaya cia bururu, na nguo iria ngʼemie, na mĩgeka ya marangi maingĩ ĩtumĩtwo na ndigi njogothe ikundĩkĩtwo ikanyiitio.
english: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo andũ ooru nĩmakaniinwo, no arĩa mehokete Jehova nĩmakagaya bũrũri.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

kikuyu: We Ũhoro aarĩ gũkũ thĩ, no o na gũtuĩka thĩ yombirwo na ũndũ wake-rĩ, andũ a thĩ matiigana kũmũmenya.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: “Jehova aanyũmbire o kĩambĩrĩria-inĩ kĩa wĩra wake, mbere ya mawĩra make ma tene;
english: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

kikuyu: Na hau mbere yakwa nĩho riiri wa Ngai wa Isiraeli warĩ, o ta ũrĩa ndoonete kĩoneki-inĩ werũ-inĩ.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

kikuyu: Nao magĩthiĩ Kaperinaumu, na rĩrĩa mũthenya wa Thabatũ wakinyire, Jesũ agĩtoonya thunagogi na akĩambĩrĩria kũrutana.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

kikuyu: hamwe na iheo iria njega mũno cia thĩ, na indo iria ciyũrĩte kuo, na ũtugi ũrĩa waikarĩte kĩhinga-inĩ kĩrĩa kĩahĩaga. Maũndũ maya mothe maroikara mũtwe-inĩ wa Jusufu, maroikara ũthiũ-inĩ wa mũriũ wa mũthamaki arĩ harĩ ariũ a ithe.
english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush.‡ Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

kikuyu: Musa nĩathikĩrĩirie mũthoni-we na agĩĩka ũrĩa wothe aamũtaarire.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

kikuyu: Jehoahazu aarĩ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩtatũ rĩrĩa aatuĩkire mũthamaki, nake agĩthamaka arĩ Jerusalemu mĩeri ĩtatũ.
english: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: no atĩ nĩetĩkagĩra andũ kuuma ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ ciothe arĩa mamwĩtigagĩra na mageeka ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa mũndũ-wa-nja oimire harĩ mũndũ mũrũme-rĩ, no taguo mũndũ-mũrũme aciaragwo nĩ mũndũ-wa-nja. No rĩrĩ, indo ciothe ciumaga kũrĩ Ngai.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

kikuyu: Nĩakaruta maguta mothe o ta ũrĩa maguta marutagwo kuuma iruta rĩa ũiguano, nake mũthĩnjĩri- Ngai nĩakamacinĩra kĩgongona-inĩ igũrũ matuĩke mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova. Ũguo nĩguo mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai akaahoroheria mũndũ ũcio, nake nĩakarekerwo.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Ndarĩ ekĩra rũrĩrĩ rũngĩ ta ũguo, mawatho macio make ndũrĩrĩ itirĩ ciamamenya. Goocai Jehova.
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ngaakorwo ndĩmacooketie kuuma ndũrĩrĩ-inĩ, na ngaamongania kuuma mabũrũri-inĩ ma thũ ciao, nĩngeyonania atĩ ndĩ mũtheru kũgerera harĩo maitho-inĩ ma ndũrĩrĩ nyingĩ.
english: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

kikuyu: No ūthondeke kamūndū mūgūnda-inī kana ūige ngui nīguo ciingate therū icio.
english: You can use a scarecrow in the banana field, or have the field guarded by a dog to scare away the monkeys.

kikuyu: Na o rĩmwe Roho akĩmuoya akĩmũtwara werũ-inĩ,
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa gũkũngũĩra gũciarwo kwa Herode-rĩ, mwarĩ wa Herodia nĩainĩire andũ, na agĩkenia Herode mũno.
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

kikuyu: O na mũngĩkorwo mũrĩ na areri ngiri ikũmi thĩinĩ wa Kristũ, mũtirĩ na maithe maingĩ, nĩgũkorwo thĩinĩ wa Kristũ Jesũ ndaatuĩkire ithe wanyu ũndũ-inĩ wa Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

kikuyu: Hihi kūgūria mbura nĩ ũndũ wa bata kũhũra waru bũrũri-inĩ wa Kenya? Nĩ njĩra irĩkũ ciagĩrĩire kũhũthĩrũo?
english: Is top dressing important in potato production in Kenya ? What are the recommended practices?

kikuyu: Ndatũũrĩte ndĩmatũmagĩra ndungata ciakwa cia anabii kaingĩ, o arĩa maameeraga atĩrĩ: ‘Tigai gwĩka ũndũ ũyũ ũrĩ magigi, o ũyũ niĩ thũire!’
english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai ũrĩa mũnene na Kĩama gĩothe gĩa athuuri o nao mangĩheana ũira ũcio. O na nĩmaheire marũa ndwarĩre andũ ao kũu Dameski, na niĩ ngĩthiĩ kuo nganyiite andũ acio ndĩmarehe Jerusalemu nĩguo maherithio.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

kikuyu: Nĩũgaciunanga na njũgũma ya kĩgera ya ũthamaki; ũgaacihehenja ihaane ta tũcunjĩ twa nyũngũ ya rĩũmba.”
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

kikuyu: Maathĩrĩirio mbĩrĩra o ta ngʼondu cia gũthĩnjwo, na gĩkuũ nĩkĩo gĩgaatũĩka mũrĩithi wao. Magaathagwo nĩ andũ arĩa arũngĩrĩru rũciinĩ; ciimba ciao ikaabuthĩra mbĩrĩra-inĩ, irĩ kũraihu na nyũmba ciao nene.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol.† Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol,‡ far from their mansion.

kikuyu: Wathani-inĩ wao haarĩ na mbũtũ ya ita ya andũ 307,500 arĩa maarutĩtwo ũhoro wa mbaara, mbũtũ ĩyo yarĩ na hinya na nĩyo yateithagia mũthamaki akĩrũa na thũ ciake.
english: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

kikuyu: Thondeka mĩrĩnga ĩĩrĩ ya thahabu ũmĩnyiitithanie na mĩthia ĩrĩa ĩngĩ ĩĩrĩ ya gakuo ga gĩthũri mwena wa na thĩinĩ kũrigania na ebodi.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo nĩmakagarũra aanake anyu matige gũcooka kũnũmĩrĩra, na matuĩke a gũtungatĩra ngai ingĩ, namo marakara ma Jehova nĩmakamũũkĩrĩra, mamũcine na mamũniine o narua.
english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

kikuyu: “Ndungata ya mbere ĩgĩũka, ĩkĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Mwathi, mina yaku nĩyumithĩtie mina ingĩ ikũmi.’
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

kikuyu: Mũndũ agaathagĩrĩrio kũringana na ũũgĩ wake, no andũ marĩ meciiria mogomu nĩmamenagwo.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

kikuyu: “Ti-itherũ o ta ũrĩa Mũrungu atũũraga muoyo, o we ũnyimĩte kĩhooto, ũcio Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, ũrĩa ũtũmĩte ngĩe na ũrũrũ ngoro-inĩ-rĩ,
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

kikuyu: Mbarĩ cia Amerari: ciarĩ Mahali na Mushi. Ici nĩcio ciarĩ mbarĩ cia Alawii, kũringana na nyũmba ciao.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Mũtikambate tondũ Jehova ndarĩ hamwe na inyuĩ. Nĩmũkũhootwo nĩ thũ cianyu,
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo guoko gwakwa kũroahũkĩra kĩande-inĩ kũgwe, kũroinĩkĩra o irũngo-inĩ.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

kikuyu: Na kũrĩa guothe mũgaatũũra-rĩ, mũtikanarĩe thakame ya mũthemba o na ũrĩkũ, ĩrĩ ya nyoni kana ya nyamũ.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

kikuyu: Nī wega kūhanda mbegū iria ciīhokekete kuuma kūrī andū a thirikari, ta: Agricultural Development Corporation (ADC), kūgirīrīria mīrimū ta kūbutha na kūhīa tene.
english: It is recommended to plant certified seeds from official sources e.g. Agricultural Development Corporation (ADC), to prevent diseases such as bacterial wilt and early blight.

kikuyu: na Reseni, itũũra rĩrĩ gatagatĩ ka Nineve na Kala; rĩu nĩrĩo rĩarĩ itũũra inene.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

kikuyu: nĩngahũgũkĩra mũndũ ũcio, hamwe na andũ a nyũmba yake, na ndĩmaingate kuuma kũrĩ andũ ao, we mwene na arĩa othe mamũrũmagĩrĩra na kũhũũra ũmaraya na Moleku.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

kikuyu: Nake ũrĩa wĩhĩtaga na hekarũ, ehĩtaga nayo na akehĩta na ũrĩa ũikaraga thĩinĩ wayo.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living§ in it.

kikuyu: Na tondũ uuge wa mũthamaki ũrĩ hinya-rĩ, nũũ ũngĩhota kũmũũria kĩũria atĩrĩ, “Nĩ atĩa ũreka?”
english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

kikuyu: na kuuma Kĩrĩma kĩa Horu ũgaakinya Lebo-Hamathu. Ningĩ mũhaka ũcio ũgaakinya Zedadi,
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

kikuyu: Musa nĩandĩkire matĩĩna ma rũgendo rwao o ta ũrĩa aathĩtwo nĩ Jehova. Maya nĩmo matĩĩna ma rũgendo rwao.
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mĩrango yaku, na hingĩro-inĩ ciayo nĩkuo ũigĩte imenyithia cia gũkũririkania ũhoro wa mĩhianano ya andũ acio matooĩ Ngai. Nĩwahumbũririe gĩtanda gĩaku nĩ ũndũ wa kũndirika, ũkĩhaica igũrũ rĩakĩo, o na ũgĩkĩaramia makĩria; ũkĩrĩĩkanĩra na acio wendete itanda ciao, na ũgĩcooka ũkĩĩrorera njaga yao.
english: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.

kikuyu: Ũcooke wĩkĩre thĩinĩ wa ithandũkũ rĩu Ũira, ũrĩa ngũkũhe.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

kikuyu: Ngũmwĩra atĩrĩ, ũguo noguo kũgĩaga gĩkeno kĩnene igũrũ nĩ ũndũ wa mũndũ ũmwe mwĩhia wĩrirĩte, gũkĩra ũrĩa gũkenagwo nĩ ũndũ wa andũ mĩrongo kenda na kenda athingu arĩa matabatarĩtio nĩ kwĩrira.
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

kikuyu: O na mĩri yaguo ĩngĩkũrĩra thĩ na gĩthukĩ kĩaguo kĩũmĩre tĩĩri-inĩ,
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

kikuyu: Tigīrīra irio irī na fibre njiganu nīgetha ng'ombe ihote kūruta mata maingī maria magiragia githimo kia pH gūikūrūka.
english: Ensuring the presence of effective fibre in the diet promotes production of saliva, which is a buffer

kikuyu: mwanangĩko na kĩeha nĩcio cionanagia kũrĩa magereire,
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

kikuyu: “ ‘Aarĩkia gũtiga kuura, nĩageterera mĩthenya mũgwanja, na thuutha ũcio nĩagathirwo nĩ thaahu.
english: “ ‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

kikuyu: Altitude; mita 800-1600 igūrū wa iria, Ihinda rīa Kūgetha; Januari nginya mweri wa ītatū, ūritū wa maembe; gramu 280 Mūigana wa iembe; ūraihu nī sentimita 10.5 na wariī nī sentimita 7.6. Mūtī ūciaraga gatagatī ka maembe 28-400 o kīmera.
english: Altitude; 800-1600 meters above sea level Harvest Season; January to March Fruit Weight; 280 g Fruit Measures; 10.5 cm long and 7.6 cm wide Yields; 28-400 fruits/tree/season

kikuyu: Tuta ya kūmbwo īgūrū nīya bata atia harī kūmenyerera mīmera?
english: Why are raised beds important in nursery management?

kikuyu: Mũndũ angĩkorwo eetirwo arĩ mũruu-rĩ, nĩatige gũikara ta atarĩ mũruu. Mũndũ ũrĩa ũtaarĩ mũruu rĩrĩa eetirwo nĩatige kũrua.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũũcio, haũhoroũkoniĩkũrĩairio iria irutĩirwo mĩhianano-rĩ, nĩtũũĩatĩ gũkũthĩ mũhianano nĩ kĩndũ gĩa tũhũ, na atĩ gũtirĩ Ngai ũngĩ tiga o ũrĩa ũmwe.
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

kikuyu: Gĩkĩ nĩkĩo kĩhingo kĩa Jehova kĩrĩa andũ arĩa athingu mangĩtoonyera.
english: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Rĩu-rĩ, ũka ũkeiguithanie na mwathi wakwa, mũthamaki wa Ashuri: Nĩngũkũhe mbarathi ngiri igĩrĩ, angĩkorwo ũrĩ na andũ a gũthiĩ macihaicĩte!
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

kikuyu: “Korwo ndiokire ngĩmahe ũhoro, matingĩamenyire nĩ ehia. No rĩu matirĩ na kĩĩgwatio nĩ ũndũ wa mehia mao.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

kikuyu: Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Nĩngũũkĩrĩra arĩithi acio, na nĩo ngooria rũũru rwakwa. Nĩngameheria matige kũrĩithia rũũru rũu, nĩguo arĩithi acio matigacooke kũrĩa ngʼondu. Nĩngateithũra rũũru rwakwa kuuma tũnua-inĩ twao, nĩguo rũtigatuĩke irio cia kũrĩĩo nĩo.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

kikuyu: Musa akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Tũgũthiĩ na andũ aitũ arĩa ethĩ o na arĩa akũrũ, tũthiĩ na aanake na airĩtu aitũ, na tũthiĩ na ũhiũ witũ wothe, tondũ tũrathiĩ gũkũngũĩra Jehova na iruga inene.”
english: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to Yahweh.”

kikuyu: Ní úteithagia múmera gwitíra, kúgítíra warú kúgía rangi wa grini níundu wa ríua, na gúteithia waru iciare makíria
english: It provides support to the plants, prevents greening of tubers by shielding them from sunlight, and encourages the development of additional tubers.

kikuyu: Na mūtwe mūinamūku na ngingo nūngarū
english: Have raised head and straight neck

kikuyu: Marooka marĩ na mota na matimũ mao; nao nĩ andũ ooru, na matarĩ tha. Mũrurumo wao nĩ ta mũrurumo wa ndiihũ cia maaĩ ma iria, magĩũka mahaicĩte mbarathi ciao; mokĩte meyarĩire wega mbaara-inĩ nĩguo magũtharĩkĩre, wee Mwarĩ ũyũ wa Babuloni.
english: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

kikuyu: Arĩa othe marĩkĩraga magathiĩ mwena wa arĩa marĩkĩtie gũtarwo, marĩ na ũkũrũ wa mĩaka mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na makĩria, no nginya maheage Jehova iruta rĩu.
english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.

kikuyu: No kahinda kanini, arĩa aaganu mage kuoneka rĩngĩ; o na mũngĩmacaria, mũtingĩmoona.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

kikuyu: Ningĩ kiugo kĩa Jehova gĩgĩkinya kũrĩ Jehu mũrũ wa Hanani gĩa gũũkĩrĩra Baasha, akĩĩrwo atĩrĩ,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

kikuyu: Nĩndarakaririo mũno nĩ mehia make ma gũkoroka; ngĩmũherithia na ngĩmũhitha ũthiũ wakwa nĩ kũrakara, no agĩthiĩ o na mbere na mĩthiĩre yake ĩrĩa eyendeire.
english: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

kikuyu: inyuĩ mũtarĩ igweta na arĩa mũrĩ igweta, inyuĩ itonga na athĩĩni mũigue hamwe:
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

kikuyu: na Dishoni, na Ezeri, na Dishani. Acio nĩo maarĩ anene a Ahori, kũringana na ikundi ciao kũu bũrũri wa Seiru.
english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

kikuyu: Ningĩ akiuga atĩrĩ, “Wee-rĩ, nĩũkũmona magĩĩka maũndũ o na marĩ magigi makĩria.”
english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũtindeheire ngʼondu cia maruta ma njino, kana mũkandĩĩithia na magongona manyu. Ndimũhatĩrĩirie na magongona ma mũtu, kana ngamũnogia na kũmwĩtia ũbumba.
english: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

kikuyu: Magetha nīmacenjagia, maramatītwo wega no maciare 20,000kg-30,000kg harī o īka
english: Yields can vary, but with proper management, an average yield of 20,000 to 30,000 kg (20 to 30 metric tons) per īka is achievable.

kikuyu: Ngayagĩra Jehova nyanĩrĩire; ngwambararia mũgambo wakwa kũrĩ Jehova anjiguĩre tha.
english: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

kikuyu: Tigia handū hanene hegwītīkīria mīthiīre.
english: Have enough space to allow enough room for movement

kikuyu: na Uria ũrĩa Mũhiti, na Zabadi mũrũ wa Ahalai,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

kikuyu: na Nethaneli wa kana, nake Radai wa gatano,
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩ kũrĩ nyamũ imwe icookagia o ithagumia tu, na ingĩ irĩ o mahũngũ marekanĩtie; icio mũtikanacirĩe. Ngamĩĩra o na aakorwo nĩĩcookagia ithagumia-rĩ, mahũngũ mayo matirekanĩtie; ĩyo ĩrĩ thaahu harĩ inyuĩ.
english: “ ‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Mahĩndĩ makwa matiahithĩkĩte harĩwe, rĩrĩa ndoombĩirwo kũrĩa kũhitharu. Rĩrĩa ndanyiitithanagio hamwe ndĩ thĩ kũrĩa kũriku mũno-rĩ,
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Hebironi maarĩ: Jeria na nĩwe warĩ mũtongoria wao, na Amaria aarĩ wa keerĩ, na Jahazieli aarĩ wa gatatũ, na Jekameamu aarĩ wa kana.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: Hamwe na ndegwa, na ndũrũme, na tũtũrũme tũu, mũhaaragĩrieimaruta macio ma mũtu, na maruta ma kũnyuuokũringana na mũigana ũrĩa ũtuĩtwo.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Nake Onani nĩamenyaga atĩ rũciaro rũu rũtigatuĩka rwake; nĩ ũndũ ũcio o akoma na mũtumia wa mũrũ wa nyina, agaita mbeũ ya ũciari thĩ, nĩguo ndagaciarĩre mũrũ wa nyina rũciaro.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

kikuyu: Eĩĩraga na ngoro atĩrĩ, “Mũrungu nĩariganĩirwo: nĩehumbĩrĩte ũthiũ na ndoonaga.”
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

kikuyu: na Dishoni, na Ezeri, na Dishani. Ariũ acio a Seiru nĩo maarĩ anene a Ahori kũu Edomu.
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: No anene arĩa ana maaroraga arangĩri a ihingo, arĩa maarĩ Alawii, nĩmehokeirwo kũmenyerera tũnyũmba na igĩĩna cia nyũmba ya Ngai.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Mwĩmenyagĩrĩrei mũtikanaheenio. Nĩgũkorwo andũ aingĩ nĩmagooka na rĩĩtwa rĩakwa makiugaga atĩrĩ, ‘Nĩ niĩ We,’ na ningĩ mamwĩre atĩrĩ, ‘Ihinda nĩrĩkuhĩrĩirie.’ Mũtikanamarũmĩrĩre.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he‡,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

kikuyu: Nake mũndũ ũcio warũarĩte akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũthuuri ũyũ, ndirĩ na mũndũ wa kũndikia thĩinĩ wa karia rĩrĩa maaĩ moinjugwo. Ngĩgeria gũtoboka thĩinĩ-rĩ, mũndũ ũngĩ agatoboka mbere yakwa.”
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, ihinda rĩa mĩaka ĩyo mũgwanja ya bũthi, bũrũri ũcio ũgĩciara maciaro maingĩ mũno.
english: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

kikuyu: Nayo ngumo yake ĩkĩhunja na ihenya bũrũri wothe wa Galili.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

kikuyu: Igai rīa irio cia ng'ombe ya iria ibatiī gūkorwo na gīcunje kia mirongo mūgwanja kia energy, mīrongo ītatū kia protein na mūtukanio wa macūmbī. Kwa mūhiano nī ta 35% wheat bran + 35% mbembe + 30% cotton seed + 1% cumbī.
english: A dairy cattle ration should contain 70% energy source, 30% protein source and required minerals (such as: 35% wheat bran + 35% maize + 30% cotton seed cake + 1% minerals)

kikuyu: Thuutha wa kũrĩkanĩra kĩrĩĩko kĩu kũu Birishiba, Abimeleku na Fikolu mũnene wa mbũtũ ciake cia ita, magĩcooka bũrũri wa Afilisti.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jakubu na Johana, ariũ a Zebedi, magĩũka kũrĩ Jesũ. Makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Mũrutani, tũkwenda ũtwĩkĩre o ũrĩa tũgũkũhooya.”
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

kikuyu: Itina njega ciumaga kūrī: peach, sabre, sikio, Punda na Dodo
english: Cultivars used as rootstocks are: Peach, Sabre, Sikio punda and Dodo

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehova akĩĩra Musa atĩrĩ, “Ũkĩra wambate kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩkĩ, kũu rũgongo rwa Abarimu, wĩrorere bũrũri ũrĩa heete andũ a Isiraeli.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: īgūnyo cīa ngūnga cīngīnyihio atīa?
english: How to control cutworms?

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Hiramu mũthamaki wa Turo, nĩatũmĩire Daudi andũ, marĩ na mĩgogo ya mĩtarakwa, na aaki a mahiga na a mbaũ, nĩguo mamwakĩre nyũmba ya ũthamaki.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “O na inyuĩ mũtirĩ mũrataũkĩrwo o na rĩu?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

kikuyu: “Ta twĩre, maũndũ macio mageekĩka rĩ? Na kĩmenyithia atĩ maũndũ macio marĩ hakuhĩ gwĩkĩka nĩ kĩrĩkũ?”
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

kikuyu: Nake nĩagatũma araika ake macookanĩrĩrie andũ ake arĩa aamũre kuuma mĩena ĩna ĩrĩa yumaga rũhuho, o na kuuma ituri ciothe cia thĩ na cia igũrũ.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

kikuyu: Ti atĩ nĩ kĩheo ndĩracaria kuuma kũrĩ inyuĩ, no ndĩracaria kĩrĩa kĩngĩigwo mũthiithũ-inĩ wanyu.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

kikuyu: Ĩkagai ũguo harĩ o ĩmwe yacio ya iria ciothe mũrĩharagĩria.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

kikuyu: Jesũ agĩcooka akĩmũkaania, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Ndũkeere mũndũ o na ũ, no thiĩ, ũkeyonanie kũrĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, na ũrute magongona marĩa Musa aathanire nĩ ũndũ wa gũtherio gwaku, arĩ ũira kũrĩ o.”
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo nĩnjũũĩ meciiria marĩa ndĩciiragia ũhoro-inĩ wanyu, o meciiria ma thayũ na ti ma kũmwĩka ũũru, meciiria ma kũmũhe kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro atĩ ũhoro wanyu nĩũkaagĩrĩra thuutha-inĩ,” ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

kikuyu: Indo icio ciothe ciathondekithirio nĩ Solomoni ciarĩ nyingĩ mũno, ũũ atĩ ũritũ wa gĩcango ndwamenyekire ũrĩa waiganaga.
english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Paũlũ aamenya atĩ amwe ao maarĩ Asadukai, na arĩa angĩ Afarisai, akĩanĩrĩra Kĩama-inĩ kĩu, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Ariũ a Baba, niĩ ndĩ Mũfarisai, na njiarĩtwo nĩ Mũfarisai. Ndĩraciirithio nĩ ũndũ wa kĩĩrĩgĩrĩro gĩakwa gĩa kũriũkio kwa arĩa akuũ.”
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

kikuyu: na ageni arĩa othe matũũraga kuo; na ningĩ athamaki othe a Uzu; na ningĩ athamaki othe a Afilisti (aya nĩ andũ a Ashikeloni, na Gaza, na Ekironi, o na andũ arĩa maatigaire Ashidodi);
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

kikuyu: Mabundi arĩa akũrũ a Gebali nĩo maarutaga wĩra wa gũthinga mĩanya kũu marikabu-inĩ. Marikabu ciothe cia iria-inĩ na atwarithia a cio mookĩte kũu nĩguo mũthogorane nao indo ciaku.
english: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.

kikuyu: Thimo ĩkĩario nĩ kanua ka mũndũ mũkĩĩgu nĩ ta mũigua ũrĩ guoko-inĩ kwa mũrĩĩu.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Kuuma ikinya rĩa kũgũrũ nginya mũtwe gũtirĩ handũ hagima: no nguraro theri, na mĩtũnda, na ironda cia ndĩĩra itarĩ thambie, kana ikoohwo, kana ikororoiyo na maguta.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.

kikuyu: Mīciī īrīa mūrigainie: Mītuthūko ya mīrimū mīciī-inī īria mūringainie no ithereme kwa ūhūthū na īkinye gwaku mūgūnda.
english: Neighbours: disease outbreaks in neighbouring homesteads can easily spread to your farm

kikuyu: Maũndũ marĩa mangĩ makoniĩ wathani wa Solomoni, ũrĩa wothe eekire, na ũũgĩ ũrĩa onanirie- rĩ, githĩ matiandĩkĩtwo ibuku-inĩ rĩa ciĩko cia Solomoni?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

kikuyu: “Mwathani Ngai wa Isiraeli arogoocwo, tondũ nĩokĩte na agakũũra andũ ake.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

kikuyu: Hau nĩho njigĩte ithandũkũ rĩa kĩrĩkanĩro rĩrĩa rĩigĩtwo kĩrĩkanĩro kĩrĩa Jehova aarĩkanĩire na andũ a Isiraeli.”
english: There I have set the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Me mūhiano wa itumbī icomoku, rangi wa ngoikoni na mīkurura mītune.
english: Ovate and plumb, yellow colour with a reddish blush.

kikuyu: Na tondũ wa gĩkundi kĩu, akĩĩra arutwo ake mamũhaarĩrĩrie gatarũ nĩguo gĩkundi kĩu gĩtige kũmũhatĩka.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

kikuyu: īngīhota atia kūhiūrania na mathīna marīa marehagwo nī ūrugarī mūingī ūgatuma ng'ombe īgiīke?
english: How do I handle problems associated with high temperatures that lead to herd stress?

kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte ũrathe mohoro ũkĩgwetaga rĩĩtwa rĩa Jehova, ũkoiga atĩ nyũmba ĩno ĩgaatuĩka ta Shilo, narĩo itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene rĩkire ihooru na rĩtiganĩrio?” Nao andũ acio othe makĩũngana, makĩrigiicĩria Jeremia kũu thĩinĩ wa nyũmba ya Jehova.
english: Why have you prophesied in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in Yahweh’s house.

kikuyu: Andũ acio othe Ishumaeli aatahĩte kũu Mizipa nĩmahũndũkire, magĩthiĩ kũrĩ Johanani mũrũ wa Karea.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

kikuyu: Mehia mao marotũũra hĩndĩ ciothe marĩ mbere ya Jehova, nĩguo akaaniina kũririkanwo kwao gũkũ thĩ.
english: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

kikuyu: Jesũ akĩinamũka, akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Mũtumia ũyũ, agũthitangi marĩ ha? Hatirĩ o na ũmwe wao wagũtuĩra?”
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

kikuyu: “Rĩhĩria andũ a Isiraeli harĩ andũ a Midiani. Na thuutha ũcio nĩũgũcooka ũkue.”
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

kikuyu: Nao magĩkena na magĩtĩkĩra kũmũhe mbeeca.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

kikuyu: Ririkana ndungata ciaku Iburahĩmu, na Isaaka, na Isiraeli, arĩa wee wehĩtire kũrĩ o na mwĩhĩtwa ũkĩĩgwetaga, ũkiuga atĩrĩ: ‘Nĩngatũma njiaro ciaku cingĩhe ta njata cia matu-inĩ, na nĩngaahe njiaro ciaku bũrũri ũyũ wothe ũrĩa ndaamerĩire, naguo ũgaatuĩka igai rĩao nginya tene.’ ”
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring† as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’ ”

kikuyu: Nĩngwamba kũrũgamia mangʼũrĩ makwa nĩ ũndũ wa rĩĩtwa rĩakwa; na tondũ wa ũgooci wakwa ndigĩrĩirie mangʼũrĩ macio matigagũkore, nĩguo ndigakũniine biũ.
english: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.

kikuyu: O na ningĩ agĩtiga Obedi- Edomu na athiritũ ake mĩrongo ĩtandatũ na anana matungatage hamwe nao. Obedi-Edomu mũrũ wa Jeduthuni marĩ na Hosa maarĩ arangĩri a kĩhingo.
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

kikuyu: Ningĩ, Jehova ekuuga atĩrĩ: ‘Itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene no nginya rĩkaneanwo kũrĩ mbũtũ cia ita cia mũthamaki wa Babuloni, ũrĩa ũkaarĩtunyana.’ ”
english: Yahweh says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’ ”

kikuyu: Mũtikanainamĩrĩre ngai ciao, kana mũcihooe, kana mũrũmĩrĩre mĩtugo yao. No nginya mũcianange, nayo mĩhianano ya ngai ciao cia mahiga mũmiunange tũcunjĩ.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

kikuyu: nake akĩrĩkũnjũrĩra hau mbere yakwa. Narĩo rĩandĩkĩtwo ciugo cia macakaya mĩena yeerĩ, na cia kĩrĩro, o na cia kĩeha.
english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

kikuyu: Mũgongo wakwa ũiyũrĩtwo nĩ ruo ta rwa mwaki; ndirĩ na ũgima wa mwĩrĩ.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

kikuyu: Nĩmĩ ciao itariĩ ta mĩguĩ ya kũũragana; no ndeto cia maheeni ciaragia. O mũndũ aaragĩria ũrĩa ũngĩ ndeto cia thayũ na kanua gake, no ngoro-inĩ yake-rĩ, aikaraga amwambĩire mũtego.”
english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.

kikuyu: Mwĩkĩre kĩremba mũtwe, nako gatanji karĩa kaamũre ũgekĩre kĩremba-inĩ kĩu.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

kikuyu: Nake akĩoya twana tũu, agĩtũigĩrĩra moko, agĩtũrathima.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, tũcookerere! Rora ũrĩ igũrũ wone! Rũmbũiya mũthabibũ ũyũ,
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

kikuyu: Ayahudi makĩĩrana atĩrĩ, “Mũndũ ũyũ nĩ kũ arenda gũthiĩ, kũu tũtangĩhota kũmuona? Hihi egũthiĩ kũrĩa andũ aitũ matũũraga mahurunjũkĩte gatagatĩ ka Ayunani, akarute Ayunani ũhoro?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

kikuyu: Mũrũ wa Mũndũ nĩegũthiĩ o ta ũrĩa ũhoro wake wandĩkĩtwo. No mũndũ ũrĩa ũgũkunyanĩra Mũrũ wa Mũndũ kaĩ arĩ na haaro-ĩ! Nĩ kaba mũndũ ũcio atangĩaciarirwo.”
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Ningĩ Jehoshafatu magĩikara marĩ na thayũ na mũthamaki wa Isiraeli.
english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

kikuyu: Mīkorobia ya Hass būrūri-inī wa Kenya īcanūkaga mweri-inī wa ikūmi na matunda magakorwo marī makūrū gītagatī-inī kia mweri wa ītandatū nginya wa Kenda.
english: Hass avocado trees in Kenya flower in October and are ready for picking between June and September.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũrĩkũ ũngĩ ingĩekire mũgũnda ũcio wakwa wa mĩthabibũ gũkĩra ũguo ndawĩkire? Waciarire thabibũ cia gĩthaka nĩkĩ, o hĩndĩ ĩrĩa ndetereire ũciare thabibũ njega?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa rĩothe Solomoni aarĩ muoyo-rĩ, Juda na Isiraeli, kuuma Dani nginya Birishiba, maatũũraga na thayũ o mũndũ mũgũnda-inĩ wake wa mĩthabibũ na mĩkũyũ.§
english: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

kikuyu: Kũrĩ mũndũ ũrĩa mwĩhokeku ũrĩĩonanagia ũrĩ mwĩhokeku, na kũrĩ ũrĩa ũtarĩ ũcuuke ũrĩĩonanagia ndũrĩ ũcuuke,
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

kikuyu: Maithe ma ciana matikooragwo nĩ ũndũ wa mahĩtia ma ciana ciao, kana ciana ciũragwo nĩ ũndũ wa mahĩtia ma maithe; o mũndũ arĩkuaga nĩ ũndũ wa mehia make mwene.
english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

kikuyu: Nī kūrī, thirikari ya Kenya nī īrī honge irīa iteithagia ūkūria wa marigū na njīra cia, kūnyīhīa mathogora, kubūdithia arīmī na kūhe arīmī mbeca cia wonjoria
english: Yes, the Kenyan government offers various support programs, including subsidies, training, and access to credit for banana farmers.

kikuyu: Wee nĩwe waringire ciama o na ũkĩonania morirũ kũu bũrũri wa Misiri, na no wĩkaga ũguo nginya ũmũthĩ, gũkũ Isiraeli o na gatagatĩ-inĩ ka andũ arĩa angĩ othe, namo magatũma wĩgĩĩre igweta rĩrĩa rĩrĩ rĩaku.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;

kikuyu: hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩngatũma nyũmba ĩno ĩtuĩke ta Shilo, o narĩo itũũra rĩĩrĩ inene ndĩrĩtue rĩa kũgwetagwo ta kĩrumi nĩ andũ a ndũrĩrĩ ciothe cia thĩ.’ ”
english: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’ ”

kikuyu: Nī ngumo irīkū (cia magetha, ūritū na mūcamo) ikoragwo na maembe mūthemba wa kent?
english: What are the features (yields, average weight and flavor) of the Kent mango variety?

kikuyu: Karumbeta ga keerĩ kahuhwo na mũgambo mũnene, andũ a kambĩ cia mwena wa gũthini makoimagara. Mũgambo ũcio mũnene nĩguo kĩmenyithia gĩa kuumagara.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

kikuyu: Rīkoragwo na mbegū nene ya gīthiūrūrī.
english: It has a large, round seed

kikuyu: Na Judasi aarĩkia gũthiĩ, Jesũ akiuga atĩrĩ, “Rĩu Mũrũ wa Mũndũ nĩagoocithĩtio, nake Ngai nĩagoocithĩtio arĩ thĩinĩ wake.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

kikuyu: Rĩu-rĩ, nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmĩte wage kũhingia mwĩhĩtwa waku harĩ Jehova, na wathĩkĩre watho ũrĩa ndaakũheire?”
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa athingu marĩĩaga makahũũna, no nda ya mũndũ mwaganu ĩikaraga o ĩhũtiĩ. 14
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry. 14

kikuyu: Mũigana wa matukũ maitũ-rĩ, nĩ mĩaka mĩrongo mũgwanja, kana mĩrongo ĩnana, tũngĩkorwo tũrĩ na hinya; no rĩrĩ, mũigana wamo no thĩĩna na kĩeha, nĩgũkorwo mathiraga o narua, na ithuĩ tũgathiĩ, tũkabuĩria.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

kikuyu: Andũ acio matigacooka gũkua; nĩgũkorwo makahaana ta araika. Andũ acio magakorwo marĩ ciana cia Ngai, nĩgũkorwo nĩ ciana cia ũhoro ũcio wa kũriũka.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

kikuyu: Toonyai rwaro-inĩ rwa ihiga, mwĩhithe tĩĩri-inĩ mũũrĩre kĩmakania kĩa Jehova na riiri wa ũnene wake!
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

kikuyu: wĩigĩrĩre kahiũ mũmero ũngĩkorwo ũrĩ mũndũ mũkoroku.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

kikuyu: Kaĩ wonire atĩa, wee iria, nĩguo ũre, nawe Jorodani, tondũ wacookire na thuutha?
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

kikuyu: “Andũ eerĩ nĩmambatire hekarũ-inĩ kũhooya. Ũmwe aarĩ Mũfarisai na ũcio ũngĩ aarĩ mwĩtia wa mbeeca cia igooti.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo thĩinĩ wa Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega, ũthingu ũrĩa uumĩte kũrĩ Ngai nĩũguũrĩtio, na nĩguo ũthingu ũrĩa wonekaga na ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia kuuma o kĩambĩrĩria nginya kĩrĩkĩro, o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “Mũndũ ũrĩa mũthingu arĩtũũraga muoyo nĩ ũndũ wa gwĩtĩkia.”
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”*

kikuyu: Ĩno nĩ ndũmĩrĩri nditũ ĩkoniĩ Duma: Atĩrĩrĩ, nĩ harĩ mũndũ ũraanjĩta kuuma Seiru, akanjũũria atĩrĩ, “Mũrangĩri, ũtukũ ũkinyĩte ha? Mũrangĩri ũyũ, ũtukũ ũkinyĩte ha?”
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

kikuyu: Kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio kwanyu kũrĩĩkagĩrĩria na ngũĩ na njũgitano, na mũkahũũrana na ngundi ta andũ aaganu. Kwĩhinga kũrĩa irio kwanyu kwa matukũ maya gũtingĩtũma mĩgambo yanyu ĩiguo kũu igũrũ.
english: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

kikuyu: na rĩrĩ, nĩndarehe maciaro ma mbere ma tĩĩri ũrĩa, Wee Jehova, ũheete.” Nawe ũkĩige kĩondo kĩu mbere ya Jehova Ngai waku na ũinamĩrĩre mbere yake.
english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.

kikuyu: Nĩngakenaga ngĩmeeka wega, na ti-itherũ nĩngamahaanda gũkũ bũrũri ũyũ ngwatĩirie na ngoro yakwa yothe o na muoyo wakwa wothe.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

kikuyu: Nĩngarĩrehithĩria mũthiro, na ndũme thakame ĩtherere njĩra-inĩ ciarĩo. Arĩa oorage nĩmakaagũa thĩinĩ warĩo, naruo rũhiũ rwa njora rũrĩũkĩrĩre mĩena yothe. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, Mũrũ wa Mũndũ nĩ Mwathani o na wa mũthenya wa Thabatũ.”
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Ndarĩ haha; nĩariũkĩte! Ririkanai ũrĩa aamwĩrire hĩndĩ ĩrĩa aarĩ na inyuĩ Galili atĩ:
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

kikuyu: Kuona atĩ andũ akwa nĩmahehenjetwo-rĩ, o na niĩ ndĩmũhehenje; nĩndĩracaaya na nĩnyiitĩtwo nĩ kĩmako kĩnene.
english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.

kikuyu: Ngai akĩĩra Solomoni atĩrĩ, “Kuona atĩ ũndũ ũyũ nĩguo wendi wa ngoro yaku na ndũnahooya ũtonga, kana kũgĩa indo nyingĩ o na kana gĩtĩĩo, kana gĩkuũ gĩa thũ ciaku, na kuona atĩ ndũnahooya ũtũũre muoyo matukũ maingĩ, no wahooya ũũgĩ na ũmenyo wa gwathaga andũ akwa arĩa ngũtuĩte mũthamaki wao-rĩ,
english: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

kikuyu: Mūrimū wa mboga kūbutha ūtambagio nī mĩmera īngī ĩrĩa ĩrīna mūrimū ūcio, mbegū kana tĩri, kūhutio nī matata ma maaĩ, rūhuho, macini na maaī ma kūrīma.
english: The disease spreads through infected plants, seed or soil, splashing of water, wind, machinery and irrigation.

kikuyu: Niĩ ndĩ na ũira wake atĩ nĩarutaga wĩra na hinya, akenogia nĩ ũndũ wanyu, na nĩ ũndũ wa arĩa marĩ Laodikia na Hierapoli.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

kikuyu: Ndĩramwĩra ũguo nĩgeetha mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ ndakanamũheenie na ngarari cia mawara.
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

kikuyu: o ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “Mũndũ ũrĩa wonganĩtie nyingĩ, ndarĩ kĩndũ aatigĩirio; nake ũrĩa wonganirie nini, ndarĩ kĩndũ aagire.”
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”*

kikuyu: Ndundu ya werũ-inĩ na ndundu ĩrĩa ĩgambaga nĩikegwatĩra kũndũ kũu; nayo ndundu ĩrĩa nene na ihuru nĩkuo igaaka itara ciacio. Ngai nĩagathima Edomu na gĩthimi gĩa kĩrigiicano, na agũthime na kabirũ ka ihooru.
english: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

kikuyu: No mũthamaki wa bũrũri wa Misiri akĩmooria atĩrĩ, “Musa na Harũni, nĩ kĩĩ kĩratũma mũrute andũ wĩra-inĩ wao? Cookai wĩra-inĩ wanyu!”
english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Paũlũ na Baranaba marĩ kũu Ikonia, magĩtoonya thunagogi ya Ayahudi o ta mũtugo. Marĩ kũu makĩaria na ũhoti mũingĩ mũno o nginya Ayahudi aingĩ na andũ-a-Ndũrĩrĩ magĩĩtĩkia.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

kikuyu: Ihũa rĩu rĩraahooha, o rĩo ũthaka wa riiri wake, o rĩu rĩakĩtwo gĩtwe-inĩ gĩa kĩanda kĩrĩa kĩnoru, itũũra rĩu rĩkaahaana ta ngũyũ ĩĩruĩte mbere ya magetha, nayo mũndũ aamĩona amĩnyiitaga na guoko gwake, nake no kũmĩrĩa amĩrĩĩaga.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

kikuyu: Tĩĩaga Jehova na ũtonga waku, ningĩ ũmũtĩĩage na maciaro mothe ma mbere ma irio ciaku cia mĩgũnda;
english: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakahoroheria mũndũ ũcio wĩhĩtie atekwenda hau mbere ya Jehova na aarĩkia kũhoroherio, nĩakarekerwo.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Uzia aarĩ wa mĩaka ikũmi na ĩtandatũ rĩrĩa aatuĩkire mũthamaki, nake agĩthamaka arĩ Jerusalemu mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtano na ĩĩrĩ. Nyina eetagwo Jekolia, na oimĩte Jerusalemu.
english: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ngoretwo nĩ mathĩĩna na mĩnyamaro, no maathani maku nĩmo ngenagĩra.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kikuyu: Wagīrīire kūrigīrīria gūtherema na njīra ya kweherania ngūkū iria ndwaru, gūthambia na dawa ya kūūraga njamuthi indo cia kūnyūīra, kūrīīra na nyūmba o mūthenya.
english: Prevent further spread by isolating the sick birds, clean and disinfect drinkers, feeders and chicken house daily.

kikuyu: Nĩamwarĩirie na ũhooreri, na akĩmũhe gĩtĩ gĩa kũmũtũgĩria gũkĩra athamaki acio angĩ maarĩ nao kũu Babuloni.
english: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

kikuyu: Mahihagĩra ndamaiyũ mĩtaro-inĩ; nĩo makinyangaga ihihĩro cia ndibei o magĩkuaga nĩ nyoota.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

kikuyu: Mũngĩoya ũyũ ũngĩ nake akoone mũtino-rĩ, mwatũma mbuĩ ici ciakwa ithiĩ mbĩrĩra na kĩeha.’
english: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’†

kikuyu: Makĩongerera ũthamaki wa Juda hinya na makĩnyiitĩrĩra Rehoboamu mũrũ wa Solomoni handũ ha mĩaka ĩtatũ, na ihinda rĩu nĩmathiiaga na mĩthiĩre ya Daudi na ya Solomoni.
english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

kikuyu: Othe nĩmacookete na thuutha, othe marĩ hamwe nĩmatuĩkĩte amaramari; gũtirĩ o na ũmwe wĩkaga wega, gũtirĩ o na ũmwe.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Nĩnjiguĩte ndũmĩrĩri kuuma kũrĩ Jehova: Atĩ nĩatũmire mũrekio athiĩ kũrĩ ndũrĩrĩ, agaciĩre atĩrĩ, “Ũnganai mũrĩtharĩkĩre! Arahũkai mũkarũe mbaara!”
english: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”

kikuyu: Na aarĩkia kũmĩona, akamĩigĩrĩra ciande ciake akenete,
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

kikuyu: nĩguo ũhote kũnyiita thĩ na mĩthia yaguo, nao arĩa aaganu maribaribwo moime kuo?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

kikuyu: na rĩrĩ, mĩigua yamerete kũndũ guothe, na mũgũnda ũkaiyũra riya, naruo rũthingo rwa mahiga rũkamomoka.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo hatĩka ndĩkunũkaga kuuma thĩ, kana thĩĩna ũkamera tĩĩri-inĩ.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

kikuyu: Ūkīhuhīra rita rīa keerī, huhīra mbura ya kīmera ītanaringa na ūcokere maita mangī merī o thutha wa wiki ithatū.
english: Start the 2nd round of sprays before the onset of long rains and do 2 more at 3 weeks interval.

kikuyu: Mũrũ wakwa, ngoro yaku ĩngĩgĩa na ũũgĩ-rĩ, hĩndĩ ĩyo ngoro yakwa no ĩkene;
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

kikuyu: ndũmĩrĩri ya mũndũ ũrĩa ũiguaga ciugo cia Ngai, ũrĩa ũrĩ na ũmenyo uumĩte kũrĩ Ũrĩa-ũrĩ-Igũrũ-Mũno, ũrĩa wonaga kĩoneki kuuma kũrĩ Mwene-Hinya-Wothe, ũrĩa ũgũũaga agakoma thĩ, namo maitho make makahingũka, ekuuga ũũ:
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: Inyuĩ mũrĩ aira a maũndũ macio.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

kikuyu: inyuĩ irĩma, na tũrĩma tuothe, na mĩtĩ ya matunda, na mĩtarakwa yothe,
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũũru arongooragia o ũremi; nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩagatũmĩrwo mũnene ũtarĩ tha amũũkĩrĩre.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

kikuyu: Jehova ndarĩĩkanĩire kĩrĩkanĩro gĩkĩ na maithe maitũ oiki, no nĩarĩĩkanĩire na ithuĩ, ithuothe arĩa tũrĩ muoyo ũmũthĩ.
english: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

kikuyu: Andũ othe nĩmakamũmena nĩ ũndũ wakwa.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Angĩkorwo ndan- gĩhota kũruta gatũrũme, nĩakaruta ndirahũgĩ igĩrĩ kana tũtutuura twĩrĩ, kamwe ka iruta rĩa njino na karĩa kangĩ ka iruta rĩa kũhoroherio mehia. Ũguo nĩguo mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai akaamũhoroheria, nake mũndũ-wa-nja ũcio nĩagathera.’ ”
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’ ”

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio agĩĩta mũrori ũcio wa indo, akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Ũhoro ũcio ndĩraigua ũgũkoniĩ nĩ ũrĩkũ? Heana ũhoro wa ithabu rĩa ũrũgamĩrĩri waku, tondũ ndũgũcooka kũndorera indo ciakwa rĩngĩ.’
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Jusufu na ariũ a ithe othe, na rũciaro rũu ruothe rwa ihinda rĩu magĩkua,
english: Joseph died, as did all his brothers, and all that generation.

kikuyu: no rĩrĩa maatoonyire, matiigana gũkora mwĩrĩ wa Mwathani Jesũ.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, arutwo amwe ake nĩmaragia ũhoro wa hekarũ, ũrĩa yagemetio na mahiga mathaka na iheo iria ciarutĩirwo Ngai. No Jesũ akiuga atĩrĩ,

english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

kikuyu: Ningĩ-rĩ, ũngĩkorwo ũkĩgooca Ngai na roho waku tu-rĩ, mũndũ wa arĩa marĩ gatagatĩ kanyu ũtarataũkĩrwo, angĩkiuga “Ameni” atĩa mahooya-inĩ maku ma gũcookia ngaatho, kuona atĩ ndaramenya ũrĩa ũroiga?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

kikuyu: no rĩu ndĩ na gĩkeno, ti tondũ nĩmwaiguithirio kĩeha, no nĩ tondũ kĩeha kĩanyu nĩgĩatũmire mũhere. Nĩgũkorwo mwagĩire na kĩeha o ta ũrĩa Ngai endaga, na nĩ ũndũ ũcio ithuĩ tũtirĩ ũndũ mũũru o na ũmwe twamwĩkire.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

kikuyu: Mwena wa ithũĩro wa nja ĩyo warĩ wa mĩkono mĩrongo ĩtano§ kwarama na warĩ na itambaya cia gũcuurio, na itugĩ ikũmi na itina ikũmi na warĩ na tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa twa betha twĩkĩrĩtwo itugĩ-inĩ.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: “Rĩrĩa Musa aakinyirie mĩaka mĩrongo ĩna-rĩ, agĩtua itua rĩa gũceerera andũ ao a Isiraeli.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers,† the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Magĩthondeka gatanji kaamũre ga thahabu therie, na igũrũ rĩako magĩkurura, o ta ũrĩa mũhũũri ũkururagwo, ciugo ici: MŨTHERU MWAMŨRĨRE JEHOVA.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

kikuyu: Igathiī kīoro kīhūthū kīna thakame kana ona mīnyoo
english: Wet droppings with blood or worms

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩĩra Ayahudi arĩa maamwĩtĩkĩtie atĩrĩ, “Mũngĩrũmia ũrutani wakwa-rĩ, mũrĩ arutwo akwa kũna.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

kikuyu: “ ‘Thuutha wa ũguo nĩngacooka, na njake rĩngĩ hema ya Daudi ĩrĩa ĩgwĩte. Nĩngaka iganjo rĩayo rĩngĩ, na ndĩmĩcookie harĩa yarĩ,
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

kikuyu: Nowe Jesũ akĩnyiita mwana ũcio guoko, akiuga atĩrĩ, “Mwana wakwa, ũkĩra!”
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

kikuyu: No mũici ũcio angĩaga kũnyiitwo, mwene nyũmba no nginya athiĩ mbere ya aciirithania nĩguo kũmenyeke kana nĩwe ũiyĩte indo icio cia mũndũ ũcio ũngĩ.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

kikuyu: Nĩndĩrĩririkanaga matukũ marĩa ma tene; ndĩrĩcũũranagia mawĩko maku mothe na ngatarania maũndũ marĩa moko maku meekĩte.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Nake akĩmeera atĩrĩ: “Ti ũhoro wanyu kũmenya ciathĩ o na kana mahinda marĩa Ithe witũ atuĩte na ũhoti wake mwene.
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

kikuyu: Nĩakaiguagĩra tha arĩa matarĩ hinya na arĩa abatari, na ahonokie arĩa athĩĩni kuuma kũrĩ gĩkuũ.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

kikuyu: No Jeremia akĩmacookeria atĩrĩ, “Ĩrai Zedekia atĩrĩ,
english: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:

kikuyu: “ ‘ “No rĩrĩ, rũrĩrĩ o ruothe kana ũthamaki o wothe arĩa makaaga gũtungatĩra Nebukadinezaru mũthamaki wa Babuloni, kana marege kũinamia ngingo mekĩrwo icooki rĩake, nĩngaherithia rũrĩrĩ rũu na rũhiũ rwa njora, na ngʼaragu, na mũthiro, nginya rĩrĩa ngarũniinithia na guoko gwake, ũguo nĩguo Jehova ekuuga.
english: “ ‘ “ ‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says Yahweh, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

kikuyu: Ũroaga gwĩka ũndũ ta ũcio, wa kũũraganĩria arĩa athingu hamwe na arĩa aaganu, arĩa athingu na arĩa aaganu ũmataranĩrie ũndũ ũmwe. Ũroaga gwĩka ũndũ ta ũcio! Mũtuanĩri ciira wa thĩ yothe-rĩ, githĩ ndagĩrĩirwo nĩ gwĩka ũrĩa kwagĩrĩire?”
english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

kikuyu: Nĩwe warĩ mũthamaki wa Jeshuruni, rĩrĩa atongoria a andũ moonganĩte, marĩ hamwe na mĩhĩrĩga ya Isiraeli.
english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

kikuyu: Baasha ooragire Nadabu mwaka wa gatatũ wa Asa mũthamaki wa Juda na agĩtuĩka mũthamaki ithenya rĩake.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

kikuyu: ngamĩĩra mĩrongo ĩtatũ cia mĩgoma na njaũ ciacio, ngʼombe mĩrongo ĩna na ndegwa ikũmi, na ndigiri mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ cia mĩgoma na ikũmi cia njamba.
english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

kikuyu: Andũ othe nĩmaheetwo iheo cia kũhonania? Andũ othe nĩmakĩaragia na thiomi? Andũ othe nĩmagĩtaũraga thiomi?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

kikuyu: Inyuĩ-rĩ, geragiai gũikarania na mũndũ o wothe na thayũ kũngĩhoteka.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

kikuyu: Mathitangĩre o ngero thuutha wa ĩrĩa ĩngĩ; ndũkanareke magatoonya ũhonokanio-inĩ waku.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

kikuyu: Andũ othe nĩmakaigua ũhoro ũcio nao metigĩre, na matigacooka gũkorwo marĩ na kĩnyararo rĩngĩ.
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

kikuyu: Nao arĩa maiguire ũhoro ũcio makĩũria atĩrĩ, “Nũũ ũngĩkĩhota kũhonoka?”
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Andũ a Sidoni‡ na Arivadi nĩo maatwarithagia marikabu ciaku; nao andũ aku arĩa oogĩ, wee Turo, nĩo maarutaga wĩra marikabu-inĩ.
english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũthingu atũũraga mũtũũrĩre ũtarĩ ũcuuke; kũrathimwo-rĩ, nĩ ciana ciake iria atigaga.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

kikuyu: Na hĩndĩ ĩrĩa moimagaraga-rĩ, magĩcemania na mũndũ woimĩte Kurene, wetagwo Simoni, nacio thigari cikĩmũkuuithia mũtharaba ũcio na hinya.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

kikuyu: Rakeli akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Biliha ndungata yakwa ya mũirĩtu ĩrĩ haha; koma nayo nĩgeetha ĩnjiarĩre ciana, na niĩ ngĩe na nyũmba na ũndũ wayo.”*
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

kikuyu: Waitĩrĩirio maguta ũtuĩke ta kerubi mũgitanĩri, na nĩkĩo ndaakwamũrire. Wee warĩ kĩrĩma-igũrũ kĩrĩa gĩtheru kĩa Ngai; waceeragĩra mahiga-inĩ ma mwaki.
english: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.

kikuyu: Ndeto cia andũ arĩa aaganu nĩ cia kuohia andũ mamaite thakame, no mĩario ya andũ arĩa arũngĩrĩru nĩĩmahonokagia.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

kikuyu: We ndarĩĩaga irio iria irutagĩrwo mahooero-inĩ marĩa marĩ irĩma igũrũ, kana agatiirĩra maitho mĩhianano ya andũ a nyũmba ya Isiraeli. We ndathaahagia mũtumia wa mũndũ ũrĩa ũngĩ, kana agakoma na mũndũ-wa-nja rĩrĩa arĩ na ihinda rĩa mweri.
english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,

kikuyu: Ngai arĩ kũu thĩinĩ wa itũũra rĩu, na rĩtikenyenyeka; Ngai nĩwe ũkaarĩteithia kĩrooko gũgĩkĩa.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa marĩ igweta maratũma ndungata ciao igatahe maaĩ; irathiĩ marima-inĩ ikaaga maaĩ. Iracooka na ndigithũ itarĩ kĩndũ; ikehumbĩra mĩtwe iconokete na ikuĩte ngoro.
english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

kikuyu: Mũtumia-mũthamaki ũrĩa wa mwena wa Gũthini nĩakarũgama hĩndĩ ya ciira hamwe na andũ a rũciaro rũrũ arũtuĩre ciira, nĩgũkorwo oimire ituri cia thĩ oke athikĩrĩrie ũũgĩ wa Solomoni, na rĩu ũmwe mũnene gũkĩra Solomoni arĩ haha.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩndetigĩrire, ngĩthiĩ ngĩhitha taranda yaku thĩ. Atĩrĩrĩ, ĩno no ĩrĩa yaku ndagũcookeria.’
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

kikuyu: na Jeuzu, na Shakia, na Mirima. Acio nĩo maarĩ ariũ ake, na maarĩ atongoria a nyũmba ciao.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

kikuyu: mũthenya wee ndũngĩringĩka nĩ riũa, kana ũringĩke nĩ mweri ũtukũ.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

kikuyu: Nĩyo nyamũ ya mbere harĩ ciũmbe cia Mũrungu, no rĩrĩ, Mũũmbi wayo nowe ũngĩmĩkuhĩrĩria na rũhiũ rwake rwa njora.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

kikuyu: Nao othe magaacookia, makwĩre atĩrĩ, “O nawe nĩwagĩte hinya o ta ithuĩ; ũhaanĩte o ta ithuĩ.”
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

kikuyu: Nake akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Reke hakorwo harĩ na kĩrĩĩko giitũ nawe, o ta ũrĩa haarĩ kĩrĩĩko gatagatĩ ka baba na thoguo. Ta kĩone, kĩheo kĩa betha na thahabu nĩkĩo ndagũtũmĩra. Rĩu tharia kĩrĩĩko kĩanyu na Baasha mũthamaki wa Isiraeli nĩguo atigane na niĩ.”
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

kikuyu: Matu mooiririe mbura, nacio ngwa ikĩruruma igũrũ guothe; heni ciahenũkire ikĩrathũka mĩena yothe
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

kikuyu: Kũrĩa guothe ndaanathiĩ na andũ a Isiraeli othe- rĩ, ndĩ ndooria mũtongoria o na ũmwe wa arĩa ndaathire marĩithagie andũ akwa atĩrĩ, “Mwagĩte kũnjakĩra nyũmba ya mĩtarakwa nĩkĩ?” ’
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’ ” ’

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, kaĩ thũ ciakwa nĩ nyingĩ-ĩ! Andũ arĩa manjũkĩrĩire nĩ aingĩ mũno!
english: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Nĩwathiire kũrĩ Moleku ũrĩ na maguta ma mũtĩ wa mũtamaiyũ, na ũkĩongerera maguta maku marĩa manungaga wega. Nĩwatũmire abarũthi aku mathiĩ kũndũ kũraya mũno; ningĩ ũgĩikũrũka o nginya mbĩrĩra-inĩ!
english: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.†

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio anene othe o na andũ arĩa maatoonyire kĩrĩkanĩro-inĩ kĩu, magĩtĩkĩra atĩ nĩmekũrekereria ngombo ciao cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja, na atĩ matigũcooka kũmaiga ũkombo-inĩ. Magĩgĩĩtĩkĩra ũhoro ũcio na makĩmarekereria.
english: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Sarai mũtumia wa Aburamu ndaamũciarĩire ciana. No nĩ aarĩ na mũirĩtu Mũmisiri wamũtungatagĩra wetagwo Hagari;
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

kikuyu: “Ĩra Harũni na ariũ ake matĩĩage maruta marĩa matheru marĩa andũ a Isiraeli maanyamũrĩire, nĩgeetha matikanathaahie rĩĩtwa rĩakwa itheru. Niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

kikuyu: Hihi ingīrūa na tūtambī mūthemba wa mealybugs atīa?
english: How to manage and control Mealybugs?

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jerusalemu nĩgũkoima matigari ma andũ, nakuo Kĩrĩma-inĩ gĩa Zayuni kuume gĩkundi kĩa arĩa mahonokete. Kĩyo kĩa Jehova Mwene-Hinya-Wothe nĩkĩo gĩkaahingia ũguo.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.’

kikuyu: Nĩakaruta nyamũ ĩyo ya iruta rĩa njino rũũa na amĩtinangie tũcunjĩ.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

kikuyu: Nake mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai nĩakamĩrehe kĩgongona-inĩ, amĩthiore ngingo ĩtinĩke mũtwe, amĩcinĩre kĩgongona igũrũ; nayo thakame yayo ĩitwo hau mwena-inĩ wa kĩgongona.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

kikuyu: Ningĩ Solomoni nĩathondekithirie indo ciothe iria ciarĩ thĩinĩ wa hekarũ ya Ngai: aathondekire kĩgongona gĩa thahabu; na metha cia mĩgate ĩrĩa yaigagwo mbere ya Jehova;
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

kikuyu: Na maarĩkia kũina rwĩmbo, makiumagara magĩthiĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Nĩagaathana thingo ciothe ikũrũrwo mwena wa na thĩinĩ, namo makũrũro macio mateo kĩara-inĩ na kũu nja ya itũũra.
english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũkaagĩa kĩrĩĩko na mũndũ-wa-nja gĩa kũmũhikia, no mũndũ ũngĩ nĩakamuoya akome nake. Nĩũgaka nyũmba no ndũkamĩtũũra. Nĩũkahaanda mũgũnda wa mĩthabibũ no ndũkambĩrĩria gũkenera maciaro mayo.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

kikuyu: “Maũndũ maya mothe ndamwarĩria tũrĩ o na inyuĩ.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

kikuyu: nĩgũkorwo nĩwe wĩkagĩra mĩgĩĩko ya ihingo ciaku hinya, na akarathima andũ aku arĩa marĩ thĩinĩ waku.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩrĩa andũ a Juda maakinyire harĩa hangʼethanĩire na werũ-rĩ, magĩcũthĩrĩria mbũtũ ĩyo nene ya ita, makĩona no ciimba theri ciagwĩte thĩ; gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe wetharĩte.
english: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

kikuyu: No ithuĩ tũkĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, ‘Ithuĩ tũrĩ andũ ehokeku; tũtirĩ athigaani.
english: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

kikuyu: Akĩinamĩrĩra, na akĩrora thĩinĩ, akĩona mataama ma gatani marĩ maige thĩ, no ndaatoonyire.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

kikuyu: “Nĩ niĩ Jehova Ngai waku, ũrĩa wakũrutire bũrũri wa Misiri, kuuma bũrũri wa ũkombo.
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: Maūndū maya no mateithie gūcokereria gūkūra kwa mūembe:
english: Here are some steps you can take to help restore its growth:

kikuyu: Mendaga ihinda rīa mīeri ītatū ya riūa, gūgīcoka kuura.
english: It needs a prolonged dry period of about three months, followed by rain.

kikuyu: Korwo mũndũ ũyũ ndoimĩte kũrĩ Ngai ndarĩ ũndũ angĩhota gwĩka.”
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

kikuyu: Tondũ ũcio, o na kũngĩtuĩka nĩ niĩ kana nĩ o-rĩ, ũhoro ũyũ noguo tũhunjagia, na noguo inyuĩ mwetĩkirie.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

kikuyu: “Gũtirĩ ndungata ĩngĩhota gũtungatĩra aathani eerĩ. Nĩ ũndũ no ĩthũũrire ũmwe yende ũcio ũngĩ, kana ĩĩheane harĩ ũmwe, ĩnyarare ũcio ũngĩ. Mũtingĩtungatĩra Ngai na mũtungatĩre mbeeca.”
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”§

english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

kikuyu: Arĩa anogu ndwamaheire maaĩ, na nĩwaimire arĩa ahũtu irio,

english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

Aahaandire mũthingi wakuo na thogora wa gũkuĩrwo nĩ mũriũ wake wa irigithathi Abiramu, nacio ihingo ciakuo agĩciaka na thogora wa gũkuĩrwo nĩ mũriũ wake Segubu ũrĩa warĩ mũnini, kũringana na kiugo kĩa Jehova kĩrĩa kĩarĩtio nĩ Joshua mũrũ wa Nuni.
english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

english: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, Yahweh has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

kikuyu: “Na rĩrĩ, kamwana gaka kangĩaga gũthiĩ na niĩ tũgacooka kũrĩ ndungata yaku ũcio baba, o baba ũcio muoyo wake wohanĩtio na muoyo wa kamwana gaka-rĩ,
english: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

kikuyu: kuuma mũhĩrĩga wa Zebuluni, nĩ Eliabu mũrũ wa Heloni;

english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

kikuyu: O rĩngĩ Iburahĩmu akĩinamĩrĩra mbere ya andũ acio ene bũrũri,
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

kikuyu: Mũthenya ũkinyagĩria mũthenya ũrĩa ũngĩ ũhoro; naguo ũtukũ ũkamenyithia ũtukũ ũrĩa ũngĩ ũhoro wa riiri ũcio.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ o ĩyo ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ magĩtũma Paũlũ athiĩ ndwere-inĩ cia iria, no Sila na Timotheo magĩtigwo kũu Berea.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
